bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyu yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes byab bzhugs so//sgra la shin tu mkhas par gyur te pa ṇi byā ka ra ṇa zhes pa sgra'i bstan bcos spro ka nyis stong yod pa zhig mdzad/ de la klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bus ma hā snye sha zhes 'grel pa 〈sna ka 'bum yod pa zhig mdzad/ de gnyis yul dbus su dar bar 'gyur/ ka tsan gnyis zhes grags pa ni/ rgyal po bde spyod bzang po'i shad po shwa ra 'a zhes pas gzhen nu na rti ka bsgrubs pas zhag bdun nas gzhen nu smin drug me bya la zhon pa mthong nas ci 'dod zer ba na sgra shes par 'tshal lo zhes zhus pas/ kun bshad rkang pa bzhi'i bar bstan pa na sgra la shin tu mkhasapar gyur te 'tshal lo zhes smras pas/ me bya'i bzhen pa gyen du bskyod nas mjug sgro khra bun gyis mthong ba na ka lā pa bzod par gsol lo zhes smras te yi ger bkod pa ni ka wā pa yin la/ de la du rga seng lhas 'grel pa dur seng mdzad/bram ze grags 'byor gyis 'grel pa slob ma la phan pa mdzad/ de sogs 'grel pa mang du byung ste yul dbus su shin tu dar bar gyur/ tsan+d+ra pa ni slob ma zhig 'dul ba'i don du slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa yin la/ de la rang gi zhang po dharmā dwa dzis 'grel pa stong phrag drug pa dang / seng ge bzang pos 'grel pa su brgya dang / nyi ma'i snying po'i 'grel pa grub pa sogs mang du 'byung zhid yul dbus su shin tu dar bar gyur ba yin/ sgra rig pa'i bye brag rig pa'i gnas chung bzhi ni/ mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs/ sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ snyan dngags shes na tshig rgyan la mi rmongs/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs zhes pa bzhi yin la/ de yang mngon brjod ni chos re re la ming gi rnam grangs du ma yod par ston pa ste/ slob dpon a ma ra 99

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()ko dzis 'chi med mdzod ces pa'i bstan bcos mdzad cing / de la su bhu ti tsan+d+rasa'agrel pa 'dod 'jo zhes pa mdzad pa sogs dang / sdeb sbyor ni drang thong ser skyas byas pa'i rtsa ba'i mdo dang / de'i dper brjod rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad pa dang / khyad par du 'phags pa sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rang 'grel dang bcas pa slob dpon shārnyi pas mdzad pa sogs kyis ston pa yin la/ snyan ngag ni slob dpon dwaṇ+ḍi 'am dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa me long gi bstan bcos nyid dang / dper brjod ni shar pa'i lam la dpag bsam 'khri shing dang / lho pa'i lam la dpa' bo'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa sogs kyis ston pa yin zhing / zlos gar ni/ slob dpon dga' ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dang / slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar sogs kyis ston pa yin no/ /'o na rig pa'i gnas chung ngu 'di dag phyi nang thun mong ba yin pas bslabs kyang sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur ram snyam na shin tu'ang 'gyur te/ mgon po byams pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma sbyang ba(na/ /zhes sogs dang / mdo drin lan bsabs pa las/de bas na bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir rig pa'i dngos po lnga la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes dang / mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /che'i na sogs(mtha' yas pa gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ de bas na dge slong gi thos pa ngan pa snyan ngag sdeb par mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / snyan dngags gtso bor byed pa rnams lha yul gyi bya gzhan la tshigs bcad kyi bskul zhing rang bag med du stod par skye bar 100

bsngan pa dang bsnan 'dzin gyi lo rgyu yong 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhe na mi 'gal rte/ de ni 'dod pa'i gtam gyi snyan ngag mi bya ba la dgongs pa'i phyir te/ mdo sde nyid las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la bstod pa dang bstan pa gsal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir snyan ngag bya'o/ /de las bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / mdo sde bskal bzang las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni/ /snyan ngag mkhan tshe bde gshegs rtswa mchog la/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang / /dang po byang chub tu ni sems bskyed do/ /zhesapa dang / 'dul ba lung las/sangs rgyas skar rgyal la ni ngas//de tshe tshigs bcad gcig bstod pas/ /bskal pa dgu ni phyir bsnyil to/ /zhes dang / me long las/ de ltar skyon bral skal bzang ldan pa yis/ /snyan ngag bzang pos dkon mchog rnam gsum gyi/ /yon tan tshul bzhin rab tu bsngags byas na/ /grags dang 'byor dang rgyal mchog thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ der ma zad snyan ngag gi rtsom nga kho nas yi dam gyi la 'grub cing zhal mthong ba yang yod de/ me long las/thos dang 'bad pa dag gi ngag bstan nas/ /ci zhig ltar na nges par rjes 'dzin byed/ /ces dang / mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ sdeb stor gyi gtsug lag dang mthun par rtsom shes na/ rtsom pa kho nas lhag pa'i la'i zhal mthong bar 'gyur ba yang yod do/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon zla ba grags pas/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi ser 'phreng gis bsus ba na/ tsan+d+ra go mis rang gi mdun du 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku zhig shing rta'i 'khor los 'dren du bcug de la snyan ngag gi bstod pa mdzad cing phebs pa na sku gzugs des 10/

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i cho 'byung gces bsdus/()mjing pa yon mdzad nas gsan te/ nga la de 'dra'i yon tan rang 'dug gam zhes gsung byon zhing / de la 'jam dbyangs mjing yon du grags pa'i gtam rgyud tshad ma rlung ltar grags/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi rgyal po'i chad pas yan lag lcags sgrog gis bcings te chu bo gaṅgā la bskyur ba'i tshe slob dpon gyi sgrol ma la snyan ngag gi sgo nas bstod pas/ sgrol mas gsan cing chu bo'i dbus su gling sprul pa la tsan+t+ra'i gling du grags pa'i gtam rgyud tshad ma yang yod pa'i phyir/ don 'di la dgongs nas slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs kyi bstod par/ tsan+d+ra go mi 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen mchog /rgyal po'i chad pas gaṅgā'i chu la bskyur/ /gus ldan zhe sar bcas pa'i sdeb sbyor gyis/ /'dzum zhal dga' mas sing ga'i gling la bzhag /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzo rig pa la rnam par ma gyur pa sems kyi bzo ni sems bzang ngan gyi dbang las 'khor 'das kyi bde sdug 'grub pa lta bu dang / brjod pa sgra'i bzo ni sgra dang snyan ngag dang dbyangs la sogs ngag gi 'gyur ba la bya dgos shing / rnam par gyur pa dbyibs kyi bzo ni byed pa po dang ma 'brel ba ni 'jig rten chags pa sogs yin la/ byed pa po dang 'brel ba ni rig pa'i gnas lnga'i nang tshan gyi bzo lta bu la 'jog pa yin/ de'i gtso bo yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa nyid yin la/ de'i yang thog mar byung ba ni ri mo'i gzugs dag yin te/sngon rgyal po 'jigs thul gyis rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs pas mi rnams tshe lo 'bum du 'phel zhing shin tu bde zhing skyid par gyur pa'i tshe/ bram ze zhig gi bu gzhon nu gces pa zhig glo bur du shi bas/ bram zes rgyal po la khyod kyi 102

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyus yongs 'du'i me rtag gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//rgyal srid chos bzhin du ma bskyangs pa 'dra ste/ khyod kyi 'bangs la dus min gyi 'chi ba byung nas bdag gi bu 'phrogs so/ /bu slar ma btsal na bdag 'di khar lceb bo zhes smras pas/ rgyal pos bram ze khrid de gshin rje'i rgyal po nyi ma ltar 'bar ba'i drung du phyin te/ bram ze'i bu bstsal du gsol zhes zhus pas/ gshin rje'i rgyal pos ngas ma lan/ rang rang gi las su zad do zhes smras pa na/ rgyal po khros te/ gshin rje'i rgyal po dang g.yul 'thab pa na 'jig rten thams cad dngangs par gyur pa'i tshe/ tshangs pa byon nas gshin rjes ma nyes/ so so'i lasasu zad do/ /'on kyang bram ze'i bu ri mor bris shig ces bsgo ba ltar bris pas tshangs pas gsol te bram ze la gtad/ slar rgyal pos tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du byon te ri mo 'bri tshul zhus pas/ ri yi mchog ni ri rab yin/ /sgo nga las skyes rnams kyi ni/ /gtso bo nam mkha' lding yin no/ /mi yi gtso bo sa bdag ste/ /de bzhin ri mo sgyu rtsal gtso/ /zhes dang / rgyal po de bzhin sku rtsal kun/ /ri mo'i las la yang dag bstan/ /zhes bzo'i bsngags pa brjod nas bi shwa rkarmas ston par lung bstan cing / des 'khor los bsgyur ba'i tshad gtso bor byas te/ tshad dang mi ldan pa'i nyes pa/ ldan pa'i phan yon sogs bstan cing / lus la mdzes pa ma tshang na/ /tshad dag gis sna ci zhig bya/ /zhes mdzes dgos par yang bstan pa sogs ri mo'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i tshad yig ces bya ba drang srong e tre'i bus sbyar ba las 'byung zhing / gzhan yang dus kyi 'khor lo dang / bde mchog sdom 'byung sogs du ma las 'byung ba yin/ thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la yang sku'i rten ri mor bris pa thog mar byung ba yin te/ 'dul ba lung las/ de 103

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i dus su yul sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal po u tra ya na dang / yul dbus kyi rgyal po gzugs can snying po gnyis ma mthong ma 'phrad pa'i grogs po byas nas skyes bskur res byas pa na/ rgyal po u tra ya nas rin po che'i khrab rin gyi gzhal du med pa zhig bskur ba na ma gaṅgā zhi rgyal po gzugs can snying pos de'i skyes lan du 'os pa ma rnyed par sems shin tu zhus par gyur nas/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ri mor bris pa dang / bka' tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas pa bris la skur cig ces gsungs pa ltar bzo bo rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la blta zhing 'bri bar brtsam pa na/ sku nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'bar bas 'bri ma nus par bcom ldan 'das khrus kyi rdzing bu'i steng du bzhugs/ de'i gzugs brnyan rdzing bur shar ba ltar bris pa la thub pa chu lon mar grags pa de dang /rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs bzlog gi tshigs bcad/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshigs bcad dang / bslab pa'i gzhi lnga'i tshigs bcad dang / de dag gi phan yon dang bcas pa bris te gser gyi za ma tog tu bcug nas glang po che la bkal te bskur/ 'di 'jig rten gsum las 'das pa'i skyes yin pas rgyal po khyod dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas pas gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang me tog dang bdug spos la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang bcas te bsus/ go skabs yangs par seng ge'i khri'i steng du bzhugs su gsol te dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas zhal phye zhig ces pa'i spring yig dang bcas pa brdzangs/ sgra sgrogs kyi rgyal pos kyang de bzhin du byas te zhal phye 104

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyu yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhe bya ba bzhugs so//ba na/ tshong pa rnams kyi mgrin gcig tu sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod pa thos pas ba spu thams cad gyen du langs shing mchi ma rang dbang med par g.yos/ tshigs bcad rnams bklags pas skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du gyur te bden pa mthong bar bshad pa dang / yang ston pas chos gsungs pa'i tshe shākya'i ming can gyi chung mas mu tig gi do shal khyim du lus pa bran mo len du btang ba na bran mo'i bsams pa la 'di lta bu'i chos zab mo nyan pa'i dbang med par 'gro dgos pa shin tu skal pa dman snyam pa'i tshe/ ston pas de'i bsams pa mkhyen nas chos tshigs su bcad pa gcig bris te gnang ba 'don zhing phyin pa na lam du ba drus ma zhig gis brdungs te shi de ma thag sing rga gling gi rgyal po'i bu mor skyes/ skyes ma thag tu yul der mu tig gi char babs pas mu tig can nam mu tig gi 'khri shing can du btags/ de nas re zhig na yul dbus kyi tshong pa mang pos sing ga'i gling du phyin/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' tshigs su bcad pa 'ga' zhig ston pa dang bu mo'i yid 'phrogs te/bzang po'i glu de da dung longs shig zer ba na tshong pa rnams kyi 'di glu min sangs rgyas kyi bka' yin zhes bshad pa na bu mo mu tig can sangs rgyas kyi mtshan thos pa tsam gyis lus kyi ba spu langs/ mig mchi mas gang bzhin du sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ci 'dra zhig yod ces dris pa na/ tshong pa rnams kyi ci nusakyi yon tan brjod pas bu mo shin tu dad par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la / bdag 'khor ba'i gnas las drang du gsol zhes pa'i 'phrin yig phul ba ston pas bzhes te/ de'i lan du ras kyi ngos la 'od zer btang ba ltar rig 105

pa tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gce bsdus/()byed pa dag gis bris te bka'i tshigs bcad 'ga' dang bcas pa bskur ba mthong ba'i mod la bu mos bden pa mthong ste yul de'i mi kun bstan pa'i sgor btsud/ drin lan du dkon mchog gsum la mu tig mchog ma ga ṅgā'i bre re re phul/ sku de la thub pa 'od zer mar grags te sku gzugs kyi thog ma yin/'bur sku'i thog ma ni bcom ldan 'das ma gshegs pas dge 'dun gdugs tshod la spyan drangs pa'i tshe gral gyi dbus mi brjid par mthong nas khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis ston pa la bdag gis ston pa'i sku rin po che las grub pa zhig bzhengs nas dge 'dun gyi gral gyi thog mar bzhugs su gsol na rung ngam zhes zhus pa na/ ston pas gnang ste mgon med zas sbyin gyi glang po che mchog la zhen gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te dbul po'i srang la sogs pa grong khyer kun tu zhugs nas 'gro ba kun la dmigs pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa bzang pos de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi rgyu blangs te rgyal ba'i sku gzugs mang du bzhengs pa rnams yin/ gsung rten gyi thog mar ni / 'khor lo bar pa'i tshe brgya byin gyis gser gyi glegs bu la be+e ḍūr+ya'i zhun mas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo bris te lha'i gnas su mchod cing bkur sti byas par gsungs pa dang / rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan sogs gzungs mang po glegs bam du byas te rgyal mtshan gyi rtser btags pas lha ma yin gyi g.yul las rgyal bar gsungs pa dang / khyim bdag gor ta shi ba'i yo byad rnams dge 'dun la phul ba bzhes pa'i tshe ston pas rgyal ba'i bka'i glegs bam tshad du mi snang / mu stegs byed kyi gzhung tshad du snang bar gsungs 106

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzan spya lo rgyus yongs 'du' me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//pas bka' bsdu gsum pa'i sngon du yang rgyal ba'i bka' yi ger bris pa yod par bshad pa rnams yin la/de nas ston pas thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas gang la gang 'dul gyi gzugs kyis 'jig rten la phan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdzad pa yin par yang nges dgos te/mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/thabs mchog dag gis legs sgrub pa'i//chos phyir gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan/khyod kyi phrin las mngon bsam na//bsam mi khyab pa 'di ltar snang //chos kyi dbying kyi pho brang du//sangs rgyasarnams la chos skur snang //stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su//rgyal sras mchog la longs skur bstan//'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas su//'gro la sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed//skye ba'i sprul pa dga' ldan du//lha rnams gdul bar bya phyir bzhugs//mchog gi sprul pa sna tshogs pa//gdul dka' 'ga' zhig 'dul ba'i phyir//ri rab ri yi rtse mo sa/sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor za bo der//dbang bskur mdzad nas rnam par btul//bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'dul ba'i phyir//rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs kyis bskor//zhes dang /mi yi 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir//gzhon nu rol rtsed sna tshogs mdzad//dka' thub dga' ba sun dbyung phyir/khyod kyis lo drug dka' ba spyad//rgyal po zas gtsang sngon rabs kyis//mgu mdzad khams drug bshig nas btul//rgyal po chen po pi lin+da//'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyis brtsal//rgyal po u tra ya na ni/khyod sku ri mor brisapas btul//'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi cho 'phrul gyis//lha dang bcas pa'i bdud kyi sde//btul nas chos dbyings sgrol bar mdzad//rgyal po ma skyes dgra yi sdig/0

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()ras yug chen pos bsdams pas sbyangs/ /zhes dang / phyag na rdo rje stobs chen gyis/ /dbang phyug chen po bsad nas btul/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams bsdigasanas btul/ /lha mo nam gru bstod pas btul/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje dang / /rigs sngags sbyor ba'i cho ga dang / /ril bu sman gyi sbyor ba yis/ /sdug bsngal can rnams legs par gsos/ /zhes dang / mnyan yod la sogs gdul dka' ba/ /'dul phyir shā ri'i bu la sogs/ /nyan thos chen po mngags pa mdzad/ /rigs dad bya phyir 'char ka dang / /yul gzhan rgyal po 'dul ba'i phyir/ /'phags pa ka ta ya na sogs/ /gang la gang gis 'dul gyur pa/ /de 'dra'i tshul gyis thams cad btul/ /de lta'i phrin las bsam yas pa mthong dpa ༷sa par gyur na yang / /su zhig ngo mtshar skye mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyar ra/ga/so ba rig pa'i byung tshul la phyi rol mu stegs byed kyi lugs ni/ snyan tshig mchod sbyin/ srid srung / nges brjod de rig byed bzhi bslab pa brda' sprad do / / sdeb sbyor skar rtsis/ thos pa rtog pa ste yan lag drug dran pa dang chos te nye ba'i yan lag gnyis rnams tshangs pa'i zhal bzhi las byung bar 'chad do/ /rig byed kyi bstan bcos las/ gang phyir tshangs pa yi ni zhal/ /dbus ma nasani tshe'i rig byed/ /ces sogs bshad pa'i phyir/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs ni sngon lha chen po rnams kyis rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las bdud rtsi bum pa gang byung ba de bgo bar brtsams nas sgra gcan na gzhen pas lag bde bar bskos te bum pa gtad pas/ sgra gcan gyis bsams pa la 'di ni rnyed par dka' bas 108

ba na pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyus yong 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhe byab bzhugs so//rang gis 'thung nas bros pa legs snyam ste de bzhin byas pas/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha chen po rnams kyis phyi bzhin bsnyegs te khyab 'jug gi 'khor lo 'phangs pas sgra gcan gyi mgrin pa la phog ste mgrin pa bcad pa na kho khros te 'khor lo dam bca' bzhi ldan phyir 'phangs pa tshangs pa'i mkhur tshos la phog pa'i tshe tshangs pa tshe la dbang bas 'chi bar yang ma nus/ 'khor lo dam bca' dang ldan pas 'tsho ba yang ma nus pa'i skabs su/ sangs rgyas kyis byin rlabs kyis rang gi mkhur tshos las oṃ a tha zhes pa'i sgra byung ba na sngon sangs rgyas las gso dpyad 'bum pa thos pa dran te gso ba'i las la sbyar bas bde bar gyur pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje las byung ba yin zhes 'chad pa yin te/yan lag brgyad pa las/ sgra gcan bdud rtsi brkus pa la/ khyab 'jug gis ni rke bcad pas/ /zhes dang / tshangs pas tshe yi rig byed dran/ /zhes dang / yi ge oṃ dang a tha'i sgra/ /gnyis po 'di dag sngon tshangs pa'i/ /mkhur tshos rdol te mngon par byung / /des na 'di gnyis bkra shis yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/tshangs pas skye rgu'i bdag po la bshad/ des tha skar gyi bu gnyis la bshad/des brgya byin la bshad/ des lha'i drang srong rgyun shes sogs gtsug phud can bdun la bshad/ drang srong rgyun shes kyi rang gi bu drug la bshad/ de nas drang srong lug nag 'bar/ rgya skyegs sna la sogs pas gzhud mang du byas te lha yul du dar bar gyur/ mi yul du dar tshul ni sngon bcud chags nas ring po ma lon pa na gshed bu zhig sa zhag ma zhu bar na ste/ smre sngags 'don pa na tshangs pa 'ongs te chu bskol btang bas zhi ste/ nad pa la snga ba gshed bu/ sman pa la snga ba 109

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i cho 'gung gces bsdus/()tshangs pa/ sman la snga ba chu skol zhes grags/ 'o na gso ba rig pa la bshad bya'i bka' med dam zhe na/ sman dpyad kho na ston pa'i mdo rgyud med kyang 'dul ba lung sman gyi gzhi las/ dge slong nad pas sman pa la dris te bya'o/ /zhes dang / sman rnam pa bzhi bsten tshul gsungs pa rnams dang / gser 'od dam pa'i nad rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i le'u dang / gso dpyad 'bum pa dngan de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i mdo las dus ma yin par 'chi ba dgu yod pa khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa las ma thos sam/ de'i phyir sman dang sngags kyi sbyor ba rnams bstan to/ /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ de nas sems can kun phan phyir/ /thams cad snying por bsdus pa yin/ /sgrub pa'i sbyor ba bdud rtsi mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad par bya/ /ga pur dang ni gur gum dang / /zhes sogs dang / dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rlung 'joms lan tshwa skyur ba dag tu rab tu 'gyur te mngar dang bska ba dag ni mkhris pa'i dgra/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams yin te/ slob dpon zla dgas/sman gyi lung dang gser 'od dam pa dang / /gso dpyad 'bum pa la sogasabaka' yin te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / rin chen spungs par/rig gsum mgon pos gsungs pa'i rgyud la sogs pa yod par bshad/ bstan bcos ni slob dpon klu sgrub kyi sbyor ba brgya pa/ 'tsho ba'i mdo tshigs su bcad pa / rtsa a wa'i cho ga dngul chu rin chen phreng ba/ gser 'gyur sbyor ba rnamasamadzad/ bod snga ma kha cig reg pa rtsa'i mdo/ 'tsho ba zas kyi mdo/ phan pa sman gyi mdo/ gtar bsreg dpyad kyi mdo/ me mas bzo'i mdo ste mdo lnga/ bdud rtsi 110

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyu bong 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bsags so//snying po sogs dpyad gzhung bcu dang bcas pa mdzad zer yang / de dag la rgya gzhung gi mtshan nyid ci yang ma tshang pas klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa min par nges/slob dpon dpa' bos yan lag brgyad pa chen po/ yan lag brgyad pa la 'jug pa/ de'i snying po bsdus pa sogs mdzad/ khyad par snying po bsdus pa rtsom pa'i tshe/ sa gsum dge legs 'byung ba yis/ /dge ba'i ltas ni sna tshogs 'byung / /zhes bshad cing gzhung de la rang 'grel yang mdzad/ kha che zla dgas snying po bsdus pa'i 'grel pa zla zer dang / yan lag brgyad pa chung ba yang mdzad zer/ 'di slob dpon dpa' bo'i sras dang dngos slob tu 'dod pa yod kyang / dpal chen dge ba'i sras chag la mngon dga' yin zhing / de'i sras zla dga' yin la/ de nyid kha che'i sman pa don mchog gi dngos slob yin par bshad de/ zla zer nyid las/ bdag gi mes por gyur pa ni/ /dpal chen dge ba zhes grags yin/ /de ni da lta sa gsum na/ /grags pa dri med sgrogs par byed//de sras chag la mngon par dga'//de'i bu zla ba mngon dga' bdag/slob dpon blo gros chen po ni/ khyud shes don ldan ming btanas pa/ /don dam zhes pa sman pa'i mchog kha che'i yul du skyes pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/de la sogs pa 'phags pa'i yul du dar zhing rgyas par byung / des(na 'phags yul du chos kyi rgyal po tsan+d+ra bdun/ pā la bdun/ se na bzhi la sogs pa byung zhing de dag gi ring la mkhas pa dang grub pa'i slob dpon grangs med pa byon sdong / de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad pa yin 111

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()brgyad pa bstan pa de nyid gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir lo paṇa rnams kyis ji ltar bsgyur ba'i tshul ni/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od lung bstan pa'i mdo las/nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar lha tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi pho brang yum bu bla mkhar gyi steng du rin po che'i sgrom bu zhig babs pa kha phye ba na gser gyi mchod rten khru gang ba/ tsin+ta ma ṇi'i gzungs/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo/ dpang skong phyag brgya pa rnams byung / gang yin ngo ma mkhyen kyang yid du 'ong bas ming gnyan po gsang bar btags/ nam mkha' nas mi rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes pa 'byung ngo zhes lung ston pa'i sgra yang grags/ kha cig mnal lam du byung yang zer/ gang ltar de la phyag mchod byas pas rgyal srid dang mnga' thang cher rgyas/ rgyal po yang gzhon sha can du gyur te dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga'am nyi shu thub zer/ de yang chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten bye ba dang / glegs bam bye ba bzhengs/de'i rab gnas kyi skabs glegs bam 'ga' zhig rgyal mtshan gyi rtse la btags te mchod pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs dang / bod du bstan ba dar ba'i rten 'brel gyi dbang gis mthun pa'i rlung chen po g.yos te mkha' la bteg nas pho brang gi rtse la babs pa yin zhes kha cig zer/ gzhan dag ni nam mkha' las babs zer ba bon po nam mkha' la dga' bas bon gtam yin/ don la paṇ+ḍi ta blo sems 'tsho dang/ lo tsā ba li the ses de rnams khyer nas 'ongs pa rgyal po la phul bas yi ge yang mi shes/ don yang ma go bas lo paṇa gnyis phyir log 112

bstan pa dang bsnan 'dzan gyi lo rgyus yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i rdo shal zhes byab bzhugs so//dgos pa byung ba yin zer ro/ /gang ltar de la bstan pa dbu brnyes pa zer de nas mi rabs lnga na gnam ri srong btsan dang btsun mo 'bri za thod dkar gyi sras spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa srong btsan sgam po'am/ mtshan dngos khri lde srong btsan du grags pa byon/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la rgyal sar byon/ mtha'i rgyal phran thams cad dbang du bsdus/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa blon po mgar zhes grags pa des bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i sras mo khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa bal bza' khri btsun rgyal po kri sku'i thugs dam gyi rten shākya thub pa dgung le rdzobargyad pa'i sku tshad du kri kris bzhengs/ sangs rgya 'od srungs kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje/ gzhan yang byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/rang byon sgrol ma/ be+e ḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed gsol ba gang btab kyi 'bras bu dus su 'jo ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu sogs rten mang po dang bcas pa spyan drangs/slar rgya nag gi rgyal po'i sras mo sgrol ma'i sprul pa rgya bza' kong jo/ ston pas dgung lo zhe gcig bzhes pa'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum du dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i tshe / la'i dbang po brgya byin gyis sbyin bdag byas/ ston pa dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad bzo bo bi shwa da smos rgyu rin po che las bzhengs pa jo bo shākya mu ni sogs rten mang po dang / bzo dang rtsis kyi gtsug lag mang po spyan drangs/ shākya mu ni 'di thog mar lha yul dang u rgyan dang rgya gar rnams su yun ring du bzhugs/ de nas rgya gar gyi rgyal po dharmā pā la las/ rgya nag rgyal po pri ta bi dza ya la skyes su bskur te rgya nag tu lo lnga brgya bzhugs/ de nas bod du byon pa yin zhes grags so/ /gang ltar bal mo bzas kha'o thang gi 'tsho bsub te ra sa 113

brtse chen 'od snang las/4skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()'khrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bod kyi sa gzhi srin mo gan rkyal du 'gyel ba lta bu'i snying gar bzhedas/ rgya mo bzas ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de'i ring la rgyal pos sa dgra mnan pa'i ched du dpung pa g.yas la ka tshal/ g.yon la khra 'brug rkang pa g.yas la gtsang 'gram/ g.yon la grom pa rgyang ste ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang dang / gru mo g.yas la kong po bu chu/ g.yon la lho brag 'khon mthing / pus mo g.yas la ka brag g.yon la pra du ma tsi re re mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang dang / lag mthil g.yas la byang 'tshal rlung gnon/g.yon la khams kyi glang thang sgrol ma/ rkang mthil g.yas la mang yul byams pa sprin gyi lha khang / g.yon la mon bum theng steng yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi/ gzhan yang sa gnon gyi lha khang mchod rten sogs brgya rtsa brgyad sprul pas bzhengs/ bod la yi ge med pas thon mi a nu'i bu sa sto ṭa bod skad du bod legs zhes pa rgya gar du chos dang yi ge slob tu brdzangs/ des bram ze li byin la yi ge dang / paṇ+ḍita lha rig pa'i seng ge la sgra bslabs/ chos mang du gsan nas bod du byon pa'i tshe rgyal po dbu ru btsun mo tshal na rdo dkar po zhig la spyan ras gzigs kyi sku bzhengs pa dang mjal/ phyag dang zhe sa phul bas/ khyod kyi sgra dang yi ge shes khas ma gsungs/ shes lags zhu yis pas/ 'o na nga'i yi dam la bstod pa gyis gsungs/ lo tsā bas/ zhal ras gsal la ngang mdangs gang bsadakar/ /ga dmasang ga thar lam lags pas 'chad pa dang / /las ngan bag chags thams cad bsal mdzad pa/ /'phags pa ma pham yang dag dam pa lags/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod pa mdzad pas/ rgyal po shin tu mnyes te 114

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi po rgyu yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//zhabs spyi bor blangs/ sri zhu phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ rgyal po la sgra dang yi ge bslabs pas tshegs med par mkhyen pa'i tshul bstan te/ bod du chos dge ba bcu'i rgyal khrims btsugs/ lo tsā bas bod kyi skad dang bstun nas gsal byed sum cu/ dbyangs gug kyed bzhir bsdus/ dbyibs kha che'i yi ge la dpe byas te 7 sa'i sku mkhar ma rur yi ge bcos/ sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug sogs sgra'i bstan bcos brgyad brtsams/ mdo za ma tog bkod pa dang / pad+ma dkar po sogs bsgyur/ rgyal pos gdams ngag gnang nas yer par sgom grwa btsugs/lo drug cu rtsa dgu rgyal srid bskyangs/ brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa la yab yum rang byon lnga ldan gyi thugs dar thims/ de nas ring zhig na khri lde gtsug brtan nam mes ag tshom gyis lha sa'i brag dkar sogs gtsug lag khang 'ga' re bzhengs/ bran dka' mu la ko ṣa sogs kyis mdo sde las brgya pa dang gser 'od sogs bsgyur/ de'i sras ljang tsha lha dbon la/ rgya mo bza' gyim shang kong jo bod skad du mtsho'i pad+ma zhes pa spyan drangs/ de ma byon gang du ljang tsha gshegs pas yab dang 'dus/ rdzo bo shākya mu ni mun khang nas ra sa 'khrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje ra mo cher bzhugs su gsol/mchod pa rgya chen po btsugs/ de gnyis kyi sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa khri srong lde btsan gyi chung ngu'i dus su sba sang shi sogs mi bzhi rgya nag tu chos 'tshol du btang / rgya'i hwa shang mngon shes can dang mjal/ sgom pa'i lung nos/hwa shang de na re/ sang shi la ston pas gdong dmar gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lung bstan pa de khyod yin/ rgya gar gyi 115

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/() mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho zhes pa de bod kyi 'dul skal yin/ gzhan sus kyang bod la phan mi thogs zer/ de bzhis chos bam po stong tsam dang hwa shang gzhan zhig spyan drangs te 'ongs pa'i tshe me'i ag tshom 'das/ khri srong lde btsan na gzhen pas blon po rnams kyis chos khrims bshig chos byed pa byung na sprugs par byas/ lha shākya mu yi rgya yul du skyel bar brtsams pas mi sum brgyas ma theg par bye thems su sbas pas sba gnam khri thog rje thang la 'bar bya ba rgyab gas nas shicog gru rkyen rgyal 'gong bya bas sbam nas shi bas lha bye 'og tu bcug pas lan zer nas bton/ dre'u gnyis kyis bteg nas mang yul skyid grong du bskyal te lo bcu gsum bzhugs/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje shar phyogs ra mo'i thang la bskyal nas zhag bdun lus/ de nas ra mo cher bzhugs su gsol/ de'i tshe sang shi sogs kyi chos rnams mi mngon par sbas/ hwa shang slog blon po 'gos rgan gyisathabs byas nas sang shi mang yul gyi blon por bskos te brdzangs/ de nas rgyal po dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa rgyal sar bskos/ 'gos rgan sogs kyisagros byas te ma zhang gron pa skyes gson por dur du bcug rta ra klu gong byang la sprugs/ jo bo skyid grong nas spyan drangs te lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol te/ mchod pa rgya chen po btsugs/ sba gsal snang gis bodhi satwa spyan drangs/ pho brang rlung 'tshubs su kha che a nan+da sa lo tsā byas nas rgyal pos dge ba bcu dang khams bco brgyad kyi chos gsan/ de'i rjes su bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can 'dul ba'i phyir du u rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha wa spyan drangs/de'i lo rgyus gong du bshad pa ltar yin/ de nas bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis116

bsnan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyus yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes byab bzhugs po//grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ bo dhi sa twas rab gnas mdzad pas rab gnas legs te bod khams su bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dus su 'gran pa tsam byung / de'i tshe bod la btsun pa btub mi btub nyams sad pa'i phyir/ sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ste/ sngar med pa'i rab tu byung ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/de la sad mi mi bdun ni/ dbas rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ bod skad du rin chen bsrung ba/sbas dz+nyā na spro rak+ṣi ta ye shes dbang po bsrung ba ste dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa'i mkhan po bod la bka' drin che zhing bo dhi sa twa gshegs nas 'dis gdan sa mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' rta skad ces pa sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan pa yin/rat+na nas rak+ṣi ta rin chen dbang po bsrung ba ste rgan gsum/ glang pu ga wa me rak+ṣi ta bde bar gshegs pa'i go cha bsrung zhes pa bar pa yin/ gzhen gsum ni/pa gor be+e ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta rnam par snang mdzad bsrung ba 'khon nā gas rak+ṣi ta klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ gtsang de brgyu rak+ṣi ta lha'i dbang po bsrung ba ste 'di rnams bod kyi btsun pa la snga ba yin/ sad mi mi bdun la lo tsā ba ka ba dpal brtsegs sogs brgya rtsa brgyad kyis blo sbyangs/ de dag la cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang ye shes sde sogs stong rtsa brgyad kyis blo sbyangs zhes yi ge rnying ma 'ga' las 'byung ngo / /bo dhi sa twa sku 'da' khar khri srong lde btsan la rgyal po khyod kyi bod yul 'dir slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis ma mo'i gtso mo brtan ma bcu gnyis la bka' gtad pa'i phyir mu stegs ni mi 'byung mod/nyin mtshan dang yar ngo mar ngo sogs kyi rten 'brel gyi dbang las chos lugs gnyis su 'gro bar 'gyur te nga 'das pa'i 'og tu rgya nag dge slong bya ba/ bya 1/7

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()byed kyi chos kyis 'tshang mi rgya/ sems rtogs na rnam par mi rtog pa yin no zhesacig car ba'i lam ston pa zhig 'byung / de'i tshe nga'i slob ma kā ma la shī la spyan drangs la rtsod pa byed du chug des rtsod pa chos phyogs su zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan te gshegs/ de nas ye shes dbang po mkhan por bskos te bstan pa ring zhig bskyangs/ slar dpal dbyangs rgyal tshab tu bskos te smo brag mkhar chur sgom du byon/ de'i ring la hwa shang ma hā ya na'i lugs dar te lus ngag gi dge ba rgyun chad/ gtsug lag khang rnams kyi mchod pa stong / bod phal cher kho'i lugs su gyur/ dpal dbyangs sogs bo dhi sa twa'i slob ma nyung shasazhig bsgyur du ma 'dod/ chos min gyi rtsod pa chen po byung bas rgyal po thugs ma bde bar ye shes dbang po lho brag nas spyan drangs/ des mkhan po'i lung bstan gyi dran bskul phul nas kā ma la shī la spyan drangs/ rgya nag dge slong dang rtsod du bcug pas pad ma'i ngang tshul rgyal te rgya gar ba'i lugs dar bar byas/ de'i tshe rgyal pos lta ba klu sgrub kyi lugs bzung / spyod pa chos spyod bcu dang pha rol tu phyin pa la slob/ dkar po chig thub kyi lugs byed du mi dbang ngo zhes bkasabacad de hwa shang rgya nag tu brdzangs/ des brtsams pa'i dpe lnga po gter du sbas/rtsod grwa der kho'i lhum lus pas hwa shang na re/ da dung bod kyi bstan pa'i mjug tu nga'i chos lugs 'ong ba'i ltas yin zer te/ da lta chos khungs ma rnams bor te phyag rgya chen por ming btags pa'i dkar po chig thub la gtso bor byed pa 'di tsho yin par sems so/ /kā ma la shī las sgom rim rnam pa gsum/ de'i rgyab brten du dbu ma snang ba brtsams spya /stan pa snga dar gyi dus na shin tu dar

bstan ri dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyus yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes byab bzhugs so//che'o/ /hwa shang gis mngags pa'i rgya'i bshes gnyen pa bzhis kā ma la shī la bkrongs/ btsan po yang drug cu rtsa dgu la gshegs te/ de'i sras mu ni btsan pos rgyal sa bzung / bsam yas su sde snod gsum gyi mchod pa btsugs/ bod 'bangs kyi ltogs phyug lan gsum bsnyams/ de nas sad na legs mjing yon nam khri lde btsan gyis dgung lo bzhi pa la rgyal sa bzung / skar chung lha khang bzhengs/ chos kyi srol btod/ de nas de'i sras mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyis 'u shang rdo'i lha khang bzhengs/ mtha' bzhi'i ru thams cad dbang du bsdus/lo paṇa mang po'i zhabs nas bteg nas bka' dang bstan bcos sngar ma 'gyur ba mang po bsgyur/ bsgyur ba rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab ste chos kyi srol cher gtod/ rab tu byung ba'i dbu 'phang bstod rgyal po nyid kyi dbu skra la dar yug btags nas de'i steng du dge 'dun rnams bzhugs su gsol te spyi bor 'bur ba'i brda yin/ bod dmag gis rgya nag lan du ma bcom/ slar dbon zhang 'dum byas/ lha sa dang rgya bod gyi mtshams dang pho brang lta na sdug gsum du rdo ring bslangs/ de la chad mdo'i yi ge btab ste/ de yan chad la bstan pa snga dar zhes grags so/ /de nas sdig blon chos la mi dga' ba rnams kyis gros byas/ lha sras gtsang la sprugs/ dbas rgyal gto re dang / co ro legs sgra gnyis kyis mnga' bdag bkrongs/ glang dar ma 'u dum btsan la rgyal srid gtad/ dbas rgyal gto re nang blon du bskos/ thog mar rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ bar skabs su thugs la gdon gsol te chos bsgyur ba'i 'phro bcad/ paṇ+ḍita rnams rang yul du brdzangs/ rab byung la la bsad/ la la phab/119

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()btsun pa'i rtags 'bor du ma 'dod pa rnams mda' gzhu bskur nas rngon pa byed du bcug dkon mchog gi mchod pa rgyun bcad/ lha sa dang bsam yasasogs gtsug lag khang rnams su bshas ra byas/ pu sti phal cher lha sa'i brag la sbas te 'dul ba'i bstan pa ming med par byas so/ /bstan pa phyi dar la bstan pa'i me ro smad nas blangs tshul dang stod nas gsos tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyal po sdig can gyis bstan pa bsnubasapa na lha sa'i dpal lha mos bskul te lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal po bkrongs te khams su bros pas thar/ chu bo ri'i sgom grwa na/ gtsang rab gsal g.yo dge 'byung / dmar shākya mu rne gsum sgom mdzad kyin bzhugs pa na btsun pa'i gzugs kyis khyi ra byed pa mthong / gtam dris pas/ rgyal pos bstan pa bsgrubs tshul thos nas dngangs te 'dul ba'i dpe dre'u la bkal nas mnga' ris stod du bros nas hor yul du phyin/ bstan pa dar bar bya snyam yang skad ma go bar mdo smad du byon/ mdo khamasadaben chung gi dgon pa yang zer/ dan tig shel gyi dgon pa yang zer bar gzhi phab nas bzhugs pas bon po'i rigs su skyes pa mu zu gsal 'bar bya ba'i rigs sad pa'i byis pa gzhen nu zhig khong rnams la dad cing 'dul ba la lhag par mos nas rab tu byung bar zhus pas gnang ste gtsang gi mkhan po dang / g.yos las slob byas te rab byung dang dge tshul sgrub/ mkhan slob kyi mtshan las dras te dge ba rab gsal du mtshan gsol/ phyis thugs rab che bas dgongs pa rab gsal du grags/ slar mkhan slob de nyid dang / dmar gyi gsang ston/ rgya nag hwa shang ko bang dang / gyi 120

bstan pa dge bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyus yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhe bya ba bzhugs so//ban bya ba gnyis kyis kha bskangs byas te bsnyen par rdzogs/ des mkhan slob dang gong seng ge grags la 'dul ba bslabs/ de nas lo lnga lon pa na/ dbusanas klag pa lam pa klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ 'bri ye shes yon tan/ rag she tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sba tshul khrims blo gros/ sum pa ye shes blo gros dang lnga/ gtsang nas mgur mo rab kha ba/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug shab sgo lnga pa tshong btsun shes rab seng ge mnga' ris pa 'od brgyad spun gnyis/ bo dong pa u pa de dkar ba dang lnga ste mi bcu khams su phyin/ gtsang la bka' drin zhus pas nga rgas nas mkhan po mi theg bla chen la zhus gsungs pa ltar zhus pas nga bsnyen pa ra rdzogs nas lo lnga las ma lon pas mkhan po mi btub gsung ba la/gtsang na re/ dmigs gsal la btub pas gyis gsungs/ bla ma chen posamakhan po/ gtsang gi las slob/ g.yos gsang ston/ dmar dang hwa shang gis kha bskangs byas te thams cad rdzogs par byas/ bla chen gyi gsung nas lo ston mthu che bas bstan bsrung gyis/ klu mes btsun pas mkhan po gyis/ tshong ge blo rno bas ston pa gyis/ 'bring bskos mkhas pas gnas gzhi bzung gsungs te brdzangs/ de rnams kyis dbus gtsang du 'ongs te gnas gzhi so sor bzung /'dul ba'i grwa btsugs te bstan pa spel ba la bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslang ba zhes zer ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces pa bod chos rgyal gyi rgyud du 'brungs/ dang por rgyal srid chos bzhin bskyangs/ phyis mkhan po ye shes bzang po la rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs pa des yab mes kyi rnam srol bzang po bsab tu re ba'i thugs bskyed rlabs po ches kun nas bslangs 121

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/lta'o/te mi nyi shu rtsa gcig la gser bre re bskur te rgya gar kha cher chos slob tu brdzangs pa las bcu dgu tshad pa'i nad kyis grongs nas phan par rngo ma thogs/lo chen rin chen bzang po/ de'i g.yog pu rangs pa lo chung legs pa'i shes rab gnyis kyis phan thogs shing / lhag par lo chen rin chen bzang pos rgya gar shar nub dbus thams cad du myul/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang / jo bo nā ro ta pa sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma rab tu mang po'i zhal las mdo sngags kyi bdud rtsi blangs te bod du spyan drangs pa la stod nas gsos pa zer ro/ /'di la kha cig bar dar zhes pa'i tha snyad byed pa ni mi 'thad de/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcus bstan pa spel ba nas 'di'i bar la bstan pa med pa'i bar stong ma byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar gnyis las/ bar dar zhesapa'i tha snyad med cing / de yang 'dul ba'i bstan pa kho na'i dbang du byas la/de'i nang nas kyang dbus gtsang kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ khams mnga' ris gnyis su bstan pa snga dar nas dbus gtsang gi mi bcus bstan pa spel ba'i bar du 'dul ba'i bstan pa med pa'i bar stong ma byung zhing dbus gtsang nyid du yang 'dul ba'i bstan pa nub skabs sngags pa rten skya bo rnams kyis gsang sngags kyi nyams len lkog tu byas shing rten dang glegs bam mi mngon pa'i sar gces par bskyangs pas phyis bstan pa byung ba na phyag mchod dang /dpe lta ba sogs longs spyod pas chog pa 'di byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na dbus gtsang du 'dul ba'i bstan pa med pa'i bar stong lo ji tsam byung zhe na/ kun mkhyen bu ston chen pos lcags mo bya la bstan pa bsgrubs pa nas bdun cu rtsa 122

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyugayongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//gsum pa chu mo bya la bstan pa byung ba yin zhes dang / 'brom ston pas bdun cu rtsa bdun 'byung bar bshad pa dang / rnal pa paṇ+ḍi tas brgya dang brgyad byung bar bshad pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis drug cu rtsa gsum 'byung bar bshad po dang /'ga' zhig gis bdun cu byung bar bshad pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis brgya dang bcu lhag tsam byung bar bshad pa sogs mi mthun pa sna tshogs 'byung bas dpyad par bya'o/ /des na mi bcus smad nas bslang pa dang / lo chen gyis stod nas gsos pa gnyis ka phyi dar yin te/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/sdom gsum rab dbye las/ phyis nas gangs ri'i khrod 'di sa /sangs rgyasabastan pa legs par bsgyur/ /de nas bstan pa dar ba'i tshe/ /rgyal po dar masabastan pa bsnubs/ /de rjes chos log du ma 'phel/ /de tshe bla ma ye shes 'od/ /chos rgyal de yis skyes bu mchog /rin chen bzang po kha cher brdzangs/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /mkhas pa de yis sngon med pa'i/ /chosarnams phal cher bsgyur cing zhus/ /chos dang chos min rnams 'byed pa/ /zhes bya'i bstan bcos mdzad nas ni/ /chos log thams cad bsgrub par mdzad/ /de yi slob ma zhi ba 'od/ /des kyang sngags log sun 'byin pa/ /zhes bya'i bstan bcos mdzad ces zer/ /de dag 'das pa'i 'og tu yang / /chos log 'ga' zhig 'phel ba'i rgyus/ /lhas btsas zhes bya'i lo tsā ba/ /des kyang chos log sun 'byin pa/ /zhes bya'i bstan bcos mdzad nas ni/ /chos dang chos min rnam par phye/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dgu pa de la bod kyi chos rgyal la sogs pa'i chen po rnams kyis sri zhu 123

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyis gnyan po gsang ba la phyag mchod mdzad pa dang / srong btsan sgam pos rang gi 'bangs su gyur pa'i lo tsā ba rnams kyi zhabs spyi bor blangs shing sri zhu phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pa dang /rab tu byung ba'i gzugs brnyan tsam la'ang rgyal po nyid kyis phyag mdzad pa sogs bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi dbu 'phang ches cher btod do/ khri srong lde btsan gyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba rab tu byung ba'i sde btsugs nas bshad nyan gyi srol legs par btod/ rab tu byung ba re re'i zhabs nas bteg ste bstan pa bla nar bkur bas bod khams kyi bde skyid dbyar gyi mtsho ltar gyur/ mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyis bod kyi rab tu byung ba mi re re la 'bangs kyi khyim bdun re 'bul ba sogs kyis bkur sti cher mdzad/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su bsam yas kyi btsad po mnga' bdag tsā la na yab sras kyis dbus gtsang gi mi bcu khams su rdzong ba'i bdag rkyen/ yar byon nas sna len dang bstod bkur cher mdzad pas 'dul mngon dang phar phyin la sogs pa'i bshad nyan rlabs po che btsugs/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / de'i dbon po lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po dang / pu rangs pa legs pa'i shes rab sogasalo tsā ba mang por bdag rkyen mdzad pas sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad nyan rlabs po che stod nas dar/ rgya brtson seng / gung thang ba nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba pho nyar mngags te jo bo rje dpal ldan mar me mdzad spyan drangs/bka' gdams kyi srol chen po btsugs pa sogs bod kyi chos rgyal rim par byon pa rnams kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa la phu dud 124

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyus yongs 'du ri me tog gsar pa 'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//ches cher mdzad pas bstan pa rin po che 'di ches cher rgyas pa yin no/ / bcu pa mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad nyan gyis ji ltar gtan la phab pa'i tshul rmi/ sde snod kyi bshad nyan la 'dul ba smad lugs kyi bshad pa ni bstan pa snga dar gyi bshad pa'i rgyun khams su 'phos pa/ klu mes kyis blangs te spel ba dang / mngon pa kun btus kyang bstan pa snga dar gyi bshad rgyun khams su 'phos pa las yar 'phel te khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung dang / de'i slob ma rwa khri bzang 'bar dang / brang ti dar ma snying po sogs las brgyud de shin tu dar bar mngon byung yang / da lta ni lung rgyun tsam las bshad pa'i rgyun mi snang / 'dul ba stod lugs kyi bshad pa sna paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pā la mnga' ris su byon/ de'i slob ma pā la rnam gsum/ de'i slob ma zhang zhung ba rgyal ba'i shes rab las 'phel ba yin zhing / dus phyis kha che paṇ+ḍita sde pa yod ba'i shar brgyud chen po shākya shrī bod du byon/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / byang chub pa rdor rje dpal/gnyis la sogs pa bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad cing / bshad nyan kyang mdzad pa las 'phel ba la 'dul ba bar lugs zhes grags/ mngon pa mdzod kyi bshad nyan ni paṇ+ḍita ska tis khu kha mi thub pa sa 'di bar yi ge ba mun dam snyam/)mchimasapartson 'grus seng ge dang / mchims thams cad mkhyen pa sogs la bshad cing /de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchims pa rnams las brgyud de 'phel ba yin/byams pa'i chos lnga ni rngog blo ldan shes rab/ btsan kha bo che gnyis nas 'phel zhing / dbu ma'i bshad pa ni pa tshab nyi ma grags nas pa tshab kyi bu bzhi las brgyud de 'phel/ tshad ma rnam nges sogs kyi bshad pa ni rngog lo chen po las 125

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()'phel zhing / tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi bshad pa ni thog mar rma dge ba'i blo gros dang / bar du rngog lo chen pos bshad nyan mdzad kyang rgyun ma tshugs pa la phyis sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa kha che paṇa chen dang / de'i paṇa chung gsum dang bcas pa lasagasan te bshad nyan gyi srol btsugs pa las 'phel ba yin/ gsang sngags kyi bshad nyan ni/ sngon rwa pa dang / rngog pa dang / dpyal lo dang / 'gos lo sogs las kyang mang du 'phel lo/ /gtso bor gyur pa sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kye gsang gsum du grags pa la kye rdo rje'i skor ni/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i bka' babs kyi slob ma bzhi las brgyud de rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras las 'phel lo / / lha nag dril gsum du grags pa'i bde mchog gsang mtha'i skor ni/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs dang / mal lo blo gros grags sogs las brgyud de sa skya pa yab sras las 'phel/ gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lug bas ni gnyan 'e1 tsā ba nas gnam kha'u pa la brgyud cing / 'phags lugs ni 'gos lo tsā ba/dbus pa dge ser/ gnam kha'u pa nas brgyud de sa skya pa yab sras las 'phel/gshin rje gshed kyi skor rnams ni/ sdong ston shes rab dpal las brgyud de 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa las 'phel ba mang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnamasani mal lo blo gros grags las brgyud de sa skya pa yab sras las 'phel rig pa'i gnas chung ba sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kho nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir shing rta'i grol gsar du phye ba yin te/ sgra rig pa la mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo dang / shes rab 'phro ba dang / shes rab la 'jug pa dang / sgra nyer bsdu ste bzhi dang / tshad ma rig pa la rigs pa'i gter rang 'grel dang bcas pa dang / bzo rig pa la sku 126

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyu yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhe byab bzhugs so//gzugs kyi bstan bcos dang / sa brtag pa sogs kyi bstan bcos dang / gso ba rig pa la yan lag brgyad pa'i bsdus don dang / sdeb sbyor la me tog gi chun po de'i ngal gso'i dpe tsam ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje la bskul ba gnyis/ snyan ngag la mkhas pa'i kha rgyan 'apyad/)/ mngon brjod la tshig gter/zlos gar la rab dga'i 'jug pa dang / de'i rol mo'i dbyangs 'dren pa'i phyogs tsam ston pa rol mo'i bstan bcos la sogs pa mdzad nas gangs ri'i khrod 'dir ches cher dar bar mdzad pa'i phyir te/ chos rje nyid kyi gsung las/skye ba gzhan du sbyangs pa dang / /mkhas pa du ma bsten pa dang / /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ khes bya kun la 'jigs med thob/ /ces dang / byang phyogs 'di na tshig la mkhas pa med/ /legs par shes nas 'chad pa kho bo tsam/ /zhes dang / sgra pa nga yin rtog ge pa nga smra ba ngan 'joms nga 'dra med/ /sdeb sbyor nga mkhas snyan ngag nga nyid mngon brjod 'chad la 'gran med nga / /dus sbyor ngasashes phyi nang kun rig rnam dpyod blo gros mtshungs med nga / /de 'dra gang yin sa skya pa ste mkhabs pa gzhan dag gzugs brnyan yin/ /zhes zhal gyi 'tshes par mdzad pa'i phyir/ 'o na de lta bu nga rgyal ma yin nam zhe na/ rang la rjes su yi rang ba'i tshig yi ge'i lam du 'god pa ni mkhas pa dang grub pa rnams la shin tu 'os pas gzu bor gnas pa'i gtam ngo mtshar med du byung ba zhig yin te/ de dang tshul mtshungs pa dpal ldan chos kyi grags pas/ spre'u'i tshogs kyis ri bong bzung nas chu gter bzhag ces grog mkhar smra/ /rgyas pa srid sgrub brda shes de dag bde min lo rgyus sgrog par byed/ spya /sa tshig don srang la gzhal bzhin ji

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ltar gnas pa bden smras kyang / /'gro kun mgrin pa brkyangs nas sun 'byin de'i phyir grags ldan khyod la 'dud//ces dang / gal te chos kyi grags pa yi/ /smra ba'i nyi ma nub pa na/ /chos rnams gnyid log yang na shi /chos ma yin rnamasad gzod longs/ /zhes dang / slob dpon blo brtan gyis/ bdag blo phyogs gcig bzhag pa dang / /gzhan blo phyogs gcig bzhag pa gnyis/ /gal te tshad las gzhal rung na/ /srang la bcal na bdag blo lci/ /zhes dang / slob dpon rgyan mkhan pos/ shes rab 'byung gnas skyes pa na/ khi shes bya'i tshogs rnamasami 'dar na/ /de la sems med yang na ni/ /lhags sam ba glang mngon sum yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na bod na yod pa'i bshad nyan gyi rgyun 'di dag phal mo che sa skya pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen re re las ma brgyud pa med cing / de yang rje btsun gong ma rnams dang / gtso bor mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i phrin las kyi rgyun kho na yin pas 'gran sems dang phrag dog sogs rgyang ring du dor nas bka' drin rjes su dran par bya rigs pa yin no/ /bzo rig pa yang ri mo dang sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dang phyag tshad dang dge legs la sogs pa'i brtag pa dang / sa brtag pa la sogs pa brtag pa rnam pa brgyad dang / cis kyang bzo rig pa'i khongs su gtogs par mkhas pa rnams bzhed pas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las 'byung ba'i a rmi dang / dbri bsnan sogs rtsis kyi yan lag ma tshang ba med pa dpyis phyin pa legs par mkhyen nas rje btsun chen po'i nang rten dbu rtse rnying ma na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku gzugs da lta 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar bar grags pa'i /28

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyus bongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa 'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//rus shing dang pra bzo la sogs pa chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa 'di ni dus phyis dza lha'i gling na bzo rig pa la shin tu mkhas par byas pa dag gis mngon par 'du byas pa'i sku gzugs dag gis brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro bar ma zad 'di'i khri rgyab yol slob dpon zangs tshas mdzad pa la yang 'gran mi bdo bas/rtsa rgyud nas bshad pa'i ri mo'i bkod pa gan dar dkar po kha phyed do lhag pa la phyag gi mngon par 'du mdzad pa rgya ma dpon grags la gnang ba dang / shang sreg shing du gyang ngos la bris pa'i 'jam dbyangs gar gzigs dang / dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi khor sa'i ngos la bris pa'i 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi phyag mtshan gyi ri mo sogs ni deng sang gi ri mo ba shin tu mkhas par byas pa 'bum gyi blo gros phyogs gcig tu bsdoms nas bris kyang cha tsam du yang mi 'gro ba zhig ste/ de lta bu'i phyag rgyun la brten nas gtso bor 'phel ba yin/ gso ba rig pa yang bod 'dir dang por ni rgya nag nas byung ba yin la/ nyis ni rgya gar sogs phyogs mang po nas 'phel bar mngon mod/da lta rgyud bzhi zhes yongs su grags pa ni/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos mdzad pa yin gyis/ rgya gar nas 'ongs ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos gang yang ma yin mod/ bod blun log rtog can dag gis sgro skur gyi gzhir song drogs rgya gar nas byung rgyu ba dang / rdza pa ye shes gzungs la rig brgyud du gnang rgyu ba'i khul mdzad pa yin/ de lta na'ang g.yu thog mgon po ni sman bla nyid kyi sprul par grags shing / mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pas 'khrul pa'i dri ma bsangs pa zhig yin pas/ 'di dag kyang shin tu lkog // gyi don la rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'dra

brtse chen 'od snang las/ skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bas tshad ma yin par mkhas pa rnams la grags so/ /chos rje pas kyang yan lag brgyad pa sogs rgya gar nas byung ba'i gso rig gi bstan bcos rnams dbyis phyin par bslabs te shin tu mkhas par mkhyen nas yan lag brgyad pa'i bsdus don mdzad cing / de'i lhan thabs 'ga' yang byung ba sogs bka' srol ༷di las mched pa brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed sogs mang du byung bar snang nga / / bcu gcig pa la rgyu'i sgo nas dang / 'bras bu'i sgo nas/ rtags kyi sgo nas/ rigs kyi sgo nas/ phrin las kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags tshul dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po de nyid byang chub sems dpa' phyag na pa blo'am spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / mthu stobs kyi mgon po bi rū pa'i sprul pa yin par 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i gzigs snang la ma cig zhang mo bya ba'i mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba thugs dar 'dzin pa zhig 'bral med du 'khor zhing 'dug pas rigs bskrun pa'i cho ga mdzad pa na/ sa chen gzungs shing de yang sku sha dkar la 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhi zhing dul ba/ 'gro ba kun la ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes lta bu'i thugs rje chen po zhig byung bas brtse ba chen por grags pa dang / siṅga la'i gling na bzhugs pa'i mkhan po dgra bcom pa zhig gis a tsar+ya zhig la bod na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sprul pa sa skya pa bya ba yod pas der song zhig ces lung bstan pa ltar byon pas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma gsum gyi nang tshan du gyur pa dang /130

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyus yongs 'du ri me ton gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//khams pa rgya lo la rgya gar du rtsa rlung gi gegs byung ba 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub sus kyang sel bar ma nus pa'i tshe/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros bod na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sprul pa sa skya pa bya ba yod kyis/ des gegs kyi rigs che chung gang yang sel mi nus pa med pas/ de can song zhig ces lung bstan pa ltar byon pas bla chen gung thang du bzhugs pa dang mjal/ gegs sel gyi dmigs pa phra mo zhig bstan pas de ma thag grol te/ sku rten dang glegs bam sogs rten mang po dbu thog tu khur nas rgya bod gnyis na khyod las gdams pa che ba yod re gsungs nas dbu bsnyung theng gsum bzhes pa dang / zhing gzhan du gshegs pa na bde ba can/ po ta la/ gser mdog can/ nub phyogs u rgyan bzhir gshegs par bshad pa'i dang po gnyis spyan ras gzigs longs sprul gyi zhing khams yin pas rang gnas su byon pas kyang grub mod/ tha snyad du mi g.yo ba dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mngon sum du zhal bstan nas gdams pa dang /rjes su bstan pa gnang bas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab mnga' ba dang / rje btsun rtse mo ni gzungs ma thag saṃ khyu ta'i skad smra rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas te nga ni byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das pa'o/ /zhes lan gnyis kyi bar du gsungs/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa mkhan po bsod nams rtse mo rdo rje theg pa mtha' dag gi dbang phyug dam pa sa skyar skyes so/ /zhes pa'i yi ge rdo rje gdan gyi sgo'i ya themal btab pa ko'u sham+bha'i paṇ+ḍi ta de ba ma nyis phyogs thams cad du bsgrags pas 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin par grus /da/ tha snyad du slob dpon mi thub zla

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()ba'am sbyang dka' zla ba'am dkar gsal zla ba zhes pa'i mtshan gyi khyad par gsum dang ldan pa de nyid sogs paṇ+ḍi ta'i skye ba bar ma chad pa bcu gcig tu skye ba bzhes par bshad pas/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen pa thogs med du grub pa dang / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan ni rdzo bo rje mnga' ris nas dbus gtsang du phebs pa'i lam 'brong ngu'i la rtse nas sbom po ri'i ngos la 'brong gnyis/ za ba gzigs/ de ci'i ltas yin zhus pas/ ma 'ongs pa na ma hā ka la gnyis der byon nas 'gro don mdzad pa'i ltas yin/ zhes sa skya pa'i chos skyong gur zhal rnam gnyis la mdzad pa de lung bstan/ de nas phyag 'tshal sgang du phebs pa na chibs las babs te/ sa dkar 61gas la phyag mchod rgyas pa zhig mdzad/ ci lags zhus pas/ sa dkar po pha gi'i ngos la khyiX yig gcig sgyi yig bdun/ hūṃ yig gcig rnams 'dug pa la phyag mchod byas pa yin gsungs/ de ci'i ltas lags zhus pas/ ma 'ongs pa na spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa gzhig sa chen/'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun ni/ gcen kun dga' 'bar/slob dpon bsod rtse/ rje btsun grags pa/ gcung dpal chen 'od/ sa pa ṇa/ zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mi'/'gro mgon 'phags pa dang bdun no//phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa gcig 'gro mgon phyag na rnams pha gir byon nas 'gro don mdzad pa'i ltas yin zhes lung bstan pa dang / chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos su gzigs shing / de dang mthun par sangs rgyas zhu 'phrin las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dge bsnyen mchog gi skur bstan nas/ /bdag gi 'khrul pa'i dra ba bcad/ /yun ring dus nas 'di nyid 132

bsnan pa dang bstan 'dzan gyi lo rgyus yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhe bya ba bzhugs so//ni / khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes so zhes/ /mkha' la de 'dra'i sgra grags pa/ /legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pas 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa yin par grub mod/ tha snyad du sgo mtha' yas pa'i blo gros la sogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i skye ba bdun bar ma chad par bzhes par bshad pas rig pa'i gnas ma lus pa la mkhyen pa nyi ma ltar gsal ba dang / chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta ni kha che paṇa chen siṅga lar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ hor gyi pho lha gnam thel dkar pos gdan 'dren du byung ba na rang gi yi dam gyi lha rje btsun ma sgrol ma la zhus pas/ khyed phyin kyang phan mi thogs/ bod na khyod kyi slob ma 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan bya ba yod/ des phan thogs pas lung ston cig gsungs pa ltar lung bstan pa dang / rje btsun rin po che grags pa byang gi nyi lung phug par bzhugs dus nye ba'i rim gro pas mthong snang la hor gyi cha lugs can gyi rta pa sa gzhi go skabs pa tsam byung / rje btsun gyi phug par song / mig 'khrul pa'am ci yin snyam nas bltar phyin pas thams cad rje btsun gyi drung na gral byas 'dugade'i khrod nas khye'u dkar po dung so khor mor yod pa zheg langs te rje btsun la phyag 'tshal/ rje btsun rin po che 'di rnams hor gyi pho lha gnam thel dkar po bya ba khyed spyan 'dren par 'ong ba yin par 'dug nga gnyan chen thang lha bya ba yin te khong rnams kyi lam sna la 'ongs pa yin/ hor gyi lha mi thams cad la phan pa'i phyir du 'byon dgos zhu ba/ rje btsun chen pos/ nga na so yang rgas hor dang las 'brel che ba rang yang med pas phan mi thogs/ nga'i tsha bo 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa kun dga' rgyal 3 ) spyan drangs na hor dang las 'brel

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()yang che bar 'dug pas phan thogs pa 'ong zhes lung bstan/ nang mchod bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te srin lag gi rtses 'thor ba gnang bas de rnams bzi ba'i rnam pas nyams kyi mtshan thog thag glu gar sogs kyi dus 'da'/ nam langs pa na log song bar mthong ba dang/ yang cha lung rdo rje'i brag tu bzhugs pa'i tshe tshogs bdag glang sna can gyi mkha' dbyings mthon por bteg nas rgya nag gi yul khams thams cad bstan/ 'di thams cad khyod kyi gdul bya yin gsungs pa na sngar bzhin gsungs te/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi gdul byar 'ong bar gyis zhes bka' bsgos pa dang / gtsang nag phug pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer gyis mnal lam zin nas shar phyogs su 'phur byon pas/ri bo rtse lnga yin zer ba'i spang ri bzang po zhig gi rtser gnas gzhi bzang po lta bu zhig gi dbus su khang pa bzang po zhig 'dug pa la 'di 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi pho brang yin snyam nas bskor ba 'ga' byas/ sgo yun ring du ma rnyed pa la slar shar phyogs nas sgo gcig byung / nang du byon pas gtsug lag khang bzang po zhig gi dbus na bla ma chos rje pa bzhugs 'dug 'di 'jam pa'i dbyangs yin snyam nas(phyag 'tshal byin rlabs zhus pas/ gsung ni gang yang ma byung / glegs bam dar sna tshogs kyis gril ba zhig gnang / kha phye nas bltas pas mtshan brjod kyi dpe gser gyis bris pa zhig 'dug de ma thag mnal sad de/ de phyin chad chos rje pa la tha mal pa yin snyam pa'i bsam pa skad cig kyang ma skyes pa dang / chos rje pa ling chu rtser khab na bzhugs pa'i tshe mi mang pos ri bo rtse lnga la mchod pa 'bul du phyin pas thams cad la rmi lam mthun par 'jam pa'i 134

bsna pa dang bstan 'dzan gyi cha rgyus yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhe bya ba bzhug so//dbyangs 'di na mi bzhugs/ ling chu rtser khab na bzhugs zer ba byung bas/slar log ste ling chu rtser phyin pa na chos rje pas mi mang po la chos gsungs pa dang mjal/ chos kyang thob ste thams cad la 'jam pa'i dbyangs yin snyam pa'i nges shes skyes pa dang / lha rje bi rje sogs mos gus can gyi slob ma mang pos 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos su mthong ba sogs kyi phyag na ral gri'i sprul pa yin par grub mod/ tha snyad du dbyig gnyen dang rngog blo ldan shes rab sogs paṇ+ḍita'i skye ba bar ma chad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga'am rtsa bdun gyi bar du rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pas shes bya thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa dang /'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa ni/ sngar gyi jo bo rje'i lung bstan dang / dgung lo gsum bzhes pa na sgrub thabs mtsho skyes la mkhas pa du ma'i dbus su bzhad pa mdzad pa dang / dgung lo brgyad pa la chos rje pa'i sngon 'gro'i chos 'khor gyi dus rab tu byung ba khri phrag du ma 'dus shing / de'i nang na sde snod 'dzin pa rang yang stong phrag du ma dang / gdugs thogs pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po stong lhag pa 'dus pa'i dbus su rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa dang /dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa la sdeb sbyor dang tshig rgyan du mas spras shing / bshad pa'i tshe na'ang dgag sgrub dang bcas pa smra ba'i rgyan bzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas mdzad pa na/ mkhas pa thams cad kyi nga rgyal chag nas ha las pa ra gyur te so skye la 'di lta bu 'byung ba mi srid/'di ni nges par sa la gnasapa'i 'phags chen zhig bo sna /zhes gleng bas 'phags pa zhes pa'i mtshan bla dwags su chags pa sogs kyi zur phud lnga pa/ spyal par grags mod/ tha snyad du rgya gar

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/ ()du rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta du mar skye ba bzhes pa dang / bod du yang glang ri thang pa dang / spyan ras gzigs dang gsung gleng mdzad par grags pa'i sa ston ri ba sogs mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa du mar skye ba bzhes pas shes bya'i gnas thams cad la/ chos rje bas/ mkhas pa la la mtsho bzhin ngang gis gang / /la la rgyal po'i bu bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /ces pa ltar gyur pa yin la / de lta bu'i shing rta'i srol gsar du gtod pa'i bka' srol la phyis chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgya spru 4'a/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis/ bla ma 'di la grub chen thang stong rgyal po 'jam dpal gyi rjes gnang / bka' 'gyur gyi lung / sa skyabaka' 'bum gyi lung / dbu sems gnyis kyi sems bskyed kyi cho gal sogs pa gsan/ sa 61 thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams sogs nyid kyi dpon rigs su 'khrungs pa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu nam mkha'i skar phran gyi grangs tsam dang / rjes su 'brang ba mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi pha mthar byon par ma zad/ grub pa chen po'i go 'phang la bzhugs pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pas lung gis brtags/ rig pas dpyad/ bshad nyan gyis gtan la phab ste shin tu rnam par dag pa la dag par gzigs pa'i phyir na bka' srol gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /gnyis pa mkhas pa'i 'bras bu'am bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu mkhas shing grub pa chen po'i sar zhugs pa/chos lugs rang snang du mi mngon pa tsam ma yin par rang gzhan kun la zla ltar grags pa mtha' yas pa bskrun par mdzad pa ste/ de yang sa skya pa chen po'i zhal 136

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyu yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes byab bzhug5 so//slob ni 'khon sgyi chu ba la kye rdor ḍom+bi lugs kyi dbang gsan pa'i nub kyi mnal lam du srid pa'i rgya mtsho yin zer ba'i mtsho dmar mer ba zhig la zam pa gsum btsugs te nye ba la mi gsum/ bar pa la mi bdun/ ring ba la mang po zhig bsgral bar rmis pa dang / zhang dgon pa bas sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi skabs mdun gyi nam mkhar sku bdun du sprul te ngas kyang sgrub pa tsam byed pa ma byung yang khyod yid ches pa'i phyir du 'di tsam yin/ spyir khyod kyi sgrub pa gtso bor byas na rnal 'byor dbang phyug tsam 'ong / bshad pa gtso bor byas na phyag rgya chen kro mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma gsum/ mchog thob pa'i slob ma gsum ni/ si sgo gling gi rnal 'byor pa / byang chub sems dpa' stag sgom pa skyi 'bar te gsumacho / /bzod pa thob pa bdun/ ni/ bla ma rje btsun/ zhu bcas dngos grub/ dga' ston rdo rje grags/ nags sgom bsod nam sa rgyal mtshan/tshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa / sgom pa po dbang grags/mang chung ma ste bdun no/ /tshogs lam che 'bring la gnas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par 'byung ba dang / gzhan yang che bar grags pa rga lo tsā ba gzhen nu dpal/ la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar/ khams pa sne rtse sbar ston/ kyu ra a seng / gshan pa rdor seng la sogs pa du ma dang / rje btsun rtse mo la sa chen gyi dngos slob phal che bas gtugs shing gsung gi bsnyed rtsi blangs pa dang / grags pa la dkar shākya grags/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ sna ro'i ban+de gshin rje grags/ sal ba dbang phyug grags te grags pa'i mtha' can bzhi/sras ston blo gros grags/ rga ston rdo rje grags/ lde ston dkon mchog grags/sa ston 'jigs med grags te snga ma bzhi dang bsdoms pas grags pa mi brgyad 137

brtse chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ces pa dang / mu tshu byang chub grags/ gtsang ston brtson 'grus grags/ lha thog yon tan gzungs/ rigs ldan shes rab rin chen te gur rgyan zhus pa'i mi bzhi/ jo sras lcags kyi rdo rje/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i sangs rgyas/ khams kyi 'ji ston dge slong ste (gcig ga sngag 'dzin gyi sdom brtson 'a po bzhi/ dbyi sgom tshul khrims grags/ mon rdo rje rā dza sogs du ma dang / sa lo kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ sgrub lo byams pa'i dpal/ sum pa lo tsā ba dpal mchog dang po'i sde sogs dang / sa skya paṇ+ḍita la ngos su grags pa shar pa shes rab 'byung gan nub nyi thog pa rigs pa'i seng ge gung skyo ston dri med gsum/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mas gnyan ston tshul khrims rgyal mtshan zhang ston 'od bde ba gsum/ lho pa rin chen pa dmar chos kyi rgyal po gnyis/ grub sgo ba yon to dpal tshogs sgo ba kun dga' dpal gnyis/ sdom phrug bgres pa dpal bzang po'i mtha' can sher 'byung sogs bcu gsum/ gzhon pa rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can bdun/ye za po sogs/skad gnyis smra ba glo chag zhang gsum/ 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge gzad ring dar ma tshul khrims/ jo nang kun spangs 'a po'i bla ma kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ snar thang pa mchims ston nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri sogs sde snod 'dzin pa du ma dang / sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin rgyal ba yang dgon pa sogs rab tu mang po dang / 'phags pa la khang gnyan zhang gsum/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ shad dkon mchog dpal sher yang la ra btu byung lam 'bras pa kun blo/ bo dong pa shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/jo nang pa kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ snar thang pa brgyad pa sogs du ma dang /138

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyu yong 'du'i me tog gsar pa 'i do shal zhes byab ba gugs so//rgyas par na kha ba can pa'i bla dpon ji snyed pa de snyed kyis zhabs spyi bor blangs shing gsung gi bdud rtsi len par mdzad pa ste de lta bu dag bskrun par mdzad pas na/ bka' srol gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni bla ma sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa na yab gshegs/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags gdan sar bskos pas/ ba ri ba'i gsung las pha jo sras kyi bu bya ba slob gnyer dgos/ slob gnyer byed pa la shes rab dgos/ shes rab kyi lha 'phags pa 'jam dpal yin pas 'di sgrubs shig gsungs nas 'jam dpal gyi rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs kyi lung gnang ste bla brang shar du sgrub pas dung gi mi chen po zhig yang yang byung / de bla ma la zhus pas/ dpe dkar 'di bar chad zhig byed 'dod yin 'dug pas bar 'dir jo bo mi g.yo ba sgrub gsungs nas bsgrubs pas rje btsun ma sgrol mas zhal mngon sum du bstan nas phyi'i bar chad bsal/ mi g.yo bas zhal mngon sum bstan nas nang gi bar chad bsal/ zla ba drug na rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser rin po che'i khri la bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' gnyis dang bcas pa mngon sum du zhal gzigs te blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa rig kyi bu tshe 'di la zhen na chos ma min/khams gsum la zhen na nges 'byung min/bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/gnang yang lan cig mal gyi nye gnas mdzad pa na snyan gzhi thu mo zhig byung ba'i tshe/bzo mo ci tsi zhes pa brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi ya rgyal des sman phul bas dwangs/yang re zhig na de'i snyun ro langs te yun ring po zhig snyun pas gsung ngag 139

bco 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()thams cad brjed pa na 'di shes pa bod na ni med pas 'dri sa mi 'dug rgya gar du phyin kyang ci 'dra yod mi shes snyam thugs ma bde bar sa skya'i brang khang rnying par mtshams bcad de bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas/ thog mar rmi lam du zhang dgon pa ba byon nas gsungs/ slar mngon sum du byon nas gsungs pas thams cad gsos par gyur te/ de dus bstod pa mdzad pa'i nang na / rang gi spyad pa'i las las gyur pa g.yo ba yi/ /nad kyis btab pa khyod kyi thugs rjes zil mnan nas//rmongs par gyur pa ye shes chen po'i ros gang ba//rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed kyi mthu yis rjes su skyongs/ /zhes pa 'byung / de'i rjes su birlu pa dpon g.yog lnga byon te gsungs pa'i lo rgyus gong bzhin/ rtse mos ni/ gzhon nu'i dus nas 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rnams zhal gzigs shing ma bde ba'i drogs pa ci byung yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug la zhus chog pa byung / dgung lo nyer brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe gsung ngag gi lta ba'i skabs nam mkha' 'od kyi gur khang gi dbus su rje btsun chen po la 'jam dpal/ zhu byas la kye rdo rje/ gnyags/ rmog ston/ gtsug tor dbon po sogs bco lnga la spyan ras gzigs su bstan te chos nyan bcu dgu dag pa'i snang ba la bkod cing / rje btsun chen po la sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ u rgyan sogs yul nyer bzhi dang / po ta la sogs du mar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du byon te brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad pas nye ba'i gnas bsam pa gnyis pa dri ma med pa'i rtogs pa bsgrun par mdzad pa sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas/ rje btsun chen pos mnal lam du kye rdor rgyud 140

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gye lo rgyus yong 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhug so//brtag gnyis/rdo rje gur//pu ṭa/gsum gyi pusti gsol bas chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid thugs su chud/ dgung lo nyi shu pa'i tshe nyin par g.yengs par mnal du song ba'i mnal lam du mtshan brjod phyed tsam bton pa'i snang ba byung / yang lan gcig mnal lam du tshar gcig bton pa rmis te mnal sad pa na thugs la 'dzin ma dgos pa byung zhing / de'i tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal skye ba bdun gyi bar gyi yi dam gyi lha'o zhes pa'i sgra nam mkha' la grags pa byung / yang lan cig mnal lam du sa skya pa chen po rdo dkar 'jam pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi rnam pa yod pa/ dbus su hūṃ dang a/ mtshams bzhir ya ra la wa bzhi yod pa/ phyogs bzhi stong par yod pa zhig bstan te ngas khyod la chos bstan pa thams cad kyi don 'dir 'dus pa yin te/ byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid dngos/ /dang po chos nyid gdan du bya/ /gnyis pa rlung la sbar zin bya/ /gtum mo'i me drod rab tu sbar/ /byangs sems chu rgyun dbu mar zhugs/ /sa sogs 'byung ba dbang du bsdu/ /ye shes lnga ni mngon gyur nas/ /'chi ba med pa'i gnas thob bo/ /zhes gsungs pas phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad thugs su chud/ yang lan cig dbus su bla ma sa skya pa chen po la nye ba'i sras brgyad kyisabaskor/ g.yas su shākya thub pa la nyan thos brgyad kyis bskor/ g.yon du kye rdo rje la lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i zhal mngon sum du bstan nas khyod sdom pa len na su la len/ dbang bskur zhu na su la zhu gsungs pa na/ bdag sdom pa len pa'i slob dpon nam dbang bskur zhu ba'i bla mar gyur pa ni chos kyi rje nyid do / / zhes zhus pas/ de kho na bzhin te khyod kyis legs par rtogs pa de bzhin 141

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()no / / zhes dbugs dbyung ste chos dang 'jig rten gyi dge legs thams cad yar 'phel du song / yang slob dpon rin po che bde ba can du gshegs nasayun ring po ma lon pa'i tho rangs zhig mnal lam du slob dpon rin po che na bza' sbub ha re sku lus 'di nyid kyi mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i na bza'i sbubs nas sbrang po che lta bu'i skad gcig bar snang las 'thon te khyod 'di nas byang phyogs su zhing khams dpag tu med pa 'das pa na sangs rgyas kyi zhing gser mdog can bya bar de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od rnam par rtsen pa'i rgyal po'i bstan pa la 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bsod nams mtha' yas bya ba bzhugs/ de'i sras 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas su skye'o zhes pa'i sgra rang grags su byung ngo / /yang kha che paṇa chen gyi shang bsreg shing du zla ba gza' 'dzin gyi sgo yig btab pa na rje btsun gyis ro rkyang gnyis rlung sems 'gro 'ong bkag ste/ dbu ma'i nang du khams dkar dmar bsres pas de'i mtshan mo zla ba 'char rgyu ma byung / de'i sang chos rje pas paṇa chen la de ci yin zhus pas nga brdzun mar btang ba'i phyir khyod kyi khu bo dge bsnyen rgan po de la dka' las ci yang byung song gsungs zhes gsungs par grag go /yang bde ba can du spyan 'dren gyi pho nya lan gnyis byung ba'i dang po phyir zlogs/gnyis pa'i tshe lha rnams kyi bde ba can gyi bsngags pa dang mi mjed kyi mi bsngags pa mang du brjod nas nan gyis spyan drangs pa na/ kho bo zhing bzang ba la dga' ba dang / ngan pa la mi dga' ba med cing / zhing sbyangs pa la dman pa nyid khyad par che/ kho bo la ltos pa'i mgon med pa mang po yod pas nga mi 'gro 142

bstan pa dang bsnan 'dzin gyi lo rgyu yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//gsungs nas zlogs/ dgung lo bdun cu bzhes pa'i tshe ci nas kyang gshegs dgos zhes nan gyis spyan drangs/ bde ba can gyi bkod pa yang gzigs/ tho rangs chos rje pas tsog pur 'dug ste gsol ba btab pas cung zad mnal ba na / bde ba can nas 'ongs zer ba'i lha tshogs nam mkha'i khams khyab pa rnams kyis seng ge'i khri rgyan du mas brgyan pa dang / mchod pa'i bkod pa rgya mtshor 'khyil ba dang bcas pa thogs nas rje pa bde ba can du spyan 'dren zer ba la gsol ba btab pas kyang mi smra bar 'khod/ rje pa nyid la gsol ba btab pas gshegs pa la spro bar 'dug khyod kyang bde ba can gyi bkod pa la ltos shig gsungs/ phyag gi brda sprad pas/ be+e ḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi rin po che'i shing ljon pa sogs bkod pa yid 'phrog pa gzigs/ der dang po gser mdog can du gshegs gsungs pa dang mi 'gal lam zhes zhus pa dang / bla ma yab srab(kyi drung du skye bar gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam gyi stobs las/ re zhig bde ba can du 'gro/ der yun mi ring ba zhig bsdad nas gser mdog can du sngar bshad pa'i chul gyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i cha byad du byas nas sa lam phal cher bgrod skye ba gsum pa'i lus rten de la 'tshang rgya rgyu med pa'i tshul gyis rgya bar re ba yin gsungs nas gshegs pa sogs mtha' yas/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍita la dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe mnal lam du a phyi 'bum pa'i drung du dbyig gnyen yin zer ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta sngo seng lang tsho dar yol zhig la/ chos mngon pa mdzod zla ba gcig gsan par rmis/ mnal sad pa na tshig don thamasacad thugs su chud 'dug nyis kha che paṇa chen las gsan pas kyang sngar dang 143

brtse chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()khyad ma byung gsungs/ yang tshogs pa chen po zhig la tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi mchod brjod saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du gsungs pa'i tshe phrag gong gnyis nas nyi zla shar te de'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pa zhig rmis pa dang /dus gzhan zhig na phyogs kyi glang po'i gdan sar bsgos pas gshegs par zhu zer nas byon pas brag phug bzang po ngos rnams la glegs bam gyi rtsig pa mthon po dang bcas pa zhig gi lde mig gtad pa rmis/ yang kha che paṇa chen bod du ma byon gong mnal lam du chos zab mo rdo rje'i glur len pa gsan/ phyis paṇa chen dang mjal dus zhus pas/ de dus kho bo la yang de lta bu'i snang ba zhig byung gsungs/ yang rje btsun rin po che la lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhus pas bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo 'jam dpal du mthong / shes bya'i gnas thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob/ nang du yang dag pa'i rtogs pa shar/ lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'dus/ rgya dkar nag la sogs pa'i rgyal po dregs myos kyi nga ro 'brug tu ldir ba mang pos gsung gi bdud rtsi len par 'dod nas spyan 'dren gyi pho nya btang / dbang phyug dang tshangs pa la skyabs su song zhing drang srong ser skya dang gzegs zan la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa/ rgya gar na rtsod pa'i ya ma rnyed pa 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa'i ston pa drug gis chos rje pa'i snyan pa thos pas phrag dog gi bsam pa rlung ltar langs te/ kho bo cag kha ba can gyi ljongs su phyin te/ de na gnas pa'i skye bo go'u ta ma'i dge sbyong du khas 'che ba bud med kyi brtul zhugs can lta ba dang spyod pa ngan pa la zhen pa de dag sun dbyung nas rang cag gi brtul zhugs 'dzin 144

bstan dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyus yongs 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhe bya ba bzhugs so//du gzhug go zhes bgros te 'ongs pa na/ chos kyi rje smra ba'i seng ges ral pa can rkang pa brgyad dang ldan pa de re re nas sun phyung ste mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la bkod/ ral pa'i khur bregs nas nyid kyi thad du rab tu byung ste/ de lta bu'i grags dkar mi nub pa'i phyir ral pa rnams da lta'i bar du dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang gi ka rgyan du btags/ spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi g.yo ba la sogs pa yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pas snyen la bstan/ dbugs dbyung / chos kyi sgo du ma gdams pa dang rjes su bstan/cung zad bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan pa na/ 'phags pa klu sgrub dang zhi ba lha la sogs pas bsnyun dris/ bsam yas kyi btsad po shākya mgon gyis chos 'khor la spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ rgyud kyi brtag nga gnyis pa'i le'u lnga pa yan gsungs/gsung ngag phal cher rdzogs pa'i tshe/ srin po ri pas dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur rgya chen po byed pa'i tshogs dbur spyan drangs pa na nyin bar byin rlabs dang man ngag 'ga' re gnang ba/ zhal ta zhu ba'i lan gnang dgos pa sogs kyi tho rangs bar mnal rgyu ma byung / de nas cung zad mnal pa na mi skya shar ba tshan gcig byung ste phyag 'tshal/ phyag rten re phul te gral la 'dug nas gral mgo ma na re/ chos sno pa sems can thams cad skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo chen po bzhis nyam thag par mi gda'i zer/ de bzhin 'dug gsungs pas/ 'o na de la phan pa'i smon lam 'dra bdog gi zer/ skye ba skye ba med pa'i tshul rtogs kyang / /da dung skye ba'i gzeb las bdag ma grol/ /skye ba kun tu skye bor skye 'gyur ba'i/ /skye ngan bdag gis skye ba'i skyabs mdzod cig /ces pas la gsol ba thob gsungs/145

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()'o na na ba la sogs pa la'ang de bzhin sbyar bas 'chi bar mi gda'am zer/ go 'dug snyam ste de bzhin byas pas 'ong bar 'dug gsungs pas/ thugs la btags zer nas phyag re btsal te song bar rmis/ mnal sad nas bsamasapas bsam yas kyi rgyal po bhe ha ra 'khor bcas yin par go ste de bzhin 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/ des na da lta'i bar du rgyal po 'dis sa skya pa rnams kyi phrin las sgrub cing bka' nyan pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ yang hor gyi rgyal po go dan gyis spyan drangs te/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum pa/ 'phags pa dgung lo bcu bas blo/pa/ dbu su sa paṇa la rab tu byung /phyag na dgung lo dgu bzhes pa gnyibasazhabs 'bring byas te slob ma'i tshogs rags la mang bas mdun bdar te chas pa na/ bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyis khyed la mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan ci mnga' ba zhig mi 'chab par snying gtam gyi tshul du gsung bar zhu/gzhan yang hor 'di la khyed kyis phan thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan e bdog ces zhus pa'i lan du bdag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mos gus phyin ci ma log pa yod/gsung rab kyi don la go ba cung zad mchis/ mngon par rtogs pa rgyud la skyesapa tsam ni chen po mi bdog hor 'dis nged la mchod gnas la cis kyang shogam 'ong na dmag 'ong zer nas dmag byung na bod la gnod kyis dogs nas 'gro ba lags/ phan du re nas 'gro ba ma gtogs phan nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ma mchis/ lar sems can la phan na rang gi lus srog gtong ba la mi phod rgyu mi bdog pa tsam da lta shes pa la gda' zhes gsungs te/ chos kyi don du srog gtong ba sa dang po mthong ba'i lam thob pa'i rtags yin pas sar gnas kyi 146

bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi lo rgyu yong 'du'i me tog gsar pa'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'phags par zhal gyis 'ches pa yin/ hor la phan thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan mi bdog gsungs pa yang khengs bskyungs pa tsam ste/ gzhan yang rje btsun chen po sku 'da' khar khyod kyi tshe'i mjug tu zhwa khra 'phur ba 'dra ba/ lham phag pa'i sna 'dra ba gyon pa'i skad rigs mi gcig pa'i yul nas spyan 'dren gyi pho nya 'ong bas de dus the tshom ma byed par song zhig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa'i 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'ong ngo / /zhes lung bstan pa thugs la bzhag nas byon pa yin/ de nas lam bar rnams su gdul bya skal ldan la dbang byin rlabs rgyud man ngag la sogs pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin pa'i ngang nas byon te drug cu rtsa lnga pa la rgyal po'i pho brang ling chu rtser khab tu rgyal po dang mjal/ chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ cung zad ma go ba rnams yo gur gyi ban+de mkhas pa rnams kyis mtshams sbyar nas gor bcug pas rgyal po yang shin tu mnyes te theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang blo sbyong la sogs pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos du ma gsan te mchod gnas dang bla ma kun gyi phud du bkur bar mdzad/ de nas bzung ste skad rigs mi gcig pa'i yul du chos la mi dad pa rnams dad par byas/ dad pa rnams theg pa chen po la bcug ste 'gro ba dpag tu med pa smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ rab tu byung ba'i dbu 'phang bstod de dmag khral las gsum las thar bar mdzad/ de nas rgyal po go dan la sha bkra'i nad byung ba'i rim gror chab gtor 'jam dpal ma mang du mdzad pas/ lug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi tho rangs mnal lam du mi 'theng pa lus thams cad rma dang shu bas gang ba zhig sa / khyod su yin dris pas/ nga la dpon
