brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()zhes bshad pa ltar/ 'das lo nas lo bzhi brgya lon (spyi la'i sngon gyi lo 1733)pa'i tshe bsdu ba gsum pa byung ba yin pas 'ad/ /'o na rab dbye las/ lha chen gyi chosalog sun phyung ba la bsdu ba gsum par bshad pa dang 'di ji ltar 'grig snyam na/mkhas pa kha cig bha byas bshad pa'i bdud sdig to can bzang po dang / rab dbye nas bshad pa'i lha chen gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su bzhed pa yang mkhas pa'i bshad pa yin mod/ kho bo ltar na/ 'das lo nas lo nyis brgya nas kun tu rgyu lha chen po zhes pa zhig rab tu byung ste/ des gzhi lnga rjes su bsgrags shing / mchod rten can gyi ri la gnas pas/ mchod rten ri pa zhesagrags zhes 'byung ba'i kun tu rgyu lha chen po dang / rab dbye nas bshad pa'i lha chen po gnyis gnad gcig gam snyam ste da dung dpyad par bya'o/ /'di skabs kyi gzhi lnga ni/ gzhan la lan gdab pa dang / mi shes pa dang / yid gnyis dang / yongs su brtag pa dang / bdag nyid gsos par byed rdzu dang kyi la pang se de/ ༷de lnga ni sde pa rnams gyes pa'i rtsod gzhir gyur pa chen pa yan ga /dro pa sematheg chen /gyi /bstan pa dar tshul ni/ rab dbye las/ de ni sh+ka thos rnams kyi yin/ /theg pa chen po'i bstan pa ni/ man tu dar bar gyur pa'i tshe / / zhes pa ltar/ bka' bsdu gsum pa yan chad ni/ nyan thos bstan pa shin tu dar ba yin la / theg chen gyi bstan pa ston pa 'das nas/ sde pa bco brgyad du gyes pa'i 'khrug long gi skabs su nub pa lta bur gyur pa'i tshe/ 'das lo nas 198

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam ra bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//lo sum brgya lon pa sa pho byi ba'i lor (sbyi phi sngon gyi lo 1833)bram ze chen po sa ra ha byon te/ theg chen gsang sngags kyi bstan pa gtso bor spel/ sa ra ha la che 'bring chung gsum yod pa'i 'di che ba ste grub thob brgyad cur grags pa'i spyi mes so//'dis lo stong dang brgyad brgya bzhugs par grags so// 'das lo nas lo bzhi brgya lon pa sa pho 'brug (spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 1733)nyan thos kyi bka' bsdu gsum pa mdzad pa'i lo de nyid la 'phags pa klu sgrub bltams/ 'dis sngon ma bsgrags pa'i seng ge'i nga ro lan gsum bsgrags te/ gtam tshogs su kun rdzob las 'bras kyi gnad bshad de med pa'i mtha' bsal/ rigs tshogasasu don dam rten 'brel stong nyid kyi gnad bshad de yod pa'i mtha' bsal/bstod tshogs su bden gnyis zung 'jug gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gnad bshad de theg chen dbu ma'i srol rgya cher bstod pa yin no/ /'di la slob ma thugs sras bzhi/ nye sras gsum/ sras kyi thu bo bzhi sogs yod pa las/ thugs sras bzhi ni/ 'jam dpal zhal mthong shākya mi tra/sgrol ma zhal gzigs na ga bo dhi/ sa brgyad non pa ār+ya de ba/ spyan ras gzigs zhal mthong ṭha)pa tang gi pa'o/ /nye sras gsum po ni/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ legs ldan 'byed/ slob dpon dpa' bo dang gsum mo/ /sras kyi thu bo bzhi ni/ sngar gyi shākya bshes gnyen/ 'phags pa lha/ klu'i byang chub gsum gyi steng du zla ba grags pa dang bzhi'o/ /gzhan yang rgyal sras zhi ba lha/ sha wa ri dbang phyug nag po pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'ang 'di'i slob ma dngos so//yang nye gnas gsum ni ār+ya de ba/ na gā bo dhi/ zhi ba lha gsum yin zer ba'ang 199

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()'dug 'di nyid bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po ni/ nā len+t+ra'i mkhan po bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin zhes pa zhig yin par rnam thar dang lo rgyus phal cher las 'byung la/ sgra gcan 'dzin de nyid sa ra ha yin par 'ga' zhig las bshad mod/grub thob kyi spyi mes sa ra ha chen po zhes pa yongs grags de nyid ni min par sems te/ de nyid slob dpon 'di 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug nas sku tshe sring ba po yin yang / de nyid las mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin logs su bshad pas so/ /bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin gyi mkhan po ni/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin yin la/ 'di nyid kun dga' bo dang na mnyam yin mod/ sku tshe dgung lo sum brgya skor bzhugs par gsal te/ mkhan bu sgra gcan 'dzin 'das lo nas lo bzhi brgya skor du byon pas so/ /rnam pa gcig tu na 'di sku 'das pa'i tshul ma bstan par gsal te gnas bcu'i nang tshan yin nga sa so/ /'o na zla grags klu sgrub kyi zhabs zin min par 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi dris lan las bshad pa min nam snyam na/ dris lan de nyid las brgyud pa'i slob ma lta bur bshad pa nas/ rang re sa skya pa phal cher zla grags/ klu sgrub kyi zhababakazin ma yin te/ klu sgrub ston pa'i 'das lo nas lo bzhi brgya nas byon nas lo drug brgya bzhugs/ thogs med lo dgu brgya nas byon nas lo brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs/ de'i sku tshe smad kyi slob ma dbyig gnyen yin pa las/ zla grags kyi dus dbyig gnyen la sogs pa yang 'das zin nas mi bzhugs par bshad pa las shes kha pa'i phyir te/ 'jug pa rang 'grel las/ gal te gnas brtan dbyig gnyen dang chos skyong la sogs pas bstan bcos rnams kyi mdzad pa po byon zin 200

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// par gyur pa de dag gis kyang zhes sogs bshad pas so/ /zhes sogs sgrub byed lung rigs mang dag mdzad na'ang kho bo ni zla grags klu sgrub kyi zhabs zin yin pa ra sems te/ gsang 'dus sgron gsal las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rim gnyisaganas kyi rgyas btab de ni klu sgrub las rnyed pa/ khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpar btud de zla ba grags pas rim bzhin bshad ces dang / paṇ+ḍita skal ldan grags pas/ de ni dpal ldan klu sgrub las rnyed pa/ /zhes smos te/ de ni dpal ldan klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyi dngos kyi slob ma nyid du so sor ston gyi brgyud pas ni ma yin no zhes sogs bshad cing / do ha mdzod kyi ṭī ka 'ga' zhig las kyang zla grags kyis klu sgrub las man ngag dngos su thob cing mthar klu sgrub kyi dbu sbyin par btang nas bde ba can du gshegs pa'i tshe/ nā ga bo dhi/ā r+ya de ba/ zla grags gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ sku ci 'dra ba'i 'od kyi lus gcig snang bar byas nas/gar yang ma rtogs cir yang ma sems par//bcas bcos med pa'i rang bzhin rnal mar zhog /ma bcos skye med rang rig byang chub sems/ /de ltar rtogs na sangs rgyas de rang yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gdams pa gnang zhes sogs dang / de'i tshe ār+ya de bas/ 'gro'o ār+ya de ba 'gro/ /'od lus dag pa'i zhing du 'gro/ /song zhig nā ga bo dhi song / /ri bya rkang can du 'phur te song / /song zhig zla ba grags pa so/ / /dpal gyi ri la rtog med song / /zhes sogs gsungs shing / zla ba grags pas kyang / chad do zla ba grags pa chad/ /klu sgrub gshegs pas lam mkhan rgyun thag chad/ /ma bcos skye med chos kyi rgyun thag chad/ /yid la mi byed chos kyi rgyun thag chad/ /ces 201

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()smras nas dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi ri la bzhugs/ zhes sogs bshad paba'iso / / 'o na gong gi sgrub byed de la lan ji ltar snyam na/ kho bo ni gong du bshad pa ltar klu sgrub kyi dbu sbyin par gtong gong du lo drug brgya las ma bzhugs kyang /mthar dbu dang sku lus 'byar nas yun ring du bzhugs sam snyam ste/ dbu sbyin par gtong ba'i tshe/ nga ni bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du/ /song nas lus 'di ldoyang 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes dbu bcad pa'i mtshams nas tshigs bcad de ltar byung zhes pa ltar/ mthar dbu dang sku lus 'grig ste/ 'gro don mdzad pa las shes pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i rnam thar mi gcig pa kha re mthong yang mngasabs ma bris so/ /slob dpon 'di byon pa'i sa pho byi ba nas/ da lta'i shing pho byi lo 'di ni/ lo sum stong nyis brgya go drug 'das pa'i go brgyad (bdun )pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de ni dbu ma'i srol phye tshul yin la/ rnam rig pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i tshul ni/ rab dbye las/ nyi ma sgrub pa'i mu stegs byed/ /sprang po nyi ma'i dngos grub kyis/ /gtsug lag khang rnams bsregs pa'i tshe/ /dam chosamangon pa la sogs pa'i/ /sde stod phal cher bsregs zhes grags/ /de nasa'aphags pa thogs med kyis/ /mi pham mgon la gsan nas ni/ /de yi gzhung lugs dar bar mdzad/ /ces pa ltar/ 'phags pa klu sgrub byon pa'i rjes de tsam nas/ chos mngon pa la dgra lan gsum dar ba'i dang po/ mu stegs kyi rgan mos nang pa'i gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra la brtags pas/ lha klu gnod sbyin sogs kyisamachod pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi rtog sde 'di brdungs pas mu stegs 'chal ba'i klad pa 'gems zhes pa zhig 'byung bar shes nas mu stegs kyis dmag 202

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes byab bzhugs so//drangs nas bsnubs/ gnyis pa ni/ yul dbus kyi rgyal pos/ stag gzig gi rgyal po la ras kyi na bza' srubs med pa snying gar rkang rjes 'dra ba yod pa zhig skyes su bskur bas/ ngan sngags byas so zhes stag gzig gis dmag drangs nas bsnubs/ gsum pa ldan/ mu stegs kyi sprang po gnyis la bkru chu gtor bas kho zhabrugs te/ lo dgu dong du nyi ma bsgrubs nas sprang po nyi ma dngos grub ces grags pa des mig nas nyi ma'i 'od zer bkye nas gtsug lag khang rnams bsregs na ba'i bsnubs/ de'i tshe gsang ba 'dus pa'i glegs bam las chu byung ste me shi bar byas so zhes dang / klu sgrub kyis 'bum klu yul du gdan drangs nas bros so zhes kyang grags so/ /de nas 'das lo nas lo dgu brgya lon pa sa pho byi ba'i lor (spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 1223)bram ze ma gsal ba'i tshul khrims zhes pas/ rgyal rigs dang 'dus pa las 'phags pa 11: na tha/med sku bltams te/ lo bcu gnyis su byams pa bsgrub pas/ chos rgyun ting nge 'dzin las byams pa sprul sku'i zhal mthong ste/ dga' ldan du zhal gyi bdud rtsi ngoms par 'thung / slar byams pa longs sku'i zhal mthong ste bden pa mngon sum du gzigs/ sa sde lnga dang sdom rnam gnyis la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mang du brtsams/ lta ba rnam rig gi srol phye ste theg chen gyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad cing / de'i slob ma'i gtso bo bram ze ma gsal ba'i tshul khrims bram ze dang 'dus pa las gcings pa'i gcung dbyig gnyen te/ thog mar kha cher kha che 'dus bzang la brten te bye smra ba'i lugs srol la sbyangs shing / phyis gcen thogs med las theg chen gyi bka' sde sdod gsan pa de'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni/203

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byurig ces bsdus/(྅/phar phyin rang las mkhas pa 'phags pa 11la sde/ tshad ma rang las mkhas pa slob dpon phyogs glang / mngon pa rang las mkhas pa slob dpon blo brtan/'dul ba rang las mkhas pa slob dpon yon tan 'od dang bzhi'o/ /des na/thogs med byon pa'i sa pho byi ba nas nyis stong bdun brgya go bdun 'das pa'i go brgyad pa ni da lta'i shing pho byi lo 'di'o/ /'dis lo brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugasaso / / 'das lo nas lo stong dang lnga brgya gya dgu 'das pa'i dgu bcu pa me mo sprul la (spyi la'i sngon gyi lo 543)mtho btsun grub rje mched kyis bzhengs pa'i rdo rje gdan gyi mahā bo dhi byon/ me sprul de nas nyis stong brgya dang brgyad lon pa ni chu mo phag lo 'di'o/ khyim bdag ma hā pa la'i bu chung bas bzhengs pa'i ga smyo la'i nang gi mahā bo dhi ni 'di'i gong du byon zhes bshad zin to/ /'das lo nas lo stong dang brgyad brgya nyer dgu 'das pa'i sum cu pa me mo sprul la (spyi la'i sngon gyi lo 303)gnas brtan cho me skyong dpal ldan bi rā pa byon/ khong gi don gnyis lon pa sa pho 'brug gi sa ga zla ba'i nyer gsum la bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste sa dang po brnyes/ nyer dgu'i dgong sa drug pa brnyes so/ /brtul zhugs kyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad cing / slob ma'i gtso bo shar phyogs nag po pa la gsung ngag rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi sgo nas skal dman rim 'jug pa'i lam bzang dang / ḍo sdi pa la spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi sgo nas skal ldan gcig char ba'i lam bzang bstan pa'i sgo nas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad/ bi rū pa byon pa'i me sbrul nas lo stong dang brgyad brgya re brgyad pa ni shing byi 'di'o//204

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//birlu pa 'di nyid su wa na tha'i rdo'i sku la thim nas da lta yang skal ldan dang dngos su mjal ba'i skabs yod kyi sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul ni ma bstan to/ /'das lo nas lo nyis stong bzhi brgya sum cu 'das pa'i so gcig pa sa pho rta la (spyi lo 298)zla grags byon/ khong gis lo lnga brgya bzhugs/ sa pho rta de nas da bar lo stong dang nyis brgya re bdun no/ /'das lo nas nyis stong brgya dang gya lnga pa chu pho 'brug la (sbyi lo'i sngon gyi 252)rigs pa'i khu byug byon/ chu 'brug de nasabargyad brgya dang bcu gsum mo/ /'dis lo sum brgya bzhugs/ khong gis zhe drug lon pa'i tshe zla ba grags pa 'das zer ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi ngo mtshar snang ba'i kha skong na yod/ 'das lo nas sum stong brgyad cu rtsa brgyad 'das pa'i rtsa dgu pa me pho 'brug la (spyi lo 956)nā ro pa bltams/ me 'brug de nas drug brgya dang dgu'o/ khong gis brgyad cu rtsa lnga bzhugs te tshe bcu'i dgong gling bu'i sgra di ri ri (ga pa dang bcas na dag pa'i zhing du gshegs kyi sku lus spangs pa ni min no / / 'das lo nas sum stong brgya dang nyer bdun pa shing pho rta la (spyi lo 994)dpal ldan a ti sha byon/ shing rta de nas lnga brgya dang don gcig pa ni shing byi 'di'o/ khong gis don gsum bzhugs pa'i re gcig pa shing pho rta la bod du byon/ lo bcu gsum bzhugs nas chu pho rta'i tshes bco brgyad la sku gshegs so/ /jo bo rje'i dgung zla sogs la'ang mi mthun pa mang dag 'dug kyang 'dir dus gsal sor bzhag pa yin la/ zla grags byon pa'i mtshams kyang / klu sgrub byon pa'i mtshams dang lo nyis stong sum cu tsam gyi ha cang bar khyad zhugs pa 'di yang dus gsal sor bzhag pa yin gyi nges pa rnyed pa'i lung 205

rngo ni me bye she snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()—gas med nyis kā bo/da gangs can du bstan pa dar tshul ni/ rab dbye las/ phyi nas gangs ri'i khrod 'di rtswa /sangs rgyas bstan pa legs par bsgyur/ /de nas bstan pa dar ba'i tshe/ /zhes pa'i rdo rje'i tshig 'di nyid cung zad bkrol na/'o na bod gangs can du bstan pa dar ba 'di/ rgyal po su zhig gi ngo la lo paṇa ji lta bu'i bka' drin las dus nam gyi tshe tshul ji ltar dar snyam na 'di la gnyis/ bstan pa snga dar byung ba'i tshul dang / phyi dar byung ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la yang gsum/ bstan pa dbu brnyes pa'i tshul/ bstan pa srol gtod pa'i tshul/bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ spyir bod kyi rgyal rabs la rje btsun rin po che grags pas/bod kyi rgyal po khri bdun steng gcig 'a nyi)dang //legs drug lde brgyad btsan bzhi zhes bya ste//nyi shu rtsa drug sngon gyi rgyal po yin//zhes pa ltar bod kyi rgyal po'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas/ gnam ri srong btsan gyi bar rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa drug gi bar la rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i ming tsam yang ma byung la/ khri bdun pa gri gum btsan po'i ngo la bon gyi bstan pa dar nasarim par byung ngo / /'o na gnya' khri btsan po de dus nam gyi tshe/ rigs gang las byung snyam na/ 'di la bod spyi'i mi rigs kyang bod kyi gtam las spre'u dang brag srin mo las chad par bshad mod/ lha las phul byung gi bstod 'grel las/skyabs seng bu lnga dang dgra ngan dpung tshogs bco brgyad 9stoganyis )ri thab pa'i dus su/ rgyal po ru pa ti zhes pa dmag stong phrag gcig dang bcas pa bud med kyi chas su zhugs te ri gangs can gyi gseb tu bros pa las 'phel bar bshad 206

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//la / de'ang skya ses bu lnga ni/ g.yul ngor brtan pa/ 'jig sde/ srid sgrub/ lhar bcas/ ba gu la dang lnga yin zhing / dgra ngan ni/ skya seng gi phu bo yul 'khor srung gi bu 'thab dga' la sogs brgya'o/ /de dag ni rtsod dus kyi mgo 'dzugs ( lus)pa'i dus byon pa yin mod/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis/ rgyal po skya seng bcom ldan 'das kyi dus su byon pas/ bod kyi mi yang de tsam nas 'phel zhes bshad pa ni ma brtags pa kho na ste/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa byon pa dang dus mnyam du'ang / skya seng gi bu mo sgrol ma sogs skya seng gi rigs kyi rgyal po sras bcas yod kyang / de dang dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcom pa'i skya seng don mi gcig ste/ skya seng 'di ni rgyas pa'i bu yul 'khor srung dang skya seng dang blo ldan gsum gyis zlas phye ba yin pas/ thog mtshungs pa'i skabs med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bod kyi rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po/ dgra ngan gyi rigs yin par 'dod pa'i lugs gcig dang / ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi sras lnga tshigs yin zer ba dang / rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i sras chung ba stobs chung gi sras lnga tshigs yin zer ba dang / bad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed kyi sras mig mas 'gebs pa sor mo dra bas 'brel ba zhig byung bas skrag ste zangs kha sbyor du bcug ste gang ga la bskyur ba zhid pas rnyed de gsos/ cher skyes pa na sngar gyi gtam bshad rbo na yid skyo ste gangs ri'i brag tu bros pa na/ rim gyis lha ri yol ba'i khar byung ste/ btsan thang sgo bzhir thon pa las/ bon po rnams rmu thag las byon pas lha yin zer/ khyed su yin dris pas btsan po yin zer/ gang nas byon dris pas nam mkha' la mdzub mo sgreng zhing / de shing gi khri la bzhag ste 207

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()mi bzhis gnya' ba la khur bas gnya' khri btsan por btags zer ba'i lugs dang / kha cig shākya'i rgyal brgyud las chad pa yin zer ba sogs lugs mang dag yod cing / gang na'ang gnya' khri btsan po byon pa'i dus tshod ni/ 'das lo nas lo stong dang brgyad brgya nyi shu 'das pa'i nyer gcig pa sa pho sprel lor (spyi lo'i sngon gyi lo 313)gnya' khri btsan po byon pa yin la/ gnya' khri byon pa'i sa sprel nas da lta'i shing pho byi ba 'di stong dang brgyad brgya don drug 'das pa'i don bdun pa yin no zhes bshad par bya'o/ /de nas gnya' khri btsan po/ mu khri btsan po/ deng khri/ so khri/ me khri/ gdags khri/ gri gum btsan po dang bdun laganam gyi khri bdun zer/ tha ma'i sras spu lde gung rgyal ni bar gyi sde gcig yin zer/ de nas a lha legs/ i lha/ legs/ de lha/ kha legs/ gu rub legs/'brom rje legs/ tho sho legs drug la sa'i legs drug zer/ lde rmu gu/ lde rnol nas/ lde /rnyi po/ lde zeng snol nam/ lde smon lam/ lde rgyal po brgyad la rdziganyis ma ṭ+wāṃ ༵ zlo/ ṭā bye///khri sgra gzungs btsan/ khri thog rje thog btsan bzhi la yos gcig ma tshang)btsan bzhi khu btsun grag pa'i rgyal rabs nang /lde mnam/'brul po gzhung btsan/sto men bum/sto rnol nam/lde snol po/snga rtse snol nam/lde rtse rnal so/lde rgyal po ste lde brgyad/rgyal tho lo btsan/khri btsan nam/khri sgra yung btsan/khri thog rje thog btsan te btsan bzhi'o/ /zhesagasal/dpe sgrig pas)ger te de ltar yang grags pas/ 'on kyang mi rje lhas mdzad gdung rabs ni/ /nyi shu drug la drug brgya drug cu thal/ /zhes pa ltar gyi gdung rabs nyer drug gi ngo la lo grangs drug brgya drug cu song ste de'i bar la bod du 208

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bstan pa ma byung zhes shes par bya'o/ /'o na dus nam gyi tshe dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes snyam na/ rje btsun (grags)pas/ skyid pa'i gdung rabs byed dang bcu dag dang / /shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bzhi/ /de ltar gdung rabasabazhi bcu tham pa ste/ /'di yis bod khams spyi yi skyid de 'khor/ /zhes pa ltar gyi skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu'i dang po/lha tho tho ri snyan btsan gyi sku ngo la chos kyi dbu brnyes zhes bya ste/ de yang 'das lo nas nyis stong bzhi brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa'ang (spyi lo 348)gnya' khri byon nas drug brgya dang re gcig pa sa pho sprel lor tho tho ri khong bltams/ khong gi nga dgu lon pa yan la chos kyi ming tsam yang med pa la/ khong gi drug cu lon pa 'das lo nas nyis stong lnga brgya dang so dgu 'das pa'i bzhi bcu pa me mo lug gi lor (spyi lo 407)rgyal po pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi rtse na bzhugs pa'i tshe nam mkha' nas za ma tog cig babs pa kha phye bas/ za ma tog bkod pa/ pang kong phyag brgya pa/ yi ge drug pa/ gser gyi mchod rten khru gang pa rnams byung ste/ ming gnyan po gsang bar btags nas mchod pas dam pa'i chos kyi gangs can gyi 'gro la brtse ba'i byin rlabs dang nus pas rgyal po lo re gcig par 'gro rgyu/ nga dgu par log ste lo re bzhin gzhen du song nas lo bcu drug par gyur te/ lus rten gcig la sku tshe gnyis bzhes kun dril lo brgya nyi shu bzhugs so/ /gdung rabs lnga nas 'di'i don shes par 'gyur ro zhes rmi lam du lung bstan/ de ltar tho tho ri snyan btsan/ khri snyan gzungs btsan/ 'bro snyan sde sa stag ru gnyan gzigs/ gnam ri srong btsan te lnga'i ring la/ dam pa'i 209

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()chos kyi glegs bam byung zhing / gnyan po gsang ba la mchod pa tsam byung bas/chos kyi dbu brnyes pa'i gdung rabs zhes bya ste/ lha mo dri ma med lung bstan pa las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa de 'di tsam la dgongs so zhes shes dgos so/ /deb sngon du grags pa las/ rnal pa paṇ+ḍita na re/ nam mkha' las babs zer ba bon po nam mkha' la dga' bas bon gtam yin gyi/ don la paṇ+ḍita blo sems 'tsho dang / lo tsā ba le the ses chos de gnyis khyer nas 'ongs pa la/ rgyal pos yi ge yang mi shes/ don yang mi go bsapaṇ+ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba phyir log zer ba 'di dag pa 'dra ste/ dus phyis rba gsal snang gis bal por phyin mkhan po zhi 'tsho dang mjal ba'i tshe/ mkhan po'i gsung las/ bod kyi btsan po dang khyod dang / nga dang gsum gyis 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la bya rdzi ma'i bu gsum du gyur nas bod du bstan pa spel ba'i smon lam btab pa yin te/ btsan po yang ma skyes khyod kyang nar ma son pas ngas 'di na rgyal rabs dgu'i bar sgug cing bsdad pa yin gsungs pa/ rba bzhed gtsang ma na snang ba'i phyir zhes bshad 'dug pa ltar/ don la'ang gnas sam snyam ste da dung brtag go /gang ltar yang bod du bstan pa snga dar gyi dbu brnyes nas da lta'i byi lo 'di'i bar la stong dang brgya lnga brgya rtsa brgyad do/ /de ltar lha tho tho ri bltams pa nas/ gnam ri srong btsan gyi sras srong btsan sgam po bltams pa yan gyi gdung rabs lnga'i ring la lo nyis brgya dang re dgu song 'dug pas/ rje btsun (grags)pas/ chos dbu brnyes nas rgyal rabs lnga yi bar/ /lo grangs210

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar ba dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// brgya dang lnga bcu thal zhes zer/ /zhes yi ge'i skyon kho nar zad de/ lha tho tho ris kyang lo brgya nyi shu bzhugs na/ de man gyi rgyal rabs bzhi bsdoms pas lo sum cu tsam las ma bzhugs par bsgrub mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa srol gtod pa ni/ rgyal po srong btsan sgom po nas yin te/de yang 'das lo nas lo nyis stong dang bdun brgya dang zhe dgu 'das pa'i lnga bcu pa me mo glang (spyi lo617)srong btsan sgam po bltams/ me glang 'di nas da bar la dgu brgya dang zhe brgyad lon/ me glang 'di gnya' khri btsan po byon nas dgu brgya sum cu pa dang / snga dar gyi me mo lug nas nyis brgya bcu gcig pa yin no/ /des na 'dis bstan pa'i srol btod tshul la gsum/ rten byon pa'i tshul/ lo paṇa byon pa'i tshul/ chos ji ltar dar ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgyal po 'dis lo bcu gsum pa la rgyal srid bzung / bco lnga pa la sprul pa'i dge slong ā ka ra ma ti shī las/ sing ga gling gi rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas tsan+dan sprul snying las rang byon gyi spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu zhal bcu gcig pa dang /rgya bod mtshams kyi nags khrod nas tsan+dan ha ri'i sdong po las rang byon mched bzhi byon pa'i/ che ba wa ti skyid grong mang yul na bzhugs/ gnyis pa dbu gang yam khu/ ya 'ag75 na bsdo kyi nas/gsum pa rdza ma li rgya bal mtshams na bzhugs/ bzhi pa bod du rgyal po'i thugs dam la spyan drangs so/ khong gis bco brgyad pa shing pho rta la/ bal mo bza' khri btsun/ rgyal po kri kri'i thugs dam rten )byams pa chos 'khor ma dang / jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje/ rang byon sgrol ma ste/ rten gsum dang bcas pa spyan 211

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()drangs/ mi bskyod rdo rje tshe lo nyi khri pa'i dus/ ma 'ongs shākya thub pa lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad du/ rgyal po kri kris bzhengs/ rab gnas sangs rgyas 'od srungasakyis mdzad zer/ da lta ra mo che na bzhugs so/ khong gi nyi shu pa me pho sprel lor rgya mo kong jo jo bo shākya mu yi dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ nyer gsum pa sa mo phag lo ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa yin te/ de yang de'i snga lo khyi'i lo la 'o thang gi mtsho bsubs/ phag lo 'gram la zhag drug shing bzo la zhag bzhi/ thog la zhag gnyis te zhag bcu gnyis kyi khongs su lha sa'i 'og thog rgyal po'i sprul pa'i bzo bos bzhengs/ steng thog bal bzo bas zla ba brgyaganyis la tshar/ de dang dus mtshungs su rgya mos ra mo che dang / rgyal pos mtha' bzheng yaX 'dul ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ba ngas ///ga/sal las/ rgyal po'i nyer lnga pa lcags mo glang la jo bo shākya mu yi byon gsung pa 'dug ra mo che nas 'phrul snang du byon pa lta bu zhig lags sam/bod du ni de gong du byon tshar ba lags so/ /'di lta bu'i jo bo shākya 'di ni/ ston pas lo zhe gcig pa sa pho sprel lo sum cu rtsa gsum du dbyar gnas la bzhugasapa'i tshe/ rgyu lha'i rin po che las/ sbyin bdag lha dbang brgya byin gyis byas/ bzo bo bi shwa na mes byas te/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa'i sku tshad du bzhengs/ rten 'di nyid lha yul/ rgya gar/ u rgyan sogs su'ang lo mang dag bzhugs nas/ rgya gar rgyal po dharma pā las rgya nag rgyal po sri ta bi dza ya la skyes su bskur te lo lnga brgya bzhugs/ 'das lo nas nyis stong bdun brgya dang drug cu rtsa dgu pa me pho sprel 2/2

ba na rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//lor (spyi lo636)bod du byon/de nas da bar dgu brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu lon no// gnyis pa lo paṇa byon chul ni/ de'i tshe thon mi a nu'i bu thon mi sa sto ṭa g.yog bcu drug dang bcas pa rgya gar du brdzangs/ bram ze li byin la yi ge dang /pa ṇ+ḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge la sgra bslabs te/ bod du yi ge'i bstan bcos sum cu pa dang / rtags 'jug sogs brgyad brtsams te/ yi ge sogs yon tan gyi gzhi bting / za ma tog bkod pa dang / pad+ma dkar po/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog rgyal po mdo lnga/ pang kong phyag brgya pa/ dkon mchog sprin sogs mang du bsgyur to/ /gzhan yang lha lung rdo rje dpal dang / rgya gar gyi slob dpon ku sa la dgu / bal dziX slob dpon shī la mañdzu dang / rgya nag slob dpon ha shang ma hā de ba ga /shā ṭ+wāṃ/ cho/sa ni/ theg chen gyi bstan pa la sgom sgrub gtso bor mdzad cing / gtan khrims lnga bcas/ bshad pa'i sgo yang cung zad dod pa tsam mo de ltar yang grags pas/ srong btsan sgam po me mo glang la 'khrungs/ spyan rasagazigs de bcu gsum lon nas yab 'das nas chab srid lo grangs drug cu dgur bzung ste spyir lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis na/ 'phrul snang bcu gcig zhal la thim mo skad/ ces sogs bshad pa ltar/ brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa la mdzad pa rdzogs shing / thugs rje chen po'i sprul par grags so/ /des na srong btsan sgam po/ gung srong gung btsan/ mang srong mang btsan/'dus srong mang po rje/ khri lde gtsug brtan lnga ni/ chos kyi srol gtod pa'i gdung rabs zhes bya ste/ gung srong yab kyi sngon la gshegs pa ba'i phyed du byas nas/ tho 213

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()tho ri sogs lnga dang bsdoms pas/ skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu zhesabashad pa de dag yin no/ /gsum pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i dus ni/ chos rgyal khyisgong lde btsan nas yin te/ 'di la yang gsum/ gtsug lag khang dang rten lobya ba byas tshul/ lo paṇa bshes gnyen bsten tshul/ dam chos bshad sgrub daratshul lo/ /dang po sna/ gung srong gi sras mang srong gi ngo la/ rgya dmag bod la'adren zer bas 'jigs te/ jo bo rin po che ra mo che nas 'phrul snang gi lho sgome long can du gdan drangs te/ sgo la zhal ba byas nas/ 'jam dbyangs kyi snubartan bris nas bzhugs su gsol te/ gdung rabs gsum gyi ngo la mun khang du bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe 'dus srong gi sras khri lde gtsug brtan mes ag tshomagrags pa de la/ sras ljang tsha lha dbon zhes pa mtshar ba zhig yod pas/ de 'a(rgya mo gyim shang zhes pa zhig btsun mor blangs pa sras ljang tsha grongs nas me ag tshom gyis khab tu blangs/ kong jo des jo bo lho sgo nas bton nas 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang dbus mar bzhugs su gsol/ kong jo dang mes agatshom gyi 'tshims khri thog rje thang la 'bar sras khri srong lde btsan 'das lo na nyis stong brgyad brgya re gnyis 'das pa'i re gsum (spyi lo 730)pa'am/ srong btsan sgam po byon pa'i me glang nas brgya dang bcu bzhi pa lcags pho rta (sbyi tho730)la 'brungs/ khong rang gi bcu gsum pa la yab 'das te khong nar ma son pa'i tshe chos la mi dga' ba'i bdud blon co ro skyes pa rgyal song ma zhang grom paskyes dang gsum gyis shākya mu ne rgya yul du skyel bar brtsams pa mi sum brgya ma theg par bye thems su sbas/ lha sar bshas ra byas/ mkhar brag dang mgrin214

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//bzang gnyis bshig chos rnams sbas shing bcugs pa sogs byas te chos khrims bshig par brtsam ste/ de'i tshe mtshims khri thog rje rgyal gas nas shi ba/co ro skam nas shi ba sogs byung nas/ lha sbas pas lan zer nas/ dre'u gnyisakyi btegs nas lha shākya mu de skyid grong du bskyal te lo bcu gsum skyid grong du bzhugs 'dug jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje shar phyogs ra mo'i thang la bskyal nas zhag bdun lus/ slar ra mo cher bzhugs su gsol/ de nas rgyal po sku nar son nas/ mgos rgan sogs kyi grogs byas te ma zhang gson dur du bcugastag ra klu gong byang la sprugs/ jo bo skyid grong nas gdan drangs nas lha sa'i gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol/ de nas rba gsal snang gis mkhan po bo dhi sa twa spyan drangs nas/ pho brang rlung tshubs su zla ba bzhir kha che ā nan+da sa lo tsā byas nas/ rgyal pos dge ba bcu/ khams bco brgyad sogs kyi chos gsan/rgyal po lo nyi shu lon pa tsam gyi tshe yin par sems/ mkhan po 'di/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po'i bla ma rnam snang mdzad bzang po dang don gcig cing / sku tshe shin tu ring ba zhig yin/ de rjes bod kyi lha ma srin 'dul ba sogs la u rgyan pad+ma saṃ bha wa spyan drangs pa yin te/ rgyal po'i nyer gcig pa tsam la mjal bar sems/ spyir u rgyan pa 'di/ ston pa shākya thub pa bltams pa'i phyi lo sa mo sprul la sku bltams nas bod yul du 'das lo nas nyis stong brgyad brgya gya gnyis pa sa mo glang (spyi lo 749)rgyal po lo nyi shu lon pa la byon/ deng sang yang srin po'i kha gnon la bzhugs so/ /rgyal pos lo nyer gnyis lon pa lcags mo yos kyi lor dpal bsam yas kyi 'gram bting ste/ sa chog pad+ma sam+bha wa dang /215

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/lta'o/sa dpyad bo dhi sa twas mdzad/ o ṭa pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs te|ri rab gling bcu gnyis nyi zla zung lcags ri dang bcas pa'i bkod pa mdzad/ 4 6skor gcig song ba'i chu mo yos la rdzogs par grub ste/ mkhas grub de gnyis kyis rab gnas mdzad do/ /de ltar na 'das lo nas nyis stong brgyad brgya dang gya bzhi pa lcags mo yos (spyi lo 751)la bsam yas kyi 'gram bting / lo de nabasabargyad brgya dang bcu bzhi pa dang / khri srong lde btsan bltams pa'i lcags pho snyanas brgyad brgya dang so lnga pa ni da lta'i shing pho byi lo 'di yin no/ /dus gsayore'u mig na bsam yas bzhengs pa'i phyi lo chu pho 'brug la pad+ma bod du byon par bshad pa ni snga phyi go nor te/ bsam yas kyi sa chog pad+mas mdzad pas so/ ༈rgyal pos nyer drug lon pa/ 'das lo nas nyis stong brgyad brgya gya brgyad tso shing mo lug (spyi lo 755)la sad mi bdun rab tu byung ste/ bod la btsun tsabatub mi btub sad pa'i phyir mdzad de/ de phyin chad bod gangs can du rathobyung 'dul ba'i las kyi bstan pa'i srol ches dar ba yin no/ /de yang de'i tshethams cad yod smra ba'i dge slong bcu gnyis spyan drangs te/ mkhan po bo dhi satwadang / las gsang gi slob dpon ni/ dzi na mi tra dang / da na shī la yin zhing sadami bdun ni/ dba' mañdzu shrī/ gtsang khru len+d+ra/ bran ka mu ti ka ste rgan gsum/mkhan po nā leṇ+ḍa/ pa gor be+e ro tsa na/ me a tsar+ya rin chen mchog ste gzhes gsum/ bar pa glang ka na na rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ye shes dbang po dang bdun no / / yang 'ga' zhig las sba sang shi'i bu rat+na/ 'tshims a nu'i bu shākya sra ba/pa gor rat+na'i bu be+e ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ rma a tsar+ya rin2/6

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed cig bsam rab nga kar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//chen mchog 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba/ gtsang legs grub dang bdun la ngos bzung 'dug rgyal po 'di nga drug pa shing mo glang la gshegs/ 'das lo nas nyis stong dgu brgya dang so brgyad 'das pa'i so dgu pa me pho khyi (spyi lo 806)la mnga' bdag khri ral pa can bltams/ bcu gnyis pa la yab 'das nas rgyal srid bzung / 'on 'chang rdo dpe med kyi gtsug lag khang rgya phibs dang dgu thog mas gtsos pa'i gtsug lag khang stong rtsa gnyis bzhengs/ de yang khong gis bzhengs pa'i lha khang rnams tshang ma tshang 9bar rtsis na nyang stod rtsis kyi lha khang /gnas rnying gi lha khang / rtsi'i lag mas bzhengs kha pas lhag chung lha khang / thams(cad kyi rting la bzhengs pas rting nga lha khang zhes sogs bzhengs/ de dag gi rab gnas pad+ma'i dngos slob rgya 'jam dpal gsang bas mdzad/ rab tu byung ba re re la 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun phul/ dbu thod gdan du bting / mdo sngags kyi sde chen po gnyis btsugs te bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel/ rgya la dmag drangs te bcom/ dbon shad 'dum byas pa'i yi ge rdo la bris/ 'dzam gling sum gnyis la mnga' bsgyur/ khong gis bcu bdun pa chu pho stag la bstan rtsis chen po mdzad/ chu pho stag lo de ni/ 'das lo nas nyis stong dgu brgya dang nga bzhi 'das pa'i nga lnga (spyi lo 822)yin par rtse mos chos la 'jug pa'i sgor bshad pa ltar yin la/ khong gi so lnga pa lcags pho sprel lo'i bar bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher bstsal te so drug pa lcags mo bya la gshegs so/ /des na da lta'i shing pho byi lo 'di/ ral pa can bltams pa'i me khyi nas bdun brgya dang nga dgu pa dang / ral can gyis bstan rtsis mdzad pa'i chu pho stag nas/ bdun brgya dang 217

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()zhe gsum pa yin zhing / de ltar na khri thong lde btsan/ mu yi btsan po/ gcung khri lde srong btsan/ khri ral pa can te bzhi las mu rne btsan pos rgyal srid lo gcig zla ba dgu bgyis te yum gyis bkrongs pas phyed du byas nas/ shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bzhi zhes bya ste/ de bzhi'i ring la dam pa'i chos shin tu dar zhing 'gro la bde skyid cher byung ba yin no/ /'di'i skabs su rje btsun pas/de yi bar la dgu bcu go dgu sa /dam chos shin tu dar te skyid pa'i rabs /zhes bshad kyang / zhib tu rtsis na khri srong lde btsan byon nas/ ral pa can gshegs pa'i lcags mo bya'i bar la lo brgya dang bcu gnyis 'byung ngo zhesabashad par bya'o/ /de bsan/ bstan pa sngar dar gyi me mo lug nas/ ral pa can gshegs pa'i snga lo lcags pho sprel lo yan la lo bzhi brgya dang so bzhi yod pas/ dus gsal rtsa bar/ snga dar bzhi brgya so bzhi bzhugs zhes bshad pa legs mod/ de yang spyir btang ba yin gyis dmigs kyis bsal na/ dgabarnyes pa'i me mo lug nas/ srong btsan sgam po'i lo bcu gnyis pa sa pho byi ba yan gyi lo nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni gnyan po gsang ba la mchod pa tsam las/ bshad nyan sgom sgrub ma byung la/ srong btsan sgam po rgyal sar thon pa'i sa mo glang nas lcags pho sprel lo'i bar lo nyis brgya dang bcu gnyis tsam zhig bstan pa snga dar gyi dngos gzhi la byung ba yin no snyam du sems so/ /gnyis pa bshes gnyen bsnyen tshul ni/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi ngo la/ zhi 'tsho/ kā yol shī la/ bi ma la mi tra/ pad 'byung / sangs rgyas gsang ba/ shārnyi gar+bha/ sngagasasa'achang dharma kirti/ kha che dzi na mi tra/ dwa na shī la sogs dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba sad 218

bstan rtsi gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar na bya ba bzhugs so//mi bdun/ sad mi bdun las blo sbyangs pa dpal brtsegs sogs lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad/ de dag las blo sbyangs pa klu'i rgyal mtshan sogs lo tsā ba stong rtsa brgyad sogs mang du byon pa las/ khyad par bka' drin che ba ni/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twa/ u rgyan pad+ma/ kā ma la shī la/ bod kyi lo tsā ba be+e ro tsa na rnams yin la/khri ral pa can gyi ngo la ni/ bod kyi lo tsā ba/ ka ba dpal rtsegs dang / cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / zhang ye shes sde la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa chos dar tshul ni / thog mar yon kho gyi gzhi yi ge'i rigs 'di dar te/ bod kyi chos rgyal sgam po nas/ rgyal bu myang ral can gyi bar/ rgyal rabs dri med dgu byon zhing /yi ge'i mkhan po bdun byon la/ yi ge'i dpe yang bdun bkod cing / zhes pa ltar/ srong btsan nas/ nyang ral gyi bar dgu'am phyed dang bcu'i bar la yi ge'i mkhan po thon mi/ phyag dar/ rin chen 'bar/ chab dkar be'u rje/ cung pa dge bkog tshe spong byang chub/ tra shud gnyis dang dgu 'khrig ho dbyon zhing / yi ge'i dpe yang / sbal nag bgrad pa 'dra ba/ so phag gshibs pa 'dra ba/ bya pho 'jol ba 'dra ba/ nas sngon 'phying dkar steng bkram pa 'dra ba/ mu tig dar brgyus 'dra ba/ sbur nag bgrad pa 'dra ba/ nya ldang dkar chu nas phyungs pa 'dra ba / seng ge 'phyo ba 'dra ba dang brgyad bkod do/ /chos bsgyur ba'i bod kyi skad la yang / deng sang bod du grags pa'i ming / /bkas bcad yul skad 'phral skad gsum/ /bkas bcad la yang dang po dang / /bar dang tha ma gsum mi mthun/ /zhes pa ltar/ chos bsgyur ba'i bod skad la/ bkas bcad rnam pa gsum byung ba'i/ bkas bcad dang po rgyal po khri srong lde btsan yan chad nas/219

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()srong btsan sgam po man chad kyi bar la/ lo tsā ba thon mi nas/ be+e ro tsa na'i bar gyi lo tsā bas bsgyur ba rnams te/ de yang lung sde bzhi dang / phal po che dang /dkon rtsegs sogs dang / sher phyogs mdo kha cig sogs/skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa rnams so/ /rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus/ blo rno ba'i mchog khams pa go chas sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa thugs la bzung nas bsgyur ba'i 'bum thugs 'gyur du grags pa dang / de rjes nyang in+d+ra gyu rtsi dang / sbasamañdzu shrī gnyis kyis rgya dpe spyan drangs nas bsgyur ba'i rtsa 'bum du grags pa sogs kyang bkas bcad dang po'o/ /bkas bcad gnyis pa ni/ mnga' bdag nyang ral gyi dus/ lo tsā ba ka cog zhad gsum sogs kyis/ skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab ste bsgyur ba 'phags pa brgyad stong pa sogs mang dag yod de / khri srong lde btsan nas nyang ral gyi bar bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'am/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa ches mchog tu dar bas/ de dus kyi bstan pa 'dra ba 'phags yul du yang ma byung ba 'dra la zhes a ti shas gsungs zhes pa yang deb sngon na bris 'dug bkas bcad gsum pa ni/ lo chen rin bzang man chad/bstan pa phyi dar la byung ba yin te 'og nas 'chad do/ /gang na'ang bstan pa snga dar la/ rgyal po bka' drin che ba srong btsan sgam po/ khri srong lde btsan/ khri ral pa can gsum/ paṇ+ḍita bka' drin che ba mkhan po bo dhi sa twa/ u rgyan pad+ma/kā ma la shi la gsum/ lo tsā ba bka' drin che ba/ thon mi/ be+e ro tsa na/ ka cog shad gsum dang lnga lags so/ / thub dbang yongs 'das lo grangs stong phrag dang / /brgyad brgya dag dang nyi shu 'das pa'i tshe/ /sa pho sprel lo 'phags yul220

bsnar rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed ga bsam rab dkar zhes byab bzhugs so// rgyal po'i rigs/ /bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po byon/ /de nas bdun brgya rtsa dgu 'das pa'i tshe/ /me mo lug la bstan pa snga dar byon/ /tho tho ri zhesagrags pa'i rgyal po'i ngo / /kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul yin zhes grags/ /de nas brgya phrag gnyis dang bcu 'das tshe/ /me mo glang la srong btsan sgam po bltams/ /phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul yin zhes grags/ /snga dar bstan pa'i srol chen de nas bstod/ /de nas brgya dang bcu gsum 'das pa'i tshe/ /lcags pho rta la khri srong lde btsan byon//phyag na ral gri'i rnam 'phrul yin zhes grags//snga dar bstan pa'i dbu 'phang de nas bstod/ /de nas don drug 'das pa'i me khyi'i lor/ /phyag na rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul khri ral byon/ /snga dar bstan pa'i dar nas de nas phye/ /so drag lon tshe bstan pa'i nyin phyed bsgribs/ /de ltar gangs rtson bstan pa snga dar sne/ /tho tho ri nas gdung rabs lnga yi bar/ /nyis brgya bcu ru bstan pa'i skya rengs shar/ /sgong btsan nas bzung gdung rabs lnga yi bar/ /brgya dang bcu gsum bstan pa'i nyi zer 'phro/ /lde btsan nas bzung gdung rabs phyed bzhi'i bar/ /brgya dang bcu gcig bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /de ltar rab bgrang bzhi brgya so bzhi ni//snga dar bstan pa'i nyin byed shar ba ste//thub dbang lnga brgya phrag bcu'i bstan pa las/ /'phags yul sgrub pa'i lnga brgya tha ma la/ /gangs can bod kyi bstan pa snga dar byon//bzhi brgya so bzhir bstan pa'i pad tshal bshad//lcags mo bya la stug po'i sprin gyis bsgribs/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du mun pa'i gling du bzhugs//'on kyang phyi dar bstan pa'i zla shel gyis//rim gyis gsal bar byas pa 'di ngo /rdo// /

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()gnyis pa bstan pa phyi dar gyi rnam gzhag ston pa la/ rab dbye las/ de nas dar mas bstan pa bsnubs/ /de rjes chos log du ma 'phel/ /de nas bla ma ye shes 'od/ /chos rgyal de yis skyes bu mchog /rin chen bzang po kha cher brdzangs/ /zhes sogs bshad pa ltar te/ 'di la 'phros don gyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / skabs don rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bcom ldan rig ral sogs/ bstan pa snga dar/ phyir dar/ bar dar gsum du mdzad nas/ dang po 'dra ba la/ gnyis pa bar dar ni/ mi bcu sogs kyis dbusagatsang du bstan pa spel ba la ngos bzung nas/ gsum pa phyi dar ni/ lo chen rin bzang dang / 'gos lo tsā ba sogs kyis bstan pa spel ba man chad yin gsungs/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig 'di mi 'thad de/ snga dar phyi dar gnyis 'byung ba ni/ bar du dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas bstan pa'i rgyun chad pa zhig byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin la/ bar dar zhes pa ni sgro btags kho na yin te/ khyed 'dod pa'i bar dar de nas snga phyi'i bar du bstan pa med pa'i bar stong byung ba med pa'i phyir zhes gsungs so/ kho bo cag kyang de nyid sems te/ mi bcu nas/'gos lo sogs kyi bar du bstan pa gong 'phel kho na las cha zhan du song ba'i skabs cung zad kyang med pas/ bar dar gyi tha snyad mi mdzes pa'i phyir dang /khyed ltar na bstan pa snga dar nyid la yang / mes ag tshom yan chad snga dar dang /khri srong lde btsan nas bar dar/ khri ral pa can nas phyi dar zhes gsum du 'byed rigs pa ha cang thal te/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir na/ mes ag tshom gshegs nas khri srong lde btsan nar ma son gyi bar der/ ma shad sogs bdud blon 222

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar ba dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs po// gsum gyis bstan pa la rma chen po phyung ste/ bstan pa med pa lta bur byas 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /des na snga dar dang phyi dar gnyis kho na yin la/ de yang gtso bor yul dbus gtsang dang bstan pa rab byung 'dul ba'i bstan pa'i dbang du byas te / dar mas bstan pa bsgrubs rjes/ 'dul ba'i las kyi cho ga'i lag len sogs nub nas yun ring du rgyun chad kyang / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i zab don nyams bzhes sogs ni dngos sam sbas pa'i tshul gyis rgyun ma chad par byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na bstan pa med pa lo du ma zhig byung snyam na/ 'di la deb sngon las/ khams nas bod yul dbus su bstan pa byung ba'i dus mtshams ni/bu ston rin po ches/ rgan mo zhig gi ngag gi rjes su 'brangs nas/ lcags mo bya la bstan pa bsgrubs nas/ bdun cu rtsa gsum pa chu mo bya la bstan pa byung ba yin zhes gsungs la/ bstan pa'i gdung rabs la shin tu mkhas pa'i 'brom ston pa'i zhal nas bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa sa pho stag la byung ba yin zhes gsungs so / / sa pho stag nas drug cu rtsa lnga pa chu pho rta la a ti sha bod du byon zhes sogs bshad mod/ de ni bu ston gyi gsung la zhib tu ma brtag pa ste/ chos 'byung las/de ltar dbus gtsang du bstan pa med pa lo bdun cu byung nas dbus gtsang mi bcus bstan pa btsugs pa yin te/ mi bcus dbus su byon tsa na/ rgan mo zhig na re/ nga lo drug lon pa na btsun pa mthong zer/ ji tsam lon dris pas bdun cu don drug lon zer bas so/ /zhes zer/ kha cig brgya rtsa brgyad song zer ro /zhes lugs bkod pa tsam ma gtogs/ bu ston rang lugs 'di yin gsal bar bshad pa med pa'i phyir dang / khyad par don gsum pa chu mo bya la bstan 223

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byurig ces bsdus/()pa'i thog mar cung zad kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na kho bos ni 'di la lugs mi 'dra ba bzhi tsam zhig thos shing mthong ste/ bcom ldan ral gyisabastan rgyan 'bring po las bstan pa med pa lo bdun cu byung bar bshad pa'i lugs dang / 'brom ston gyis don bdun bshad pa'i lugs dang / rnel pa paṇ+ḍita smon lam tshul khrims sogs kyis brgya rtsa brgyad byung bar bshad pa'i lugs dang / mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis drug cu re gsum byung bar bshad pa'i lug bsadang bzhi yod pa las/ kho bo ni re zhig dus gsal rtsa bar/ de la brgya dang nyer bdun phri/ /bstan pa phyi dar byon pa'i lo/ /dang po sa mo bya yi lo/ /zhes pa ltar/ lcags bya la bstan pa bsnubs nas/ lo brgya dang brgyad 'das pa'i sa mo bya lo phyi dar gyi mgo bzung ba 'di rang lugs su byas nas/ de'i tshe bzhad pa'i bka' ni shin tu min te/rtsa ba zer ba'i dmar dam ra 'di/ /'grel pa zer ba'i nag nag 'dis/ /'chad pa yin pa'adra zer ba las ma byung zer ba bshad 'dug de yang rje btsun gong ma'i lung dang sbyar te spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi sgo nas zhib tu 'chad par bzhed do/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ bstan pa la skyon byed pa'i rgyal po dang de'i lo dus ngos bzung /bstan pa sor 'jug pa'i skyes bu dang de yi lo dus ngos bzung / ngos zin pa'i bstan 'dzin dang dgon gnas rim pa ltar byon pa'i tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni / rgyal po dar mas bstan pa bsgrubs zhes pa ltar te/ de yang rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi sras khri lde srong btsan la/ sras gtsang ma/ dar ma/ ral pa can gsum gyi/ gtsang mas rgyal srid ma bzung / ral pa can gyis lo bco brgyad rgyal srid bzung / so drug lon pa'i tshe/ blon po dbas rgyal to re dang / co ro 224

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar ba dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// legs sgra gnyis kyis bkrongs/ dar ma chu mo lug la bltams te/ so dgu pa lcags mo bya/ gcung ral pa can 'das pa'i lo de nyid la rgyal srid bzung ste/de yang grags pas/ bar pa glang dar sprel mgo chu mo lug /bco lnga lon nas yab 'das so dgu la/ /gcung 'das de ni rgyal srid bzung nas ni/ /zla ba drug tu tshul bzhin rgyal po byas/ /lcags slo bya yi mjug tu dam chos bsnubs/ /de nas zla ba drug dang phyed dag tu/ /sdig rgyal byas te de ltar spyir bsdoms la/ /lo gcig zla byed byas te khyi lo la/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi rdo rjes bsad/ /ces pa ltar du/ glang dar mas lcags bya'i lo gcig dang zla phyed rgyal srid bzung ba'i lo phyed dang zla ba phyed du rgyal po gdon gyis bslus te/ rab tu byung ba rnams bsad cing phab/ glegs bam rnams sbas/ shākya mu rne sogs bye thems su bcug pa sogs byas pas dam pa'i chos bsgrubs so/ /'ga' zhig glang dar mas 'brug nas bya'i bar lo drug rgyal srid bzung zhes pa dang / 'ga' zhig sa mo lug la dam chos bsnubs zer ba sogs yod kyang / 'di pa'i lugs kyis/ 'das lo nas nyis stong dgu brgya dang don bzhi 'das (spyi lo 841)srong btsan sgam po byon pa'i me glang nas nyis brgya dang nyer bzhi 'das/ snga dar me lug nas bzhi brgya dang so bzhi 'das pa'i so lnga pa lcags mo bya lo dar mas bstan pa bsgrubs so/ /zhes shes par bya'o/ /de nas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcags bya nas da lta'i shing byi'i bar la bdun brgya dang nyer gsum lon no/ /gnyis pa bstan pa sor chud pa'i skyes bu dang de'i lo dus ngos gzung ba la spyi dang dmigs bsal gnyis/ dang po ni/ lcags bya nas lo brgya dang brgyad 225

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bstan pa med la gtsug lag khang sogs gan gzhi dang dge 'dun gyi sde btsug pas phyi dar zhesabya'o//brgya dang dgu pa sa mo bya nas phyi dar gyi mgo zug pa yin te/ dbus gtsang mi bcu'am drug gis khams su sdom pa blangs te/ sa mo bya lor dbus gtsang du gtsug lag khang so sor rtsigs nas rab byung 'dul ba'i bstan pa spel bas so / / gnyis pa dmigs bsal la gsum/ phyi dar nyid la yang / mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi dus bstan pa'i dbu brnyes pa'i dus/ khri bkra shisabartsegs pa dpal gyi dus bstan pa'i srol btod pa'i dus/ bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i dus so/ /dang po ni/ bstan pa bsnubasapa'i lcags bya'i phyi lo chu khyi'i lor/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes/ bsam pa lhag bsam gyis kun nas bslangs pas rgyal po sdig can bkrongs/ dpal gyi rdo rje de gnyag dz+nyā na ku ma ra'i slob ma/ dpal gyi bu brgyad ces grags pa'i nang tshan te / de yang sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ dar rje dpal gyi grags pa/ shud bu dpal gyi rdo rje/ mang mkhar dpal gyi dbang phyug lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes dang brgyad 3nyis ga )do/ /rgyal po bkrongs pa'i lo chu pho khyi la/ rgyal po de'i sras 'od srungs dang /sras su rdzus pa yin zer ba'i yum brtan yang bltams/ de gnyis nang ma mthun te phan tshun 'brug long du song bas/ yum brtan gyis 'od srungs stod la sprugs zer te/ de gnyis kyi ngo la dbus gtsang du bstan pa med cing / sku tshe'i sked tsam la/ mdo khams su g.yo smar gtsang gsum la brten pa'i bstan pa cung zad byung ba yin no/ /de yang bu ston chos 'byung las/ bo dong pa g.yo dge 226

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'byung / 'jad kyi gyel mi gtsang rab gsal/ g.yor stod kyi smar shākya mu yi dang gsum dpal chu bo ri'i sgom grwa na yod pa las/ rgyal pos bstan pa bsnubs par shes nas mdo khams su bros pa yin gsungs/ gsung ngag chos 'byung 'ga' zhig las/ grom pa rgyang nas bros kyang zer/ deb sngon las/ drang chu'i mdo'i g.yo dge 'byung / rgya rab pa'i gtsang rab gsal/ g.yor stod kyi dmar ban shākya mu zhe gsum zer ba byas 'dug gang na'ang de lta bu'i dge slong gsum/mdo khams rma lung dan tig shel gyi dgon pa na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ las dang skal bar ldan pa bon po'i rigs su skyes pa rmu su gsal 'bar zhes bya ba gtsang gis mkhan po/ g.yos slob dpon byas te/ rab tu byung dge tshul lo gcig lon nas sngar gyi mkhan slob dang / smar gyis gsang ston/ rgya'i ha shang ke waṃ dang ke bag gnyis kyis kha skong byas nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ dme dpa' bo'i chos 'byung la smar gyis mkhan po byas zer ba'ang snang /'ga'/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho lasabasnyen par rdzogs pa'i sad mi bdun gyi nang tshan/ dba' rat+na rak+ṣi zhes pa 'di/bod kyi btsun pas mkhan po byas pa'i thog ma yin la/ de las g.yo dge 'byung /g.yos mkhan po dang / gtsang gis slob dpon byas nas/ rmu su gsal 'bar bsnyen par rdzogs zhes bshad/ gang na'ang / de nyid la phyis bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal zhes grags shing / mdo khams su bstan pa spel lo/ /g.yos dba' ra sne las bsnyen pa ra rdzogs pa ni dus mi 'grig ste/ sad mi bdun snga dar khri thong lde btsan gyi skab yin no/ /des na bar skabs der mkhan rabs gzhan btsal bar bya'o//'o na de dus kyi ha shang gnyis kha sgong du ji ltar rung snyam na/ de gnyis kyang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus/ zhi 'tsho la 227

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung mi ces bsdus/()sogs las/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas phyis khams su 'chug pa yin pas/ kha skong du rung ba'i dge slong yin no/ /zhes kho bo smra'o/ /de ltar khri 'od srungs kyi dus su khams su bstan pa byung ba ji ltar zhe na/ chos la 'jug pa'i sgo las/rgyal po de'i sras gnam lde 'od srungs dang / mched zla yum brtan gyis rgyal srid so sor bskos te/ de gnyis kyi sku ring la mdo khams me lung rdo rje'i brag ra dan tig gi yang dgon na/ gtsang rab gsal dang g.yo dge 'byung dang smar shākya mu rne zhes bya ba'i dge slong gsum bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mdo smad de nyid na bon po'i rigs su gyur kyang / mos pas spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mu dur dgongs pa rab gsal zhes bya ba byung ste/ de sangs rgyas bstan pa la dad de/sngar gyi dge slong gsum dang / rgya'i ha shang ke waṃ dang skru bag dang ḍa po dang bcas pa las bsnyen par rdzogs par byas so/ /de dag la sogs te mdo smad kyi khams gsum du bstan pa cung zad dar bar gyur to/ /zhes bshad pa las shes so/ /des na 'od srungs kyi sras rje dpal 'khor ba tsan gyis sku tshe'i smad la / dbus gtsang mi bcu sogs la brten nas dbus gtsang du bstan pa'i dbus brnyes shing / bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslangs zhes bya ste/ de yang chu mo glang la dpal 'khor btsan 'brungs/ khong gi slob dpon cang a po yin zhes grub thob u rgyan pa'i rgyal po rabs phreng las bshad/ khong gi yab 'od srungs rang lo re gsum pa/ shing pho byi lor gshegs nas dpal 'khor btsan gyis/ de'i phyi lo shing mo glang nas brtsams pa'i lo bco brgyad rgyal srid bzung nas so gcig pa la gshegs zer ro/ /de lta na'ang bla chen dgongs pa rab 228

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gsal bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bco lnga lon pa'i tshe/ dbus nas klu mes tshul khrims shes rab/ 'bri rje yon tan rdzi dkar gnyis/ gtsang nas lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang / tshong ge shes rab seng ge gnyis te chos la 'jug pa'i sgo ltar na / dbus gtsang mi bzhi'am/ bu ston ltar na dbus nas klu mes/ 'bring ye shes yon tan/ rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ rba tshul khrims blo gros/ sum pa ye shes blo gros dang lnga/ gtsang nas mgur mo rab kha ba lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug shab sgo lnga pa tshong btsun shes rab seng ge mnga' ris pa 'o brgyad spun gnyis/ bo dong pa u pa de mar ba dang lnga ste bcu'am/ yang na dbus nas klu mes dang sum pa gnyis/ gtsang nas lo tshong gnyis/ mnga' ris nas ba shi rdzi dkar ba gnyis te drug gis khams su byon te/ bla chen gyis mkhan po dang /gtsang dang g.yos las gsang gi slob dpon dang / smar dang ha shang gis dus dang kha skong sogs byas te/ tshigs gsum bar ma chad du chig rdzogs byas nas sdom pa blangs/ slar dbus gtsang du byon te/ 'das lo sum stong nga gcig lon nga bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcags bya nas/ lo don bdun 'das pa'i don brgyad pa sa pho stag gi lo'am/(spyi lo918)dpal 'khor btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung nas lo bcu bzhi lon pa'i sa pho stag gi tshe/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs las kyi cho ga dang / klog pa thos bsam gyi mgo tshugs pas phyi dar gyi dbus brnyes so zhes kho bo smra ste/ chos la 'jug pa'i sgo las/ rgyal po 'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan gyi sku ring la me lung la sogs pa gtsug lag khang brgyad brtsigs so/ /de'i dus su gtsang pa mi gnyis dang / dbus pa mi gnyis mdo 229

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()khams smad du byon nas sdom pa blangs te/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang / tshong ge shes rab seng ge dang / klu mes tshul khrims shes rab dang / 'bri rje yon tan rdzi dkar ba rnams te de dag gis dbus gtsang du bstan pa 'ongs so/ /zhes bshad pas/ dpal 'khor btsan gyi sku'i ring la dbus gtsang du bstan pa 'ongs par ches gsal ba'i phyir dang / bstan pa 'ongs pa'i sa pho stag lo de/'das lo nas sum stong lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa dang / dpal 'khor btsan gyis rgyal srid bzung ba'i lo bcu bzhi pa yin pa yang / chos la 'jug pa'i sgo las/shing mo glang gi lo la gtsang gi g.yo ru btsad po khri dpal 'khor btsan grom pa lha rtse na bzhugs nas/ yab kyi mdzad pa'i dus rtsis nas lo sum stong sum cu so bdun lon no/ /zhes bshad pas shes te/ 'od srungs drug cu rtsa gsum pa shing phyi'i lo mjug la gshegs nas/ shing glang gi lo mgo tsam la dpal 'khor btsan lo bcu gsum pa zhig gis/ grom pa lha rtser yab kyi gshegs rdzongs chos 'khor rgya cher bskor te rtsis pa na 'das lo nas sum stong so bdun lon par (sbyi lo904)bshad pa yin pas/ lo de nyid la khong gis rgyal srid kyang bzung /bstan pa la me phyung ba'i lcags bya nas drug cu rtsa lnga lon/ de nas lo bcu bzhi pa sa pho stag la mi bcus dbus bsam yas su byon nas bstan pa'i mgo btsugs so/ /de tsam la dgongs nas 'brom ston pas kyang phyi dar gyi mgo sa pho stag nas bzung ba yin no/ /zhes shes par bya'o/ /de'i tshe mi bas gnas gzhi gsar du ma tshugs kyang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi mgo tsam tshugs pas phyi dar gyi dbu brnyes zhes bya'o//de'i tshe rgyal po yum brtan gyi brgyud pa mnga' bdag ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis bstan 230

bstan rtsi gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//pa'i bdag rkyen cher mdzad pas/ bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslangs pa la khri ye shes rgyal mtshan bka' drin che bar grags so/ /de ltar na rgyal po de nyid kyi bka' drin dang / dbus gtsang mi bcu'i bka' drin las bstan pa dar ba yin mod/ mi bcus sdom pa blangs pa'i yul/ bla ma chen po nyid la thug pa dang /grum ye shes rgyal mtshan las blangs zer ba dang / 'tshur shes rab mchog las blangs zer ba'i lugs gsum byung ba las/ dang po ni snga ma ltar bu ston lugs te / mi bcus bla chen la mkhan po zhus pas/ kho bos bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga las ma lon pas mi rung gsung ba la/ gtsang na re/ dmigs bsal la btub (pa)rung las/ bla chen gyis mkhan po mdzad gsungs te/ de lta bu'i dmigs bsal gyi khungs gsal po btsal dgos so/ /de yang mdo rtsa las/bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo lnga lon zhing / lhan cig sbyar ba tha ma dang ldan na gnas ma bcas pa yang ljongs rgyur rung ngo zhes pa 'dis thon par kho bo sems so / lugs gnyis pa la grum gyi mkhan po su yin snyam na kha cig bla chen spang gong ye shes g.yung drung / grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de nas klu mes sogs yin zer/ 'ga' zhig zhi 'tsho/ rba rat+na/ g.yo dge 'byung / bla chen/ sgro mañtsa shrī/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ klu mes zhes zer ro/ /rgyal po rabs 'phreng las/ bla chen gyis/ khams kyi sog po mi drag la sdom pa phog de'i nang tshan btsun chen sher 'byung gis grum la/ des klu mes sogs la phog zer/ sog po mi drug ni/ spang gor ye shes g.yung drang dang / gsar gnas bstan grags gnyis te spang gsar gnyis/ 'al pa rdo tre+e dbang phyug bsnubs dpal gyi dbang phyug gnyis te 'al 231

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa ma'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bsnubs gnyis/ ja pa grags pa dang / btsun chen shes rab 'byung gnasaganyis te ja btsun gnyis so/ /lugs gsum pa/ deb sngon las/ bla chen shing pho byi lo la bltams/ g.yo dmar gtsang gsum las bsnyen par rdzogs/ go ring seng ge grags la 'dul ba gsan/ skyi rgya la'i gtsug tor la dbu tshad gsan/ nam dga' ldan byang chub la yo ga gsan/ ka 'od mchog grags pa la 'bum ṭīka dang / mngon pa sogs gsan/ lo zhe dgu pa la dan tig tu byon solnga bzhugs te/ brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa shing mo phag la dga' ldan du gshegs so/ /shing phag de bstan pa bsnubs pa'i lcags bya nas don lnga pa yin/ de'i mkhan bu sngar gyi sog po mi drag dang / gzhan yang / gzhad dpal gyi rdo rje dang /srags rgya mtsho ste gzhad / srags gnyis dang / zong mchog chos skyong dang 'tshur shes rab mchog gnyis te zong 'tshur gnyis dang bcu byung / 'tshur la mi bdusasdom pa blangs zhes bshad de/de rnams dpon be+e yig cha ltar bris zhes zer ro/gang na'ang dbus gtsang na bstan pa med pa'i tshe yang / shar mdo khams su dbus gtsang nas bros pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag gis bstan pa'i bya ba cung zhig byas par sems so/ /gnyis pa bstan pa'i srol btod pa ni/ dpal 'khor btsan gyi sras bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dang / skyid lde nyi ma mgon gnyis stod smad du so sor gyes tsam gyi sku ring la/ lcags bya nas lo brgya dang brgyad 'das pa'i dgu pa sa mo bya'i lo nas brtsams te/ dbus gcang mi bcus/ gtsug lag khang so sor brtsigs/ rab tu byung ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde gsar du btsugs pa ni/232

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam ra bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bstan pa phyi dar gyi srol btod pa ste/ de yang sa mo bya'i lo klu mes kyis/ la mngor gyel gyi gcug lag khang brtsigs/ de'i phyi lo glan ye shes 'bar dang /rngog byang chub 'byung gnas sogs rab tu byung / de'i phyi lo yer pa ba reng bzung / gru mer tshul khrims 'byung gnas sogs bco brgyad rab tu byung / glan rngog gru mer/ sna rnam rdo rje dbang phyug dang bzhi la klu mes kyi slob ma ka ba bzhir grags/ klu mes kyi slob bu rnams kyis kyang gtsug lag khang so sor brtsigs te/ sna rnam rdo rje dbang phyug gis rgyal lug lhas/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis gzhu kun dga' ra ba/ gru mer sogs ban+de mi phyed dang brgyad kyis sol nag thang po che/ grwa pa mngon shes kyis gra thang brtsigs so/ /de bzhin du gtsang du yang / lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis rgyan gong gi gcug lag khang bzhengs/ rgya shākya gzhon nu sogs mkhan po nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ stabs cig tu rab byung bsnyen rdzogs byas so/ /de dag gi nang tshan rgya shākya gzhon nus las stod mar la thang brtsigs/ skyo shes rab rdo rjes don mo ri/ stag lo gzhon brtson gyis stag lo lha khang / a mes zhu cig mas 'phrang dang brag dmar/ lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis zha lu brtsigs pa sogs/ mdor na/ sa mo bya de nas/ lo chen rin bzang ma byon bar du/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcu slob bu dang bcas pas/ gnas gzhi gtsug lag khang so sor brtsigs/ bstan rtsa dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ bstan pa bshad sgrub kyi gzhi bting ba ni/ bstan pa phyi dar zhes spyir btang la yongs su grags pa ste/ don 'di la dgongs nas lcags bya nas lo brgya dang brgyad 'das pa'i tshe bstan pa phyi dar gyi mgo bzung 233

brtse chen 'od snang las/4skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ba yin no/ /zhes mkhas pa dag gis bshad pa yin la/ de yang bstan pa'i rtsisadang sbyar na/ 'das lo nas sum stong brgyad cu rtsa gcig 'das pa'i gya gnyis pa sa mo bya (spyi lo 949)la bstan pa phyi dar byung zhing / sa mo bya de nas drug brgya dang bcu bdun 'das pa'i bco brgyad pa ni/ da lta'i shing byi 'di lags so/ /gsum pa bstan pa phyi dar shin tu dar ba ni/ rgyal po stod kyi lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po nas yin te/ de yang khri bkroshis brtsegs dpal gyi sras ni/ dpal lde/ 'od lde/ skyid lde'o/ /skyid lde nyi yomagon gyi sras ni/ lde gtsug mgon/ bkra shis mgon/ dpal gyi mgon dang gsum mo/ /chu pho 'brug gi lo la yab mched so sor gyes te/ lde gsum posagrom pa lha rtser gdan phab ste gtsang phyogs la mnga' mdzad pas smad kyi lde gsum grags te/ de yang dpal lde'i brgyud kyis zam pa gsum la dbang mdzad pa ni/ lha rtse'i nas zam sngon mo/ gling bu'i sha zam dmar mo/ mang nyulagyi gser zam ser po'o/ /'od lde'i brgyud kyis lho sgo gsum la dbang mdzad pa ni/ drin dang mnya' nam rdzas kyi sgo/ bud mkhar ra shing gi sgo/ zar stag sna rtsod kyi sgo'o/ /skyid lde'i brgyud kyis byang gi mdzod gsum la dbang mdzad pa ni / byang g.yu mtsho sngon mo tswa'i mdzod/ byang kha sna brgyad sha'i mdzod/ gu lang go po gser gyi mdzod/ ces grags pa'o/ /mgon gsum po stod du 'chugs te/ pu rangs / zhang zhung / mang yul gsum du so sor gdan chags pa ni/ stod kyi mgon gsum du grags so/ /de ltar yab mched gyes pa'i chu pho 'brug lo de/'das lo nas sum stong brgya dang nyer lnga pa (spyi lo 992)dang / phyi dar sa mo bya 234

ba lhan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//nas bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa yin no/ /stod kyi mgon gsum gyi nang tshan bla ma dam po'i gsung ngag chos 'byung ngo mtshar snang ba na bkra shis mgon gyi sras 'od kyi rgyal mtshan/de'i gras 'khor re dang srong nge gnyis zer ba ring mdzad 'dug/bkra shis mgon gyi sras khri lde srong nge dang /khri dpal 'khor lde gnyis byung ba'i/ khri dpal 'khor lde rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ni / lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces bya ste/ des na/ rje dpal 'khor btsan nas/ye shes 'od 'di ma byon bar la/ bod 'dir gtsug lag khang dang / glegasatham dang / dge 'dun gyi sde dang / bshad nyan sgom sgrub sogs cung zad 'phel yang / lung rigs rnam dag gis dpyad mi bzod pa'i/ dge tshul chu gtor ma dang bsnyen rdzogs der bas ma sogs dang / gnad kyis ma zin pa'i sbyor sgrol lam byed sogs/ ltar snang gi chos tshul mang po'i sprin gyis bsgribs pas sprin med kyi bstan pa rnal ma dar ba ni ma yin la/ bstan pa'i me ro cung zad gsos btab pa ni yin no/ /ye shes 'od 'di rab tu byung / lo chen rin bzang sogasakyi 'phags yul nas gsar ma'i 'gyur mgo btsugs te/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa lung rigs kyis gtan la phab pa ni/ phyi dar rgyal ba'i bstan pa shin tu dar ba'i mgo btsugs pa yin no/ /don 'di la dgongs nas/ chos la 'jug pa'i sgo las/ 'od srungs nas brtsams te de yan chad ni/ gangs can 'di na gtsug lag khang dang glegs bam bzhugs mod/ bshad pa'i bka' nyams pas gzu lum du ma byung ste/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod pa yin no//de nas 'dir bstan pa rgyas shing dag par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje dang smon lam gyi stobs can zhig sa'i bdag po bkra shis mgon gyi 235

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()sras su sku bltams pa ni/ zhes sogs dang rab dbye las/ de tshe bla ma ye shebasa'od/ /chos rgyal de yis skyes bu mchog /rin chen bzang po kha cher brdzangs/ rdo'ajam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin rlabs pa'i//mkhas mchog de yis sngon med pa'i//richos rnams phal cher bsgyur cing zhus/ /zhes sogs kyis/ bstan pa phyi dar :shāsgo / rgyal po lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po nas ngos bzung ba ni/ bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslangs te/ stod mnga' ris nas shigatu dar ba 'di la dgongs so zhes kho bos legs par bshad pa yin te/ gzhanartsodu na 'di'i gong du yang mi bcu slob bu sbyin bdag dad ldan dang bcas pa bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher bsgrubs zin pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /'di ma byon gong du bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam las bstan pa med ces kyang brjod parami nus te/ de yan chad du dge slong bzhir 'ongs pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde dang / de dag gi rgyud so sor thar pa'i bslab bya rnam par dag pa dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi las kyi cho ga'i lag len sogs yod pas/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu gsum ka tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na lha bla ma rab tu byung ba'i me pho 'brug gi lo 'di/ bstan pa phyi dar shin tu dar zhing rgyas par byed pa'i lo dus kyi thog ma yin par lung rigs kyis grub la/ lo 'di ni 'dasalo nas sum stong brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad 'das pa'i rtsa dgu pa (spyi lo1016)yin no/ /'o na 'di rab tu 'byin pa'i mkhan po su zhig snyam na/ deb sngon sogs las/ de'i tshe bstan pa med pas lha bla ma yab sras gsum rang rtag bangarang gis blangs nas dkon mchog gi drung du phul rab tu byung zhes bshad pa ni 236

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mi 'thad par sems te/ de'i tshe phyi dar sa mo bya nas kyang lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad lon pas bstan pa shin tu yod pa 'i phyir ro/ /de bsan kho bo ni/ deb sngon rang nyid las/ lo chen rin bzang lo bcu gsum lon pa'i tshe/ mkhan po ye shes bzang po las rab tu byung bar khong rang gi dngos slob khri thang dz+nya nas bkod pa'i rnam thar na yod ces bshad pas/ de gnyis mkhan po gcig par sems te/mkhan po ye shes bzang po'i mtshan gyi/ ye shes zhes pa de ye shes 'od la sbyar zhing / bzang po de lo chen rin bzang la sbyar 'dug pa'i phyir snyam mo/ /de lta bu'i mkhan po de yang / zhang zhud pa rgyal ba shes rab la/ 'dul ba'i sgrub brgyud kyi bla ma dharmā pā la/ skre ta ka ra gnyis/ bshad brgyud kyi bla ma dz+nya na shrī bha dra dang / shrī bhu su twe shan ti gnyis te bzhi yod pa'i/ dz+nya na shrī bha dra ni/ ye shesadapal bzang po yin pas/ paṇa chen de nyid yin par sems so/ /gnyis pa ngos zin nas bstan 'dzin dang dgon gnas rim par byon tshul la gnyis/ bstan 'dzin rim par byon tshul/ dgon gnas rim par byon tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'das lo nas da lta'i shing pho byi la'i bar la sum stong drug brgya go bdun lon pa'i tshe/ phyi dar sa mo bya nas lo bcu dgu pa me mo yos yan gyi sum stong dang brgya ru sleb cing / de yan chad du ni/ dbus gtsang mi bcus bstan pa la bya ba byas pa yin la/ sum stong brgya nas nyis brgya ma zin gyi bar la lo paṇa su zhig byon zhes pa nas/ sum stong drug brgya pa nas bdun brgya ma zin bar 'di la mkhas pa su zhig byon nas bstan pa la bya ba ji ltar byas snyam na/ 'di la drug yod pa'i/ dang po sum stong brgya zin nas nyis brgyar 237

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ma slebs kyi bar 'di la/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa sprin med kyi mkha' la rgyu skar gyi tshogs bkra ba lta bu zhig dar ba yin te/ de yang 'brog mi nas brgyud pa'i lam 'bras/ mar pa nas brgyud pa'i bka' brgyud/ 'brom nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdams/ dam pa nas brgyud pa'i zhi byed/ khyung po nas brgyud pa'i ni gu/ rmangasar ser po nas brgyud pa'i pho bcod/ ma gcig nas brgyud pa'i mo bcod skor dang bcas pa'i phyi dar nyid la lhag tu 'phel ba'i gdams pa'i sgo chen po drugalo chen nas brgyud pa'i yo ga'i chos skor dang bcas pa bdun dar/ gzhan yang bde kye gsang gsum/ dus 'khor 'jigs byed sogs bla med kyi rgyud sde chen po lnga'i rgyud bshad man ngag khrid rim sogs deng sang bod na grags pa'i phal po che zhig dus de tsam nas brtsam ste dar ba yin no/ /zhes khong du chud par bya'o/ /de yang sum stong brgya pa'i skabs su thog mar byon pa'i mkhas pa chen po bka' drin che ba ni/ lo chen rin chen bzang po ste/ sum stong brgya dang gsum du sleb pa'i lcags pho rta (spyi lo 970)lor/ lo chen rin chen bzang po bltams/lo 'di phyi dar sa mo bya nas nyer gcig 'das pa'i nyer gnyis pa yin/ 'di nas deng sang bar la lnga brgya dang go lnga lon no/ /lo chen 'di la slob ma mang du yod kyang / lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/grab pa gzhen nu shes rab/ kyi nor dz+nya na dang bzhi la thugs kyi sras bzhi zer/pu rangs pa an ston grags rin/ rgya ye tshul/ dgung pa dge bshes/ mar yul ba dkon mchog rtsegs bzhi ni/ lo chen dang lo chung gnyis rka'i slob ma yin/myang stod rkyang po spe dmar gyi rkyang po chos blon/ shangs kyi sum ston ye 'bar/238

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar ba dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs // myang stod lce gzhar/ spang kha dar chung gi gzhen nu rgya mtsho bzhi ni gtso cher lo chung gi slob ma yin/ rngog ge sar dang / zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab gnyis ni lo chung khong gi slob ma yin no/ /gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ smon 'gro'i mar pa rdo ye/ mnyan ston tshul 'bar/ spang chang pa seng ge rgyal mtshan bzhi la zangs dkar gyi bu bzhi zer ro/ /bsnur nyi ma 'od zer ni/ mnyal pa nyi ma shes rab kyi slob ma yin/ glan chos 'byung / rtsa skya dkon mchog grags/dmar chos rgyal/ sgang ston shes rab 'bum bzhi ni bsnur gyi slob ma yin te/de dag gis gtso bor rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa spel lo/ /de lta bu'i yo ga'i brgyud pa la/ yo ga stod lugs dang / smad lugs zhes/gnyis su grags te/ lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod la/ sangs rgyas zhi ba la gsan pa'i yo ga'i chos lugs/ sa cha smad dbus gtsang du dar ba yo ga smad lugs dang / sku tshe'i smad la dharmā pā la la gsan pa'i yo ga'i chos lugs/ stod mnga' ris su dar ba la yo ga stod lugs zhes 'jog pas so/ /'di la mkhas mchog rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis gzhan phan 'khrul sel las/ sharnya nas brgyud pa'i kha che mkhan po'i lugs dang / dharma pā la la gsan pa'i rgya gar shar phyogs pa'i lugs zhes pa'i tha snyad 'thad kyi yo ga stod lugs dang smad lugs zhes pa'i tha snyad rje btsun gong mas bshad pa med cing / sangs rgyas zhi ba ni lo chen dang phyi lo nas mjal ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta yin gyi / sku tshe stod kyi bla ma gtan nas ma yin zhes sogs gsungs te/ 'di la kho bos da dung dpyad par byas nas 'di yin smra bar spro'o/ /'dul ba stod lugs dang / smad lugs kyi bshad bka' lag len sogs kyang lo chen 'di'i sku ngo la 239

brtse r+pā 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()dar ba yin te/ de yang smad 'dul ni/ bstan pa snga dar gyi rgyun g.yo smar gtsang gsum dang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal la/ mi bcus sdom pa blangs te/ smad mdo khams nas dbus gtsang du rim gyis 'phel ba'i 'dul ba'i bstan pa'i rgyun 'di la grags shing / de la gzus yan chad du smad 'dul la bshad bka' cung zad ma gtogs pa cher med mod/ lo chen 'di'i sku tshe'i stod tsam la gzusardo rje rgyal mtshan gyis 'dul ba la bshad pa rgya cher mdzad pa'i slob ma dbus gtsang ba'i gzus kyi bu chen bzhi/ de la bla ma rnam gsum/ de las rgya 'dul/de las slob ma ka bzhi/ de las bya 'dul/ de las rtsis 'dul sogs lasabargyud de bshad pa rgya cher 'phel bas so/ /de dag kyang ji ltar snyam na/ mi bcu'i nang tshan klu mes kyi mkhan bu ka ba bzhir grags pa'i gru mer la mkhan bu gsum ste/ gra phyis kyi klungs legs pa'i shes rab/ gra phyis kyi skyor shes rab 'byung gnas/ gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang gsum mo/ /gzus la bu chen bzhi ste / sbos tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ glan tshul khrims byang chub ste dbus pa gnyis/ sne po pa grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / 'dzim pa shes rab 'od zer te gtsang pa gnyis so/ /dang po sbo tshung tshul 'byung gi slob ma ni/ nyang 'tshams pa rin chen bla ma/ sne bo pa grags rgyal gyi slob ma ni ko khyim pa ye shes bla ma/'dzim pa sher 'od kyi slob ma ni/ zhang zhung pa rgyal she dang / sog tshul khrims bla ma gnyis so/ /de lta bu'i bla ma gsum gyi slob ma ni/ rgya 'dul dbang phyug tshul khrims/ rgya la bu chen ka ba bzhi ste/ 'dar 'dul 'dzin/ mtha' bzhi brtson 'grus 'bar/ jo gdan nag po dar tshul/ me tsho byang chub rdo rje 'od/ me tsho'i 240

bstan rtses gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// slob ma ni bya 'dul brtson 'grus 'bar/ de'i slob ma ni rtsis 'dul gzhon nu seng ge'o/ /stod 'dul ni/ lo chen dang bla ma ye shes 'od kyi sku tshe'i smad la/rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pā la spyan drangs 'dul ba'i bstan pa spel ba las/mkhan bu pā la rnam pa gsum ste/ sa dha pā la/ gu ṇa pā la/ pra sgo pā la'o/ /pra sgo pā la'i mkhan bu zhang zhung pa rgyal ba shas rab ste/ des dharmā pā la nyams len dang / bram ze 'dul 'dzin pre ta ka ra la phyag len bslabs pas sgrub brgyud kyi bla ma rnam pa gnyis/ shrī dz+nya na bha dra dang / shrī su :dhi shirnya la gzhung gi bshad pa gtso bor gsan pas bshad brgyud kyi bla ma gnyis so/ /de ltar 'dul ba la brgyud pa gnyis yod pas stod 'dul ba rnams ni/ rgya gar nas bshad sgrub kyi brgyud pa bar ma chad pas phyag len dang bshad pa sogs khungs btsun la / smad 'dul ba rnams ni/ gzus dang bla ma rnam gsum dang rgya 'dul la sogs pas bshad pa mang dag mdzad kyang / rang bzo ma gtogs brgyud pa med pas khungs thub med do zhes zur za bar mdzad de/ zhang zhung pa rgyal she'i slob ma zhing mo che ba byang chub seng ges mdzad pa'i brgyud rim gyi yi ge las/ bslab pa gsum las tshul khrims kyi/ /bslab pa ston pa 'dul ba yin/ /sde snod brgyud pa gnyis yin te/ /phyogs snga ma dang phyi ma'o/ /dang po bod kyi brgyud pa ste / / dge slong rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis/ /slob dpon med phyir gzhung rnams la/ /lta rtog byas nas bshad pa mdzad/ /de la slob pa rnam pa bzhi/ /dge slong tshul khrims 'byung gnas dang / /tshul khrims byang chub dbus kyi'o/ /dge slong grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / shes rab 'od ni gtsang gi'o/ /de slob tshul khrims bla ma 241

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ste / / tshul khrims 'byung gnas slob ma ni/ /dge slong rin chen bla ma'o/ /de gnyis slob ma che ba'i mchog /dge bshes dbang phyug tshul khrims yin/ /de yi blo yis brtag byas nas/ /dgag dgos rgyu mtshan mang po byas/ /tshul khrims bla mas yan lag dang / /spyi don bsdus don bam po gsum/ /blo yis brtags nas yi ger bkod/ /de dag slob ma che ba ni/ /ye shes rgyan gyis mgo bsgre byas/ /slob dpon sun dgrang blo yis rtog /rgya gar brgyud pa med pa yin/ /de ni phyogs snga 'god pa'o/ /zhes smad 'dul la phyogs snga brjod nas dgag pa mang dag mdzad rjes rang lugs 'jog pa na/ phyi ma mnga' ris 'dul 'dzin la//rgya gar brgyud pa yod par bzhed//de yang sgrub pa'i brgyud dang ni/ /bshad pa'i brgyud dang rnam pa gnyis/ /sgrub pa'i brgyud pa 'di lta ste/ /lha rgyal bla ma ye shes 'od//'jam dpal sprul par rab grags pa/ /de ni rtsa rgyud chen po las/ /lung bstan thob pa tho ling gi /dpe med lhun grub gtsug lag khang / /bzhengasanas rgya gar shar phyogs nas//mkhas btsun snyan pa'i 'brug sgra can/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan mthon po yis/ /kun la gsal bar gyur pa yi/ /dharmā pā la zhesabya ba/ /ye shes 'od kyis spyan drangs nas/ /thugs rje nyi mas rgyud skul nas/ /bstan pa rin chen gnas bya'i phyir/ /mkhan po mdzad nas sgrub brgyud spel/ /de yi mkhan bu'i gtso bo gsum/ /dge slong sa sgru pā la dang / /jo bo gu ṇa pā la dang / /dge slong pra sgo pā la'o/ /pra sgo pā la'i mkhan bu ni/ /shad zhung yul gyi 'dul ba 'dzin/ /dge slong rgyal ba'i shes rab ste/ /tshul khrims g.yag gi rnga ma dang / /mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du bsrungs/ /yon tan rang bzhin thams242

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// cad kyi/ /rgyur gyur 'dul ba'i sde snod las/ /mang du thos shing nges byas pa/ /snyan pas nam mkha' sa steng khyab/ /thugs rje'i sprin las chos char phab rab byung tha ma'i rgyud spangs nas/ /bstan pa rin chen rgyas mdzad pa/ /zhes sogs bshad pa ltar yin no/ /des na 'dul ba smad lugs kyi bshad pa ni/ gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan nas gtso bor dar bas lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod nas dar la/ stod lugs ni dharmā pā la'i mkhan bu pā la rnam gsum nas dar bas/ lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad nas dar ba yin no/ /zhes shes par bya'o/ / de lta bu'i lo chen des mnga' bdag lha lde btsan gyi slob dpon mdzad/ paṇ+ḍita'i bla ma bdun cu rtsa lnga bsten/ dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs/ rmang lo tsā ba dge ba'i blo gros sogs zhu chen pher ba'i slob ma lo tsā ba bcu lhag byung / bstan pa phyi dar gyi mdo sngags kyi bka' drin phal cher khong gi ngo la byung / stod 'dul ba'i gtso bo zhang zhung rgyal she'i slob ma ni/ dpal 'byor shes rab dang / tshul khrims blo gros la sogs pa yin/ dpal 'byor shes rab 'di ni/ pu rangs lo chung grags 'byor shes rab ༄5chog sher dang / lo tsā ba gzhen nu mchog gi slob ma yin/ pu rangs lo chung 'di ni/ shrī khang dmar gyi gad logs su/ sku lus 'di nyid kyis mkha' spyod du phebs/ khong dang lo che chung du sdebs pa'i lo chen ni mar pa do pa chos kyi dbang phyug yin/ khong gi slob ma dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/de'i dbon po thub pa shes rab/ de'i dbon po dmar chos rgyal yin/ de dag slob brgyud dang bcas pa 'khor lo bde mchog gi bstan pa la gtso bor bka' drin che'o/ /lo chen rin bzang gi rjes la/ gtsang phyogs 'dir sngags kyi bstan 243

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()pa spel ba la 'brog 31 tsā ba snga ba yin te/ stod smad kyi yab mched mjal dus las lo gnyis pa/ ga ya dha ra dgung lo nyis brgya dang zhe gcig bzhes pa/'das lo nas sum stong brgya dang nyer lnga 'das pa'i nyer drug pa chu mo sbrul (spyi lo 993)la 'brog mi bltams/ chu sprul de nas deng sang ni lo lnga brgya dang don gnyis pa yin la/ lo 'di phyi dar sa mo bya nas zhe lnga pa yin zhing / lo chen lasanyer gsum gyis gzhen pa tsam mo/ /de yang bod kyi rgyal po smad kyi lde gsum po grom pa lha rtse na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgyan gong du lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug la bka' stsal te/ mkhan po rgya shākya gzhen nu/ slob dpon se ye shes brtson 'grus/gsang ston nyang rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i dge slong bdun/ dge tshul gnyis/ dge bsnyen gcig dang bcu spyan drangs te grom pa rgyang du dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs pa'i dus su/ rab tu byung ba phyed dang sum brgya tsam 'dus pa'i nang nas/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes/ stag lo tsā ba gzhen nu brtson 'grus/leng ye shes gzhen nu gsum/ mkhan slob rgyal po dang bcas pas rgya gar du chos slob tu btang / bstan pa'i rtsa ba yin pas 'dul ba/ bstan pa'i snying po yin pas phar phyin/ bstan pa'i nying khu yin pas gsang sngags slobs shig cesabakas rab tu gdams pa las/ 'brog mis mkhas pa sgo drug dang / dpa' bo rdo rje las mdo rgyud kyi zab don blangs/ khyad par phyis ga ya dha ra bod du byon pa las gsung ngag rin po che'i bdud rtsi bzhes nas/ bstan pa spel ba'i slob ma'i gtso bo/ man ngag tshar ba gsum/ rgyud tshar ba lnga/ grub pa thob pa bdun sogs byung ba'i/ dang po lha btsun ka li/ 'grom de pa ston chung / se mkhar chung 244

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa skya pa'i 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ 'phrang 'og gi dbrad dkon mchog rgyal po/ mnga' ris pa'i gsal ba'i snying po/ lha rtse'i gyi lngang dbu dkar ba/ shangs kyi brag we so nag pa dang lnga'o/ /gsum pa ni/ skyer snem se'o/ /gshen sgom rog po/ dbus pa grod po che ste pho gsum dang / shab cho/ lcam gcig 'phyad mo nam mkha'/ srad mo ko yi/ stod mo rdo rje mtsho ste mo bzhi'o/ /bla chen 'di'i bka' drin las ma rgyud kye rdo rje'i bka' srol las rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa'i zab don lhag par dar ro/ /'di'i grub thob gsum gyi snyer sgom dang / gsher sgom gnyis ni/ gtsang sgyer bu ba dang / rta nag pa yin pas/ 'brom de pa'i slob ma se rog gnyis dang cung mi gcig pa 'dra ste/ de pa'i slob ma se rog gnyis kyis bla chen la chos kyi bka' drin thob pas/ dngos grub cung zad re thob ces bshad kyi/ grub pa thob ces ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na se rog gnyis ni dbus pa sma ra ser po can dang / nag po can zhes zha lugs 'chad pa ltar dag par sems so/ /mdor na bla chen 'di/ga ya bltams pa'i chu mo sprul nas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu 'das pa'i chu mo sbrul la sku bltams/ sku gzhon nu la rgya gar du byon/ nā len+d+ra/ mkhas pa sgo drug sogs lo brgyad dang / dpa' bo rdo rje la lo bzhi dang / bal por pham mthing pa lo gcig bsten te lo bcu gsum rgya bal du gsan sbyong sogs mdzad/ phyis zhe dgu lon pa lcags mo sbrul la/ ga ya dha ra dang thog mar mjal/ gsung ngag rin po che'i bka' drin lo gsum du nod/ nga gnyis bzhes pa chu mo lug la/ ga ya khu rdor༄6da gsum sogs bsgyur/ drug cu re gsum yan chad la/ gsan spyong 245

ba rme chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()dang 'chad pa sogs kyis bstan pa spel nas/ de nas chos dbyings su mgashegs bar du gtso bor sgrub pa mdzad/ brgyad cu rtsa lnga lon pa'i tshe/ sku lu ma spangs par 'ja' lus su dgongs bzhed pa la/ rten 'brel cung zad 'ang brten nas bar dor mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa ste/ de lta bu'i bla chen madros pa'i chu gter chen po las bka' babs kyi chu rgyun chen po bzhi bab pa'i rgyun 'dzin par byed pa ni rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kho na yin te 'og nas 'chad par byed do/ /zha lugs pa rnams kyis 'brog mi rgya gar du lan gnyis byon pa'idang po la/ shan ti pa sogs kyi drung du lo brgyad bzhugs/ dpa' bo rdo rje dang zhal mjal dbang zab mo'i drin thob tsam byas nas bod du byon/ slar rgya gar du byon dpa' bo rdo rje'i drang du lo bzhi bzhugs zhes 'chad par byed do/ /de nasamar pa snga ste/ sum sneng brgya dang zhe bzhi 'das pa'i zhe lnga pa chu pho byi (spyi lo1012)31ra mar pa bltams/ 'phags yul du lan gsum byon/ bka' babasakyi bla ma bzhi'i zab don bdud rtsi'i bcud thob pa til lo pa'i dngos slob nā ropaṇa chen gyi gsung gi bdud rtsi longs spyad pas/ bka' brgyud ces pa'i sgra bo che 'di khong nas dar ba yin la/ de yang til lo pa la bka' babs bzhi ji ltar byung na/ phyag rdor/ sar ha/ lha hi pa/ ḍi gi pa las brgyud pa dang po phyag chenagyi bka' babs byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ klu sgrub/ ma tang rdzilas gnyis pa pha rgyud kyi bka' babs/ mkha' 'gro ma su ma ti/ thang lo pa shing61 pa/ po'o ri pa las gsum pa ma rgyud kyi bka' babs/ birlu pa/ zlosdi pa/ pi na pa/ la ba pa/ in+d+ra bu ti las sa bzhi pa'i bda' babs so/ /de yang til brdung 246
