brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()pa brgyad brgya la gdugs thogs lnga brgya byung zer/ re gcig pa lcags pho stag zla ba bdun pa'i nyer lnga la gshegs so/ /de la slob ma'i mchog mos gusamathar thug stag lung pa bkra shis 'bar/ rtogs pa'i mthar thug sna bu pa gling ras/ shes rab mthar thug pa par bu ba/ nus pa mthar thug pa mtshan bu ba dzhaibaka' babs bu chen bzhi/ par bu ba 'ji phyu pa 'i slob ma shes rab can bzhi'i/par bu bar grags pa de yin/ skal ldan ye shes seng ge rtogs ldan mi nyagasgom rin/ grub thob nyang re se bo/ kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung bzhi la gdamasapa'i bu bzhi zer/ 'bri khung skyu ra rin chen dang la/ chos rje lta bum pa/ chos rje rgyal tsha/ ban dha phug pa bzhi la ro gcig rtogs pa phyed dang bzhi zer te/ brnya phug pa jo mo yo da pas phyed zer ro/ /de sogs mang du yod kyang gtso bo bsdusan / gling ras 'bri stag gnyis/ khro phu ba kun ldan/ gcang pa ras chung dang bzhir 'dus so/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa'am dbu se ni/ bcu drug lon pa'i tshe/rngog lo'i slob ma bre bo mchog gi bla ma dang / chag seng ge grags las rab tu byung / mtshan dpal chos kyi grags pa zer/ lo nyi shu pa la dbus stod lung rtse thang du byon/ rgya dmar dang phyu pa las dbu tshad/ sha ra ba las bka' gdams/pa tshab las rigs tshogs/ sa skya pa'i thugs sras gshen rdor seng las lamakha'abras/ rga lo dang a seng la sbyor drug sogs gsan/ mal 'dul 'dzin 'kha bsnyen par rdzo gas/ lo gsum pa la dwags po'i sras su gyur/ lo brgyad cu rtsabazhi pa la gshegs so/ /de'i slob ma ni/ brgyud 'dzin gyi bka' babs 'gromagon ras chen/ 'gro don gyi bka' 2)6 pa bka' gdams pa/ rtog

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam ra bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ge 'i bka' babs dbra sgom pa chos brtson/ rdzu 'phrul bka' babs te chung sangs rgyas dang bzhi'o/ /sum stong nyis brgya dang nga lnga 'das pa'i nga drug pa chu mo yos (spyi lo 1123)la skye med shad brtson 'grus grags pa byon/ dwags po sgom chul dang / rgya 'o sogs bsten/ tshal gung thang sogs btab/ don gnyis pa chu mo glang la gung thang gi 'bum mo che bzhengs/ bang rim gsum pa'i tshe zhi bar gshegs so/ /des na da lha'i shing byi 'di/ dwags po'i sa mo lug nas bzhi brgya dang gya drug phag gru pa dang dus gsum mkhyen pa'i lcags stag nas nyis brgya dang nyer lnga/ zhang gi chu mo yos nas bzhi brgya dang zhe gnyis su slebs pa'i lor shes par mdzod cig sum stong nyis brgya dang drug cu 'das pa'i re gcig pa sa pho sprel (spyi lo 1128)lo gling rabs bltams/ rang lo so gcig pa nas rgyal ba lo dang / sum pa lo sogs lo ras mched gsum snga phyir lo bco lnga bsten te/nā ro pa'i gdams pa nyams su bzhes/ zhe gcig pa la phag gru pa 'i lhan cig skyes sbyor gsan pas/ chu bo gaṅgā tshun na lta ba bzang bar grags/ dbyar zla gsum phag grur bzhugs/ bud med sngon slo zhig gis mdo rgyud kyi lung gnang bas mdo rgyud rang dbang du 'grel ba'i spobs pa thob/ bka' 'gyur thugs la bzhugs/ mkha' 'gro ma lngas rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rgyu gos chen la sku rnams thags las bton pa phul ba da lta yang sna phu chos lung na yod zer/ rang lo re gcig pa sprel lo dbyar ra'i nyer brgyad la gshegs/ 'di skye med zhang las lo lngas gzhen no/ /gling ras kyi slob ma'i gtso bo ni gtsang pa rgya ras ye shes rdo rje'o/ /dgung lo lnga bcu nga gcig ba//7 / /sum stong nyis brgya dang don

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()bzhi 'das pa'i don lnga pa chu pho khyi (spyi lo 1142)la stag lung chos rje bkra shi dpa g.yang shod bong rar bltams/ lo bco brgyad pa la rab tu byung / nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la dbus su byon/ phag gru pa lo drug bsten/ so dgu pa lcags pho byi lo la stag lung du phebs/ tshogs pa stong phrag 'dus/ rang lo re dgu pa rta lo mgo zla'i tshes bcu dgu la gshegs so/ /'bri gung pa chen po ni/ khams kyi ldan mar chu mo phag (spyi lo 1143)la byon pas/ stag lung pa las lo gcig gisagazhen/ so lnga pa la zhang sum thog pa kye po ye rdor las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sku gzhen nu nas phag gru pa bsnyen/ gdan sa lo gsum mdzad de gzhan don cher ma byung / phyis so bdun pa la 'bri khung du phebs/ tshogs pa lnga khri lnga stong lnga brgya nyer lnga 'dus/ 'di ni slob dpon klu sgrub kyi skye bar grags te/ sing ga gling gi dgra bcom pa zhig gis/ kha che paṇa chen gyi gcung po la me tog bzhi bskur te/ gcig 'bri zhes bya ba'i dgon pa na slob dpon klu sgrub byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal du skye ba blangs yod pa de la phul/ gcig rat+na kubazhi'i gtsug lag khang na byang chub sems dpa' skal ldan shing rta yod pas de la phul/ gtsag rī bha ba zhig yod pa de la phul/ yang me tog gcigs paṇa da ri mjal tshe kha phye'o zhes pa'i gtso yas snang ngo //gcig des lha chen po zhig bzhengs pa 'dug pasade'i thugs dar zhog ces bshad pa dang / yang kha che paṇa chen klas mo cher bzhugs pa'i tshe 'bri khung pa'i khams btsun zhig gis/ paṇa chen la chos gosaslang zhes sku chos la 'jus/ nye gnas kyi kho brdabs te sna khrag byung bas/ paṇa chen thugs dam gyi tshe sgrol ma byon pa huX 8zhag bdun du ma byon te/ khyod dpon

bstan rtsi gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//slob kyis klu sgrub kyi slob ma la sdig bsags nyes pa de sbyang ba la rab byung gzhan la rang gi lo grangs kyi chos gos byin cig ces sogs bshad pa las shes so/ /dgongs gcig la sogs pa'i bstan bcos brtsams/ thugs sras spyan snga bas 'grel pa yang mdzad do/ /mthar rang lo don lnga pa glang lo zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la sku gshegs pa las/ slob ma gnyis kyis tshogs pa la zhal ston par gsol bas slar 'od gsal las bzhengs te nyi ma gnyis su chos gnang bas nyer bdun la gshegs so/ /mchod pa gang la 'dzin zhus pas/ nyer lnga la gzung gsung nas lnga mchod du grags so/ /'di'i thugs sras ni spyan snga ba grags pa 'byung gnas te/ 'di nyid rje btsun grags pa chos dbyings su gshegs pa'i gsol 'debs kyi tshogs dpon la/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis spyan drangs zhes kyang zer ro/ /des na 'bri stag gnyis kyi bar na lo gcig las med la / stag lung pa chen po rje btsun bsod rtse dang na mnyam/chos rje sa paṇa shar la thegs pa'i tshe/ 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po mjal gsung ba cung mi 'grig pa 'dra ste/de'i dus 'bri stag gnyis char gshegs tshar bas/ des na de'i tshe 'bri khung spyan snga ba dang mjal ba las 'os med do//de gnyis gling ras las lo bzhis gzhen no/ /bka' gdams pa'i skor la/glang thang pa shing pho rta lo yin pas sa chen las lo so brgyad kyis bgres/ sha ra ba lcags pho khyi lo ba ste/ sa chen las nyer gnyis kyis bgres/ bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od shing mo yos lo pa ste sa chen las bco brgyad kyis bgres/ bya 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo rje lcags mo sprul lo pa ste sa chen las lo dgus gzhen/stabs ka ba dme grags chu mo lug / mi ste sa chen las lo bcu gcig gis

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()gzhon/ 'od 'jo ba gzhon nu yon tan me mo lug lo pa ste sa chen las lo lngas gzhon/ bsod rtse las bco lngas bgres/ rje sgam po pa ni sha ra ba las lo brgyad dang / bya yul ba las lo bzhis gzhen/ gling ras sa chen las lo drug gis gzhon/ g.yin yang / phyu pa'i seng chen brgyad/ gnyal zhig bu dgu/ pa tshab bu bzhi sogs sa chen yab sras gsum dang ci rigs par thog mtshungs pa lags so/ /sum stong nyis brgya dang so gsum 'das pa'i so bzhi pa lcags mo sprul (spyi lo 1101)la/ gling gi thugs sras gtsang pa rgya ra nyang stod du byon/'di rje btsun grags pa las bcu bzhis gzhen/ 'brug ra lung gi dgon pa btab/ 'brug pa zhes yongs su grags shing / nā ro pa'i sprul par byed/ 'di la slob ma'i mchog dbon sras dang chos sras gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbon sras dar ma seng ge sogs so/ /gnyis pa la dang por che ba spang rkyang gnyis/ bar du che ba brgya 'bras gnyis/ tha mar che ba lo rgod gnyis sogs yod pa las/ dang po ni / spa ri ba dang rkyang mo kha pa gnyis/ gnyis pa ni brgya legs pa dang 'bras mo ba gnyis/ gsum pa ni lo ras pa dang rgod tshang pa gnyis so/ /de yang lo nasamached pa la smad 'brug dang / rgod tshang pa nas mched pa la stod 'brug dang /dbon sras sogs kyis skyong ba la bar 'brug ces grags so/ /gzhan yang sku'i sprul pa dam pa sa skor ba/ gsung gi sprul pa dam pa gter khung pa/ thugs kyi sprul pa dam pa ko brag pa/ phrin las sprul pa grub thob dgon g.ye dang bzhi'o/ /de lta bu'i gtsang pa rgya ras de ni nga gcig pa dbo zla'i nyer lnga la gshegs so/ /'di nyid bltams pa'i lcags sprul na/gyi /zhi brgya dang nyag ma bzhi ru slebs pa

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid bye nga lhag bas mar bdakar zhes byab bzhugs so// ni shing pho byi lo 'di yin no/ /gsum pa/ sum stong sum brgya pa'i skabs su byon pa ni/ ko brag pa/ khro lo/ sa lo/ rgod tshang pa rnams te/ de yang sum stong sum brgya gnyis 'das pa'i gsum pa lcags pho stag (spyi lo 1170)la nas brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan ding rir byon/ lo brgyad cu bzhugs/ dwags po bka' brgyud dang lam 'bras zha lugs sogs nyams len mdzad/ slob ma'i gtso bo yang dgon pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags dang gnyis/ g.yin yang dpyal lo/khro lo/chag lo/ gnyal lo ste/ lo tsā ba bzhi'o/ /deb sngon las ko brag pa sa paṇa dang dgung mnyam yin zer ro/ /dus gsal gyi lug lta ran paṇa lasalo skor gcig gis bgres so// sum stong sum brgya dang bzhi 'das pa'i lnga pa chu mo sprul ṣ+ka pho 'brug la babs/sgrig pa pos/na(spyi lo 1172)la ste1 sdo(zur+sha tsā ba dra'i5bang pa dpa'/byon/ 'di ni phag gru pa'i dngos slob rgyal tsha ri mgon dang / de'i dbon po kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung gnyis yod pa'i/ kun ldan ras pa'i dbon po yin la/kun ldan ras pa'i slob ma gcig ri mas/ nya pa lus skyes zhes pa la bu gcig skyes pa skyes bu dam pa gcig 'byon pa shes nas gso skyong mdzad pas gces sgom rdzo nga par grags/ mkha' skyong brag pa zhes kyang bya/ 'di nyid sa chen gyi dngos slob tu 'dod/ 'ga' zhig sa chen gyi dngos slob rgyal tsha ta la phug pa yin la/ de dang ma gcig ri ma'i dngos slob gces sgom rdzong pa yin zer/'ga' zhig 'di 'khrungs yul khams pa yin la/ nyi gzhug brag tu lta ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i don skyong ba'i mkha' skyong brag pa dang / rta nag ga ga'i rdzo nga la sgom pas gces sgom rdzong pa /yang grags zer/ bdag gi bla ma ni/

brdzi chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chog 'byung gces bsdus/()gces sgom 'di la rta nag gces sgom dang / kha rag gces sgom sogs yod pa'i/ man ngag rin spungs gsung ba po ni rta nag gces sgom yin gsung ngo / /gang ltar na'ang khro los/ rje mi tri/ paṇa chen burnya shrī/ shākya shrī gsum rim pasaspyan drangs/ byams chen bzhengs pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba mtha' yas pa mdzad do/ /'di dang rje sa paṇa rtsod pa mdzad pa'i rtsod yig kyang yod do/ /sum stong sum brgya dang bcu bzhi song ba'i bco lnga pa chu pho stag (spyi lo 1182)la gang bangacan mkhas kha pa'i ga khug rgyan bang skya paṇ+ḍita byon/ chu stag de nas sum brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gsum lon pa'i lo ni da lta'i shing byi 'di yin la/ des na phyi dar sa slo bya nas nyis brgya dang so gsum song zin pa'i so bzhi'am/ rngog lo tsā ba byon pa'i me mo bya nas brgya dang nyer lnga 'das pa'i nyer drug pa'am/ sa chen kun snying byon pa'i sa pho sprel lo nas dgu bcu 'das pa'i go gcig pa chu pho stag la sa paṇ+ḍita bstan pa'i nyi ma shar ba yin no/ /paṇa chen 'di nyid btsas ma thag tu saṃ spru ta'i gsung dbyangs snyan par sgrogs/ bco lnga man chad la/ rje btsun chen po'i drung du/ sa skya gong ma'i gsung gi bcud mdo sngags kyi zab gnad yongs su rdzogs/ bcu dgu pa la ku mud bshad pa'i dus kyi 'od gsal chen po'i ngang las/ a phyi 'bum pa'i drung du mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen la chos mngon pa mdzod dang / kha che paṇa chen la de nyid kyi chos zab mo rdo rje'i glu las legs par nod/ rgya gar shar phyogs su phyogs kyi glang po'i gdan seng ge'i khri la 'khod de/ glegs bam gzhal du med pa'i lde mig bzung / pad dkar bzhad pa'i dus kyi mdangs rab tu rgyas pas rdo/ 'phrang du zhu ston rdo rje skyabs la

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes byab bzhugs so//byams chos sogs lung gi chos skor/ nyi shu pa la rkyang 'dur du/ me bya byang brtson dang gtsang nag pa'i slob ma mtshur ston gzhon seng la bod bgres po nas brgyud pa'i tshad ma'i chos skor/ gzhan yang phywa pa'i seng chen brgyad kyi rtsegs pa dbang phyug seng ge la bod la grags pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i chos ji snyed pa/ spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od la/ bod la grags pa'i zhi byed rdzogs chen gcod bka' gdams la sogs pa'i gdams ngag ji snyed pa khong du chud/ nyer gsum pa shing pho byi lor gtsang chu mig tu kha che paṇa chen dang mjal/ paṇa chen de nyid dang de'i slob bu rgya gar shar nub gung gsum na sgra la mkhas par grags pa'i saṃ ga shrī ste dge 'dun dpal dang / su ga tā shrī ste legs par gshegs pa'i dpal dang / dwa na thi la ste tshul khrims sbyin sogs snga phyir bsten te/ bod rgan po'i 'gros kyis zlo bslad pa'i lha rgyan gyi bshad srol las byon pa'i tshad ma la sogs pa'i rig gnas che ba lnga/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod/ zlos gar/ rtsis te rig gnas chung ba lnga ste/ rig gnas bcus bsdus pa'i zab chosathams cad/ chos sgo skyel du byon pa'i sgo nas legs par nod de sa paṇ+ḍi ta zhes snyan par grags/ paṇa chen dbus nas 'khor rjes de nyid kyis nyi shu rtsa bdun bzhes pa'i sa pho 'brug gi lor lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis bzhengs pa'i nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du/ kha che paṇa chen gyis mkhan po/ spyi bo lhasapa byang chub 'od kyis las slob/ don mo ri pas gsang ston bgyis te bsnyen par rdzogs/ sa paṇa 'di nyid sku bltams pa'i lor rje btsun rtse mo 'ja' lusasu gshegs pas zhal gyi bdud rtsi da/rdo su ma thob kyang / rang lo so lnga pa'i

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bar du grags pa'i 'chi med bdud rtsi ngoms nga ra gsol/ khyad par lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnad rang sar 'grig ste sa dang po'i yon tan mchog tu brnyes/ nyid kyi so gsum pa la kha che paṇa chen slar kha cher bzhud/ so lnga pa la rje btsun chen po bde ba can du gshegs/ rje sapaṇa so lnga pa 'i tshe grags pa gshegs dus bstan rtsis mdzad pa na so lnga pa me khyi yan la sum stong sum brgya dang lnga bcu song bas slan chad kyang de bzhin rtsi bar bya'o/ /zhes 'di pa ltar gyi rtsis zhakhrul med pa 'di yin no/ /so brgyad pa tsam gyi tshe/ rgya bod kyi ngan rtog gi brag ri 'joms par byed pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos rigs pa'i gter zhes grags pa de brtsams/ lnga bcu rtsa gcig tsam gyi tshe legs bshad kyi sbrang rtsi spel ba'i dga' ston/ bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas par byed pa'i sdom gsum rab dbye'i nyin byed kyang shar/ lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa'i tshe 'phags pa wa ti'i dri'i gtsang khang dang 'dab 'byor ba'i dpal gyi gnas su/rgya gar lho phyogs kyi 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa'i phas kyi rgol ba ngan pa drug lung rigs kyis tshar bcad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bcug gang gi snyan pa'i rnga sgra gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ma shongs te/ rgya dkar nag dang hor bal gyi ljongs thams cad kyang gang bar byas/ drug cu rtsa gsum pa'i tshe/ stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba rgya nag mtha'i rgyal po go dan gyis bsod nams kyi mgron du spyan drangs/ drug cu rtsa lnga pa me pho rta'i lor pho brang chen po ling chu rtser gdan phebs/ rgyal rmes nyams sad pa'i phyir sgyu ma 'i dri gtsang khang khang phran gyis bskor ba'i gtsug lag khang gi sgyu la/ṭ+wāṃ 4gyi ra bar spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ ting nge

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'dzin gyi mthus brtan par bzhugs su gsol te/ byang phyogs sprul pa 'i sde'i gtsug lag khang zhes phyogs kun tu snyan par grags/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po la bslus chen po der byung / rgyal po 'khor bcas dga' bdes yid rab tu g.yos/bdun cu pa'i bar du rgya nag po'i yul du bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel/ lcags phag smal zla'i bcu bzhi'i tho rangs sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdos/ sku'i skye ba phyi ma mkha' la spyod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i gar gyis rol/ de shes gnyis pa'i tshe/shar phyogs mu mu nir rgyal po nyi ma stobs 'phel gyi sras dam par gyur te sa lam phal cher bgrod/ de nas gsum pa'i tshe mngon dga'i zhing du bde bar gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas/ longs sku'i cha byad sku mdog gangs ri'i mdog can chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can rin po che'i rgyan dang rab tu mdzes pa'i gos )bklubs pa dag pa'i 'khor 'bum gyis bskor ba'o/ /de ltar na phyi dar nyid la bstan pa'i nyin byed lan gsum shar te/ lo chen rin bzang gis/ dar mas bstan pa bsnubs rjes kyi chos min thams cad tshar bcad/ de rjes mgos rngog rnam gnyis kyis slo bur gyi chos log thams cad sun dbyung / de nas bzung ste chos rje sa skya pa chen po grags pa'i mtha' can gyi sku'i tshe'i stod smad lo brgya tsam zhig bstan pa sprin med kyi mkha' ltar gnas pa las/ phyis rang bzo phag mo'i byin rlabs/ yi dam dkrong bskyed/gtum mo bde rkyang / sems bskyed rmi lam ma/ sems bskyed rku thabs/ bsngo ba yod dge dkar po rig thub sogs chos min gyi rnam grangs brgya rtsa zhig gi mun rum tshar gcod pa la bstan bcos sdo/ 0/sum rab dbye'i nyin byed 'di shar ba

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()yin no/ /des na deng gi dus na rgyal ba'i bstan pa la lung rigs kyis cung zad dpyad du yod pa 'di paṇa chen 'di nyid kyi bka' drin yin no/ shes bya rig gnas lnga'i sgo phye ste/ rig pa'i gnas la blo kha cung zhig phyogs pa'i bod kyi gzhen nu blo gsal dag la paṇ+ḍi ta zhes pa'i mtshan tsam gyis kyang kha ba can 'di dkar por byas pa min nam/ de yang phyi dar la lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sku ngo la/ rma la lo tsā bas tshad ma la bshad pa cung zad mdzad cing / khyung po gragasases kyang tshad ma bshad de tshad ma rnying ma zhes pa'i bstan pa cung zad dar/ de rjes rngog lo chen pos tshad ma rgyan dang chos mchog gtso bor bton te tshad ma gsar ma zhes bya ba'i bstan pa spel/ de nyid kyi dngos brgyud kyi slob bu dag gi rang bzor sgro btags pa'i tshad ma'i bstan pa ha cang dar ches pa'i tshe/ dag ma dag gi rab dbye legs par phye ste/ sde bdun gyi snying po gsal bar ston pa'i tshad ma rigs pa'i gter zhes bya ba'i sgo nas tshad ma'i bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin shar ba yin zhing / rig gnas g.yin la yang des mtshon te shes par mdzod cigs paṇ+ḍi ta'i slob ma'i mchog rtogs pa'i brgyud 'dzin tshogs grub dbon gsum/man ngag gi brgyud 'dzin lho dmar rnam gnyis/ bshad pa'i brgyud 'dzin shar nub gung gsum/ sdom phrug bgres pa dpal bzang po bcu gsum/ gzhen sargyal mtshan gyi mtha' can bdun/ lo tsā ba chen po bzhi/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pachen po bzhi/ mkhas btsun gyi thugs sras bzhi/ sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin rgyal r+pāyang dgon pa/ sbas pa'i grub chen zangs tsha bsod rgyal lo/ /de dag kyang rimapa ltar/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpa10/6gtsang snyer phur lcags pho rta la byon/

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//chos rje pa lo bcu gsum bsten/ go brgyad pa la gshegs/ sa paṇa las lo nyer brgyad kyis gzhon/ grub thob yon tan dpal stag ste ngam rings su byon/ chosarje pa lo drug bsten/ se mo che ras pa zhes grags/ dbon po 'phags pa rin po che sa paṇa nga bzhi bzhes pa'i shing mo lug la byang ngam rings klung khungs su byon no / / tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa la la nyan zhang gsum zhes grags te/ la ru ba bsod nams bzang po/ stag rtse la ru gser khang du byon/bco brgyad pa la 'phags pas rab tu byung / shar pa rdo rje 'od zer la rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ phyis spyi'i sen mo rang grub thob yon tan dpal la lo gsum gsung ngag gsan no/ /nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa la stod byang mdog rje rong dbyig mkhar du chu pho rta la byon/ tshogs sgom pa lo bcu gsum bsten/ lo go drug bzhugs/ tshogs sgom pa las lo bcu gnyis kyisagazhen no/ /lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal lho pa drug pa yin/ sku shin tu bgres pa nas byang ngos su brda don gsal ba'i tho sgrig zhu ba la byon/ dmar chos rgyal/ pu rangs lo chung gi dngos slob dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbon brgyud yin/ chos rje pa lo brgyad bsten/ shar nub gung gsum gyi/ shar pa shes rab 'byung gnas dang / shar pa rdo rje 'od zer te sku mched gnyis/ nub pa 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge de'i dbon po nyi thog pa sangs rgyas kun smon/de'i ka chen khang gnyan shad gsum zur khang pa dang bzhir grags pa'i khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ gnyan dar ma seng ge zhang mdo sde dpal/ zur khang pa dkar shākya grags/ gung pa la skyo rdo/ ḍi med de/ de thams cad sa paṇa gyi

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()dngos slob yin no/ /dkar shāka ni gtso bor grags pa yin no/ /sdom phrugabagres pa bcu gsum ni/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal bzang po/ rin chen skyob pa dpal bzang po/ lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal bzang po/ shad rgyalab dpal bzang po/ zhang mdo sde dpal bzang po/ phyi ru ba seng ge dpal bzang po / grub snying po rdo rje dpal bzang po/ ldong ston shes rab dpal bzang po jo gdan byang chub dpal bzang po/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal bzang po/ skyo ston drimed dpal bzang po 'a nyis ga snams so/ /jo gdan byang chub dpal ni/ chosarje pa'i slob ma shin tu yin kyang / kha che paṇa chen gyi mkhan bu yin pas chos rje pa'i sdom phrug tu cung zhig mi rigs pa 'dra mod/ 'on kyang rje kun mkhyen gyi ṭīk+ka ltar bgrangs pa'o/ /gzhan pa rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can bdun ni/ shar paye shes rgyal mtshan/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ dga' ldan pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gsol ja ba 'dul ba rgyal mtshan/ 'u yug pa dpal gyi rgya camatshan/ yar klungs pa shākya rgyal mtshan/ yar klungs pa byang chub rgyal mtshan rnams so/ /de yang yar klungs pa byang chub rgyal mtshan ni/ chos rje pa'i rnam tharatshigs bcad ma rgyas pa rtsom pa po yin la/ rnam thar bsdus pa rtsom pa po'i yar klungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan yang bsnan nas rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can brgyad ces bya'o/ /lo chen bzhi ni/ chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ glo bo lo tsā ba shesarab rin chen/ rong pa rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ shad lo tsā ba grub pa dpal dang bzhi'o/ /chag lo ni/ chag dgra bcom gyi dbon po ste/ me mo sprul lo la byon/sa paṇa las lo bco lngas gzhen no/ 3/༷/ lo ni kha che paṇa chen gyi slob ma'ang

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// yin la gtso bor ras chung snyan brgyud kyi brgyud pa la bzhugs pa de'o/ /yar klungs pa rgyal tsha lung gi dbang phyug zhang bya ru ba ār+ya de ba/ lu phu ba bsod nams rin chen/ slang ra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan de sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po bzhi/ mkhas btsun chen po bzhi ni/ bo dong pa rin chen brtson 'grus rdo rje / gtsang nag phug pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzad pa ring mo/ te ra pa byams pa mgon po dang bzhi'o/ /bo dong rin po che ni lcags pho sprel lo pa ste/ sa paṇa las lo bco brgyad kyis gzhen/gtsang nag phug tu mkhas pa yongs su grags pa gsum byon pa'i/ gtsang nag brtson 'grus seng ge ni/ phywa pa'i seng chen gcig yin la/ gtsang nag phug pa thugs rje seng ge ni/ jo nang kun spangs zhad gi slob ma ste bar do 'phrang sgrol mdzad pa po de yin/ 'jam dbyang shes rab 'od zer ni/ thog mar sa paṇa la dgag pa mdzad pas 'jam dbyangs mi dges pa'i rnam pa bstan/ bshags pa byas te chos rje khu dbon gyi thugs sras su gyur pa'o/ /sum stong sum brgya dang bcu drug 'das pa'i shing pho 'brug (sbyi lo 1184)la zang tsha bsod na mthasargyal mtshan sku 'bum rnam rgyal du byon/ dgung lo nga drug pa sa mo phag rgyal zla'i nyer gnyis la mdog ros kyi sag rir gshegs/ 'phags pa dang 'gro mgon phyag na gnyis/ bdapon rin chen rgyal mi'/) slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas gnyis la re zhig zangs tsha'i sras bzhi zer/ phyi ma gnyis sa pho khyi lo pa dgung mnyam yin no/ /sum stong sum brgya dang nyer gcig 'das pa'i nyer gnyis pa sa mo bya (spyi lo 115)la /ste tshang pa mgon po rdo rje bltams/

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()lo bcu dgu pa la rab tu byung / gtsang pa rgya ras kyi zhabs zung zla ba gsunibasten/ kong po nas dza lan dha ra'i bar gyi gnas rnams su sgrub pa gzhan donakho na mdzad/ bdun cu bzhes pa rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum la gsheg bkaslob ma'i mchog rang las lag pa gcig rang dang mnyam pa brgyad sogs byon pa las/ rang las lhag pa ni yang dgon pa yin la mnyam pa brgyad ni rten 'brel rang dang mnyam pa ni rings pa/ sgrub tshugs rang dang mnyam pa pu tri ri khrod gling pa/ mos gus rang dang mnyam pa spyil dkar ba/ snying rje rang dang mnyam pa ma bdun pa/ zhen log rang dang mnyam pa gangs shākya bshes gnyen/dag snang rang dang mnyam pa nam mkha' rdo rje/ dka' spyad rang dang mnyam pa g.ya' mdo rings kyi sha kya ras pa/ brtul zhugs rang dang mnyam pa grub chen sngasargyan pa dang brgyad do/ /des na rgod tshang pa byon pa'i sa mo bya nas sum brgya dang don drug yin la 'di sa paṇa las lo bdun gyis gzhon/ sum stong sum bskyodang so lnga 'das pa'i so drug chu mo phag (spyi lo 1203)la rong pa sgro lo byon/khams pa rgya lo'i skye bar bzung nas rgya lo zer/ khams pa rga lo 'di sa chen dang phar slob tshur slob yin/ dpyal lo'i drung du rgya yig sogs la sbyangs/ brgyad stopa la gshegs so/ /'di'i slob ma ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ khro phu rin po che/lho pa grub seng / thang ston lo tsā grags rgyal/ man lung pa chen po'o/ /sum stongasum brgya so drug 'das pa'i so bdun pa shing pho byi lo (spyi lo1204)la kha rtsepaṇa chen shākya shrī bha dra 'khor paṇa chung dgu dang bcas te bod du phebs/ de'i tshe ko brag pas lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ khro // /rgo gsum/ sa los lo nyi shu rtsa gsum/

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam ra bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgod tshang pas ༅ drag lon/ des na jo bo rje bod du byon pa'i shing pho rta lo nas/lo brgya dang lnga bzlo 'das pa'i nga gcig pa shing pho byi lo paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du byon pa yin zhes bya'o/ /'khor paṇa chung dgu ni dbu phar la mkhas pa su ga tā shrī / sngags 'dul la mkhas pa dza ya rat+na/ sgra dang mngon pa la mkhas pa bi bzhi tsan+d+ra/ tshad ma la mkhas pa dwa na shī la/ tsan+d+ra pa la mkhas pa saṃ gha shrī/ mngon pa gong 'og la mkhas pa su ma ti ga / dus 'khor la mkhas pa dzi na su pa ta/spyod 'jug la mkhas pa mahā bo dhi rnams so/ /de yang kha che khri brtan gyi bye brag dza sho dha ra zhes par shing mo glang gi lo (spyi lo 1145)paṇa chen 'di nyid sku bltams/ lo bcu pa la bram ze las ra la sgra rig gsan/ lo dgu nas nyer gnyis bar la tshangs spyod dge bsnyen mdzad/ nyer gsum pa la mkhan po su kha shrī bha dra bde ba dpal bzang po las rab tu byung / nyer dgu'i bar du kha cher bzhugs/ sum cu pa la yul dbus ma ga dhar byon/ mkhan po shan+ta ka ra gup+ta ste zhi ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa dang / da sha bha la dang / gsang ston dha bar ka sogs bco brgyad las bsnyen par rdzogs/ drug cu bzhes pa'i tshe khro lo lo so gsum lon pa gcig gis byi lo mchu'i zla ba la spyan 'dren la byon te rgya gar be+e ḍūr+ya'i tshong 'dus su phebs/ shākya'i bstan la shākya'i sras bltams shākya'i mtshan/ /zhes sogs kyi zhu yig rten dang bcas phul/ ba yi sha ra bya bar paṇa chen dang mjal/ paṇa chen gyi gsung gis/ lo tsā ba 'di chos mang du shes pa/lha chen po bzhengs pa'i stobs yod pa'i yar rgan cig yod bsam pa la na tshod gzhon nur 'dug chos sgyur ba'i lo sdo ༵ yang mi phod/ sgrub thabs 'ga' byin

ba chen 'od snang las/sa ci'i chos 'gungs tses bsdus /()la 'o skol da pon slob phyir log gsungs/ paṇ+ḍi ta dzā ya shrīs dpon slob rnamasalo tsā ba'i gzugs la brnyas 'dug pa sa 'bel ba'i gtam smyos shig ces skabs dbye/ lo tsā bas paṇa chung dgu la dri ba mi 'dra ba gnyis gnyis byas/paṇa chen rab tu dges te spyan drangs pa'i rngo thogs/ paṇa chung rnams la'ang do li byas te rim pas spyan drangs/ chu mig tu khro phu'i bsu ba'i bkod pa dge 'dun drug cu/ dar gdugs rol mo sogs drug cu dang bcas pas khro phur spyan drangs/ de'i tshe sa paṇ+ḍita sa yab dpal chen 'od po phag lo sku gshegs nas/gshegs rdzongs kyi sku skal rkyang 'dur du 'bul bar phebs pa'i bar lam chu mig tu chos rje dang mjal/ tshad ma chos mchog gi bstod pa sogs mdzad pa yin zer/ khro phur byi lo'i dbyar gnas mdzad/ tshul shing len pa brgyad brgya byung / brgyad stong pa sogs gsungs so/ /lo tsā bas dar zab kyi thun yon de ma chag par phul/ lho brag pa byang chub dpal la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / dbus la 'bri khung pas spyan 'dren pa'i cha rkyen mang po slebs/ slas mo cher phebs rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i rten ma chod rnams zhal phye/ mchod pa gzab par phul/gtsang po ba bsod nams mdzes kyis mjal/ bdag bsnyen par rdzogs nas lhung ba byung ba ma dran pas tshul khrims bsrungs pa'i dge ba bsngo bar zhus pas/dbu zhwa zul gyi phud phyag thal mo sbyar nas bsngo ba rgyu bzang 'di lta bu rgya gar na yang dkon gsungs nas bsngo ba mdzad/ glang lo'i dbyar gnas slas mo cher mdzad dgag dbye thon nas chu mig ring mor byon/ rgyan gong gnas su rdo rje dpal la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / gzhu ṭ+wāṃ 2mo'i nang la byon/ mtshur phu nas stod

bstar rtsis gsal ba'i snyed byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs po//lung brgyud de jo bo rnam gnyis la mchod pa phul/ mtshur phu ba'i skyel mi rnamasal / khyed kyi dgon pa na sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i sku gsum snang ba khyed kyis ngo ma shes gsungs/ sku gsum ni bde mchog yab yum go ldogashākya thub pa sprul sku la yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor gyi lha dang gsum mo/ /de nas srin po rir stag lo dbyar gnas mdzad/ byams chos khrid dang rigs tshogs rnams gsungs/ me mo yos la sol nag thang po cher phebs/ bstan rtsis mdzad pa na/ smin drag zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /tshes brgyad nam gung mnyam pa la/ /zla ba ri tshug la nub tshe/ /thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /de rjes lo ni stong phrag gcig /bdun brgya dang ni lnga bcu dang / /zla ba gnyis dang zla ba phyed/ /de bzhin nyi ma snga rabs 'das/ /ches/sogs bshad/ 'o na rang lugs kyi skar rtsis dang ches mi mthun no snyam na skyon med de/paṇa chen gyi bstan rtsis kyi 'das lo'i thog ma ni/ mtho btsun grub rje dang bde byed bdag pos byang chub chen po'i sku bzhengs dus kyi me mo sbrul nas bzung ba yin no zhes bshad zin la/ de lta bu'i me sgrul de ni/ 'das lo nas stong dang lnga brgya gya dgu 'das pa'i dgu bcu pa yin no zhes kyang bshad zin zhing / paṇa chen gyi bstan rtsis 'di ni me mo yos lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes lnga la mdzad pa yin pa dang / me yos nag pa zla ba'i tshes lnga ni/ mahā bo dhi byon pa'i me sbrul nas/lo stong dang bdun brgya dang lnga bcu 'das pa'i lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa me mo yos lo rang gi steng nas zla ba phyed dang gsum dang zhag lnga song ba de yin par shin tu gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na me yos3 di/ ni 'das lo nas lo sum stong sum

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()brgya dang bzhi bcu dang paṇa chen bod du byon pa'i lo bzhi pa yin no/ /de nas byang rwa sgreng du byon pa'i yar lam 'bri khung pas spyan drangs kyang / gdan cig pa dang bka' gdams pas gegs byas/ mjal du ma ster zer ro/ /phyis de sa pho 'brug gi lo gtsang du phebs/ nyang smad rgyan gong du sa paṇa la bsnyen rdzogasaganang / gsang ston snyi bo lha pa byang chub 'od pa ni shing pho byi lo ste/ de'i tshe re lnga pa yin/ sbrul la'i dbyar gnas rin chen snang du mdzad/ rta lo'i dbyar gnas shangs lu gu gdong du mdzad/ la btsun gung thang pa la bsnyen rdzogasaganang / sprel lo'i dbyar gnas khro phur mdzad de/ chu pho sprel lo gre zla ba'i tshesagasum nas bcu gsum gyi bar du khro phu byams chen gyi rab gnas mdzad/ rim gyis khro phu nas mnga' ris su phebs te/ bya lo'i dbyar gnas pu rangs su gnang / shing pho khyi lo kha cher phebs te lo nyer dgu tsam zhig tu bstan 'gro'i don mdzad/ dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa sgrog zla ba'i tshes lnga la zhi bar gshegs/ de la paṇa chen shing pho byi lor bod du phebs nas/ lo bcu gcig bod du bzhugasazer ba 'di la phal cher mthun mod/ 'khrungs lo la mi mthun pa 'ga' zhig 'dug pa'i/ deb sngon las/ paṇa chen me mo lug la bltams/ don brgyad pa shing pho byi lor bod du phebs/ chu mo bya'i bar lo bcu bzhugs/ shing khyi la kha cher thegs/ go gcig shing bya la gshegs zer mod/ khro los mdzad pa'i bstod pa las/ gcig gis ma tshang lo brgya'i dus/ /bya lo sgrog zla'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /spen pa'i nyi ma'i tshes lnga la/ /'gro ba'i nyi ma nub par bstan/ /zhes go dgu pa bya lor zhi bar gsheg/ //ra bshad pa dang cung zad 'byor kyang /

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//thub dbang yongs 'das lo ni brgya phrag bcu/ /drug bcas dgu bcu rtsa gnyis mthar son tshe/ shwakya'i bstan srog ngur smig 'dzin pa'i gtsor/ / byon gyur drang srong de yi rnam thar bris/ /zhes pa dang mi 'byor te/ lung des/ paṇa chen lugs kyi 'das lo nas stong dang drug brgya go gnyis 'das pa'i tshe paṇa chen sku 'brungs par bshad la/ thang po cher bstan rtsis mdzad pa'i me mo yos yan chad la lo stong dang bdun brgya lnga bcu 'das par paṇa chen rang gi bshad pa ltar yang khas blangs dgos pa las/ khyed ltar na thang po che'i me mo yos lo ni paṇa chen gyi brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa yin pas/ paṇa chen 'khrungs gong yan chad kyi stong drug brgya go gnyis dang / paṇa chen dgung lo gya gcig po bsres pas stong bdun brgya don gsum du yang sleb 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /jo gdan mkhan chen chos grub seng ges mdzad pa'i paṇa chen gyi rnam thar las/ khro los mdzad pa'i/thub dbang yongs 'das lo ni brgya phrag bcu/ /drug bcas dgu bcu rtsa gnyis mthar son nas/ /zhes pa 'di yi ge ma dag pa yin pas/ thub dbang yongs 'das lo ni brgya phrag bcu/ /dgu bcas bdun cu rtsa gsum mthar son nas/ /zhes 'don dgos la/ de ltar na 'das lo nas lo stong dgu brgya don gsum 'das pa'i lcags pho sprel lor paṇa chen bltams/ re lnga pa shing pho byi lor bod du phebs/ don lnga pa shing pho khyi la kha cher phebs/ go dgu pa khyi la zhi bar gshegs zhes bshad pa yang / thang po cher rtsis pa'i bstan rtsis dang 'gal te/khyed ltar na thang po che'i me yos ni paṇa chen gyi drug cu rtsa brgyad yin la/ drug cu rtsa brgyad po de dang / paṇa chen 'brung /snying gi lo stong dgu brgya don gsum po

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa sbya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bsres pas/nyis stong zhe gcig tu yang 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na kho bo ni skabs 'dir dus gsal sor bzhag nas/ kha che paṇa chen rang nyid kyi bstan rtsis ltar gyi/ 'das lo'i stong dang drug brgya go gnyis 'das pa'i go gsum pa shing mo glang la paṇa chen bltams/ drug cu pa shing byi la bod du phebs/ bdun cu pa shing khyi la mnga' ris nas kha cher phebs te go dgu pa la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ mnga' ris nas kha cher phebs dus jo gdan gtsang po ba/ byang rdor rnam gnyis kyi gnas kyi slob dpon du bzhag shing khyi de nas lo bcu gcig pa paṇa chen gyi dgung lo brgyad cu lon pa'i tshe/ byang rdor rnam gnyis kyis dge 'dun gyi sde so sor btsugs pa ni/ dge 'dun sgang pa dang / tshogs mo che pa zhes zer la/ de gnyis las mched pa bye ma rdzing bu dang / chos lung pa zhes zer te jo gdan tshogs sde bzhi zhes grags so/ /des na thang po cher rtsis pa'i me mo yos lo ni/ paṇa chen gyi drug cu rtsa gsum pa yin la/ re gsum po de dang / paṇa chen 'brungs gong gi stong drug brgya go gnyis po bsres pas/ stong dang bsnyen brgya dang lnga 'byung ba la 'khrul pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na kha che paṇa chen gyis bod du lo bcu gcig bzhugs/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa la phan che/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta dang byang rdor gnyis la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang / shangs pa rdzo gdan dang / seng ge zil gnon la me tog phreng rgyud sogs rgyas par gnang /'dul ba stod smad gnyis kyi steng du/ 'dul ba'i brgyud pa zur pa zhig kyang spel/ slob bu mang du byung yang sa paṇ+ḍi ta kho na sras kyi dam par mdzad/ de yang 'dul ba smad 'dul ba'i sdom brgyu// ṭ+wāṃ/ thub dbang / shā ri'i bu/ sras sgra

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam ra bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//ga can 'dzin/ bram zer sgra gcan 'dzin/ klu sgrub/ legs ldan 'byed/ dpal sbas/ ye shes snying po/ zhi ba 'tsho/ dbas rat+na/ gtsang rab gsal/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ klu mes tshul khrims shes rab sogs yin la/ stod 'dul ba'i sdom brgyud ni/ dharma pā la/ pra sgo pā la/ zhang zhung rgyal she dpal 'byor shes rab/ zhing mo che ba byang chub seng ge yang rtse ba rdo rje seng ge sag pa pad+ma g.yung drung / rtsis 'dul thugs rje byang chub/ bde ba can pa shākya byang chub/kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ byang chub seng ge byang chub bzang po/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan bla ma/ mdog lho pa mkhas chen kun dga' dpal bzang po/red mda' ba sogs so/ /mkhan brgyud gsar pa'i sdom brgyud ni/ ston pa/ shā ri'i bu/ sgra gcan 'dzin gnyis/ klu sgrub/ gu ṇa ma ti ste yon tan blo gros/ rat+na ma ti ste dkon mchog blo gros/ shrī dharma pā la ste dpal ldan chos skyong / gu ṇa swā ga ra ste yon tan rgya mtsho/ dharma pā la ste chos kyis skyong ba/ ka a khre na)ra gugaste zhi 'byung sbas pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sa paṇa rnams so/ /stod 'dul ba'i dharma pā la yan gyi sdom brgyud gsal bar bris pa mi snang / yang stod 'dul ba'i dharma pā la dang mkhan brgyud gsar ma'i dharma pā la gnyis don gcig na klu sgrub nas brgyud tshul 'dra mod/ cung zad thog mi mtshungs pa 'dra'o/ /des na da lta'i shing pho byi lo 'di kha che paṇa chen bod du byon pa'i shing byi nas lo sum stong sum brgya lnga bcu rtsa gcig lon pa'i lo yin no/ /sum stong sum brgya dang zhe bzhi 'das pa'i zhe lnga pa chu pho sprel (spyi lo 1212)lor/ stag sde ba seng ge rgya99mtshan mdog pha ri lung du byon/ bo dong ri/ /rdo'i zhabs la gsas/ lo gya gsum

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus ()bzhugs/ snga tshar gyi bu chen shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / shong blo gros brtan pa ste sku mched gnyis/ gcen gyis skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing dang / snyan ngag me long / sgra tsan+d+ra pa sogs sngar ma 'gyur ba'i chos mang po bsgyur/ sku mched de gnyis kyi slob ma ni mang mkhar khra tshang pa mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ de'i slob ma dpang lo ste lo tsā ba de bzhi sgra dang snyan ngag sogs la bka' drin che ba yin/ rgya gar gyi kha che blo brtan ni blo brtan dang po yin la/ shong blo brtan dang / dpang blo brtan la blo brtan gnyis pa dang gsum pa zhes grags/blo brtan bzhi pa ni/ tshig gter gyi 'grel pa mdzad pa po de yin no/ /dpang los lo bcu gsum pa nas/ mdog tsha snar stag sde ba seng rgyal zhi bar gshegs kyi bar lo bcu dgu pa'i bar bsnyen zer bas/ stag sde ba'i phyi tshar gyi slob ma yin la/ stag sde ba ni tshogs sgom pa las lo gnyis kyis ga the ne no/ /sum stong sum brgya dang zhe lnga 'das pa'i zhe drug pa chu mo bya (spyi lo 1213)yang dgon pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la stod lha'i shrī lung par bltams/ bla ma'i mchog ni/ sa paṇa/ rgod tshang pa/ ko brag pa/ 'bri khung spyan snga rin chen dang bzhi/ slob ma'i mchog ni/ lo ras chos skyong dpal dang / dar ma rgyal mtshan gnyis/spyan snga rin ldan dang /zur pa rin chen dpal gnyis te bzhi'o/ /zur phug pa'i thugs sras ni 'bar ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ste/ yang dgon pa'i sku skye ru byed do/ /yang dgon pa'i zhe drug sa rta lo nam mthongs kyi tshes bcu dgu la gshegs so/ /sum stong sum brgya dang nga bdun 'das pa'i nga brgyad pa shing mo bya (spyi lo 1225)la nam3 sding pa zas bde legs rgyal mtshan

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed la ga bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// las stod bya rog tshang du bltams/ nyer gnyis pa rta lo rgod tshang pa'i drung du byon/ de nas bcu gsum pa sa mo lug la ni ring btab/ de nas lo sum cu rtsa gnyis 'gro don mdzad de/ nga bdun pa sprul lo dbyug pa zla ba'i nyer dgu'i srod la gshegs so/ /thugs kyi sras ni dbon kun dga' rdo rje dang / mkhan po sher grags so/ /nam ring pa ni nyan chen pa las lo gsum gyis gan ni/ sum stong sum brgya dang re gnyis 'das pa'i re gsum pa lcags pho stag (spyi lo 1230)la grub thob sku rgyan rin chen dpal ba lho nas lhums su 'ang du dbyon/ bcu drug pa la rgod tshang pa las dge bsnyen mdzad/ bo dong rin rtse/ bcom ldan ral gri/go lung pa mdo sde dpal sogs la mdo phyogs gsan/ go lung pa'i gcung po yin/ bo dong rin chen rtse las bsnyen rdzogs rgod tshang pa la gdams pa gsan pas sgro 'dogs chod/ shrī rdo rje rnal 'byor mas pu ti gcig gnang ba mid pas bka' mdo rgyud la thogs pa med/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i u rgyan sogs dgu ru byon/ dgung lo go gnyis pa lcags mo bya lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyi shu la gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog karma rang byung rdo rje/ grub thob tsha byung ba/rtogs ldan g.yag mgo ba/ rtogs ldan zla seng dang bzhi'o/ /rtogs ldan tsha byung bas sbu tra nas lha sar nyin re la phebs/ rgya khab brgya dus re la gsol nas ba spu'i bu gar dus gcig la 'don/ rtogs ldan zla seng sku 'da' khar bu ston rin po ches gsol ba btab ste lo gsum bzhugs zer ro/ /des na da lta'i shing byi 'di/ yang dgon pa'i chu bya nas sum brgya dang gnyis pa/ nam ring pa'i shing bya nas sum brgya dang bzhi bcu pa3/ di rgyan pas lcags stag nas sum brgya

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()dang so lnga pa lags so/ /sum stong sum brgya dang re 'dun 'das pa'i re brgyad pa shing mo lug (spyi lo 1235)la 'phag pa rin po che pyon/ drug pa'i tshe/ chosarje sa paṇa gyi phyag phyir skyid grong du byon zer/ bcu pa la gcung phyag na dang bcas chos kyi rje gong la phebs pa'i zhabs phyir thegs/ dbus su chos rje sapaṇa gyis mkhan po/ zul phu ba'i na bza' 'phred gsol gyis slob dpon bgyis te rab tu byung / bcu gnyis pa la rgyal ngo 'i pho brang chen por phyag phebs/bcu bdun yan la lung rtogs kyi yon tan phul du phyin/ de'i tshe chos rje sa paṇa gyis bstan pa'i khur chen po nyid phyag tu gtad/ dag pa 'i zhing du gshegs bco brgyad pa la chos rje'i dgongs rdzogs sogs legs par bsgrubs/ bcu dgu lon pa chu mo glang gi lo/ hor rgyal po se chen gan gyis pho brang ta hur spyan drangs/ lugs rtoganyis )kyi mdzad pas rgyal po'i thugs rab tu phyogs te/ rgyalapos zhus pa'i ngor/ rgyal pos gtsos pa'i skal ldan gyi gdul bya lnga phrag la dgyes pa rdo rje'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur/ ti lha'i mtshan gsol/ dbang yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum phul/ khri skor bcu gsum ni/ lho byang gnyis/ chu zhal gnyis/ lha shangs gnyis te gtsang la drug g.ya' phag gnyis/ rgya 'dzi5 gnyis/ 'bri stag gnyis te dbus la drug yar 'brog khri skor dang bcu gsum yin la/ 'di nas bzung bod khams thams cad dpal ldan sa skya pas lugs gnyis kyis bskyangs so/ /de nas lo nyer gnyis pa la rgya hor yul gyi mtshamasasu / mkhan po snye thang pa grags pa seng ge las slob rdzo gdan bsod namasargyal mtshan/ gsang ston yar klung pa sdu/ chub rgyal mtshan sogs las bsnyen

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar ba dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// par rdzogs/ slar so gcig pa shing mo glang la dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ de'i tshe bod dbus gcang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen che rgu thams cad kyis mdo 'ams su bsu ba ser sbreng la phebs/ shong rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bstod pa spel legs kyi snyan ngag phul/ 'bel ba'i gtam gyis bka' mchid mchog tu stsal/de dag kun gyi nang nas la stod pa gangs shākya bshes gnyen dang / dbus kyi 'bre'u rin po che gnyis la mchog tu dgyes pa thob ces kyang zer/ dbus gtsang khams gsum chos dang zang zing gis 'byor pas bde ba la bkod/ slar so gsum pa la gong nas spyan 'dren gyi gser yig pa slebs pas shar la phebs/de'i tshe gsol gzil mchod gsum/ 'jal yig mdzod gsum/ thab 'dren gdan gsum/ rta skya gnyis/ mdzo khyi gnyis te las tshan bcu gsum gyi bkod pa gnang /bcom ral gyis/sangs rgyas bstan pa bka' phyag sprin gyis bsgrib//ces sogs kyi zur za'i zhu mchid phul/ bstan pa 'phel 'grib 'byung ba rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes sogs kyi bka' mchid stsal/ so bzhi pa sa pho 'brug la dpon chen shākya bzang pos khri skor bcu gsum bskul te lha khang chen mo'i gzhi bting / rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs/ dbang yon du rgya'i yur ma chod/ bod chol kha gsum phul/ chol kha gsum ni/ dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod gon gyo mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad gling kha rta'i chol kha zhes zer/ 'ga' zhig mang yul mtsho/ gu ge g.ya'/ pu rangs gangs kyis bskor bas stod mnga' ris skor gsum chol kha gcig gtsang la g.yas ru dang g.yon ru gnyis/ dbus la sbu ru dang g.yo ru gnyis te bar dbus 3 2 ḍi bzhi chol kha gcig tsha ba sgang / po

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()'bor sgang / smar khams sgang ste smad mdo khams sgang gsum chol kha gcig yin zer ro/ /slar zhe gcig la dpal ldan sa skyar phyag phebs/ zhe gsum pa me mo glang la/ rgyal po jin gyim gyis sbyin bdag mdzad de/ gtsang chu mig ring mor dge 'dun khri phrag bdun la gser ja gos dar sogs kyis mchod nasachos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ zhe drug pa 'brug lo zla ba bcu pa'i nyer gnyis ldobade bar gshegs so/ /'di nyid la slob ma'i mchog man ngag gi bka' babasashad dkon mchog dpal dang / dge slong kun blo gnyis/ rgyud kyi bka' babasadaga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal dang / dga' ldan pa kun bsod gnyis/ mgon po'i bka' babs dam pa kun dga' grags/ mnyes pa'i mchod g.yog ti shri grags 'od/ bla chen sangs rgyas sras/ ring phug pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ pro lung pa kun smon dang bzhi'o/ /nus pa'i bdag nyid gcung phyag na rdo rje dang / rgyal bu jin thim gnyis so/ /gzhan yang che ba'i bdag nyid shar pa dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen/ shar pa kun dga' seng ge shar pa 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ khang gsar ti shri sangs rgyas dpal/ gnyan tshul khrimasargyal mtshan/ cha gan dbang phyug mtshan dang drug go /de dag las 'gro mgon phyag na sa mo phag (spyi lo 1239)la mdog gad ler byon/ lo drug pa la gong la byon/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mthar phyin/ nyer lnga pa la bod du phebs/ nyer dgu pa yos lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gnyis la sgo rum du gshegs so/ / 'di 'phags pa las lo bzhis gzhen/ sum stong sum brgya don gnyis 'das pa'i don gsum pa lcags pho byi (spyi lo 125//sa shad dkon mchog dpal ra sa

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mtshal gung du byon/ shar pa sher 'byung la rab tu byung/ brag sram du bo dong rin chen brtson 'grus rdo rje la phar tshad sogs sbyangs/ tshogs sgom pa dang ra nyis pa chen po sogs kyang bsten/ ra ma la dge slong kun blo dang / gnyis 'phags pa rin po che bsu ba la byon/ rang lo so lnga pa shing byi'i lor 'phags pa dang mdo khams gtso mdor mjal/ lo re brgyad bzhugs/ sum stong sum brgya dang don bdun 'das pa'i don brgyad pa shing mo sbrul (spyi lo 1245)la ti shri gragasaca(da stag sde ra lung du byon/ ti shri lo bcu gnyis mdzad/ 'phags pa las lo lngas gzhen/ lo nga brgyad bzhugs des na da lta'i shing byi 'di 'phags pa rin po che byon nas sum brgya dang nyer gnyis 'das pa'i nyer bzhi pa lags so/ /mdor na 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po ches bcu dgu bzhes pa chu mo glang la hor se chen rgyal po'i ti shri thob pa nas/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis kyis rang lo re lnga pa chu mo sprul la rgya nag tā ming rgyal chen gyi ti shri thob pa'i bar lo grangs brgya dang drug cu re gcig gi bar du dpal sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim pas/ rgya hor gyi rgyal po'i ti shri thob pa rim can du byung ba kho na yin la de yang dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas rgyal po go dan gyi spyi bor dbang gi cod pan bcings pa'i bka' drin yin mod/ ti lha'i mtshan ni ma gsol te de'i tshe rgyal po go dan rgyal srid kyi khur bor nas/ rang gi dbon po se chen rgyal po rgyal sar bton zin pa nyid kyis so/ /de ltar na chos rje khu dbon gnyis kyi bka' drin las bod khams thams cad dmag khral las gsum las brtan te/lo grangs brgya lhag tsam zhig gi bsdu 2〉 rgyal srid chos bzhin du bde bar

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bskyangs pa ni/ gang la gang 'dul gyi dbang gis skal ldan gyi gdul bya la bde ba'i ngal gso chen po thob pa yin no/ /deb sngon las/ dpal ldan sa skya pasalo grangs bdun cu rtsa lnga'i bar du khri skor bcu gsum bdag mdzad nas sa mo glang nas ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis khri skor bcu gsum bdag mdzad pa yin no zhes bshad la/ de la nges pa'i gtan tshigs yod na sa mo glang de 'phags pa rin po che ti shri mdzad pa'i chu mo glang nas go drug 'das pa'i go bdun pa theg chen chos rje bltams pa'i lo de yin par gdon mi za mod/ ji ltar bden kho bos da dung dpyad par bya'o/ /sum stong sum brgya dang go bzhi 'das pa'i go lnga pa chu pho khyi (spyi lo 1262)lo bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpa 'as bltams/ mang mkhar khab smad du yab slob dpon ye 'byung nyer lnga'i sras yin/ bcu drug pa la 'phags pa dang mjal/ mi res pus mo la babasangayon tan slob gsungs/ bcu dgu pa la 'phags pa zhi bar gshegs/ nyer gcig pa la gong la byon/ snyan dgra'i stabs kyis so lnga pa'i skabs sman che'i yul 'byon dgos pa shar/ ti shri grags 'od khu dbon gyis legs pa'i mtshams sbyar/ so drug pa la 'phags pa ti lha'i dbon po yin nges su 'dug pas gdung brgyud spel dgos kyi rgyal po'i lung bud/ so bdun pa sa pho khyi la saskyar phebs/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi 'byor pas gdan sa bskyangs/ re gsum pa shing pho byi ba la zhi bar gshegs so/ /'di nyid la sras kun dril bco lnga tsam zhig byon par snang yang / yongs grags sras dgu ni/ ti shri kun blo yab so brgyad pa sa mo phag la byon bcu gci/ ༵ la ti shri thob/ nyer bzhi pa khyi lo bod

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed ga bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhus sa so // du bsnyen rdzo gas la byon/ nyer drug pa la yab gshegs/ sku mched rnams la bla brang so sor bgos/ nyer dgu la gong du gshegs zer/ mkhas btsun pa sku mched la bzhi thog bla brang pa zhes zer te/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa yab zhe bzhi pa sprul lor bltams/ so dgu la gshegs/ gcung gu shri nam mkha' rgyal mtshan yab gshegs pa'i byi lo'am/ yang na chu pho byi lo pa chos rje bla ma dang dgung mnyam yin zer/ nyer gsum pa la gshegs so/ /ti shri kun dga' legs 'byung sku mched la lha khang bla brang pa zer te/ gcen ti shri kun dga' legs 'byung yab zhe bdun pa sa pho sprel lor byon/ de'i gcung ti shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan yab zhe dgu pa lcags pho khyi lor byon/ sa'i len dbang kun dga' legs pa lcam sring la dus mchod bla brang pa zer/ 'di ti shri kun dga' legs dang dgung mnyam yin no/ /ta dbon kun dga' nyi ma sku mched gsum la rin chen sgang bla brang zer te/ ta dbon kun nyi'i gcung 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan ti shri kun rgyal dang dgung mnyam yin/ so bzhi pa zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu gcig la gshegs so/ /gcung chos rje bla ma yab nga gcig pa chu pho byi lor byon/ re bzhi pa/ nyer lnga la gshegs so/ /des na da lta'i shing byi 'di bdag nyid chen po byon pa'i khyi lo nas sum brgya dang gsum du sleb pa lags so/ /mnyam med grags rgyal 'di las lo gcig gis gzhen lo gya lnga bzhugs zer/ kha che paṇa chen bod du byon pa'i shing pho byi (spyi lo 1204)lor na pa snyi byon/ sa paṇa las lo nyer gnyis kyis gzhon/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma pom brag pa'i zhabs la sdu/gas/ hor rgyal pos kyang spyan drangs/

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()mes bsregs/ chu la bskur/ mtshon gyis btab kyang gnod pa ma byung bsazhabs tog byas zer/ brgyad cu pa lug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la gshegs so/ /'di ni sa ra ha'i sprul pa yin la/ 'di sku skye brgyud spel du byon pa ni/ dmi rang byung rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ mi bskyod rdo rje ste/ dme bkri nas mi bskyod rdo rje'i bar bdun byon zin pa la/ dus gsum mkhyen pa ni/ skal bzang gi sangasargyas stong gi drug pa seng ge'i rnam 'phrul yin par bshad la/ dmi pa lha ni/ sar ha pa'i rnam 'phrul du bshad kyi/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku skye yin zhes kyang ma bshad pas/ na me zhwa nag pa zhes grags pa'i thog ma ni ga me pa: nas ngosa'adzin dgos par sems la 'on kyang na me pa zhes pa'i mtshan 'dogs pa ni dus gsum mkhyen pas/ smad du rkam po gnas nang / bar du po rna lha steng / stod du mtshur phu'i dgon pa btab nas dmi pa zhes mtshan 'dogs par gsal bas/dus gsum mkhyen pa la dme pa zhes pa'i sgra bshad du yod pa tsam zhig yin no snyam du kho bos sems so/ /de lta bu'i rkarma pa lha'i slob ma ni/ rje u rgyan pa/dmi zhwa dmar can/ zhwa ser can/ zhwa khra can la sogs pa'o/ /spru' / sku zhwa dmar pa mus khrims dpal ni me pho byi lor bltams/ til lo pa'i slob ma khol po dga' zhes pa'i sku skye yin zer ro/ /sa bcad bzhi pa sum stong bzhi brgya pa'i skabs su byon pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po dharma pā la/ dpang lo/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bu dol la sogasapa'i mkhas pa rnams te/ de yang sum 3rdo bzhi brgya 'das nas nyag ma gcig

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes byab bzhugs so//gi steng du sleb pa sa pho 'brug (spyi lo 1260lor/ 'gro mgon phyag na'i sras dharma gal bltams/ bcu gsum pa la sa skya'i gdan sa mdzad/ de'i lor 'phags pa zhi bar gshegs/ nang rten lha chen dpal 'bar dang / 'phags pa'i sku 'dra 'bum thob bcu gsum zhes grags pa rnams bzhengs/ bcu bzhi pa la gong la byon/ ti shi mdzad/ nyi shu pa la mdo khams pa tri maṇ+ḍal zhes par tshes bco brgyad la gshegs so/ /des na shing byi 'di dharma pā la'i sa pho 'brug nas nyis brgya go bdun pa yin/ sa pho 'brug de ni/ 'phags pas lha khang chen mo bzhengs pa'i lo yin te dpal ldan sa skya btab nas lo brgya dang go drug pa sa pho 'brug la lha khang chen mo'i 'gram bting zhes 'byung ba yin no/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang lhag ma brgyad 'das pa'i zhig dgu ༄ye pho byi (spyi lo 127)lo dpang lotsā spublo gro brtan pa las stod gyam du byon khong gis lo lnga lon pa'i tshe 'phags pa rin po che dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ yum snga mor gshegs nas lug gi 'o mas gsos pas lu gu zhes par grags/ kho bo ba'i 'o mas gsos na legs pa la lug gi 'o mas gsos pas blo gros kyi phyed 'grib ces gsungs/ lo bdun pa la mkhan chen gser khang pa dang me ston 'dul 'dzin las rab tu byung / bcu gcig pa la mdo rtsa rdzogs par bzung / bcu gsum pa la mdog tsha snar stag sde seng rgyal lo bcu dgu pa'i bar du bstem/ bcu dgu pa la stag sde pa gshegs nas mang mkhar khra tshang du lo tsā ba mchog ldan la dus 'khor sogs gsan/gzhan yang / stag sde ti phug gi mkhan po shes rab dpal dang / sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa dang / 'jam skya /cho / rong pa shes rab seng ge sogs kyi

ba chen 'od snang las/ sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()zhabs pad bsnyen/ rong pa sher seng 'di ni rong pa rga lo'i sras te lcags mo phag lo pa yin/ ti shi grags 'od las lo drug gis gzhon/ dpang lo las nyer lngas bgres/ slob ma yang dpang lo/ dpal ldan seng gi skyi ston grags rgyal sogs mang du byung / lo yang re lnga bzhugs zer ba de'o/ /nyi shu pa la sngar gyi mkhan slob las bsnyen par rdzo gas/ nyer gcig pa la bal por byon sgra snyan ngag la sbyangs/ spyir bal por lan bdun byon/ so gnyis pa la gung thang gnasapo cher chos gzhi btsugs/ gung thang bde blo sogs slob bu mang du byon/ dpang lo 'di ni khong rang bzhugs dus kyi mkhas pa/ bu dol/ rgyal sras pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ kun spangs chos grags dpal/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched gnyis/ rne ring pa 'jam dbyangs mtshan can sogs mkhas grub thams cad kyis chur zhabs la btud/ mkhas pa'i grags pa shin tu che/ bo dong e'i gdan sar/ rgyal sras rin po ches zhu phul bas/ gu ru thogs med thos pa'i gtam la snyan/ nyid kyi zhal nas legs par ma gtogs nyes par bshad pa ga la srid/ kho bo mkhan po chen ngo stag sde pa seng ge rgyal mchan gyis kyang ma thob pa'i gdan sa yin pas de ring rang la 'gro/ 'gyur na mi 'dod/ da lta rang 'gro zhes gsungs pa nas drug cu rtsa gcig lon pa'i tshe/ bo dong e paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i gdan seng ge'i khri la 'khod/ brgyud 'dzin gyi sras rang nyid kyi dbon po lo cwa ba byang chub rtse mo zhes grags pa de yin la dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun pa chu pho rta lo nag pa zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la bo dong er dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ //rdzu stong bzhi brgya dang lhag ma dgu 'das

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes byab bzhus sa so// pa'i bcu pa me mo glang (spyi lo1277)la brag phug pa bsod nam dpal bltams/ dpang lo las gcig gis gzhon/ lo don bdun bzhugs/ slob bu mang du byung yang gtso bo chos rje bla ma/ brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/brag phug pa blo gros brtan pa/ ka bcu pa gzhen nu seng ge dang bzhi'o/ /brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma ni/ sa skya bu ston dbang phyug rgyal po/ g.yag sde ba nam mkha' bsod nams/ mdo khams gtso mdo dpal 'bar gyi thim chu ba blo gros dkar po ste blo bzang dkar por grags pa dang gsum/ blo bzang dkar po'i slob ma ni/ gon gyi ye shes dpal yin la/ gon gyi slob ma ni khams kyi chab la kha ba blo bzang dkar mo dang / mkhan chen g.yag pa sogs yin zhing / blo bzang dkar mo la/ lam 'bras pa blo bzang du grags pa dang / paṇa chen bo dong pa sogs kyis gsan no/ /ri khrod pa blo brtan ni/ me pho 'brug lo pa ste/ chos rje bla ma las lo bzhis gzhon no/ /sum stong bzhi brgya bcu bzhi pa lcags mo sprul (spyi lo 1281)lor 'am 'brabs pa ye shes dpal mdo khams su byon/ lo bcu bzhi pa la nyan chen po'i bu chen blo gros dkar po la 'khrid dang gdams pa gsan/ zha lu bu ston la theg chen sems bskyed gsan/ sa skyar gzhung rgyas pa mkhan chen dbang phyug dang la la rnam rig gsan/ kun spangs chos grags dpal la sbyor drug gsan/ na bza' ba lo bcu gnyis bsten te gsung ngag sogs gsan/ bla ma gu ru dbang phyug brtson 'grus la ni gu sogs gsan/ 'khon bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i sras gung pa bkra shis dbang bzang rdo sdu dmar po skor gsum sogs gsan/

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()lo lnga bcu nas gya lnga'i bar du gzhan don kho na mdzad/ slob ma'i mchog blo bzang dkar mo/ mkhan chen g.yag mo sogs te/ gya lnga pa sprul lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer gnyis la 'jam sa lha sdings su gshegs so/ /sum stong bzhi brgya bco lnga khrug )'das pa'i bcu drug 'dun )pa shing pho sprel (spyi lo 1284)lor gan pa rang byung rdo rje mnga' ris su byon/ lo gsum par ming yongs su grags pa'i dme pa yin zhwa nag khyer lha/ga gsungs/ rang byung rdo rje zhes pa rkarma pa lha'i gsang mtshan yin zer/ mdo sde ma gzigs par skyes rabs tsam ci yin zhus pas/ dme pa lha'i dus khams kyi ra ba sgang du tshar gcig bltas gsungs/'dis tor tho to thi mur gyi ti sgri mdzad zer bas/ spyir tho to thi mur gyis lo nyer lnga rgyal srid mdzad pa'i stod la ti shri kun rgyal gyis ti shri mdzad/ bar skabs su bla chen bsod blos mdzad/ mjug tu ti shri med pa lo brgyad byung zer ba'i tho han gyi sku tshe'i stod ti shri kun rgyal dang thog mtshungs tsam du ti shri mdzad par mngon te/ rang byung rdo rje ti shri kun rgyal las lo nyer drug gis bgres pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gang na'ang dgung lo nga drug pa bya khra tshes bcu bzhi la rgya nag pho brang la gshegs so/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyer gsum 'das pa'i nyer bzhi pa lcags mo yos (spyi lo 1291)la gnyag phu pa ba the snan na mtha dbang phyug mus gling skyar byon/ bcu gcig pa la mkhan po shākya mgon dang slob dpon 'od zer rtse mo las rab tu byung / mdog stod du mkhan chen gung rgyal las 'dul ba/mus chen rgyal mtshan dpal dang / slob dpon shes rab ral gri sogs las mdo phyogs gsan/ bcu dgu pa la /sbyin chen chu bzang pa dang / slob dpon

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs po// 'od zer rtse mo las bsnyen par rdzogs/ bsgol gyis kha bskang ba sogs nas nyi shur sleb zin pa las ma 'das/ nyan chen pa las lam 'bras sogs gsan/g.ya' gdung rings su bsam gtan la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnyag phu btab/ sbyin bdag dang gzhi bdag mched gsum dang bcas pas gnyag phu phul/ bshad sgrub kyi phrin las mchog tu rgyas/ mthar phag lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu la gshegs so/ /'di ku me rang byung rdo rje las lo lngas gzhen zhing / bu ston las gcig gis bgres so/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyer gnyis 'das pa'i nyer gsum pa lcags pho stag (spyi lo 1290)la/ zha sdo(ba(ston rin chen grubashab smad sgom gnas su byon/ dpang lo las lo bcu bzhes gzhen/ kun mkhyen dol bu las lo gnyis kyis bgres/ rgyal sras thogs med las lngas bgres so/ /lo bdun pa la khro phu rin po che sems dpa' chen po bsod nams seng ge'i drung du sems bskyed dang brgyad pa la smin byed kyi dbang zab mo nod/ khro phu sems dpa' chen po de ni/ kha rag sgom chung pa'i bar srid gzhan don du skye ba tshol ba na/ khro los dag pa'i spyan ras kyis gzigs te/rigs kyi sras su bskrun pa yin zer/ bco brgyad lon pa'i tshe mkhan po rin po che seng ge dpal dang slob dpon tshad ma'i skyes bu las rab tu byung / mkhas mchog tshad ma'i skyes bu/ rigs pa'i thigs pa/ bsod nams mgon po zhesamatshan gsum dang ldan pa de'i drung du phar tshad sogs la sbyangs/ nyer gcig pa la yab dang lhan cig tu dbus gtsang gnyis su grwa skor mdzad/ dbus nas mkhas pa shākya gzhen nu dang / kha rag 3gas gzhen/ gtsang nas mkhas pa dpal

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ldan seng ge dang / 'jam skya sogs lung rigs kyis btul bas pha ston bu ston du grags/ nyer gsum pa la mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhen nu dang /slob dpon bsod nams grags pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa spel/ thar pa lo tsā ba la sgra snyan ngag bla ma 'phags 'od las gsang 'dus/ rong pa sher seng gi dbon po rdo rje rgyal mtshan la dus 'khor sogs gsan/ sum cu pa la/ phar phyin lung snying mdzad/ so gcig pa la zha lu'i 'dzin skyong gnang / zha lu ri phug btab/ ri phug tu tshogs pa brgya drug cu dang / zha lur sum stong brgyad brgya re 'dus/ re bdun pa la sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal la zha lu'i gdan sa gtad/ ri phug tu gdan phab/ bka' 'bum po ti so gsum bzhugs/ don lnga pa shing pho 'brug zla ba drug pa'i nyer gcig la gshegs so/ /'di la slob bu shin tu mang yang / gtso bo sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ byang pa dkon mchog grags/ gong gsum bde chen pa chosakyi mgon po/ yo ga ba rin bzang / yo ga ba tshe dbang / khyung po lhas pa sogasaso / / chos rje bla ma/rgyal sras pa/bu ston sogs ni phar slob tshur slob yin no/ /des na da lta'i shing byi 'di/ dpang lo'i me pho byi ba nas nyis brgya dang gya brgyad pa / na bza' brag phug pas me glang nas nyis brgya dang gya bdun pa/ rang byung rdo rje'i shing spre nas nyis brgya gya gcig pa/ bu ston gyi lcags pho stag nas nyis brgya dang don lngar slebs pa lags so/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyer bzhi 'das pa'i nyer lnga pa chu pho 'brug (spyi lo 1292)la kun mkhyen do'ang bu shesangarab rgyal mtshan mnga' ris dol bu/3 ༷na tshan du byon/ bcu gsum pa la skye

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// stongs su mkhan po tshul khrims snying po las rab tu byung / der skyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags rgyal byon pa la rdo rje phreng ba bslabs/ bco brgyad pa la skyi ston grags blo phar phebs pa la tshad bsdus sbyangs/ de nas skyi ston pa sa skyar phebs te slar dpal ldan sa skyar skyi ston shāka 'bum dang skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan te khu dbon de gnyis kyi drung du mdo phyogs la sbyangs/ nyer gsum pa la bka' bzhi'i steng du spyod 'jug bsnan te po ti lnga la grwa skor mdzad de/ nyer lnga pa la chos lung mkhan po bsod grags las bsnen par rdzogs/ so gcig pa la jo nang du yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs pad bsten/ so lnga pa de'i gdan seng ge'i khri la zhabs pad brten/ so dgu pa la mchod rten chen po bzhengs/ lo phyed dang bzhi la grub/ nyams rtogs kyi mdzod rdol/ lo bcu gsum du jo nang gi seng ge'i khri la 'khod de chos gsungs pas spyir bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dang / khyad par gzhan stong pa zhes phyogs kun tu snyan pa'i ba dan g.yos/ nyid kyi zhe bdun pa sa pho stag lor/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal gdan sar bskos/ rta lor lo tsā ba gshegs te nyid kyi re gsum pa shing pho rta lor phyogs rgyal ba gdan sar bskos/ bdun cu pa la nub chos lung du chos rje bla ma dang mjal bka' bsdu bzhi pa sogs gnang / slar bdun cu pa lcags mo glang zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes drag la zhi bar gshegs/ des na rje 'di dmi rang byung rdo rje dang mjal te rang tshung pa'i grub mtha' bzung bas/ dme pas phyis gzhan stong par 'gyur bar lung bstan zer/ spyir gzhan stong pa'i lugs thog mar dme rang byung rdo rjes bzung bar sems/ jo nang du ni 3// mkhyen chen po man chad gzhan stong

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()par song ba yin no/ /'on kyang jo nang thog mar 'debs pa po ni jo nang kug sbangs zhang thug rje brtson 'grus shes rab grags pa de nyid yin te/ tsomo yos kyi lo byang mdog stod ngab byar spangs khang du byon/ 'phags pa rin dzoche las lo brgyad kyis gzhon/ bar pa 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa rin chos rgyal mtshan la lam 'bras gsan/ chos sku 'od zer la sbyor drug sogs gas rkyang 'dur du 'chad nyan yang mdzad/ phyis 'chad nyan bskyungs te sgom la zhug te kun spangs par grags slar jo nang gi dgon pa btab/ bshad sgrub spel mas gnang bas kun spangs bu bzhir grags pa byon te/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes las stod pa dbang rgyal/ mun me brag kha ba grags pa seng de ston pa kun rgyalasarnams so/ /las stod dbang rgyal dang / jo nang kun spangs ni lam 'bra bsres brgyud kyi skabs su mtshan smos pa de yang yin no/ /brag kha ba grag pa seng ge ni/ las stod byang gi rgyal sde thang dkar byon/ khro phu sems dpa chen po dang / bu ston seng ge 'od las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sa skyar phya rub seng ge dpal la rnam 'grel dang / rdzo nang kun spangs pa dang / byang sems rgyal la sbyor drug sogs gsan/ lo gya dgu thug bzhugs/ slob ma yang chos rje bla oṃdang / ka bcu pa gzhen seng sogs byon zer/ byang sems rgyal me'i slob ma ṣ+kamakhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho ste mdog gi spen par byon/ chung ngu nas skyar 'jam dbyangs pa la sogs pa bsten/ phyis jo nang du sbyor drug gsan na gdan sa bskyangs/ de'i slob ma ni kun mkhyen chen po zhes bshad zin la/ kunamakhyen dol bu bas lo bdun cu bzhu/sdu/ slob ma'i mchog kun spangs chos

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//grags dpal/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen te sras kyi gtso bo bzhi'o/ /gzhan yang 'jam dbyangs chos dpal mgon po/ g.yag sde paṇa chen/ 'jam sngon 'jam sgeg snar thang pa mchims blo bzang grags pa/ chos lung mkhan po bsod nams bzang po dang grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis/ bla brang pa bzang po dpal/ thang chen pa kun dga' 'bum sogs mang du yod do/ /kun sbangs chos grag dpal ni/ g.yas ru byang gi dpon yon btsun chen po grags pa dar gyi gcen dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sras te/ dpang lo/ dpal ldan seng ge bu dol la sogs pa'i mkhas grub mang du bsten/ bzang ldan chos rje 'ga' rong chung kha chos sde sogs chos grwa btab/ bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa cher mdzad do/ /sa bzang ma ti pa ni mdog spang bor du byon/ bzang ldan gyi mkhan po thog ma yang mdzad/ mkhas shing phrin las rgya che bar byung ngo / /phyogs la rnam rgyal ni mnga' ris dol por me pho rta la byon/ kun mkhyen dol po las lo bcu bzhis gzhen/ gzhen pa'i dus su dbus chos 'khor gling du gsan sbyongs mdzad/ dbus gtsang du grwa skor mdzad pa'i zhor la jo nang du kun mkhyen chen po'i zhabs zung bsten/ byang bdag chen tā dben nam mkha' brtan pas/ kun mkhyen dang dpon slob gnyis mnga' risasu spyan drangs/ chos sde chen po btab/ phar tshad kyi bshad nyan yang dag pa mdzad/ gdan sa mkhan chen bstan rgyal ba la gtad nas rang lo zhe dgu pa la jo mo nang gi gdan sa mdzad/ lo lnga nas de yang gtad nas dbus la bzhud/slar se mkhar chung du phebs/ dus ༷/ra sogs kyi 'chad nyan gnang nas/

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byupa gces bsdus/()shog ga li 'grem/ pa sum brgya tsam gyi nang nas/ gsol ja rgyug pa'i chos dpon brgyad cu tsam byung zer ro/ /jo nang phyogs las pa 'dis dpal ngam rings chosasde'i chos sde bla brang dang 'du khang rnying pa dang shar nub kyi grwa khang la sogs r+pābatab pas chos sde btab ces grags pa ni/ 'das lo nas sum stong bzhi brgya dang bdun cu rtsa 'dren gyi skabs su yin par sems la/ 'di nyid chos sde'imakhan rabs lnga pa yin zhing / 'di nyid kyis mkhan po bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gtad rjes/ slar yang mkhan po mdzad cing de nas mkhan po bstan pa'i rgyalamatshan la gtad ces mkhan rabs las 'byung / khong gis mkhan po lan gnyisamadzad pa de/ khong pas jo nang gdan sa mdzad rjes yin nam ji ltar yin oṃ'atshal/ gangs khrod pa grags pa dpal ni/ chu mo 'brug gi lo sgyer phu rgya par byon/ kun mkhyen dol bu dang dgung mnyam yin zhing / mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa zhig yin zhing / lam 'bras sa lugs dang zha lugs gnyis char bzhugs/ de yang sa lugs ni/ la tu ba dang nyan chen pa gnyis la gtso bor gsan gzhan yang tshogs sgom pa'i dngos slob gnyan snying po rgyal mtshan/ de'i slob ma mang mkhar ba rta lung bkra shis bzang po/ dza tsha lung nga rgyal mtshan dpal/ bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ dge gon thugs rje bsod nams dang bzhi'i rta lung la'ang thor chags gsan zer/ khong gis zha lugs ni/ 'dzim pa rgyal mtshan dpal la gsan pa yin la/ 'dzim pa de la lam 'bras kyi 'khrid lugs mi 'dra ba bco brgyad bzhugs par grags pa'i/ rgan mo lhas pa mkhan chen byang chub dpal la gsan/ des ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la 336

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed ca ga bsam ra bang kar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//gsan pa yin la/ de lta bu'i gangs khrod pa nas brgyud pa'i gsung ngag ni/ des sa bzang ma ti la gnang / des theg chen chos rje la gnang / des 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gnang / des bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal ma/tshan nas brgyud de kho bo cag gi brgyud pa 'di la bzhugs pa yin no/ /gangs pa 'di nyid kyis dpal ngam rings kyi mkhan po yang lo dgu'i ring mjad de mkhan rabs gsum pa yin/ mkhan po thog ma ni dpon chen yon btsun chen ngo sa/ ti shri grags 'od dang / de'i dbon bo ti shri sangs rgyas dpal dang / de'i dbon po kun spangs grags pa rgyal mtshan rnams la bka'i gnang ba zhus shing /khu dbon de dag gis mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar nas stag sde la rgyab tu sku 'khrungs nga 'i mkhan po shākya seng ge spyan drangs nas chos sde chen po thog mar btsugs zhes 'byung bas sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyi shu tsam zhig 'das nga 'i tshe dpal ngam rings kyi chos sde thog mar gzhi tshugs pa yin snyam du sems so/ /des na kun mkhyen dol bu dang kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa byon pa'i chu pho 'brug nas lo grangs nyis brgya dang don gnyis 'das pa'i don gsum pa shing pho byi lo 'di yin no zhes khong du chud par bya'o/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyer bdun 'das pa'i nyer brgyad pa shing mo lug (spyi lo 1295)la rgyal sra thogs med bzang po dpal lho phul chung du byon/ bcu bzhi pa la bsam gling pa dpal 'bar dang /rin chen dpal bzang gi drung du rab tu byung / mtshan bzang po'i dpal zhes gsol/ bco lnga pa la bo dong er slob dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du mngon pa sogs la sbyangs/ 'jam /3 7 nyi ma rgyal mtshan pas/ mngon pa

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()nas zang zing med pa'i tshor ba sdug bsngal bshad kyang / zang zing med pa dang /tshor ba sdug bsngal srid pa 'gal bas lan thobs gsungs pa la/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa la nyon mongs med kyang / snga ma'i las dbang gi tshor ba sdug bsngal 'byung tshul bshad pa'i sgo nas lan mdzad pas/ thogs med bzang po dpal zhes snyan par grags/ dpang lo bu dol chos rje bla ma la sogs pa'i mkhas grub dam pa bsten nas bcu dgu pa la bshad pa'i dga' ston spel/nyer gcig pa nas 'chad po'i ring lugs bskyangs/ nyer dgu pa la byang sem rin mgon dang / nam mkha' sangs rgyas sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs/ soganyis nas zhe gcig gi bar du bla brang rta ra'i gdan sa mdzad/ de nas e'i chos kyi khrir gsol ba btab kyang ma gnang ste/ kho bo las ches lhag pa zhig sgrub gsung dpang lo chen po nyid spyan drangs/ byang chub kyi thugs kyis bshadasgrub kyi bstan pa ches lhag par bsgrubs te re bdun sa glang lor dbus la byon/ta'i si tu byang rgyal dang mjal tshur zhabs gtugs zer bas/ theg chen chosarje'i bcu gsum lon pa'i si tu ba gshegs pa'i lo de tsam yin par semagagang na'ang don lnga pa lcags phag smyo bya)tshes nyi shu la zhi bar gshegs so/ /slongama'i mchog ni/ bu dol chos rje bla ma lo chen byang rtse sogs mtha' yas shing /gtso bor brgyud 'dzin ni dpal ldan seng ge sogs so/ /rgyal sras pa bu rin joche las lo bzhi dang / dol bu ba las gsum gyis gzhen zhing / lo chen byang rtselas brgyad dang / chos rje bla ma las bcu bdun gyis bsres so/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang so lnga 'das pa'i so drug pa sdo ṭ+wāṃ yos (spyi lo 1303)la lo chen byang rtse

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lag bsam rab dkar zhes byab bzhugs so//la stod lho zur tshor dpang gi lcam mo zhig gi sras su bltams/ bdun pa la dpang lo'i drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nod/ bcu drug pa la shong lo'i dbon po mkhan chen chos skyong dpal las dge tshul du bsgrubs/ dpang los mnga' ris gnas po che dang / sa skya sogs su bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar 'khrid de bslab sbyangs mdzad/ dpang los brtag pa mdzad pa'i phyir/ bur rdog mang po bgrongs byas pa bcal nas re re nas blangs shing rtsis pas ma tshang ba med par rtsis 'grig 'phral phugs kyi mdzad pa la dges pa thob ste dkar po nam langs shes mtshan du gsol/ nyer gnyis pa shing mo glang lor dpal ldan sa skya'i mkhan po 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan dang / las kyi slob dpon dpang lo dang gsang ston chos rje bla ma/ grib tshod mkhan chen bsod nams bzang pos bgyis te bsnyen par rdzogs/ sprel lor sa skyar bshad gsar dang / gzhan yang zha lu sogs su grwa skor mdzad/ yongs kyi bshes gnyen chen po chos rje bla ma sku mched/ dpang 61/ rgyal sras pa/ bu dol gnyis/ gangs khrod pa grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ mchims blo bzang grags pa sogs la mdo rgyud kyi gsan sbyangs mthar phyin/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad de/ don brgyad pa rta zla'i tshes nyer gcig la gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog nyid kyi dbon po lo chen grags pa dang / sgra pa nam mkha' bzang po sogs so/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang so bdun 6rgyad )'das pa'i so brgyad 'gu )pa me pho rta (spyi lo 130(2)la rig pa 'dzin pa gzung bas kyi dpa'i sa ba mdog gad sler byon/ dgung lo brdi/ / rtsa bzhi bzhugs/ byang rtse las lo

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()gsum gyis gzhon/ sum stong bzhi brgya dang zhe gnyis 'das pa'i zhe gsum pa lcags pho khyi (spyi lo 1310)lor/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan byon/'di nyid bzang po dpal gyi sras rnams bla brang go bzhir gyes pa'i bla brang rin chen sgang pa zhes grags pa de yin la/ 'di'i gcen rin chen snang pa tā dben kun nyi dang / dus mchod bla brang pa dbang kun legs dang / lha khang bla brang pa ti shri kun dga' legs 'byung gsum dgung mnyam yin la/ 'di'i gcung bla ma dam pa dang / bzhi thog bla brang pa gu shri nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gnyis dgung mnyam yin zhing / bdag nyid chen po'i sras dgu'i tha chung yin no/ /de yang 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan ni/ rang lo nyer gnyis pa'i tshe/ gcung bla ma dam pa dang gnyis bo dong bya rgod gzhong rnying pa'i gtsug lag khang du/ tshogasapa'i mkhan po bsod nams grags pa dang / slob dpon dpal ldan seng ge las bsnyen par rdzogs/ gdul bya dag pa la 'jam dbyangs seng ge'i zhab pad brtan par yang mthong / so bzhi pa sprel lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu gcig lko gshegs so/ /'di nyid lo chen byang rtse las lo bdun gyis gzhon zhing / rab tu ma byung gong gi sras bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras 'jam dbyang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ de nyid spi brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi gsung ngag rin po che'i bdud rtsi ngoms par gsol ba/kho bo cag gi brgyud pa'i gtso bor byed pa yin no/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang zhe bzhi 'das pa'i zhe lnga pa chu pho byi (spyi lo 1312) lo chos rje bla ma bsod nam 49ga mtshan bltams/ gzungs pa la/ 4spya drug gis gzhen/ lo gsum pa'i tshe

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes byab bzhugs so//bla ma bzang po dpal la 'jam dbyangs kyi lung nod nas bsnyen pa mdzad pas thogs med kyi spobs pa brnyes/ bcu gcig pa la bla chen kun blo bod du bsnyen rdzo gas byon pa la dge bsnyen zhus/ bcu bdun pa la mkhan chen bsod grags las rab tu byung / nyi shu pa la bya gzhongs rnying par bsnyen par rdzogs/ yongasa'adzin gyi dam pa dpang lo/ bu ston/ lo chen byang rtse/ rgyal sras thogs med/dam pa brag phug pa/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ dpal ldan seng ge sogs las mdo brgyud kyi zab don blangs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i ring lugs legs par bzung / dbus gtsang gnyis su 'dus pa chen po rnam gnyis kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ rje btsun gong ma'i bka' bsdu ba mdzad de/ bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad do/ /de yang re gcig pa byi lor bo dong e'i chos grwar/ bo dong er gtsang phyogs kyi dge 'dun stong phrag bzhi bcu dang re gnyis pa glang lor bsam yas su dbus phyogs kyi dge 'dun stong nyi shu la/ gser dngul zho dar la sogs pa'i zho 'gyed dang / 'bel ba'i gtam gyis dga' ba bskyed/ snye thang du dus kyi 'khor lo 'chad pa na dpe 'grems don gnyer ldan pa lnga brgya lhag cig 'dus/ bstan 'gro'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad de/ stod lung pa shes rab rdo rjes 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar bar mthong ba sogs dag pa'i snang ba bstan/ 'di nyid kyi bka' 'bum la yang po ti nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhugs/ dgung lo re bzhi pa shing mo yos kyi lo zla ba drug pa'i nyi shu lnga'i nyin dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog ni/ /// rgyal tshab chen po gnyis/ gsung

pa tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ngag 'dzin pa'i thugs sras brgyad/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po bzhiyongs grags kyi mkhas pa chen po bcu gcig go /dang po ni/ snar thang pa sherasnang ba dang / yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngag 'chang gzungs pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ jo nang mkhan chen byang seng / lo chen byang rtse/ lochen skyabs mchog dpal/ spyan snga grags pa byang chub bo/ /de dag las sngag 'chang gzungs pa las bzang po rgyal mtshan dang / mkhas pa dge bzang gnyisakyi sgo nas gsung ngag rdzong lugs zhes grags pa'i brgyud pa'i gtso bo yin 'a1gnyis pa chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims nas/ grub chen burnya shrī la brgyud degasung ngag ngor lugs zhes grags pa'i brgyud pa'i gtso bo mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas brgyud pa gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa gsum ni/ kho bo cag gi brgyud pa'i gtso bo bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan la yang bzhugs pa yin te/ chos rje glam / bla chen kun rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blogros pa zhes dang / chos rje bla ma/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ rtse chen pa kunablo / 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ bdag chen blo gros pa zhes dnganachos rje bla ma/ mkhan chen byang seng / theg chen chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs namamakha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros pa zhes brgyud pa yin la/ de nyid la rdo ring kun spangs pa/ yongs 'dzin blo gsal rgya mtsho kho bo cag gi 'dren ngadam pa de nyid la bka' babs pas so/ /drug pa lo chen byang rtse las/ lo chenagrags pa/ des paṇa chen phyogs la /sna rgyal zhes bo dong pa dag gi brgyung

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar ba dkar zhes byab bzhugs so// pa'i gtso bo mdzad pa yin no/ /brgyud pa bdun pa sna lo chen skyabs mchog nas/shangs chos 'khor sgang pa sgra pa shes rin sogs las brgyud pa yin la/ brgyad pa ni spyan snga pa nas rje myong kha pa sogs pa'o/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu bzhi ni/ bu dol rgyal sras pa mkhan chen g.yag pa dang bzhi'o/ /yongs grags kyi mkhas pa bcu gcig ni/ ma ti paṇa chen / red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ yi rings pa 'jam dpal rdo rje/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ gnyag phu ba bsod nams bzang bo/ rtog ge pa dkar po dpal ldan bzang po/ grub chen burnya shrī/dme rol pa'i rdo rje/ spos khang pa rin chen rgyan/ lha btsun bsam yas pa/ shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa rnams so/ /sum stong bzhi brgya don gnyis 'dasapa'i don gsum pa lcags pho 'brug (spyi'i 1340)la na ro 'kha pa'i rdo rje kong yul du byon/ chos rje bla ma las nyer brgyad kyis gzhon/ lo gsum pa'i tshe/ nga ma me pa lha'i skye ba yin 'dzam gling 'dir nga yi gdul bya mang du yod gsungs/mkhan chen don grub dpal dang gdan gcig pa bsod nams 'bum las rim gyis rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ mtshan chos kyi grags par gsol/ rol pa'i rdo rje ni/ rang byung rdo rje'i gsang mtshan yin zer/ nyer gcig pa la hor gyis gdan drangs te/ the mur gyi bla ma mdzad zer/ bla chen bsod blos ti shri mdzad pa'i skabs tsam yin par sems/ dgung lo zhe bzhi pa chu phag gi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rengs gshegs so/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang don gsum 'das pa'i don bzhi pa lcags mo sbrul (spyi'i 1341)la gnyag su pa bsod nams bzang po gtsang 3 4 /dor byon/ 'di chos rje bla ma las lo

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()nyer dgu dang / da rma rol pa'i rdo rje las lo gcig gis gzhon/ theg chen las brgyad kyis bgres so/ / lo lnga pa la gnyag chen bsod nams dbang phyugal dge bsnyen zhus/ bcu gcig pa la mkhan po don grub dpal ldan la dge tshul nod/ khyi lor mkhan po yon tan rgya mtsho dang / las slob dpal ldanabartson 'grus las bsnyen par rdzogs/ dpal ldan sa skyar nya dbon kun dag dpal la tshad ma gsan/ de nyid kyi slob bu bzhi brgya'i nang nas mchogaspyomadzad/ de'i dus na dpal ldan sa skya na mkhas pa nya brtson gnyis gragasatshezhing / mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan rkang tshugs su gnang ba las/ nya dpon ni do bu'i slob ma'i mchog dang / brtson 'grus dpal ni bu ston gyi slob ma'i mchogayin/ de'i tshe gnyag phu pa 'dis mkhan chen brtson 'grus dpal yang rig pas bcom ste ston pa bzang ba'i grags pa thob ces kyang zer ro/ /rje 'di nyidagayag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang / dmi dkon mchog gzhen nu dang mkhasangasangs rgyas 'phel dang gzhan gnyis dang bcas pa'i dpal ldan sa skya'i mkhabangapa drug gis dbus gtsang la grwa skor la phebs pa na/ nya brtson gnyis kyis thogadrangs rgya mtsho dpon rnams kyis/ sa skya mdun gyi zhing bya khra ma'i khar skyel thubamadzad/ mkhas pa khyod drag phyogs su 'bel ba'i dga' ston la chags 'a grangs lhag rgyu mi 'dug kyang / yon tan khyed drug las lhag pa phyin chad :ba'abyung zhing / so so nas yon tan gzhal du med kyang gnyag dbon bslab pas bar 'dug pas gral gyi dbus su zhog ces kyang bsngags so/ /gsang phu dnganartse thang sogs su bka' chen bzhi ma/ stan mdzod drug la bshad pa'i sgra snyan
