bsnan rtses gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam ra bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//lag par bsgrags/ mkhas mchog bsten tshul yang / kun mkhyen gangs pa la bde mchog dpal ldan bla ma dam pa las dus 'khor/ mkhan chen byang seng la sbyor drug ma ti paṇa chen la spros med/ rgyal sras pa las sems bskyed/ theg chen chos rje la lam sbas bshad/ jo nang phyogs las pa la dus 'khor gsan/de yang se mkhar chung du/ dpe 'grems sum brgya/ chos dpon brgyad cu la phyogs las pas dus 'khor gzab bshad mdzad/ ngas shes tshod de tsam yin/khyed rnams so so'i go yul yig chung re khyer shog gsung / so so nas phul bas/gnyag phu ba'i shog ril la 'dis kho bo'i grub mtha' go 'dug gsungs phyag rgyas spras te gnang zer ro/ /g.yas ru byang nas kyis 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rin chen gyi bka' stsal te/ dpal bzang ldan gyi chos grwar slob bu btsun chung drag gnang nas 'chad nyan la bskos/ lo bcu drug 'chad nyan bsrings pas blo gsal sum brgya tsam 'dus te bzang ldan dge 'phel gyi grwa tshang tshugs/ slar gcung pa chos gzhen dang grwa pa thug phrad kyis nyen bslangs/ 'jam dbyangs pas zhal 'phrad ma gnang bas/ mtshams sbyar te/ chos kyis 'byor yang nor dang mi ldan zhing / /bden tshig yod kyang zhu ba'i skabs med la/ /nyes pa med kyang nag can gnyag phu pa'i/ /zhu ba'i tshig 'di cung zad gsan par rigs/ /zhes sogs kyi zhu mchid phul te phyogs la phebs pas/ rdzo gdan mkhan po'i brtag pa bud pa dang rten 'brel sne 'dzoms te mkhan por mnga' gsol/ de yang sa pho khyi lo bco brgyad pa nas/ sa mo bya lo nyer dgu pa'i bar lo bcu gnyis su phyi nang gi bslab sbyang mthar 3// mdzad/ sum cu pa lcags pho khyi nas

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()zhe gcig pa/ byi lo'i bar lo bco lnga 'chad nyan yang dag pa mdzad/ zhe gcig pa shing pho byi lo sne gdong grags pa rgyal mtshan pas spyan drangs te/ jo gdan dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po/ kha che paṇa chen gyi gdan seng ge'i khri la lnga bcu rtsa drug nga sa mo yos kyi bar lo bcu drug zhabs brtan par 'khod do/ /mdor na bla ma yongs 'dzin bdun gyis lhag pa'i bcu phrag brgyad bsten/ 'chad pa'i rgyun bsrings/ rtsom pa phal cher sku shin tu bgres pa nas mdzad de/ don gsumapa la 'dul ba'i dka' 'grel bdud rtsi nying khu/ don brgyad pa la 'jamadabyangs kha ches bskul te/ chos dbyings bstod pa'i rnam bshad snying po donagasal/ brgyad cu pa la rnam 'grel gyi ṭī da gya gcig pa la 31 tsā ba skyab bsamachog gis gzhan stong dgag pa'i lan lung rigs gter mdzod mdzad do/ /gya gsum pa la 'dul ba 'di la bag chags sad/ gon po'i lag rjes 'job/gsungs/ lung sde bzhi so thar gyi mdo dang bcas pa la mchan bu btab/ gya lngapa la rgyud bla'i ṭī ka mdzad/ rtsod pa yang sangs pa dang bde gshegs snying po skor la rtsod pa mdzad pa sogs bstan pa dpang btsugs kyi rtsod pa mdzad/dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa gsum pa chu mo glang gi lor gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog ni/ chos bzang nyi ma/ bka' bcu pa pad+ma bzang po/ dme de bzhin gshegs pa/ dmi mthong ba don ldan/ smra ba'i seng ge rong ston chen po sog so / / des na da lta'i shing byi 'di/ rgyal sras thogs med byon pa'i shing mo luganas nyis brgya dang bdun cu pa lo chen byang rtse'i chu mo yos nas nyis brgya dang rtseganyis pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa'i / ༵ byi ba nas nyis brgya dang gsusag

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//gnyag dbon byon pa'i lcags sprul nas nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bzhir sleb pa yin no/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po g.yag zug sangs rgyas dpa 'as zhes grags pa yang / gnyag dbon dang rigs lam smra ba thog mtshungs shing / 'di las sku cung zad gzhen la mkhan chen g.yag pa lcaṭa pho stag lo pa ltar na gnyag dpon las lo dgus gzhon pa ra mchis so/ /rje btsun red mda' ba las cung bgres pa zhig yin la pa ṇa shan pa'i gtam gyi rol mtsho las/ bu ston snags pho stag lo 'khrungs pa'i re gcig pa lcags pho stag lor g.yag pa 'byungs/de'i nyer brgyad pa me mo lug la rong ston 'brungs zhes bshad 'dun /de yang rtse thang ga gi chen po byang chub rin chen sras yin pa la/ rnam pa de nyid kyi nye gnas g.yag yu che lta u pa'i sras su ngos blangs pas na/ g.yag phrug ceb(grags la/ 'khrungasasayul dngos ni sa skya 'phrang zhes bya ba de yin zhing / dpal ldan sa skya dang rtse thang sogs su gsan sbyong mdzad/ sa skya'i mkhas dbang brtson 'grus dpal la gtso bor bsten nas mdo la sbyangs shing / gon gyo ye shes la gsung ngag sogs gsan/ bu dol gyi slob ma nya brtson gnyis/ nya brtson gnyis kyi slom ma g.yag gzhen rnam gnyis zhes bstan pa'i gsal byed dam par gyur/ dbus gtsang gi mkhas grub gong ma'i bsti gnas so sor/ mkhas pa'i slob grogs ha cang mang ba min pa zhig la 'chad rgyun bsrings/ rgyun 'dzin mkhas pa rong ston smra ba'i seng ge dang / red mda' ba chen po/ gzhen nu rgyal mchog sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon la/ 'di nyid mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i nyer bdun pa shing pho rta lor dga' ldan du gshegs zhes 'byung bas/ red mda' ba chen po zhi bar gshegs pa'i chu pho 'brug gi ya/ 4/ ma'i rta lo de yin par sems so/ /

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()des na mkhan chen g.yag pas don lnga bzhugs te/ lcags pho stag la blta masang nas shing rta la gshegs pas so/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang brgyad cu 'das pa'i gya gcig pa sa pho byi (spyi lo 1348)lo mnyam med red mda' ba chen po bod miblon po mgar stong btsan gyi brgyud du/ dpal ldan sa skya dang khad nye ba'i red mda' khab sor byon/ gnyag dbon las lo bdun gyis gzhon no/ /theg chen chos rje las lo gcig gis bgres/ lo bco brgyad pa la sa bzang ma ti'i drung du / tshigs snga ma gnyis nod de mtshan gzhon nu blo gros zhes gsol/ thog mar dpal ldan sa skyar/ mkhas pa nya dbon dang / mkhan chen sangs rgyas 'phelaba'i drung du tshad ma/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung du phar phyin/ lo chen byang rtselas mngon pa gong 'og rgyal sras pa'i drung du blo sbyong / mdog lo pa mkhan chen kun dga' dpal las bsnyen par rdzogs shing / 'dul ba gsan/ mkhan posastod 'dul gyi sdom brgyud 'di ma chad cig gnang dgos zhes bka' stsal phebasazer mod/ stod 'dul ba'i bshad rgyun ma gtogs sdom rgyun rang du cung mi 'grobar sems te/ mdog lo pas chos rje bla ma las bsnyen par rdzogs shing / cho rje bla ma'i sdom rgyun ni kha che mkhan po shākya shrī las brgyud pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan —yang bla ma dpal ldan pa'i drung du lam 'bras/ lo tsā ba nam bzang / 9sa sto gogrags rgyal/ lo tsā ba skyabs mchog dpal sogs las gsang 'dus sogs mi rgyud man ngag dang / mkhan chen byang seng la dbu ma gsan zhing dkon mchog lagasol ba btab ste rang gi rnam dpyod kyis dpyad pas dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i gnad la nges pa rnyed de/ nged dang rdo /ba gnyer byed dus dbu ma'i dpe ma

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gcig 'dug ces nor mi che bar byed pa las/ nged sang rtsis su byed pa ni kho bos bstan pa la bya ba byas pa yin zhes dang / dmi pa dkon gzhen gyi gsung gis/ deng sang mkhas rmongs kun la dbu ma dbu ma zer ba 'di red mda' ba'i drin yin/ de gong thang zag na dbu ma shi ro gcig las gzhan med ces kyang gsung zer te/ rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang / dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i bstan pa la 'di kho na bka' drin che ba yin/ de yang mkhas pa 'di sngon bu rin po la mos pa shig yin na'ang / slob dpon dang grogs kyi stobs kyis kun mkhyen chen po'i grub mtha' la 'dris che ba zhig byung / de nyid kyi grub mtha'i rgyab brten bka' bstan bcos la gzigs rtog tshar gsum mdzad pas dang po la gzhan stong gi grub mtha' de ni bka' bstan bcos dag gi dgongs pa yin nges pa shar/ gnyis pa la som nyi za ba zhig byung / gsum pa la min par nges shes 'drongs pa zhig byung gsung zer ba na'ang / gnas skabs so sor phye dgos so zhes kho bo cag gi'o/ /de'i tshe chos kyi gnad ma rtogs par grub mtha'i kha 'dzin rang stong gzhan stong zhes pa'i ming tsam la zhen pa dag gis/ chos spong gi las rgya cher bsags par snang ba ni/ blun rmongs kho na'i spyod yul lo/ /mkhas pa 'di ni bshad sgrub zung ldan du mdzad de/ bul rong gi dben gnas su lo bcu gnyis bzhugs pa'i lo lnga rtsod sgom gtso bor ston pa'i thugs dam nyams bzhes kho na mdzad/ lo bdun skal ldan gyi gdul bya brgyad cu skor la nyams khrid legs bshad kyi dga' ston spel/ rtsom pa mdzad pa yang / 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog dka' chen bas /9/rtsa 'jug gzhi gsum theg chen rgyud

'tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'grang gces bsdus/()bla ma/ /chos mngon mdzod dang dpal ldan 'dus pa ste/ /rnam bshad mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs bcu phrag cig /phar tshad shes pa'i slob ma brgya phrag brgal/ /ces pa ltar yin la/ 'chad pa dbyangs kyi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma'i grangs kyang / gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen bdun/ /bka' bzhi legs par smra ba bcu phrag gcig /phar tshad shes pa'i slob ma brgya phrag brgal/ /zhes pa ltar te/ bshes gnyen bdun ni/ sbyangs pa'i mchog gyur kun mkhyen sher 'od dang / /sras kyi mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa dang / /lta ba'i mchog gyur gon gyo nyi ma grags/ /nyams len mchog gyur kun dga' dpal bzang po/ /rtsom ldan mchog gyur dpal 'byor shes rab dang / /'chad mkhasamachog gyur bsod nams shes rab dang / /rtsod bzang mchog gyur dar ma rin chen te/ /zhes pa ltar yin shing bka' bcu pa gzhan yang / byang pa bka' bcu ba dge legs dpal la sogs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i skyes bu 'di ni/ drug cu rtsa lnga pa chu pho 'brug gi zla ba bcu pa'i nyer dgu'i nyi shar la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /des na sum stong bzhi brgya pa'i mjug 'dir bka' bzhi pa dang bka' bcu pa la sogs pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i mkhas grub mang dag byung ste/hor bka' bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bka' bzhi pa nam mkha' 'od zer la sogs pa dang / bka' bcu pa ni/ rgyal tshab dar ma man chad nas byung bar gsal te/ de yan du bka' chen bzhir grags pa dang / de bzhi'i steng du ci rigs bsnan pa'i drug tsam la grwa skor mdzad pa sha stag byung ba yin la/ rgyal tshab rjes po ti bcu la bshad pa'i sroX 3 0 man chad nas dka' bcu pa zhes

bstan rtsi gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam ra bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mtshan grags shing / bo dong phyogs las pas bco lnga la bshad pa gnang yang dbon po bka' bcu pa zhes pa tsam las ma byung la/ phyis byams chen smra ba'i dbang po sangs rgyas 'phel man chad nas rab 'byams pa zhes kyang yongs su grags so/ /'on kyang bka' pa gzhon nu seng ge sogs/ de yan du yang bka' pa'i mtshan cung zhig grags par gsal lo/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang gya gcig 'das pa'i gya gnyis pa sa mo glang (spyi lo 1349)la theg chen chos rje kun dga' ba po shis dpal sa skyar byon/ chos rje bla ma las so bdun gyis gzhon/de yang bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gyi sras rnams bla brang go bzhir gyes pa'i lha khang bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa ste/ lha khang bla brang pa ti shri kun rgyal/ yab bzang po dpal zhe dgu pa lcags pho khyi lor byon pa yin la/de'i sras ta dben chos rgyan yab nyer gsum pa chu pho sprel lo la byon pa yin zhing / de nyid bco brgyad pa'i sras theg chen chos rje 'di yin no/ /de yang dang po sa bzang ma ti las rab tu byung / phyis chos rje bla ma las bsnyen par rdzogs/gzhan yang / gangs khrod pa grags pa dpal/ jo nang phyogs las sogs mkhas grub mang du bsnyen/ gsung ngag gsan pa'i bla ma yang / thog mar ma ti paṇa chen la sa bzang dgon par gsan pa yin mod/ de nyid la lam dus kyi chu rgyun chag med mi bzhugs pas/ phyis sa skya zur khang du bu ston dbang phyug dar la gsan/brgyud pa de yang chos rje brag phug pa nas brag phug dkon rgyal/ des sa skya bu ston la brgyud pa yin gyi chos rje bla ma brgyud pa la mi bzhugs pas/ phyis chosarje bla ma las dngos su nod pa mkhan sa/ byang seng la gsan pa yin no/ /zhes

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grol mchog gsungs la/ rje btsun blo gsal ca mtsho'i gsung las/ mkhan chen byang seng la zab chos mang du gsan yang /gsung ngag gsan pa'i bla ma ni snga ma gnyis kho na'o zhes gsungs so/ /gang na'ang dbang khrid gdams pa'i sgo mo brgya phrag gis skal ldan gyi 'gro ba'i yidagasos par mdzad de mthar tā ming rgyal pos spyan drangs te/ re bzhi pa chu sgo'abrug la sa skya nas shar phyogs la phebs/ re lnga pa chu mo sprul la pho brang gserakhang du rgyal po dang mjal/ rgyal po 'khor bcas la dbang gdams pa'i sgo sge'aphags pa ti shri dang 'dra bar bod chol kha gsum yang 'bul gsungs/ slar phobrang ta'i tur byon/ gser dngul gyi thub pa nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor ba gas la dang bcas pa yang phul/ 'di nyid byang ngam rings su yang lo bskor gcig tsam bzhugs/ gzhan yang / byi ru'i gshed dmar gshed snyeng la skya'i gdung rabs mang sher shing gi 'jigs byed ces gsal/ sgrig pa po ge)gi 'jigs byed gse'uthags kyi thang sku gnyis/ za 'og thogs gnyis la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyagapa phul/ slar re drug pa rta lo la gong nas bteg re bsnyen pa lug lor dpalaldan sa skyar phebs te/ don bdun pa shing mo sprul gro zhun zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyi shar la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog ni kun dga' rgyalamatshan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal lo/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang gya dasa'adas pa'i dgu bcu pa me mo bya (spyi lo 1357)la shar myong kha pa blo bzangagrags nga pa mdo khams su byon/ chos rje bla ma las zhe lngas gzhon/ red mda' ba chen po dang /theg chen pa las rim 3༷ldan lo dgu dang brgyad kyis gzhen no//

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lag bsam rab dal ra zhe byab bzhu sa so// 'di nyid lo bdun pa la mdo khams pa don grub rin chen las rab tu byung /don grub rin chen de ni/ bcom ldan rig ral gyi bu chen ldong ston rigs pa'i seng ge'i slob ma yin zer/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la dbus gtsang la byon/ grwa sa bde ba can du snye thang pa bkra shis sogs las phar phyin sbyangs/ bcu dgu pa la gsang phu sogs su grwa skor gnang / gtsang phyogs sa kyi zha lu/ snar thang / bas skya sogs su byon/ sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal dang / ma ti paṇa chen sogs la zab chos gsan grwa skor yang mdzad/ la stod byang gi bzang ldan ngam rings 'ga' rong sogs su grwa skor mdzad/ jo nang du phyogs las pa la sbyor drug gsan/ bo dong du grwa skor mdzad nas snar thang du phyag phebs/ de nas nya dbon la phar phyin dang / rje btsun red mda' ba las mngon pa dang dbu ma sogs gsan te/ de nyid kyi thugs sras dam par gyur/ skyor mo lung gi mkhan po bka' bzhi pa blo gsal la 'dul ba gsan/ gong gsum bde chen pa sogs las sngags kyi rgyud man ngag gsan/ jo gdan tshogs chen po'i mkhan po dka' bzhi pa tshul rin las bsnyen par rdzogs/ bla ma dbu ma pas mtshams sbyar te rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la chos gsan/ bla ma dbu ma pa ni/ mdo khams su byis pa'i dus nyid nas 'jam dbyangs kyi sku'i snang ba shar/ rje 'di dang phar slob tshur slob yin/ mdor na rje 'dis sku tshe'i stod la thos bsam gyis rgyud sbyangs/ bar skabs su bya bral kho na mdzad/ zab don la dpyad sgom gyi sgo nasadon nyams su bzhes/ 'phral gyi kun spyod 'dul ba'i lag len gsos btab/khyad par du dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i di// pa cher spel/ sku tshe'i smad la gzhan

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()don phyogs med du rgyas/ dgung lo nga gsum pa sa mo glang la chos 'khor lha sar smon lam chen mo mdzad/ jo bo la rin po che'i dbu rgyan yang gsol/ bka' chems las/ de nas khyad par bsnyen bkur cher mdzad pa/ /dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa/ /gsang sngags 'chang zhing rnal 'byor chen bo ni / / snying po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pa ni/ /zhal yang bsgyur zhing bsnyen bkur dam pa mdzad/ /ces pa'i lung gi don yin par yang 'chad/ lo de nyid la ri bo dge ldan yang btab/ de phyin ri bo dge ldan pa zhes yongs su gragasapa yin no/ /de nas dgung lo re gsum pa sa mo phag gi nyer lnga la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog ni/ rgyal tshab rje/ mkhas grub rje/ thamasacad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ 'dul 'dzin grags rgyal/ 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa ste 'dul 'dzin rnam gnyis la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /des na da lta'i shing byi 'di/ theg chen pa byon pa'i sa mo glang nas nyis brgya dang bcu drug pa/ shar tsong kha pa byon pa'i me bya nas nyis brgya dang brgyad du slebasapa yin no/ /sa bcad lnga pa sum stong lnga brgya pa'i skabs su byon pa sna/ rong ston smra ba'i seng ge bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun dga' rnam gnyis/ mdze de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa ste/ sum stong bzhi brgya dang go dgu 'das pa'i lnga brgya'i steng du sleb tsam gyi me mo lug (spyi rdzo1367)la rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan shar rgya mo rong du byon/ shar myong kha pa las lo bcus gzhen/ lo bco brgyad yan chad du bon la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gnang / bco brgyad pa la ga dī 4phu ne'u thog gi chos grwar gling stod pa

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar na bya ba bzhugs so// rin chen rnam rgyal dang / kong ston blo gros dbang phyug gi drung du rngog lo nas brgyud pa'i phar tshad bsdus gsum dang / dbu ma rang brgyud pa'i bshad thol/skyor mo lung gi mkhan chen dka' bzhi pa dang / 'phan yul gro sa'i mkhas pa dmar ston la 'dul ba smad lugs bya 'dul dang thog ma dka' chen gyi bshad srol/ mngon pa mdzod mchims lugs kyi bshad srol/ thang zag pa sprul sku gzhen nu rgyal mtshan la dbu ma thal 'gyur ba pa tshab kyi bshad srol/ lo pa shākya rin chen gyi drung du mngon pa gong ma sogs la sbyangs/ lo nyer gnyis pa la/gro sa'i mkhan po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang dmar ston pa'i drung du rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ rnam nges kyi ṭī ka brtsams shing 'chad pa'i 'khur bzung / mdor na lo nyer gnyis nas gya gsum gyi bar la mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyis dus 'da' ba kho na byung zhing nyer bdun pa sa mo bya'i lo la/ mkhan chen g.yag pa dang mjal te sa lugs kyi mdo'i bshad srol dang / theg chen chos rje la gsung ngag sogs sngags kyi zab don blangs nas sa rngog rnam gnyis kyi bshad srol rgyun bsrings te/ phywa pa chos seng dang / bcom ldan rig ral dang / kun mkhyen 'di gsum las 'chad pa'i rgyun dang / dngos slob bstan 'dzin gyi thon che ba ma byung zhes grags/ gtsang phyogs la yang lan gsum byon pa'i dang po lo nyer bdun pa'i tshe/ mkhan chen pa'i zhabs 'bring mdzad de mdo'i zab don gsan pa dang / legs bshad kyi skyes 'bul ba kho na mdzad/gnyis pa rang lo zhe brgyad pa la mkhan chen pa gshegs te/ lnga bcu tsam gyi tshe ding ri dang mus sogs su sngags kyi /rdo don bzhes pa dang / mdo phyogs kyi

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()phrin las spel ba kho na mdzad/ lan gsum pa drag cu rtsa gcig pa'i tshe/ sde dpon so so'i bsod nams kyi mgron dang / mdo thegs kyi chos 'bor bskor ba kho na mdzad/ bdun cu pa me pho 'brug la nā len+t+ra'i chos grwa btab nas lo bcu bzhir gzhan don mdzad cing / dbus gtsang du grwa skor mdzad pa'i po ti bcu kho na yin yang / gzhan la 'doms pa'i gzhung lugs drug cu rtsa bzhi dang/ rnam bshad mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs bzhi bcu yod gsungs/ gzhan yang lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ lo chen skyabs mchog lo chen grags pa/ kun mkhyen sher 'od/ snyan ngag pa 'jam dbyangs kha che/ mus nam mkha'i rnal 'byor sogs la zab don mang du blangs/ dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sku lus la kā ma la shī la'i thugs grong 'jug mdzad pa de'i sku'i skye bar gdon mi za bas/ dam pa'i zhi byed/ kā ma la shrī la'i sgom rim sogs ched du gsal bar mdzad cing / khyad par phar phyin gyi bstan pa dang / dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i bstan pa la kun mkhyen 'di bka' drin che ba yin no/ /legs bshad 'doms pa'i 'bras bu mkhasagrub slob ma'i grangs ni/ snga tshar gyi bu chen bstan pa 'degs pa'i ka chen bzhi/bar tshar gyi bu chen gangs can mdzes pa'i rgyan brgyad dang mchog gnyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod mtshungs pa'i bu chen gsum/ phyi tshar gyi bu chen bstan pa'i gsal byed bcu drug yang tshar gyi bu chen grags pa can bzhi la sogs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sems dpa' gzhen nu rgyal mchog sems dpa' chen po pad+ma bzang po/gzad pa blo gros rgya mtsho/spyan snga tshul khrims dar ma'o/ /bar tshar brgyad ni/ smar khams pa /sdus pa bzang po/ dge ba rgyal mtshan/

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam ra bdakar zhes byab bzhugs so// gung ru rgyal mchan bzang po/ rong chung shes rab dpal te khams pa bzhi/ chos lung bka' bcu pa/ dga' gdong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang / mkhas dbang rat+na shrī bha dra/ snar thang pa shes rab seng ge bzang ldan dka' bcu pa ste gtsang pa bzhi'o/ /(gcig lhag༄5chog gnyis ni/ dbus pa dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen dang / gtsang pa sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gnyis so/ /mdzad spyod mtshungs pa gsum ni/ mdo khams dpal ldan thod se/ sgom sde khra hral/ sa skya nas gzhen nu seng ge dang gsum mo/ /phyi tshar drug la paṇa chen bzhi ni / snar thang lo sto ba sa lha shrī/ yar rgyab dbon po paṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal/ spob 'dar ba lo chen gzhon nu dpal/ dwags po dbon po paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal lo/ /gsung sgros 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa bcu gnyis ni/ khams su lha 'bri ston pa shes rab rdo rje dang / rin chen blo gros gnyis/ dbus su bzod chen phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / mkhas grub don yod dpal ba gnyis/ nyang stod pa shes rab legs dpal/ ngam rings pa sangs rgyas grub/ mnga' ris su 'jam dbyangs sher rgyal lo/ /nges med du bzhugs pa gzhu ston bsod nams rin chen/ gsang phu nas paṇ+ḍita nam mkha' bstan pa/ gtsang rong byams chen nas dkar shākya grags/ khams nas gon gyo sbyin bzang dang / ga zi blo gros seng ge rnams so/ /yang tshar bzhi ni/ gsang phu nas grwa ston pa yon tan rgya mtsho dang / rtse thang nas chen po dpal 'byor rgya mtsho gnyis/ khams su go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal dang / gtsang du byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel te bzhi'o/ /sum stong lnga 3 5 7 dang brgyad 'das pa'i dgu pa me pho

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()'brug (spyi lo 137)la/ la stod lho shrī sar sa ta dpal gyi ri'i byang ngos kyi 'brog sde chen por/ po dong phyogs las rnam rgyal byon/ lo bdun pa la/ gyi dgon par rang gi zhang po lo chen grags pa'i drung du rab tu byung / mtshan sangasargyas rgyal mtshan gsol/ slar bo dong er lo chen de nyid las dge tshul du bsgrubs te/ mtshan chos kyi rgyal mtshan du btags/ lo bcu drug pa la dpal ldan sa skyar rnam 'grel gyi grwa skor mdzad/ bo dong er dbyangs can ma bsgrubs pas/ rgyud mangs kyi sgra las zab rgyas kyi chos tshul nod de/ phyi nang gi mdzad phrin ma lus pa sad pas dbyangs can dga' ba'i dpal zhes grags/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa la/ rtse thang dang gsang phur pu ti bco lnga'i grwa skor gnang bsamakhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ de'i tshe gsang phur mkhan chen g.yag phrug sang bkargyas dpal dang rigs gter gyi dgongs pa/ rang rig yul yod med la rtsod pa'i tshe/ mkhan chen pas rang rig yul med du zhal gyis bzhes pa la/ rje 'dis/ rang rig chos can/ rang gi gzhal bya mi bslu ba'i rig par thal/ tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na khyod kyi yul yod par thal lo zhes dang / mkhan chen pas gzugs sgra ka bum sogs rtag par khas blangs pa la/ ka ba chos can/khyod kyi gzugs med par thal/ khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rigasapa'i sgo nas snyan par grags so/ /'on kyang pha rol gyi grub mtha'i go don dang bstun na khyab pa med mtshams de kho na yin pas/ phas rgol pham par gyur pa yang ma yin no/ /de nas slar/ e chos kyi 'byung gnas su lo chen grags pasamakhan po dang / rje btsun red mda' ba3 rdo/ pos las slob bgyis te bsnyen par

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rdzogs/ des na paṇa chen 'di'i rnam thar ni bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi langs na'ang / gtso bo bsdus na rtsod pas phas rgol dregs pa gzhom nus tshul/rtsom pas bka' bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa bkral tshul/ 'chad pas bstan 'dzin gyi bu slob spel tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ las stod lhor/ ta'i si tu lha btsan byang rgyab pas mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te/ g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang rtsod pa'i tshe/ bka' bstan bcos kyi gzhung phal che ba/ rgol phyi rgol gnyis char gyi mgrin pa nas thogs med du sgrogs shing / phas kyi rgol ba g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang chen po'i spobs pa sgrub pa la/ rgol ba de nyid kyi yi dam lha rje btsun mi g.yo ba mngon sum du byon pa paṇa chen nyid kyis kyang zhal gzigs/ de'i tshe lha gcig ma ngo log sod cig ma mgo ma thon/gdong gang bo rtsod pa pham zhes grags so zhes zer mod/ don du na rje btsun mi g.yo ba mngon sum du byon pa na/ rgol ba gnyis char gyi ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i rnam thar yin zhing / rtsod pa'i ngag la yang / rang rang gi gdul bya'i snang ngor pham rgyal gyi snang ngo tsam las/ phas rgol gyi rgol ba nyid gshis la pham par rig pa ga la yin te/ dper na de'i tshe mkhan chen g.yag pas sems can sangs rgyas nges yin/ rgyas pa mi srid ces khas blang bas pa la/ paṇa chen pas sabon las myu gu skye/ skyes pa mi srid par thal/ dam bca' de yin pa'i phyir zhesapa la sogs pa la lan ma byung zhes sgrogs mod/ yang dag par na de gnyis mtshungs pa'i go skabs ga la yod de/ sems can sangs rgyas pa med par khas blangs kyi sems can las sangs rgya/ 5/byung ba med par khas ma blangs pa'i

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()phyir ro/ /sa bon myu gur song ba med par khas len gyi sa bon las myu gu skye ba med par khas blangs mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang ngam rings su bdag chen 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rin chen pas mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te dpal ba pa rings kyi bshes gnyen dag la 'bel ba'i gtam gyi sgo phye/rdon dam don byed nus pa gang / /zhes pa'i gzhung la grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag phra zhing zhib pa'i blo gros kyi sgo phye ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsod nams skyabs dang / mkhas sdi/ba dge legs dpal sogs rigs pas phamakhapar byas so/ /zhes grags so/ /des na byang mdog gi pho brang du ta'i si tu rnam rgyal grags pas mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te kun mkhyen rong ston chen po slob bu'i tshogs dang bcas pa la 'bel ba'i gtam chen po gleng / gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po khri phrag gcig gi zhal phye bar zhal gyis 'ches shing /'jam dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor drug cu'i rnam grangs legs par bgrangs shing /'phags yul du byon pa'i thal rang gi skyes chen 'dren res bgyis pa na/ rong ston chen pos legs ldan 'byed/ dpal sbas/ ye shes snying po/ zhi 'tsho/ kā la ma shī la ste lnga las bgrang ma bzod pa la/ paṇa chen nyid kyis nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam zhig thal byung du bgrangs pa sogs kyi sgo nas pha rol zil gyis mnan to zhesagrags so/ /gnyis pa rtsom pa ni/ yi dam gyi lha dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang /rdo rje phag mo la sogs pas mngon sum du gnang ba stsal zhing / dpal de nyid 'dus pa la rtsoms shig ces gnang ba nod pa dang / mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po las/ dpal sa skya pa chen po grag/ sdu rgyal mtshan dang / bu ston thams cad

bsna rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed gabs ra rab dkar zhes byab bzhugs so// mkhyen pa dang / shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pas kyang de ltar gnang ba stsal ba la brten/ de nyid bsdus pa'i rgya mtsho/ 'jug pa'i sgo bzhi/ le'u nyi khri chig stong / man ngag bdun khri nyis stong / chos kyi tshogs brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pas rgyas pa la glegs bam brgya dang bcu/ 'bring po la nyi shu/ bsdus pa la glegs bam gnyis/ shin tu bsdus pa'i snying po la glegs bam gcig khrod pa'i rtsom pa chen po mdzad de/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad do/ /gsum pa 'chad pas blo gsal gyi bu slob spel ba'i tshul ni/ bzo rig nas bzung yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar/ de dang de yi bka' babs nyi shu gsum / /'jam pa'i rdo rje mi yi zlos gar mkhan/ /rnam dag 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rnam pa gsum/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i khyu mchog chen po gcig /nyi ma zla ba ltar grags mkhas grub gnyis/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mig gcig lo chen gsum/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen drug /mdo sngags yongs rdzogs mkhas pa bcu gsum dang / /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gdan sa gnyis/ /'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan bcu drug dang / /mtshan nyid rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen gsum/ /sngags gzhung rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen gsum/ /grub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ /drag po'i brtul zhugs rdzogs pa'i sngags 'chang gnyis/ /dka' bcu legs par smra ba stong phrag gcig /dka' bzhi kun tu smra ba stong phrag zung / /phar tshad shes pa'i slob ma khri phrag brgal/ /tshe 'di blos btang grub chen lnga bcur ldan//lhag par rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /rdo rje phag mo gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin sdu/1 /sa la dge slong ma yis rab grags

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()pa / / sprul pa'i gar gyis gsang ba 'dzin par mdzad/ /zhes pa ltar/ bka' babs nyi shu rtsa gsum ni/ bzo rig gi bka' babs mnga' ris pa bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan/ gso rig gi bka' babs byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang / snyan ngag gi bka' babs ngam rings dka' bcu pa dpal ldan bzang po/ tha snyad gtsug lag gi bka' babs dpal e'i bka' bcu pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / tshad ma rigs pa'i bka' babs stag lung dkar bzhi pa mañdzu shrī/'dul ba'i bka' babs gung thang pa dpal ldan seng ge mngon pa'i bka' babs gsang phu ba bzod pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ phar phyin bka' babs gung thang pa rgyal mtshan dkon mchog byams chos kyi bka' babs sa skya bka' bcu pa mchog gi blo gros/ dbu ma'i bka' babs bka' bzhi pa shar mgon/ spyod 'jug gi bka' babs sa skya byang sems gzhon nu rgyal mchog 'chad pa'i bka' babs smar khams pa grags pa bzang po/ rtsod pa'i bka' babs shel dkar ba thugs rje dpal bzang / rtsom pa'i bka' babs rtse thang pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ btsun pa'i bka' babs gung thang pa ma ti bi dza ya/ srid pa las grol ba'i bka' babs rgyal khams kyi spong ba pa yon tan seng ge mosagus kyi bka' babs sku zhang 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i bka' babs rtse thang pa mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ gar gyi bka' babs bo dong pa dar ma seng ge sde snod gsum gyi bka' babs shel dkar ba dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ rgyud sde bzhi'i bka' babs stag lung thang pa bka' drug pa ngag dbang grags pa/ rtogs pa'i bka' babs rang dbon glang 'khor ba ngag 362

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar ba dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dbang rgyal mtshan/ bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bka' babs shel dkar ba 'jam dpal grags pa dang nyer gsum mo/ /'khon gyi gdung brgyud gsum ni/bdag po grags pa blo gros/ grags pa rdo rje/ theg chen pa'i dbon po bde legs bkra shis dang gsum mo/ /sngags 'chang ba'i khyu mchog gcig pu ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan no/ /nyi ma dang zla ba ltar grags pa gnyis ni / mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po dang / dpang lo'i sku skyer grags pa blo gros brtan pa gnyis so/ /'jig rten gyi mig gsum ni/ e'i lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang po/ lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba thugs rje dpal te gsum mo/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi mkhas pa drug ni/ bo dong stag sde pa dol pa rgyal mtshan grags/ spyi bo lhas kyi mkhan po bshes gnyen nyi ma/ rtse thang pa chos kyi grags pa/ gsang phu bka' bcu pa pad+ma bzang po/ snar thang pa dge 'dun grub pa/ shangs chos 'khor snang pa'i mkhan chen bka' bcu pa shes rab rin 'a te drug mdo sngags yongs rdzogs0 ni/ bo dong rta ra'i ོ po rin chen chos bzang ba/ dol pa rgyal bzang / bo dong grang mo che'i rgyal grags/ grang mo che'i chen po sher grags/ stag sde pa sher dpal/ sgro smon can gyi bla ma kun dpal/ bo dong rta ra'i wo po 'jam dkar/ bo dong grang mo che'i 'a po seng ge rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon chos kyi nyi ma/ gsang phu rong chung shes rab dpal/dka' bcu pa rat+na shrī/ rje'i dbon po shel dkar mkhan chen rje btsun pa/ ngam rings rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas seng ge ste bcu'o/ /(gsum lhag deb che bsod snyom pa'i gdan sa pa gnyis ni/ tsho/sdu chen po'i mkhan po don grub dpal

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()'byor dang / dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po seng ge dpal gnyis so/ /gtsug rgyan bcu drug ni dam pa rgya gar gyi gdan sa pa glang 'khor chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i gdan sa pa mkhan chen nam mkha' rin chen/ yang de'i mkhan po nyid kyi dbon po mkhan chen 'jigs med grags pa/ yang de'i mkhan po nyid kyi dbon po bshes gnyen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ ngam rings mkhan chen bsod nams skyabs/ yang de'i mkhan po dkon khang pa nyi ma/ mngon dga'i chos dpon 'jam dbyangs kun legs/ de'i mkhan po rgyal mtshan blo gros/ nyang stod bde chen gyi mkhan po dkon mchog bzang po/byams chen gyi mkhan po sku skye/ 'dzim pa'i mkhan po bkra shis rin chen/ mkhan chen lha'i rgyal po/ 'dus pa 'bring gi rtsom yig pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/'phags pa nam snying / 'dar mkhan chen bde gshegs rgyal mtshan/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po byang chub mchog ldan te bcu drug go /mdo rab 'byams pa bzhi ni/ gsang phu go rab 'byams pa/ shel dkar ba yon tan rgya mtsho/ byamasachen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ mnga' ris pa nam mkha' bsod nams dang bzhi'o/ /sngags rams pa gnyis ni/ shab lhun rtse ba kun mkhyen 'phags 'od dang / rmog lcog pa'i gdan sa ba sangs rgyas dpal gnyis so/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa bzhi ni/ jo gdan ras chen gzhen nu dpal/chos rje brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ grub pa'i rgyal mo bsod nams 'bum dang bzhi'o/ /sngags 'chang drag po gnyis ni/ ngam rings kyi ā nan+da dang / gung thang gi ṭ+wāṃ rten chos dpal bzang po/ dka' bcu

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lag bas mar ba dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//stong phrag ni bsod nams blo gros sogs so/ /dka' bcu stong phrag zung ni/ mu srad dka' bzhi pa sogs so/ /phar tshad khri phrag brgal ba ni/ de dus kyi bshes gnyen phal che ba'o/ /sgrub chen lnga bcu ni/ rnal 'byor pa rdo rje phag mo sogs so / / des dpang lo chen po'i bo dong e'i gdan seng ge'i khri la 'khod pa yin la / de'i snag gi dbon po lo chen byang rtse/ de'i rus kyi dbon po lo chen gragasapa / de'i snag gi dbon po paṇa chen 'di nyid do/ /dbon brgyud de dag gis rim par bzung zhing bo dong pa zhes snyan par grags so/ /des na lo 'di ni paṇa chen 'di byon pa'i sbrul nas brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa brgyad yin la/ paṇa chen 'di/dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun dga' rnam gnyis las/ lo bdun gyisabagres shing rong ston chen po las lo bco brgyad kyis gzhen no/ /mnga' ris bla chen chos dpal bzang po lcags mo phag lo pa ste/ paṇa chen 'di nyid las lo lngas bgres/ ā nan+da pa chu pho byi 'e1 pa ste paṇa chen 'di bas mtho bzhis bgres pa tsam yin no/ /paṇa chen 'dis don bdun bzhugs/ sum stong lnga brgya dang bcu 'das pa'i bcu gcig pa shing mo glang ( po rta na(spyi lo 1370la/ sum stong lnga brgya dang bcu bzhi 'das pa'i bco lnga pa rwa pho khyi (spyi lo 1382)la dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan 'dzin kun dga' rnam gnyis byon/snyeb 'di'i gcings lo'i tshig 'gros la gzhigs na kun dga' bzang po sngon dang kun dga' rgyal mtshan rjes la byon par ngos 'dzin dgos 'dra yang /ngor chen kun dga' bzang po 'di nyid byi ba lor sku 'das pa dang / gsham du mus chen gyi lo rgyus skabs mus chen la dgung lo drug gis bgres pa sku 'ad pa'i lo de yang me byi lo yin pa gsal por 'khod pa des na chu khyi spyi lo 1382lor bltams/ dgung lo don lnga pa me byi spyi lo 1456lor sku 'ad pa 365

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()kha tshon bcad chog pa thog mar kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang /de rjes ngor chen kun dga' bzang po bltams par ngos 'dzin dgos 'dra bad dung dpyad par 'tshal/ dpe sgrig pa sa )de yang the du rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po ni/ sa skya tshogs kyi nye gnas dpon tshang grumasayon tan gyi sras su bltams/ lo dgu pa la/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyisamakhan po/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhen nu blo gros kyis slob dpon mdzad de tshigs snga ma gnyis nod/ de nas bzung ste/ lo nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhes kyi bar du gtso cher shar chen pa'i zhabs pad bsten te rgyud man ngag zab chos blangs/ shar chen pas mkhan po/ mkhan chen blo gros dpal bas las slob/ sa bzang 'phags pas gsang ston bgyis te bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ rdor dkar gdan gcig kho na mdzad cing nyes lhung gi dris mas dben/ gzhan yang sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros la rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs rgyud sde'i bshad srol mang du gsan/ mkhan chen g.yag pa la rnam rig sogs rigs pa'i gsang tshig gnad du dril ba gsan/ sa skya sgo rum gyi rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la lo gsum gyi bar du gzigs rtog nan tan du mdzad pas/ chos spyi dang khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zab don gyi gnad la phyir ci ma log pa'i go ba phul byung bsnyes/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pa la kye rdor man ngag lugasakyi dbang bka' gsan pas/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i 'jug sgo thog ma yin zhes mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa thong / dgung lo nyer lnga pa'i tshe shar chen pa zhi bar gshegs te/ gsung ngag rin po che'i bdud rtsi sngar ma gsol bas/ thugasakyi 'dun pa cher g.yos te/ shangs choXkhor sgang du lo chen skyabs mchog drung

bstan rtsig gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam ra bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// du lhags pa na/ mdo rgyud zab rgyas kyi chos mang dag dang snang gsum gyi khrid rim tsam las thugs kyi re ba ma rdzogs pa na/ dus de'i tshe mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po'i ngang las/ bla ma kun dga' bzang po lam 'bras zhu na 'di na yar byon zer ba gcig byung bas de na phar byon pas/ ri 'bor gcig na/ dang ra sgo byang bstan rtsig pa khrol le ba zhig gi nang / khang pa sgo shar bstan zhig gi skas la 'dzegs byon pas/ skas mgo nas dge bshes sha rtsi rmug po byas pa gcig gis spos sna byas byon pas/ tshoms kha lhor bstan gcig na bla ma sku bgres se ba ber thul mnab pa gcig dang mjal te zag med kyi dga' ba chen po myong ba gcig byung / phyis dpal ldan sa skyar byon/ gsung ngag gi rtsad bcad pas chosarje dpal ldan tshul khrims dpal la gsung ngag yongs rdzogs kyi slob ma'i gtso bo gsum gyi shar chen pa ni zhi bar gshegs/ mi nyag rin rdor ni mdo khams la bzhud/ grub chen — nyid 'os su gzigs te/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa sa pho byi lo zhi dgon du byon pas/ 'od gsal du ji ltar shar ba de mngon sum du gyur pas/ mos gus kyis bsam pa tshims te lus nyams mnan gyis mi bzod pa cher skyes/ byi ba dang glang gi lo de nyid du gdan phab/ stag lo chos rje burnya/ sa skya dang sa bzang gnyis su chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe'ang zhabs pad la btud de/gsung ngag gi bdud rtsi sogs snying bcud tshims par rol/ dgung lo zhe brgyad yan la sa skya/ sa bzang sogs gnas nges med du gsung ngag sogs zab rgyasakyis dga' ston so sor spel/ de nas gnas kyi brtag pa mdzad pa na/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod de 'od gsal la /sdul por shar gang na yod ma nges pa la/

ba tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/( /)khyod kyi dgon pa don grub kyis ston pa yod zer ba 'od gsal la shar/ phyi nyag bre don grub zer bas/ gnas de'i yon tan bsngags pas/ dgung lo zhe brgyad pa sa mo bya la e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon pa chen po btab/ dpal ldan skya pa'i rgyud man ngag dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i bstan pa spyi khyab dang / khyad par bya spyod kyi bstan pa la/ rje 'di kho na bka' drin che ba yin no/ /rje 'di nyid kyisadabang khrid gdams pa'i sgo bye ba phrag brgya phye/ gsung ngag rin bo che lam 'bras tshar gsum gyis lhag pa'i bcu phrag brgyad gnang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa khri ra ba can gyis mkhan po mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi sde gsar btsugs kyang / slo bor dge 'dun stong phrag 'du ba'i chos sde/ chu 'dus su lnga brgya 'du ba/ steng khyebs su nyis brgya 'du ba/ gu ger brgya phrag sogs dang / e waṃ chos ldan du gsung ngag pa stong phrag 'du ba sogs su bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar rgyasamadzad/ mthar don lnga pa byi lo sa zla'i nyer lnga la gshegs zla ba tshes phral rje mus chen gyis gsung ngag btsugs/phyi nang gi rten bzhengs pa sogs mdzad do//sngags kyi bstan pa spel ba'i slob ma'i grangs kyang / bu ston rin po che dang rje 'di gnyis las lhag pa med pas bgrang bar mi spobs kyang / gtso bo bsdus na/bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po bcu ni/ sems dpal chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog smar khams pa grags pa bzang po/ chos rje gzhen nu seng ge byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ kun mkhyen go rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang/ 3 6 zlos kyi gtso bo sems dpa' chen po

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so // dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gzhan yang gung ru shes rab bzang po/ nyag bre rgyun skul ba paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen dga' gdong pa/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ bzod chen phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs so/ /bstan 'dzin dam pa kun dga' rgya thamatshan ni/ lo tsā ba shad ye shes sde sogs byon pa'i rigs rgyud/ dbon po nor 'phel gyi sras su/dpal ldan sa skya'i mthong smon bla brang du chu pho khyi lo de nyid la byon/ lo lnga pa la bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal las dge bsnyen nod/ bcu pa la shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan la dge tshul nod/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes btags/ nyi shu pa la theg chen chos rjes mkhan po dang/ shar yes slob dpon mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ tshad ma rigs gter rtsa 'grel la shin tu byang pas/ mtshan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal zhes theg chen pas gsol bar mdzad/ bo dong er bla ma kun dga' bzang po lo bdun tsam bsten/ tshad ma sogs la sbyong bshad mdzad/ lo bcu gsum pa la gdan sa chen bor grwa skor mdzad/ mkhan chen g.yag pa la phar phyin ṭi ka chen po rtsom pa'i rtsom yig pa mdzad de/ ṭi ka chen po brtsams pa dang / yi ger 'bri ba/ thugs la zin pa dang gsum dus mnyam du byung bas/ phar phyin legs par mkhyen/ de'i tshe mkhan chen pa bar skabs ngal gso ba'i tshe mnal cung zad mdzad de/ sad res kyi da len yang kho bos dga' ldan du phyin/ byams pa dang mjal zhes yang yang gsung ba yin zer/theg chen chos rje'i drung du gsung ngag sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa nod/ shad bla chen kun rgyal/ sa bzang pa gzhen3 6 9 blo gros/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()sogs las rgyud man ngag mang du gsan/ phyis byang nas 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rin chen gyis spyan drangs te/ dpal ldan sa skya'i zab chos mang po sgo phye/dpal ngam rings kyi chos sde dang / ya ga chos sdings zhes grags pa/ nor bu gling pa'i grwa tshang gi 'dzin skyong yang gnang / yos lor 0pa rings su mgon khang bzhengs dus/ lha khang ka gnyis ma la logs bris skya ris ja sbyor gcig gi ngo la gnang / blo bzang dkar mor grags pa'i grub chen blo gros bzang po la/gsung ngag sa lugs dang / zha lugs sogs gsan pas thugs bskyed thon par byung / grub chen des kyang / bde mchog sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa zhus/mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po las/ rje btsun gong ma lnga'i zhal gzigs te/rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal sras sbyin pa dpal/ /zhes sogs/ sho lo ka lngasabastod cing phyag 'tshal ba/ 'od gsal las bzhengs pa'i tshe yang gsal bar dran/ deng sang ya ga chos sdings na yang rgyun du 'don par mdzad do/ /mdor na 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad de/ nga lam 'bras pa mkhas pa yin/ ni gu ba rgod pa yin/ sbyor drug pa nyams myong can zhes gsung ba yin zer ro/ /slob ma'i mchog kyang sngags 'chang ā nan+da pa/bdag chen dpal ldan chos stong / sems dpa' gzhen nu rgyal mchog mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po la sogs pa mang du byon te/ slar rang lo re lnga pa me pho 'brug stag gi lo khrums zla ba'i nyer brgyad la gshegs so/ /ā nasapa chu pho byi lo la rje btsun kun rgyal las lo bcus bgres brgyad cu rtsa gsum bzhugs/ mkhang pa dge bzang sa ༵ /nga ā nan+da pa las lo nyer gsum gyis

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//bgres te re gcig bzhugs/ mnyam med dpa'/ldan sna ga11nga lcags pho stag lo pa rje kun rgyal las so brgyad kyis gzhon/ lo zhe gsum bzhugs 'dug go / 'das lo nas sum stong lnga brgya dang nyi shu 'das pa'i nyer gcig pa sa pho 'brug (spyi lo 1588)la/ mus stod gling skyar mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan byon/ dgung lo dgu pa la/ dbang 'od pas mkhan po mdzad de rab tu byung / bco lnga par gle lung mkhan po kun smon dang / zur chos pa byang seng gnyis la phar phyin spyod 'jug sogs sbyangs/ bco brgyad pa la bshad ston mdzad/ nyi shu pa la nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la gcod khrid gsan/ nyer gcig pa la ngam rings su/ blo gros rgyal mtshan pa dang / sang lo pa'i drung du phar phyin sogs sbyangs/ lo gsum nas der grwa skor mdzad/ nyer bzhi pa la lhor/ mkhas mchog thugs rje dpal ba'i drung du phar phyin gyi dka' gnad la dpyad sa skyar grwa skor mdzad/ nyer lnga pa la shes dkar du mkhas pa g.yag pa dang mjal/lho'i nags 'dabs khu lung du zla ba gnyis/ ngam rings su zla ba gnyis/ tsha snar zla ba gnyis te zla ba drug bsten phar phyin gyi gnad zab mo nyams su myong /nyer bdun pa la g.yag pa mkha' spyod du bzhud/ nyer brgyad pa la mu gu lung du sems dpa' chen po gzhen nu rgyal mchog gnyis lo bdun bsten/ tshad ma 'u yug pa'i rigs mdzod chen po sogs la sbyangs/ so gnyis pa la ngam rings su chos rje rong chen pa la phar tshad kyi gnad zab mo gsan/ so bzhi pa la byang du bka' lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab la dbu ma red mda' pa'i lugs gsan/so lnga pa stag lor lha sar skor ba 'bu/ 7rdor mdzad/ yar lam nub chos lung du

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()gangs chen ku dga' dpal las bsnyen par rdzogs/ so brgyad pa 'brug lo dpal ldan sa skyar/ rje ngor pa'i drung du bde dgyes kyi lam zab mo gsan thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ so dgu pa sprul lor theg chen chos rje gshegs/der dpon slob kyis brtag gnyis bshad pa dang sbyor drug gi gnad zab mo lanyams len mdzad/ bzhi bcu rta lor dpal ldan sa skya der gsung ngag rin po che'i zab don nyams su myong / slar yang zhe gnyis pa sa spre lo nas zla ba bdun du gsung ngag rin po che'i zab mthil phyin par gsan/ zhe gnyis pa sa mo bya nas ngor dgon gsar 'debs pa'i mkhar las dang / zab don nyams len zung 'jug tu mdzad cing / rje 'dis de'i tshe brtag gnyis rnam bshad kyi dga' ston legs par skyed / de nas bzung ste rje 'di'i re brgyad dang / rje ngor chen don bzhi bzhes pa'i bar ngor dang mus su byon res kyis/ rgyud man ngag gi bstan pa'i me ro sor chud par mdzad/ zhe dgu pa 'brug lor lha gong du kye rdo rje'i bsnyen pa zla ba bcu gsum du 'bum phrag bcu gnyig gnang / nga dgu pa stag lor/ rje ngor pa nub chos lung du phebs/ rje 'di la/ngor du lam 'brasa'adus pa'i tshogs la bdag med ma'i dbang bka' dang 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rten 'brel zab mo sgrigs shig gsung ba ltar rten 'brel bsgrigs/ rje 'di'i re dgu pa/ rje ngor chen don lnga pa me pho byi lo sa ga zla ba'i nyer bzhi la ngor gyi gdan seng ge'i khri la 'khod/ lo de la rje rdo rje 'chang dag pa'i dbyingasasu gshegs/ de nas byi glang stag gsum 'dzin skyong gi khur bzhes gnang / don gnyis pa stag lo rin spungs nor bza~X ༵ bde mchog sogs kyi dbang gnang /

ba na rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//yar lam mus su ya ma'i dgon pa btab/ don gsum pa 'brug lor mus bstan 'dzin phug tu bde mchog gi bsnyen pa gnang / ston ta'i si tu rnam rgyal grags pa yab sras la bde kyes kyi dbang gnang / don bzhi pa sbrul lor ngam rings su 'dus tshogs la gsung ngag dang blo sbyong sogs kyi dga' ston gnang /don lnga pa rta lor rje sher rgyam pa ngor gyi gdan khrir bzhag don bdun pa spel lor bstan 'dzin phug tu bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrubs/ 'od gsal chen po'i ngang du rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhal gzigs/ brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa smin drug zla ba'i tshes brgyad la mus bstan 'dzin phug tu dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ bstan 'dzin gyi bu slob bgrang bar mi bzod kyang / gsung ngag blo bshad kyi bka' babs ni bdag chen rdo rje 'chang ma ti hā: shrī bha dra kho na'o/ /sum stong lnga brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gsum 'das pa'i rtsa bzhi pa lcags mo lug (spyi lo 1391)thamasacad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub dpal ldan sa skya'i gung ru ba zhes pa'i 'brog gnas su byon/ 'brog ma tshugs par kha yul chags te rdzi bo sogs kyang mdzad/lo bco lnga pa la dpal ldan snar thang gi gdan sa bcu bzhi pa grub pa shes rab las rab tu byung ste/ thos bsam gyi gzhi btsugs/ nyi shu pa la snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du grub pa shes rab de nyid las bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyer lnga pa shing mo lug lor dbus la byon te/ khra 'brug tu sems dpa' chen po kun bzang la dbu tshad/ thang po cher rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan la phar phyin gsan/bkra shis rdo khar rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po dang mjal te/ grangs nges rnam 'byed sogs gsan/ gsang phur she zhung la phar tshad sogs gsan/ gro sar

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen dang rgya mtsho rin chen gnyis la 'dul ba gsan te / me pho rta'i bar lo bcu gnyis dbus su bzhugs/ me pho rta la gtsang la byon/byang chen sogs su 'chad nyan mdzad/ bzhi bcu pa lcags pho khyi la 'jug pa'irnam bshad mdzad/ zhe gcig phag lo la stod lho shel dkar sogs su chosadabyar bteg mkhas grub sangs rgyas dpal dang bgro gleng mdzad/ pad+ma chosasdings su bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal la sgrol ma'i dbang sogs gsan/ zhe gsum pa chu mo glang la rtsa she'i rnam bshad mdzad/ nyid kyis lnga bcu rtsa bdun pame mo yos la bkra shis lhun po'i chos grwa chen po btabs te/ 'chad rtsod rtsoyogasum gyis bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad/ brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa shing pho rta lo tshes brgyad la zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs so/ /sum stong lnga brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa drug 'das pa'i nga bdun pa shing pho 'brug (spyi lo 1424)lor mtshubs med rdo rje rgyas mtshan chag skyar skya'i phu'i 'brog gseb tu byon/ theg chen chos rje don drug bzhes pa'i lo de yin/ 'di nyid byams chen rab 'byams pa las lo bcu gsum gyis gzhen/ paṇa shāka pa las bzhi dang / kun mkhyen go rams las lo lngas bgres/ zla ba gnyis nasamanga' ris gung thang du spyan drangs/ lo brgyad pa la glang 'khor ba mañdzu shrī lasarab byung mdzad/ dgu pa la/ sha ra pa'i dngos slob kun smon mdzes pa'i dpalagyis btab pa'i dgon pa mus srad kyi gdan seng ge'i khri la zhabs bsten/ lo gsum gyi bar du chos rje yon tan mgon po las rta mgrin yang gsang sogs gsan/ bcu gcig pa shing pho stag //4/ gung thang gi chos grar/ bla chen chos

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam ra bdakar zhes byab bzhugs so//dpal bzang po lo re bzhi bzhes pa'i tshe zhabs pad bsten/ lo drug gi bar du rgyud gsum gyi gsan sbyong sogs dpal ldan sa skya'i gsung rab dri ma med pa thugs la smin/ lo bco brgyad pa lcags mo bya lor/ dpal ngam rings kyi chos grwar rdo rje 'chang ā nan+da ma ti lo bdun cu pa zhig dang / mnyam med dpal ldan chos skyong gi lo so gnyis pa zhig gi zhabs la gtugs te/ ā nan+da pa las/ lo nag dril gsum/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs/ phag mo skor gsum/ chos skyong gi man ngag sogs dang / bdag chen dpal chos drung du rgyud gsum las byung ba'i dbang bka' bcu bdun sogs dang / bde kye kyi bka' du ma gsan/ bcu dgu pa la sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pas mkhan po dang / nam mkha' lhun bzang pas slob dpon mdzad de/ bsnyen par rdzogs zer/ nyer gcig pa la gung thang gi dpal ri 'dabs kyi dgon par sems dpa' chen po rgyal mtshan dkon mchog lo nga bdun pa zhig gi drung du/ gsung ngag lam skor dang bcas pa dang / gsang 'dus mi bskyod lugs kyi dbang bka' 'gos lugs dang/ bshad bka' bo dong lugs dang / nag khrid dmar khrid sogs nod/ bzhi bcu pa la gung thang gi chos grwar shākya bha dra lo gya brgyad pa zhig la/dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dbang bshad man ngag mang du nod/ zhe lnga pa la mus srad kyi bstan 'dzin gling du rin chen chos sde legs pa lo don gnyis lon pa zhig la / gur sam sbyong rgyud sogs kyi dbang bshad man ngag mang du gsan/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / bde chen rnam rgyal grags bzang la dus 'khor dbang sogs gsan/ zhe dgu pa la da/sdu ldan sa skyar gdan phebs/ thog mar

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()sa skya sman grong du/ zhi khro sogs rnying ma'i chos 'khor mang du bskor/ de nas nyi thog dang zhe dgon sogs su bzhugs/ de nas grang mo che pa'i brgya dpon chosarje kun bsam pas/ bla ma mnyam med pa dang / chos rje gzungs pa nas brgyud pa'i chos rgyud dri ma med pa bzhugs par dgongs nas bla brang che mor spyan drangasagadan phab ste/ dgung lo lnga bcu pa nas zhi bar gshegs kyi bar gnas de nyid du zab don nyams bzhes dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad/ de yang rtsom ni rgyud man ngag lag len/ spyi 'gro gsal byed de gsal byed rnam bzhi/ bla ma 'phags pa/ bla ma dam pa/ phyag len/bka' sgrub ste sgrub pa rnam bzhi/ bir srungs 'khrul sel sogs 'khrul sel rnam bzhi dang / chu rgyun rnam bzhi sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad/ thugasasras bstan 'dzin byon tshul yang / snga tshar la gnag tshar ba/ ba 'brog rdor gling gi gdan sa ba 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje blo gros rgyalamatshan/ rje nyid kyi gcung rtogs ldan blo gros bzang po/ de nyid kyi sku zhang dka' bcu pa dkon mchog bzang po/ chen po rin chen rgyal mtshan/ de nyid kyi dbon po si ra ba nam mkha' rin chen dang drug bar tshar la/ byang pa bdag chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mi lhag chos grags/ 'dzim bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ grang mo che'i mkhan po kun bsam/ bo dong bka' bcu pa chos rin/ jo nang pa chos skyong / shangs pa kun dga' dpal ldan dang bdun/ phyi tshar la/bdag chen rgya gar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bdag po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje rin po che byams pa dkon ༵/ga dpal/ 'dzim pa kun dga' snying

bstan rtsi gsal ba'i nyid byed lag bas mar ba dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//po / nyid kyi dbon po kun rin/ grang mo che'i gdan sab nam mkha' dpal/sdom btson shes rab rin chen/ rab 'byams pa lha dbang / rgyud man ngag gnyi ka tshar ba'i sa dkar ba/ mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po dang bston/ /rje 'di nyid rigs kyang phun sum tshogs pa gtsang gi rigs yin zhing/ snga dar gyi tshe/ rgya nag nas jo bo shākya mu yi spyan 'dren pa'i rgyad pa mi bzhi'i ya gcig gi brgyud pa yin la/ 'di rigs las byon pa yang sad mi bdun gyi gtsang de lin+t+ra rak+ṣi ta zhes bya ba dang / phyi dar gyi rtsa ba g.yo dmar gtsang gsum gyi gtsang rab gsal zhes bya ba dang / de rjes gtsang ban rdor mo zhes bya ba rnying ma'i grub thob chen po dang / de nas rnam grol ba kun rin zhes bya ba sgru 'phrul sde brgyad sogs la mnga' bsnyes pa'i mkhas grub chen po sogs mang du byon no/ /thugs dam gyi rim pa yang / tho rengs lam zab bir srungs thun mong min pa/ de nas mchod gtor rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'i lam yab la brten pa'i lam dus rgyas pa/ de nas dkar chab bzhi dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg de nas gsol ba/ de nas mchod gtor 'bring dang 'brel ba'i lam dus 'bring po/ de nas yum dang /gur rigs bsdus/ saṃ ṭa'i mtsho ni bya can man ngag lung la brten pa'i lam dus rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ de nas gung tshims/ de nas zab chos 'chad pa dang rtsom pa sogs mdzad/ de nas mchod gtor rgyas pa dang lam dus rgyas pa/ sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi nyams bzhes sogs mdzad do/ /mdor na rang gzhan gyi don mthar phyin te don lnga pa nyer bzhi la dag pa'i dbyings su dpal ldan sa skya'i grang mo che de nyid du gshegs so/ /su/ /nga lnga brgya dang zhe gsum 'das pa'i

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya' chos 'byung gces bsdus/()zhe bzhi pa lcags mo yos spyo lo 4 lor/bsnyan pa'i gas / byed bya ya chen rab 'byams pa rong gi snar rdo spe spyo par byon/lo bdun pa la chosa'akhor snang du seng ge rgyal mtshan las rab tu byung /bcu gsum pa la gsang phu ne'u thog tu phyag phebs/shangs ston rin chen grub pa la gsan pa mdzad cing /bcu bzhi pa la mngon dga'i chos grwar dka' ba'i grwa skor gnang bas skyog po dka' bzhi par grags/bco brgyad par rtse thang mnyam sogs su dka' bcu'i grwa skor gnang zhing /gsang phu'i chos lung spyi khang bzhugs sa mdzad pas chosalung dka' bcu pa zhes grags/bcu dgu pa la mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi grwa sar phyag phebs/lo bcu bzhugs te/nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa la po ti bzhi bcu rtsalngas thog drangs pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams la/dpal ldan sa skyar bshad pa'i dga' ston spel bas byams chen rab 'byams pa zhes grags/gzhan yang rong ston smra ba'i seng ge sems dpa' 'a po gawo nu rgyal ma rong chung sher dpal sogs la mdo phyogs kyi gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/e waṃ chos ldan du rdo rje 'chang gis mkhan po/rje 'khor lo sdom pas las gsang /mkhas pa gzhon seng gis dus go bar mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/mkhan slob gnyisalas gsung ngag rin po ches gtsos pa'i bde dgyes gsang gsum gyi rgyud man ngag gi bas ོ po blangs/de nas 'di ltar dgongs te/dben pa'i bdud rtsis nyin mtshan 'da' ba rje mi la lta bu'am/'dus pa'i tshogs la rna ba'i bdud rtsis nyin mtshan 'da' ba rje blo ldan shes rab lta bu gang yang rung ba'i rnam thar la zhugs par bya yi/gzhan ni bdag gi ༵ ma yin no//'on kyang de gnyis gang

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//zhig bstan pa la phan par lung bstan du gsol zhes bla ma dkon mchog dpang du gsol ba'i brtag pa mdzad pa na/ 'od gsal gyi ngang der/ rgyal gyi shrī yin zer ba'i rir/ lung gi chos po ti brag ri gtams pa pha mtha' mngon sum zhig gi brda don bsam pas 'chad pa'i sgra dbyangs bstan 'gro'i dpal du dgongs te / thog mar nā len+t+ra'i chos grwar 'dus pa'i tshogs ha cang mi mang ba zhig la 'chad pa'i bdud rtsi spel/ slar sum cu rtsa brgyad pa 'brug gi lo la kha reg bod 'brug tu bstan pa'i gzhi btsugs/ 'chad nyan 'brug gi sgra ltar mtho bas/rong ston chen po'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi las/ 'brug gsum 'dzoms pas gangs can 'dir snyan grags kyis khyab par 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ slar nyid kyi so dgu pa sa mo sprul gyi zla ba dang po la 'dus pa'i tshogs brgya phrag gnyis dang bcas sa yi bdag po rin spungs nor bu bzang pos mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te 'bras yul skyed tshal du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar byas pa yin no/ /mdor na/ lo bco brgyad pa nas don lnga'i bar bstan pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod kho nas dus 'da' bar byas/ lo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad du 'chad pa'i rgyun bsrings pa yin no/ /zhes grags te/ mthar don lnga pa shing mo sprul sgron zla ba'i tshes gcig la gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog bstan 'dzin chen po bgrang bar mi bzod cing / skyed tshal nyid las mched pa'i grwa sa chen po yang thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling de las mched pa yangs pa can dang gnyis/ mnyan yod bya gzhongs dang / chos 'khor lhun po/ gzha' ri dgon gsar ba rtsa ba nyid dang grwa sa chen po 3 7 9 po 'di nyid kyis kyang 'dzam gling 'di

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()mdzes par byas pa ma yin nam/ bstan 'dzin gyi thugs sras mkhas grub bstan gsal/ rtse thang sangs lhun/ go bo rab 'byams pa/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/byams pa chos don grub/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang sogs so//des na shing pho byi lo 'di byams chen rab 'byams pa byon pa'i lcags mo yosanas brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa yin no/ /sum stong lnga brgya dang drug cu 'dasapa'i re gcig pa sa pho sprel (spyi lo 1428)lor paṇa chen shākya ma ro ba ldan gsang phu'i bar tshigs zhes par byon/ lo brgyad pa'i tshe rong ston chen po skyor mo lung du byon pa'i zhabs phyir bar ma rab tu byung ba'i mtshan shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blor gsol/ bcu pa la nā len+t+ra ra dge tshul du bsgrubs shing /de nas nyer gcig gi bar rong ston chen po'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi nyams su myong zhing / rgyan drug mchog gi gzhung la sbyangs/ nyer lnga'i tshe ngor du ngor chen/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ mus chen gsum gyis mkhan po dang las gsang mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob de gsum/ lcang lung pa gzhen nu blo gros/ paṇa chen nags rin sogs las/ gsung ngag sbyor drug sogs zab rgyasakyi chos tshul nod/ lo bco lnga pa la gsang phu'i gnas sgo grwa tshang gi 'dzin bdag gnang / bshad pa'i dga' ston dang / go sgra las drangs pa'i gnas bstod dang nga brgyad ma sogs mdzad/ rig gnas lnga la snyan pa'i grags pas khyab/ nyid kyi zhe gnyis pa sa mo glang la paṇa chen don yod dpal ba'i bkas bskul te/gser mdog can du 'dus tshogs brgya phrag bsnyen la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa spel te/ dgun chos la sdu/na pa gong 'og dpyid chos la dbu ma/

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dbyar chos la 'dul ba gtso bor 'doms par mdzad/ mnga' ris su chos rgyal bkra shis mgon gyis dpon slob sum brgya tsam spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ kun mkhyen rdzong dkar ba sdom rigs la 'chad pa'i dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i snyan pas mtshams sbyar te/ sdom pa gsum la dka' gnad dpyod pa'i dri ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa mdzad/ shar lam byang ngam rings su 'dus pa'i tsho gos kyi bsu ba bsnyen bkur sogs mdzad/ chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags pa la dus 'khor gyi dbang sogs gsan/ slar gser mdog can du dri lan gser gyi thur ma mdzad/ lar ༷di'i rdo lan gyi bstaX bcos bcu phrag gcig gi sgo nas kyang bstan pa dkar par bzlo/ ༵ ༷/lha /ce/ phra/ga bzhi la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ blo brtan bzhi pa dang de'i nye gnas blo ldan pa'i drung du ka tsan snyan ngag sogs sbyangs shing /yongs rdzogs paṇ+ḍi ta chen por gyur/ spyir rig gnas lnga dang / khyad par sgra rig dang / nang rig gi snying po/ bka' bar mtha' dang / lugs gnyis kyi srol las byung ba'i rang stong gzhan stong gi lta ba'i gnad zab mo la 'di kho na bka' drin che ba yin/ zha lu mkhyen rab chos rjes 'od gsal gyi ngang las bstan 'dzin chen po rnams la gzigs pa stsal bas/ byams chen rab 'byam bas pa/ mtshan dus sgron me 'bar te phyogs bzhir po ti bkram ste gzigs rtogs gnang zhing mtha' bram gzugs kyis bskor ba zhig gzigs/ paṇa chen 'di ni sku'i ngo bo mi snang zhing / steng gi nam mkha' la gser gyi rdo rje gzi 'od 'bar ba dang /gtor ma la me 'od 'bar ba 3 8 pya de yang / lta ba zab mo mnga' ba'i

'tshe chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gu pa gces bsdus/()mtshon byed do zhes grags so/ /mnga' ris 'khor 'phral 'du khang rnying pa dang /phyis gsar pa/ mgon khang / gos sku sogs bzhengs shing / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang che hor shākya dang / sgar pa don yod rdo rje dang / seng ge rtse ba 'phags pa rab brtan sogs kyis mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar bar mdzad cing zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs/ rtsom pa yang / tshad ma'i dka' 'grel spyi don che chung gnyis/ /rnam rigs ṭīka chen gnyis te rnam pa lnga/ /gong ma'i dka' 'grel 'og ma'i spyi don che/ /phar phyin ṭī ka lung snying spyi don gsum/ /rtsa 'jug ṭī ka stong thun chen mo gsum/ /'dul ba'i dka' 'grel las brgya'i ṭī ka dang / /sothar ṭī ka gzhi gsum las chog sogs/ /bde gsang rnam bshad gser thur chos tshan sogs/ /rtsom pa'i rnam grangs brjod par mi nus so/ /de ltar mdzad pa mthar phyin te dgung lo brgyad cu pa me mo yos gro zhun zla ba'i tshes lnga la gshegs so/ /thugs sras bstan pa 'dzin pa ni/ de dus grwa tshang go bzhi nasa'achad nyan gnang ba'i shangs chen pa/ lcang ra ba/ rdor rgyal ba/ blo bzang sogs bgrang bar mi lang ba byon no/ /des na shing pho byi lo 'di paṇa shāka pa byon pa'i sa spre nas brgya dang so bdun pa lags so/ /sum stong lnga brgya dang re gcig 'das pa'i re gnyis pa sa mo bya (spyi lo 1429)la mdo khams su go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams nga ge byon/ ngor dgon gsar btab pa'i lo de yin/ paṇa shāka pa las lo gcig gis gzhen/ lo bcu pa la byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' 'bum las rab tu byung / de nas bcu dgu bzhes pa'i bar du mkhan po de dang / go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal la sogs382

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bsten te/ gzhus lugs gsum gyis lhag pa'i bcu phrag gcig mgrin pa'i lam du rgyu zhing 'byin par mdzad de/ go bo rab 'byams pa zhes snga mo nyid nasarang byon du grags/ nyi shu pa sa pho 'brug lor/ go rams sher dpal gyis/rab 'byams la sogs bshes gnyen brgya rtsa gcig /ces brgya 'bul gyi rnam grangs su mang du bkod pa'i dkyus kyi gtso bor byas te/ rong ston smra ba'i seng ge dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis lon pa/ chos grwa nā len+d+ra thebs nas lo bcu gsum lon pa de nyid la rong ston chen po'i gsung gi brgyad myangs te lo gnyis lon pa sbrul gyi lo la rong ston chen po dag pa'i zhing du bzhud pa nas/ lo de nyid la chos grwa chen po 'bras yul gsar tshugs kyi dga' ston gsar pa la longs su spyod pa'i tshe byams chen rab 'byams rje'i zhabs kyi pa blor gtugs/lo ngo lnga la mdo phyogs kyi gnad ma lus pa la sgro 'dogs bcad/ rang lo nyer lnga pa chu mo bya'i lor/ e waṃ chos ldan du rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs pad bsnyen/ nyer drug pa shing pho khyi lor rje sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sdom brtson sangs rgyas dpal bzang po rnams kyis mkhan po dang las gsang mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ mdor na bya lo nas me pho byi lo ngor chen zhi bar gshegs kyi bar lo ngo bzhi la/ gsung ngag sogs rgyud man ngag gsan/ byi lor ngor chen zhi bar gshegs na'ang / mus chen sogs mkhasapa du ma la/ gsung ngag sogs rgyud man ngag gi zab bcud blangs te lo ngo brgyad la rgyud man ngag gi sgro 'dogs bcad/ rang lo so gnyis pa lcags pho 'brug lor mdo khams phyogs su go/8 sbyang 'phos te 'bras yul nyid du phyag

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()phebs pa na/ rab 'byams chos rje'i thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung ste/ jogasum pa sprul lo nas sprel lo'i bar lo bzhi tsam zhig 'bras yul nyid du zur 'chad pa'i dbyangs kyi blo ldan rnams yid gsos par byas/ kye rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen dang / sdom gsum gyi ṭī ke yum ston rab gsal sogs rtsom pa'i sgo yang phye / slar mus chen nyid kyi thugs rje'i zhags pas drangs te/ mus su byon/ bya lor zab chos gsan pa dang / gsang 'dus rtsod spong sogs mdzad/ so brgyad pa khyi lo rje mus chen chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags bzang gis/ byang ngam rings su spyan drangs te zhabs 'bring du bkod do/ /blo gsal 'ga' la legs bshad kyi skyes dang / kun rig rtsod spong / kye rdor rtsod spong sogs rtsom gyi me tog kha phye/me pho khyi lo de nyid kyi rgyal zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la blo gsal don gnyer can bcu phrag bzhi dang bcas/ rin spungs nang so don grub rdo rje dpon slob kyis mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te rta nag gser gling du chos kyi grwa btsugs/ khyi lo de nas sprul lo'i bar lo brgyad kyi ring la ha cang blo gsal mang ba min pa'i don gnyer can sha stag la 'chad pa'i dbyangs kyis ngal gsos/ nyid kyi zhe lnga pa chu mo sprul gyi lo de nyid la/ thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling chen po btab/ 'dus pa'i tshogs chen po la mdo sngags kyi dga' ston ngo mtshar med du byung bas spyir bstan pa'i snying po/ khyad par sdom rigs kyi bstan pa me med pa sor chud/ nyid lnga bcu rtsa lnga pa chu mo yos la e waṃ chos ldan gyi seng ge'i khri la zhabs sen bkod de/ me pho rta'i bar lo bzhir rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi dgongs pa rdzogasapar mdzad/ rta lo de la yongs 'dzin 3)spyan mchog 'phel rgyal tshab tu dbang

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes byab bzhugs so// bskur te/ slar yang rnam par rgyal ba'i gling chen por phyag phebs/ skal ldan rnams la mdo sngags kyi bka' drin stsal/ slar re gcig sa mo bya'i lo/ dpal ldan sa skyar chos kyi dga' ston spel/ tshur lam sngon mo rdzong du chos kyi dga' ston rtsol ba'i tshe cho 'brul zla ba'i nyer gcig la zhi bar gshegs so/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i slob bu yang / kong ston dbang phyug grub pa/ mus rab 'byams pa thugs rje dpal bzang po/ bka' bcu smra ba bsod nam rgya mtsho sogs bgrang bar mi bzod pa byon/ des na shing byi 'di paṇa chen 'di byon pa'i sa mo bya nas brgya dang so drug pa yin no/ /sum stong lnga brgya dang re lnga 'das pa'i re drug pa chu mo glang (spyi lo 1433)la/ rgyal ba 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang gnyis byon/ 'di paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan las lo lnga dang / kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa las lo bzhis gzhen pa tsam mo/ /de yang rje paṇa chen g.yas ru byang gi sa'i theg le/ 'jam gsar lha sdings zhes grags pa'i 'dabs khang dmar brag khung du byon/ lo bdun pa'i tshe chos rgyal dkon mchog legs pas byams chen 'dzam gling rgyan gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa bzhengs byams phrug bdun brgya gsar du bsdus pa'i skabs su/sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog gis mkhan po mdzad nas rab tu byung / mdog chos 'khor sgang du paṇa chen sangs rgyas seng ge byang sems blo gros rin chen/ dol phyug chos bzang rnams las gzhung lugs chen po la gsan pa btsal/ dpal ldan sa skyar bka' bcu'i bshad pa leg bas par stsal/ e lta chos ldan nas 'khyud de/ 'bras yul /bye tshal du kun mkhyen byams chen rab

ra tshe chen 'od snang la /ga skya'i cho4'gung gces bsdus/()'byams pa'i zhabs pad bsten/ rje 'di dang / rtse thang sangs lhun/ zha lu bka' bcu pa gsum la 'bum 'dzin pa'i bka' gnang phebs/ rje 'dis zla ba gcig la thugs su smin/ tshig don gyi bshad pas/ kun mkhyen chos rje 'dusatshogs dang bcas pa legs bshad bdud rtsi'i mchod pas mnyes te/ 'bum phrag gsum pa zhes mtshan gyi shis brjod snyan pa'i glu dbyangs su zlos/ sgra pa shes rin dang / shangs pa kun dga' dpal ldan la sgra ka tsan sogs rig gnas che chung la sbyangs pas paṇ+ḍi ta zhes snyan par grags/ sum cu pa rta lo/kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa zur 'chad pa'i skabs su byams chen chos rjes mkhan po/ go rams chen pos las slob/ zha lu bka' bcu pas dus go ba mdzad de/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje sogs mang zhig dang mnyam du bsnyen par rdzogs/ rta lo de nyid kyi dbyar chos la/ rtse thang sogs su gzhung lugs drug cu'i bshad pa'i dga' ston spel/ so gcig pa lug lo dgun chos la dpal ngam rings su sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa la bshad pa'i srol chen po btod/lug lor dbyar chos lho shel dkar du bshad pa'i chos sbyin rgyas par bstsal/so gnyis pa sprel lor glo bo smon thang gi chos sder 'bum gyis gtsos pa'i gzhung lugs brgya la mkhas pa'i dga' ston bsgrubs/ chos rgyal a mgon drung du/gdan du 'os pa'i mtha' can dang / 'bol grub dang / sum stan mnyel 'bol gyi khri la rim bzhin 'bum gyi glegs bam ka pa/ kha pa/ ga nga gnyis rnams mgrin pa'i dpal nas bkod pas/ rgyal blon 'bangs bcas ngo mtshar gyi dpal la bkod pos/ po ti lnga pa 3 8 /da gsung nas sgrogs pa dang / rgyal

bsnan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas rma ra bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//blon gyis thog drangs blon po lung gang gi skal ldan rnams la 'bum gyi lung bshad pa'i dga' ston phyogs gcig tu gnang bas/ rgyal blon kun gyis zhabasasen spyi bor blangs shing 'dod rgu'i mchod pa rgya cher phul/ so gsum pa bya lor shar lam mus chen drung du zab don gyi bdud rtsi zhus shing / skyed mos tshal du byams chen rab 'byams pa 'dus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ bsnyen cing bkur bas dges par mchod/ kun mkhyen go rams pas zur 'chad ma gnang nas lo gcig song ba/ nyid kyi so bzhi pa khyi lo/ 'jam dbyangs rje dang gnyisal zur 'chad legs bshad spel ba'i 'os su bka' bstsal/ lo bcu gsum gyi bar du blo gsal don gnyer nyis brgya skor la legs bshad kyis yid gsos par mdzad/ zhe bdun pa phag lor mi dge ba'i rkyen grogs su shar te/ blo gsal shes ldan brgya phrag gnyis dang bcas/ bsod nams kyi dpal la dbang sgyur ba'i sde dpon so sos mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te/ gnas nges med du legasapar bshad pa'i char phab/ de yang yul dbus kyi sman ljongs su shar te phag byi glang gsum/ gtsang chu gru gsum du stag yos 'brug gsum/ yar 'brog tu sprul lo / rkyang 'dur du rta lo/ nor bu sgang rgyang gdong sogs su lug sprel gnyis te/lo bas bar du gnas nges med du 'chad pa'i zlos gar ci yang bsgyur to//nyid kyi lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa sa mo bya'i lor/ gtsang stod bsod rgyal gyis mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bzang po la dpal mnyan yod bya rgod gzhongs kyi chos grwa chen po btab/ kun mkhyen go rams chen po gshegs pa'i lo de yin/ de'i phyi lo nyid kyisang di/da pa khyi lor 'phags mchog klu sgrub

ba chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur te/ lo bcu gsum du 'phags mchog rjes 'chad pa'i rgyun bzung shing paṇa chen chos rje gnas nges med du skal ba 'tsham par zab mo sngags kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ nyid kyi bdun cu pa chu pho khyi lor 'phagasamachog dag pa'i dbyings su gshegs te/ slar nyid kyis mnyan yod du sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor/ phyi lo de la mnyan yod du bdag cag gi ston pa 'khor gnas brtan gyis bskor ba dri'i gtsang khang dang bcas pa bzhengs/ don gcig pa phag lor rab gnas kyis mnga' gsol/ nyid kyis don gnyis su sleb pa/mnyan yod thebs nas lo bcu drug pa shing pho byi lo dpyid zla ra ba'i nyer gcig la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ rje 'di nyid kyis mdo sngags kyi chos gsan pa'i tshul yang rje ngor chen yab sras la sa skya ngor lugs/ bdag chen rgya gar ba dang rnal 'byor pa bstan 'dzin dpal sogs la sa skya rdzong lugs/ bshes gnyen blo gros rgyal mtshan la rje btsun bo dong pa'i de nyid 'dus pa/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa la dwags po bka' brgyud dang ras chung snyan brgyud sogs/mkhyen rab yon tan dpal byung la shangs pa dka' brgyud dang ri chos/ ka tog nor bu bzang po la rdzogs pa 'a po'i skor sogs/ rnal 'gror rdo rje'i mtshan can la zhi byed sogs te/ ji ltar gsan pa de dag kyang gnas nges med du legs par sgoms pas dus 'das pa kho na lags shing / bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad/ khyad par rigs pa'i gnad zab mos blo gsal la nges pa bde blag tu skye ba la paṇa chen 'di'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun kho na bka' drin che ba yin no/ /thugs sras ba//8 'dzin gyi bu slob kyang / thugs sras

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lag bas mar bdakar zhes rgyab bzhugs so// 'phags mchog klu sgrub/ ar ston/ blo gros rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen lcags thang chos rje/ rgyal ba dkon mchog dpal ba/ lho byang gi lha dbang rnam gnyis/'jam mgon blo gros bkra shis sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang ni/ chu mo glang de nyid la glo bo 'brog gseb tu byon/ bcu pa la brag dkar grags rgyal ba la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nod/bco brgyad pa la slo bo bdag pos sa skyar grwa bskor dang dbus gtsang du slob gnyer ba brgya phrag gsum tsam rdzong brda gnang ba'i skabs su/ dpal ldan sa skyar blo gros ga sto nu'i bzhad gsar dang / ngor du rdze btsun rdo rje 'chang dang mjal/ bcu dgu pa la e waṃ chos ldan de nyid du/ rdo rje 'chang gis mkhan po/brag dkar sems dpa' chen po kha char ba zhes grags pas slob dpon/ gcung gzhen nu seng ges dus go ba mdzad de rab tu byung / bcu dgu pa lug gi lo'i ston chos grwa chen po 'bras yul du phebs/ byams chen rab 'byams pa dang mjal/ nyid kyi nyi shur son zhing / rje byams chen chos rje'i zhe gnyis pa skyed tshal thebs nas lo bzhir sleb pa'i lcags pho sprel lo nas byams chen rab 'byams pa lus dang grib ma ltar bsten cing / gsung gi bdud rtsi mdo sngags kyi zab bcud la tshims par rol/ sum cu pa la byams chen rab 'byams chos rje dang / go rams chos rje mkhan slob las bsnyen par rdzogs/ so bzhi pa khyi lo nas/ paṇa chen 'bum pa gnyis kyi zur 'chad mdzad/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du rgyas par mdzad/ nyid kyi nga gsum pa shing mo sprul lo byams chen rab 'byams pa dag pas byed du gshegs/ lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa me

'tshe chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/() pho rta lo nas skyed mos tshal gyi gdan seng ge'i khri la zhabs sen bkod pa'i sgo nas don gcig bzhes kyi bar du mdo sngags kyi bstan pa bskyangs/ don gcig pa chu mo phag gi zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gcig la zhi bar gshegs/ thugs sras bstan 'dzin mang du byon yang / bstan pa la phan pa'i bshes gnyen pa nyid kyi gdan sa ba nyid dang / chos 'khor lhun po 'debs pa po paṇa chen dngosagrub dpal 'bar dang / gzha' ri dgon gsar 'debs pa po lha dbang blo grosarnams so/ /des na shing byi 'di/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang dang gnyis byon pa'i chu glang nas brgya dang so bzhi pa lags so/ /sum stong drug brgya pa'i skabs su byon pa ni rgyal ba lcags thang pa chen po la sogs te sum stong drug brgya dang drug 'das pa'i bdun pa shing pho rta (spyi lo1474)lor gtsang lcags thang rab 'byams pa byams pa bso de na mang byon/ bcu gcig pa la yul de'i sangs rgyas gling zhes bya bar bsod nams legs pa dang / 'chad dka' bcu pas mkhan slob byas te rab tu byung / bcu gcig pa de nyid nas bco brgyad kyi bar la mdog chos 'khor snang du bshes gnyen shākya rgyal mtshan dang blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis la rig pa'i rnam 'gyur legs par sbyangs/ bcu dgu par mnyan yod bya rgod gshongasathebs nas lo bzhi lon pa'i tshe chos grwa de nyid du/ 'jam dbyangs 'phags mchog klu sgrub la grangs chen bco brgyad kyi legs bshad dang / gsung ngag sogs sngags kyi zab gnad lo grangs brgyad kyi bar du gsan/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa la gsung ngag shangs3 30 bka' brgyud/ ras chung snyan brgyud

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sogs zab khrid kyi bcud chen po blangs/ nyer lnga pa la dpal 'khor bde chen dang / nyer drug pa la rtsed thang du gzhud lugs bcu drug gam bcu bdun la legs bshad kyi skyes phul/ nyer dgu pa la/ mdog ya ga chos sdings su/byams pa dkon mchog dpal gyis mkhan po/ lu phu gdan sa pa dbon brtson 'grus rgya mtshos las slob/ mtshungs med chos rje dpal 'byor bas gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ mdor na dgung lo nyer gcig pa nas/ sum cu'i bar blo gsal don gnyer mang po la sgos su legs bshad ci yod ngoms/ so gcig nas lo lnga'i bar gyi gnas bskos pa'i zur 'chad gnang / so drug nas lo gsum/ gsang phu ba chos grags kyis mkhan po/ rje 'dis slob dpon mdzad/ so dgu pa chu pho sprel lo dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol te/ de nas dgung lo re bzhi bzhes kyi bar lo grangs nyi shu rtsa drug tu dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i gdan seng ge'i khri la zhabs bkod de 'chad pa'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags/ mdor na/ nyer gcig pa la sgos chos gnang ba nas/ re bzhi pa la gdan sa gtad kyi bar lo kun dril bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi bar du mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan kho nas bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad/'chad pa'i skabs der yang / mtshungs med rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi dngos slob shes rab rin po che la rdzong lugs kyi gsung ngag gsan pa sogs gsan pa mang du mdzad/ re bzhi pa me mo bya lo paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis la gdan sa gtad de na bza' brag phug tu gdan phab/ re lnga pa sa pho khyi lor chos rgyal tshe dbang rdo rjes dpal ngam rings kyi mkhan por 3/ 'a gsol/ re bdun pa lcags pho byi

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ba'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i gnam gang la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ 'chad pa'i 'bras bu bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu brgya rtsa gcig byon par bshad kyang / gtso bo bsdus na/ paṇa grub bzang po bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs phyogs las rnam rgyal/skyid gshongs pa chen po blo gros rnam rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ 'dzam gling rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas lhun grub/ lnga rig bkra shisachos 'phel/ gdan gcig pa shākya rgya mtsho/ mkhas mchog grags pa bzang po/'jam mgon dpal ldan bkra shis dang brgyad do kho bo cag kyang lo bco lnga lon pa'i tshe/ kun mkhyen chen pos gdan sa paṇa grub bzang po bkra shis la gtad tsam gyi bya lo/ dpal mnyan yod kyi gtsug lag khang du/ rje nyid kyi zhabs pad bsten/ rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs kyi bka' drin bstsal te/ dges pa chen pos bskyangs shing / byin rlabs snying la sim/ming bsgyur ba'i tshe/ khyod kyi skya ming la ci zer gsungs/ klu rgyal nor bur 'bod zhus pas/ ming zur gyi klu ming de ma chad pa zhig dgos pa 'dug da khyod yon tan che ba 'dam mam/ grags pa che ba 'dam gsungs/ ci yang zhu ma spobs pa la / yon tan che ba dga' mod/ ming la 'di bzhin gyis gsung ba phebs shing brtse bas bskyangs/ mdor na 'chad pa kho nas bstan pa spel ba la/ rong ston gyi rjes su/ kun mkhyen lcags thang pa 'di nyid bka' drin lhag par che ba yin no / / sum stong drug brgya nyi shu rtsa bdun 'das pa'i rtsa brgyad pa shing mo yos (spyi lo 1495)la paṇa grub bzang po bkra shis byang phyi 'brog dol khrod du byon/yongs kyi 'dren pa lha mang lcags gsum 'chi med dbang po 'dzam gling rab 392

bsnar rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'byams te lnga la mdo sngags kyi gsan pa mdzad cing / zhe gsum pa me mo bya la mnyan yod bya gzhongs kyi khrir 'khod de/ lo ngo bdun du 'chad pa'i rgyun bsrings/ zhe dgu pa chu mo yos la dpal ngam rings kyi dbu mdzad dang / ya ga chos sdings kyi bshad grwa bskyangs/ lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa me mo lug la/ chos sde chen po'i khri chen po la zhabs brten nas lo bco brgyad du bstan pa bskyangs/bdun cu pa shing pho byi lo 'di nyid la dag pa'i zhing du phebs so/ /de ltar khro bo'i bstan rtsis 'di ni/ shing pho byi lo nas mgo brtsams te me pho stag lor rdzogs par grub pa yin no/ /'di yan gyi bstan rtsis rnams ni/ shing pho byi lo yan sor bzhag nas rtsis pa yin la/ deng sang gi me stag ni/ 'das lo nas lo grangs sum stong drug brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa sum stong bdun brgyar nyag ma gcig gis ma chog pa'i lo de yin no/ /zhes shes par mdzod cig sum stong drug brgya so bdun 'das pa'i so brgyad pa shing mo glang (spyi lo 1505)la rgyal ba skyid gshong pa blo gros rnam rgyal 'dar skyid gshongs su byon/ bco brgyad pa la mnyan yod du lcags thang chos rje'i zhabs pad bsten te mdo phyogs sbyangs/ phyis su rje blo gsal rgya mtsho dang / rje kun dga' grol mchog drung du gsung ngag sogs sngags kyi zab don blangs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la dpal 'khor bde chen dang nyer drag pa la byang ngam rings su bshad pa'i snyan grags ches cher khyab/ nyer bdun dro la dpal chos 'khor gling gi bshad grwa gzung ste lo bcur bstan pa spel/ so brgyad pa la mnyan yod kyi gdan seng ge'i khri mnan te lo brgyad du lung rigs kyis bstan pa ba/zlo / mi dbang chos rgyal yab sras mnyes

ba chen 'od snang 'a /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()par byas te/ 'tsho ba'i rten du chos gzhis bzang po zhus te mnyan yod la mthun pa'i rkyen du sbyar/ zhe brgyad pa la ngam rings chos sde'i dbu mdzad/ ya ga chosasdings kyi bshad grwa stongs bzhin par/ chos kyi rgyal po tshe dbang rdo rje yab sras kyi bkas bkug ste/ lo bdun du 'chad pa'i dbyangs snyan par zlos/ lnga bcu rtsalnga pa la gnas bzang po gnyag phur gdan phab ste zab don nyams su bzhes/drug cu rtsa gcig pa glang gi lo la/ chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen sku mched kyis dpal bam rings kyi mkhan por mnga' gsol te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin pa'o/ /mthar dgung lo gya gcig pa bya lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyi shu dgu la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ kho bo cag gis kyang bya gshongs nas nyer gnyis la zhabs drung du 'byor/ sku mnyel ba med par chos zab mo'i 'bel gtam cher mdzad/ nyer lnga'i tho rengs khyed 'chad nyan 'chag phyin pa drag gsungs/ bdag sku khams kyi tsho zin zin mi 'gro zhus pas/ sku khams kyi tshod de ring zin yong gsungs/ cung gdangs su 'gro ba yin nam snyam pa las ma byung/nyin par yang thugs dgyes pa'i 'bel gtam kho na gnang / dgong mo thugs dam mdzad rjes mnal cung zad mdzad/ de sad mtshams sku drang por bsrang sde da kho bo la gsal 'debs gyis shig gsungs/ kho bos kyang gsal 'debs 'bul lugs bgyis/ 'jigs pa'i tshab tshub mi dgos lhod kyis lhod gsungs/bum dbang gi 'da' ka ma phul bas de min gsungs/ gong ma gsum gyi 'da' ka ma'i gsal 'debs phul bas de bzhin yin gsungs/ thugs dgyes bzhin tu lta stangs mdzad de mnyam par bzha/mi lta ba spros bral la blo phyam 'gro na
