bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'da' ka ma mi thebs mi srid tshe 'di dang mthong lam gyi bar na dar tsam las med ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'da' ka ma'i ngang de nyid la sa dang po'i grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med stogs par gdon mi za ba'i nges pa rnyed pa lags so//rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grol mchog me mo yos la glo bor byon/ drug cu pa me stag zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la chos lung byang rtser gshegs/ rje blo gsal rgya mtsho shing pho stag la 'dar mang mkhar rmu ru byon/ don gsum pa me stag zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga la 'dar snang tshar ram grang mo che'i dgon par gshegs/ rje 'di gnyis gshegs pa'i me stag ni/ 'das lo nas sum stong dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa yin no/ /zhes gong du bshad pa las shes dgos/ kho bo cag gi 'dren pa 'di gsum gyi rnam par thar pa ni logs su spro bar sha chags pas 'dir ma bris so/ /'dir bstan rtsis mdzad pa po'i rnam par thar pa yang phyir logs nas 'chad do/ /zhes smra bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa dgon gnas rim par byon tshul la/ bstan pa phyi dar la/'das lo sum stong brgya dang don lnga 'das pa'i don drug pa chu mo lug (spyi lo 1043)la mang mkhar the sdo/ sdo/nga zhes grags pa lam 'bras pa'i gnas de byon/'debs pa po rje ga ya dha ra dang 'brog mi yin/ chu mo lug de nas shing pho byi lo'i bar la lnga brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis lon/ sum stong brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa sa mo gling (spyi lo 1049)la/ lnga1 dong 11na/ 'debs mkhan bshes gnyen mu ta chen po yin sa glang de nas lnga brgya dang bcu bdun lon/ sum stong brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa drug pa 3 9 rdo bdun shing pho 'brug (spyi lo 1064)la

brtse chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()lam 'bras pa'i se mkhar chung byon/ de nas lnga brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyisalon/ sum stong dang nyis brgyar sleb pa'i me mo lug (spyi lo 1067)la byang rwa sgropabyon/ 'brom ston gyi lnga bcu rtsa gcig lon tshe btab/ me lug de nas bzhi brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa brgyad lon/ 'di dus gsal ltar yin/ 'brom gyi lam yig sogs ltar na/ jo bo gshegs pa'i phyi lo me mo lug la snye thang du jo bo'i gshegs rdzong rgya cher bsgrubs/ de'i phyi lo sa pho sprel lo 'brom rang gi lnga bcu rtsa gnyis lon pa'i tshe/ rwa sgreng btab ces bya'o/ /sum stong nyis brgya dang bzhir son pa'i lcags mo phag (spyi lo 1071)la gsang phu ne'u thog gi chos sde byon/ de nas bzhi brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa bzhi/ 'debs mkhan rngog legs 'o/ /bde sngon la 'debs lo gcig ces dang /gtam gyi rol mtsho las/ lo bco lnga'i bar khyad bcos pa sog mimathun pa cung zad 'dug na'ang /'di gsug dus gsal rtsab re'u mig dang bcas pa'i lug so/ /sum stong nyis brgya dang drug tu slebs pa'i chu mo glang (spyi lo 1 73)la bod kyi rdorje gdan dpa ldan ri byon/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos bzhi bcu lon pa'i tshe btab/ chu glang de nas bzhi brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis lon/rang lugs dus gsal ltar na/ rdzo bo byon pa'i shing pho stag lor 'khon da na mchog rgyal po nyer gcig lon/jo bo me rta la gshegs pa'i lo de na lo brgyad pa chu mo glang 'khon gyis bzhi bcu par dpa la ldan sa ba7ces bya'o/ /'das lo nas sum stong nyis brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa drug chu mo bya (spyi lo 1153)la snar thang gi snar+sha sde gtum ston blo gros grags kyis btab/ de nas shing byi 'di bar la bzhi brgya dang bcu gnyis lon/ sum stong nyis brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa sa pho stag (spyi ṭ+wāṃ //58)la ye shes seng ges phag 31 shākya

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//btab/ de nas bzhi brgya dang bdun/ sum stong sum brgya dang brgyad du sleb pa shing mo lug (spyi lo 1175)la 'tshal zhang btsun grags kyis btab/ de nas sum brgya dang dgu bcu/ sum stong sum brgya bcu gnyis pa sa mo phag (spyi lo 1179)la 'bri gung byon/ 'debs mkhan 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon pos lo so bdun lon pa'i tshe'o/ /de nas sum brgya dang brgyad/ sum stong sum brgya bcu gsum pa lcags pho byi (spyi lo 1180)lor stag lung byon/ 'debs mkhan stag lung bkra shis dpal gyis sodagu lon pa'i tshe'o/ /de nas sum brgya dang bdun/ sum stong sum brgya dang dgu bcu ṣ+ka shu pa )ste mo lug (spyi lo 1187)la gung thang shad btsun grags kyis btab/ de nas sum brgya dang don brgyad/ sum stong sum brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo lug (spyi lo 1259)la zang zang ne ring byon/'debs mkhan sras bde legs rgyal mtshan yin/ de nas sum brgya dang drug lon/ sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyag ma gcig tu slebs pa sa pho 'brug (spyi lo 1268)lor sa skya'i lha khang chen mo/ 'phags pa rin po ches so bzhi bzhesapa'i tshe/ dpon chen shākya bzang pos khri skor bcu gsum bskul nas btab/ de nas nyis brgya dgu bcu rtsa bdun/ dpal ngam ring kyi chos sdo yang / sum stong bzhi rgya nyi shu kha 'dren gyi skabs su btab par sems te/ mkhan po gsum pa gangs khrod pa grags pa dpal gyis dgung lo bzhi bcu lon pa lcags mo lug lor/ si tu rdo rje mgon po dang 'dzim pa rgyal mtshan dpal gyis bkas bskul te mkhan po mdzad pa yin la/ khong gis mkhan po mdzad pa'i lo de la/grwa pa phogs len lnga bcu dang khong da//7 slob bcu ste drug cu tsam las ma byung /

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()lo gnyis nas brgya dang bcu bzhir 'phel bas brgya ston bzang po mdzad cesagangs pa'i rnam thar na bzhugs shing / khong gis mkhan po gnang ba'i lo de ni 'das lo nas sum stong bzhi brgya drug cu rtsa drug pa yin la/ de gong du yang chosasde btab nas/ mkhan rabs gnyis song ba las shes so/ /chos sde 'di nyid kyi mkhan rabs ni/ shākya seng ge nas/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros rnam rgyal gyi bar nyi shu rtsa dgu yin la/ bzang ldan chos sde yang / dpal ngam rings chos sde'i rjes tsam la byon pa yin te/ kun spangs chos grags dpal gyis bdag rkyen mdzad de/ bzang ldan/'ga' rong /chud kha chos sde gsum dus mnyam du btab cesa'abyung zhing / dka' lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab dgung lo brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe rdzong chos sde gsar du btsugs/ khong gis so gnyis pa la rdzong chos sde'i mkhan po mdzad/ so bdun pa la ngam rings chos sde'i mkhan po mdzad ces de nyid kyi rnam thar las 'byung ba gang zhig chos rje bka' lnga pa de nyid ngam rings chos sde chen po'i mkhan rabs dgu pa yin pa las shes so/ /dpal ldan bzang ldan gyi mkhan po ni/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ kun spangs chos grags dpal/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas bzang po/ rtse lnga nam mkha' ye shes/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ gzhon nu tshul khrims/ gzhon nu shes rab ste bdun kho na las gzhan ma byung ngo / /rtse thang gi chos sde lcags mo yos la btab ces deb sngon las 'byung bas/ sum stong bzhi brgya brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa lcags yos (spyi lo 1341)la ce kho thang byon/ de nas nyis brgya dang bcu bzhi lon/ 'debs mkhan ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan zhes /sdus pa/ khri skor bcu gsum la dbang

bstan rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes byab bzhugs so// bsgyur zhing sne'u brag rtog gzhis kha rin spungs/ bsam grub rtse sogs 'deb sa pa po de yin/ sum stong lnga brgya dang bcu ru son pa me mo sbrul (spyi lo 1277)la mdog zhe dgon gyi sngags dgon byon/ de nas brgya dang brgyad/ 'debasamakhan grub chen burnya shrī lnga bcu rtsa gcig bzhes pas/ rje dpal ldan tshul khrims la gsung ngag thog mar gsan pa'i tshe yin/ 'das lo nas sum stong lnga brgya bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo glang (spyi lo 1409)la 'brog ri bo dge ldan byon/ de nas brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa drug 'debs mkhan rje blo bzang grags pa lnga bcu rtsa gsum lon pa na'o/ /sum stong lnga brgya dang drug cu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo bya (spyi lo 1429)la ngor dgon gsar byon/ 'debs mkhan rdo rje 'chang gis bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad lon pa na'o/ /sa mo bya nas brgya dang so drug lon dpal lor chos sde yang sa mo bya long ste' wa dang na mnya yin zer ro/ /sum stong lnga brgya dang drug cu rtsa dgu pa me 'brug (spyi lo 1426)la nā len+d+ra byon/ de nas brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu/'debs mkhan rong ston gyis bdun cu lon pa'i tshe'o/ /sum stong lnga brgya dang brgyad cu pa me mo yos (spyi lo 1447)la ba po shis lhun po byon/ 'debs mkhan thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyis lo nga bdun lon pa'i tshe'o 'di 'bras yul bas lo gnyis snga tsam mo/ /sum stong lnga brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo sbrul (spyi lo 1449)la 'brabang ku' / skyed tshal byon/ de bas brgya dang bcu drug 'debs mkhan byams chen rab 'byams pas so dgu lon pa'i tshe'o/ /sum stong lnga brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa drug pa sa mo bya (spyi lo 1453)la mdogaya ga sna khri sding byon/ de nas ba/ spyang bcu gnyis/ 'debs mkhan mkhas

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()btsun dpal ldan bzang po/ sum stong drug brgya das nyag gcig 'das pa'i gnyis pa sa mo glang (spyi lo 1469 )la dpal shākya mchog ldan zhe gnyis lon pa'i tshe thub bstan gser mdog can du bshad pa'i grwa btsugs/ sa glang de nas shing byi bar la dgu bcu rtsa drug sum stong drug brgya dang lnga ru sleb pa chu pho 'brug (spyi lo 1472)la mdog lu phu rdzong lugs kyi sngags dgon byon/ de nasago gsum/ sgrub chen chos rin gyis lnga bcu rtsa gnyis lon tshe btab/ sum stong drug brgya dang nyag drug tu sleb pa chu mo sprul yi lo 147shel/ kun mkhyen go bo rab byams pas zhe lnga lon pa'i tshe thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i bshad grwa btab/ de nas go gnyis/ sum stong drug brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo bya (spyi lo145)la thub bltan mnyan mthod bya bakhilko pas dpal 'bum phrag gsum pas lnga bcu rtsa bdun lon tshe btab/ de nas bdun cu rtsa drug lon pa nas/ zugabastan yangs chen de nas lo bzhi sa byi lor btab/ sum stong drug brgya so lnga pa chu pho khyi (spyi lo 1502)lo sgyi chu rdzong lugs kyi sngags dgon byon/ de nas drug cu rtsa gsum/ 'debs mkhan byams pa dkon mchog dpal/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i steng du btab/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir khro phu byams chen zhesagrags pa ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du byon pa'i shing pho khyi lo nas mgo brtsamasate / sum stong sum brgya zhe bzhi 'das pa'i bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ chu pho sprel(spyi lo1212)lor/ paṇa chen de nyid kyis gtso byas te rab tu gnas pa'i me tog gtor/ khro lo byams pa dpal lo zhe gcig lon pa'i tshe yin/ me tog 'thor ba'i chu pho sprel lo nas/ sum brgya lnga /sdu rtsa gsum lon pa ni da lta'i shing pho bya

ba na rtsis gsal ba'i nyid byed lhag bas mar bdakar zhes byab bzhugs ngo // lo 'di yin no/ /rab gnas mkhan po paṇa chen gyi drug cu rtsa brgyad yin/ sum stong lnga brgya dang drug cu rtsa drug 'das pa'i/ rtsa bdun pa shing pho stag (spyi lo1434)la dpa ldong ma rings byams chen byon/ de nas brgya dang so gciga'adebs mkhan chos rgyal dkon mchog legs pa/ mkhan po ā nan+da ma ti dang /seng ge dpal rin pa gnyis kyi ngo la sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog gis bkod pa gnang nas btab/ de'i tshe sems dpa' chen po gzhen nu ba lnga bcu yin/ ā nan+da pas drug cu re gsum lon/ sum stong drug brgya 'das nas lhag gcig gi steng du slebs pa sa pho byi (spyi lo 1468)lo rin sbung bas byamasachen byon/ de nas dgu bcu rtsa bdun/ 'di'i zhal bkod kyang sems dpa' chen po bas gnang zer bas/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa drug pa'i lo yin no/ /de ltar kho bo'i bstan rtsis 'di ni/ shing pho byi ba (spyi lo 1564)nas brtsams/ me pho stag (spyi lo157)la rdzogs par grub pa yin mod/ 'di yan chad 'das lo nas du song sogs rtsis pa ni/ shing byi yan chad gzhir bzhag pa yin la/ rdzogs par grub pa'i me pho stag 'di ni/ 'das lo sum stong drug brgya dgu cu rtsa dgur slebs pa'i lo de yin pas/ sngar rtsis pa'i steng du lo gnyis bsnan te me stag yan la gsal bar shes par gyis shigade ltar bstan brtsis lhag bsam rab dkar zhes bya ba bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa la yid ches pa'i rnam thar lo rgyus dang sbyar te/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa spyi bye brag la gus pa bskyed pa'i phyir 'dren pa dam pa rnam gsum gyi zhabs rdul gtsug gi4 4/chod pas/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa spyi

ba chen 'od snang la /sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()bye brag la so sor ma 'dres pa'i rnam dpyod kyi spobs pa/ gzu bor gnas pa'i chos bzhin rjes su 'brang bas/ so so la ma dad pa'i rnyog pa'i dri ma bsal ba shākya'i dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa mang du thos pa klu sgrub ces bya bas/ ston pa chos dbyings su bzhugs nas sum stong brgya phrag drug dang dgu bcu rtsa dgu pa bdun brgyar gcig gis ma chog pa me stag (spyi lo 157)gi sa ga zla ba'i dus bzang po la/ dpal ya ga chos sdings kyi mdun sa chen por sbyar ba 'dis kyang /bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom gsum dang /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas phyogs mtha' dag tu dar zhing rgyas la kun ring du gnas par gyur cig de ltar rang gis sug ris su bgyis pa las/ slad kyi 'das lo sum stong bdun brgya nyi shu pa/(spyi lo 1587)thams cad 'dul zhes pa me mo phag gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la 'dar chos 'khor yang rtse'i sngags grwa slob bshad gling gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o/ khri1 lha stu sarba dza ga haṃ//402

༄tsho/ /tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /su snyi pra dza ṣ+ṭhaX gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas ma rig pa'i/ /mun pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus nyer bsal te/ /rig pa'i gnas la blo gros mchog stsol ba'i/ /klu sgrub rgya mtsho snying nas dran no skyongs/ /tshul gnas gser gyi yol go rnam dpyod kyi/ /'od snang rmongs mun 'joms la dpa' ba dang / lhan cig brtson 'grus lhag bsam rgyan bkra ba'i/ /mdza' bshes legs bshad mo mchog sbyin 'dir dgyes rol/ /zhes bsngags brjod sngon du song nas/ 'dir rang cag gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal pos gdul bar bya ba'i bstan pa 'di la ni thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bla na med pa thob par 'dod pa'i blo gsal dag gis bslab par bya ba'i gnas ni rig pa'i gnas lnga po 'di nyid yin te/mdo drin lan gsab pa las/ de bsan bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir du rig pa'i dngos po lnga la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga/ zhes sogs dang / bdag nyid chen po sa paṇ+ḍita sa/rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' bas ring / /de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang mkhas rnams kyis/ shes bya'i 403

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gces bsdus/()gnas rnams spyong zhes legs par gsungs/ /zhes dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po sgra pa shes rin pas/ rig pa'i gnas lngar legs par ma sbyangs na/ /dgra bcom gyis kyang kun mkhyen thob mi srid/ /de bas don gnyis mthar phyin bya ba'i phyir/ /kun mkhyen lam 'dir mkhas rnams brtson par rigs/ /zhesadang / 'dren pa dam pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ lnga rig chos la ma sbyangs zag med kyi/ /bdud rtsi thob pa'i rgyal ba 'ga' yang med/ /rig gnas che chung shes bya'i gnas rnams la/ /blo gros rtsal du thon cig grogs po dag /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sgra rig pa/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ gso ba rig pa / nang rig pa ste lnga po la legs par bslab dgos pa yin no/ /'o na de lnga la slob pa las dgos pa ji lta bu snyam na/ tha snyad tshig gi cha la legs par sbyangs pas/ de nyid mkhas pa shes pa na/ tshig gi cha la log rtog zhugs pa thams cad tshar gcod par byed pa dang / mngon gyur sogs don gyi cha la legs par sbyangs pas de tshul bzhin du shes na don la log rtog zhugs pa thams cad sun 'byin nus pas/ rig gnas dang po gnyis shes na rgol ba ngan pa gzhan dag tshar gcod pa dang / bzo gnas sku gzugs kyi cha tshad dang / gser 'gyur gyi rtsi la sogs pa shes pas skye bo 'byor pa can dang / dbul phongs rnams kyi don byed cing / gso ba rig pa'i gnas tshul bzhin du shes pas sems can nad pa sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa rnams rjes su bzung ba'i phyir rig gnas bar pa gnyis dang / rang nyid kun shes mkhas pa'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob par bya ba'i phyir rig gnas lnga la legs par bslab dgos pa yin te/ gzhan dag tshar gcod 404

tha snang rig gan lnga'i lta ra byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad snar bu'i phreng ba/rjes su gzung phyir dang/ /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir zhes gsungs pas so/ /byams mgon gyi gzhung 'di nyid la rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po 'gyur med bde chen gyi bzhed pas/ 'phags mchog gis kyang zhes pa ni cung zad mi 'thad de/'phags mchog rnams kyis rig gnas la sbyang mi dgos shing gzhung 'di'i dod du yang / ka ta rnyi zhes pa cis kyang gi skad dod yod pa yin gyis/ gis kyang zhes pa'i skad dod kyang med pa'i phyir/ des na gzhung gi 'bru gnyer ba'i tshe 'khor du gnas pa'i 'phags mchog rnams kha la 'phags mchog ces bos nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par byed na cis kyang rig gnas lnga la sbyang dgos zhes gsungs/ thams cad mkhyen pa mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i bzhed —pa sa/ de lta bu'i dgos pa ni rang gi blo tshod du/ 'phags pa mchog gis rig gnas la sbyang mi dgos so snyam pa shar ba'i tshod dpag las yin mod/ 'dir skabs kyi 'phags pa ni byang sems 'phags pa rnams yin pas/ de rnams sa yongs sbyongs kyi skabs su shes bya'i gnas thams cad la slob dgos par bshad yod pas/ 'phags pa dman pa nyan rang las ches mchog tu gyur pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sar gnas rnams kyis kyang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i phyir du rig pa'i gnas lnga la slob dgos na/ so skye'i blo gsar rnams kyis rig gnas la slob dgos pa lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes pa'i don yin gsungs te / bla na med pa'i bshad tshul yin no/ /byams pa'i gzhung 'di nyid kyis rig gnas lnga'i go rim dang / thog mar gang nas 'jug gi rim pa yang log smra tshar gcod pa'i yan lag gnyis thog mar bstan/ don gnyer rjes su 'dzin pa'i 405

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()yan lag bar du bstan/ nang rig pa rjes su ston par mdzad pa las tshad mar ci yang ma mdzad par/ rig gnas kun shes las/ rig gnas dang po don gnyer rjes 'dzin te/ /bstan pa gnas phyir dkon mchog gsum gyi rten/ /bzhengs par 'dod pa'i 'byor ldan lhag bsam can/ /rgyal bas bstan 'dzin nyid du lung bstan zhing / /zhes bya ba la sogs pas bzo rig rig gnas dang por mdzad pa ni cung zad mi 'thad par mngon no/ /de ltar rig gnas lnga las kyang thog mar sgra rig pa la slob dgos te/brjod bya'i don rtogs pa ni rjod byed kyi tshig la rag las shing / de'i tha snyad rtogs pa yang sgra rig pa la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du yang slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi nus/ /dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs na/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhesagasungs pa ltar ro/ /rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na/ don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs pa'i thabs su tha snyad sgra rig pa'i gzhung lugs la legs par slob dgos pa yin no/ /ji ltar slob pa'i tshul la yang gnyis te/ sgra rig pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / ji ltar byung ba'i sgra rig pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la lnga/rgyal bas gsungs tshul/ rgyal sras kyis mdzad tshul/ lha yul du byung tshul/ rgya gar du dar tshul/ bod du 'gyur tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mkhas pa'i dbang po sgra pa shes rin pas rig gnas kun shes las/ gsum pas tshig la 'khrul pa sel ba'i phyir/ /de la log par smra ba tshar gcod byed/ /sgra rig de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa ni/ /nges tshig so so yang dag rig pa yi/ /yi 406

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blogs la mgrin rgyan legs bshad rmar bu'i phreng ba/ge dbri dang bsnan dang bsgyur ba dang/ /tshig gi rnam dbye sogs kyi rnam 'gyur ro / khyad nga ra rnga bo che yi mdo las ni/ /byings dang ming dang kun bshad nyer bsgyur dang / /krita dang de phan gyis bsdus sgrub pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab las 'byung gsal bar gsungs/ /zhes ga sdo pabs pas/ yang dag par rdzo gas pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs tshul ston pa yin te/ de la spyir nges don par rlom pa rtsing por gzu lum du spyod cing / tha snyad kyi bden pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa dag na re/ sgra rig pa'i gzhung lugs ni/ rig pa'i gnas thun mong ba tsam yin zhing / lhag par phyi rol pa'i drang srong dag gis bshad pa la gtso bor brten pa yin gyi/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rnamasalas gsal bar mi 'byung zhing / bslab par bya ba'i gnas kyang ma yin no snyam du sems shing / de skad tshig tu yang smra bar byed do/ /'di ni 'thad pa ma yin te/gal te khyod kyi 'dod pa gzhir bzhag na thun mong ba'i rig gnas dang / lam la slob tu mi rung zhes par song la/ de lta na khyed rang gi lag len dang dngos su 'gal ba ste/ khyed rang yang tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom zhing / de'i nang nasaphyi rol pa dang thun mong ba'i chos med par khas len dgos shing / khyad par sdo/ba mtha' bye brag smra ba nas bzung ste/ dbu ma pa'i bar gyi zhi lhag gi nyams len dang / bya rgyud nas bla med kyi bar gyi zhi lhag gi nyams len spyir bshad pa rnams dang / lhag par snying po'i bcud phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'i tshe/ lhag mthong gi rten gzhir gyur pa'i zhi gnas shig bsgom mam mi bsgom/ bsgom na ni phyi rol pa dang thun mong ba'i nyams len khyed rang yang byed bzhin par ma song 407

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ngam/ legs par soms shig gal te de la kho na re/ zhi gnas tsam sgom yang lhag mthong dang byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i khyad par yod do zhe na/ kho bo cag kyang de skad smra ba yin te/ sgra rig tsam thun mong yin kyang / lhag bsam byang chub kyi sems dang / gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i gnas dang / thos don snying por dril lugs kyi khyad par shin tu che ba yin no/ /yang sangs rgyas kyi gsung las mi 'byung snyam pa yang khyed rang thos pa chung ba'i skyon te/ spyir chosadang / don dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / spobs pa so so yang dag pa ste bzhi'i gsum pa nges pa'i tshig 'chad pa'i tshe/ yul ljongs kyi skad dang nges tshig mtha' dag sogs skad rigs spyir slob tshul dang / khyad par saṃ khyu ta la yi ge dbri ba dang / bsnan pa dang / bsgyur ba dang / tshig thams cad ka lā pa ltar si sogasati sogs dang / tsan+d+ra pa ltar snye dang ting gi mtha' can khyad par 'khor lo tha ma'i mdor gtogs pa rnga bo ches mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung las sangs rgyas rtag pa dang bdag la sogs pa med pas de dag ni phyis 'ga' zhig gis rang bzor byas pa'o zhes smra bar 'gyur yang / de lta min te/ de dag de'i gsung las rgyas par 'byung tshul gsungs shing / de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la skad kyi byings la sogs pa med pas/ de dag phyis 'ga' zhig gis rang bzor byas so zhes smra bar 'gyur yang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la byings la sogs pa yod par gsungs shing / gzhan yang sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'da' tshul ston yang / don la thar pa'am myang 'das ni rtag brtan ther zug yin pas skye 'jig med pa'i dpe khang bzangs bzhig kyang de'i nam 408

tha snyad rig gan lnga'i ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad snar bu'i rlung ba/mkha' mi 'jig pa dang / de dper byas na 〉〉 zhes bya ba'i skad kyi byings kyi don ni tsho zhes bya ba'i rkyen gyis de grub pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rkyen du 'gyur te/ ji ltar 'jig rten pa'i bstan bcos rnams las/ nā mā khyu ta u pa sa rga krita tad dhi ta zhes bya ba la sogs pa bsdus pa'i grub pa'i tshig de la grub pa zhes bya'o/ /grub pa'i tshig de'i grub pa gang yin pa de ni yang mi mngon pa med do zhes byings rkyen gyis bsgyur yang / byings kyi rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba ni thar pa'i dper gsung zhing / sgrub tshul de dag ston pa'i gzhung ni/ nā ma zhes pa'i ming le dang / ā khyu ta kun bshad/ krita ces pa spo ta kyi le'u ste sgra'i lus gzhud tshan gsum du bsdus shing / de dag gi rnam 'gyur dang nyer mkho sna u pa sa rga nye bsgyur dang / tad dhi ta de phan la sogs pa'i gzhung ngo / /de yang de tu bstan bcos la ste bkra shis pa'o/ /zhes pa'i byings bzhag de la las la k+ta'o zhes pas k+ta'i rkyen sbyin/ byings mtha'i u dang / rkyen gyi ka rjes 'brel yin pas phyis/ gha dzha lha dha bha rnams kyi dha min pa'i ta tha dag la dha 'o zhes pas dha ru bsgyur/ byings kyi dang po ge'i sa'o zhes pas ṣa sa ru bsgyur/ dhu ṭa rnams kyi gsum pa'o zhes pa'i mdos dha yig da ru bsgyur/ ming tshig tu sgrub pa la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i am byin pas/ grub pa zhes pa grub pa la 'jug pa'i grub pa'i tshig go /de bzhin sdu de bzhin gshegs pa'i skad kyi byings ni mkhas shing khong du chud pa'o gsungs te/ budhe khong du chud pa'i rtogs pa'i la'o/ /zhes pa'i byings las sgrub ces gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir dang / khyad par sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams su gzungs sngags kyi rigs phal cher ba zhig legs par sbyar ba 409

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()dang mtshungs par gsungs pas/ legs sbyar ma shes na de dag klog pa dang /'chad pa'i thabs mi shes pas thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son par 'dod pa'i blo gsal dag gis brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs la 'bad pa chen pos brtson par bya'o zhes snying nas gdams so/ /gnyis pa rgyal sras kyis mdzad tshul ni/ kun shes las/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gis/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbyangs gsal la brten pa'i/ /yi ge'i bsdu ba mdzad pa'i sgra yi mdo/ /yod par dbyangs 'char mdor bsdus thog mar gsal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs kyis gsungs pa'i sgra mdo yang yod pa yin te/ dus 'khor dbyangs 'char gyi mdor bsdus thog mar/ dbyangs dag gi dang po a yig yin pa de ni/ a sogs lnga ste/a i re u '-i zhes rang byung gi bshad pa'o//a i u ṇa ṛ '-i ka zhes pa ni so sor bsdu ba gzung phyir ro/ /e o zhes bklag pa las mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ste/ e yig dang o yig dag gi yon tan gyis so/ /ṛ kṛ a ṇa las ri la dag go /zhes pa'i mdo'i phyir/ ṛ '-i dag ni ma snang du mi 'gyur te/ de gnyis kyang yon tan dang ldan pas e yig la sogs pa rnams dang khyad med do/ /zhes sogs nas de dag kyang nam mkha' la sogs rang bzhin gyi dbang gis grangs bzhin du 'jam dpal gyis/ rang gi brda sprod pa las bris so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa lha yul du byung tshul ni/ kun shes las/ tshangs pa rtag zhi bsabyas pa yang yod/ /brgya byin gyis byas in+d+ra byā gar/ /de la drang srong phur bus 410

tha snyad rig gnas snga ji ltar byung tshupa gas la bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad chor bu'i phreng ba/legs sbyangs pas/ /shin tu mkhas pa'i nga rgyal mchog tu gyur/ /nga rgyal brgya byin gyis bcom zhus nas ni/ /lha phran blo gsal mang la 'chad 'phro bzhag /da dgung rang nyid sgra la sbyong bar zhus/ /nyan 'chad gnyis ka gyis zhes bkas bskul bas/ /dus bzang brgyad la gzhan la mi ston par/ /rang nyid bslab pa'i sbyor la brtson pa sa na//nyan po gzhan gyis dus bzang bsrung dgos shar//zhes gsungs te/ 'di dag gi lo rgyus rgyas par ni spyi don du gsal zhing / sarba dz+nyā zhes pa'i sgra mkhan zhig gis lha'i dbang po la bslabs zhes pa'i sarba dz+nyā ni zhang po'i ming yin la/ 'di dag ni phyi rol pas mchod pa'i lha yin zhing / des bshad pa'i sgra rig rnams kyang phyi rol pa'i lugs yin mod/ gang zag dang bstan bcos de dag ngan par ni mi blta ste/ tshangs pa la sogs pa de dag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul du mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa las gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ mdo de nyid las/ bskal pa bzang po 'di 'das pa'i sngon bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa na/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i cha byad kyis mi 'dul bar/ phyi rol pa'i lha'i gzugs dang rtags dang mtshan mas 'dul bar mkhyen nas/ lha thams cad mkhyen pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs te/ tshangs pa phrag pa nas byung /dbang phyug dpral ba nas byung / nyi ma spyan g.yas pa nas byung / zla ba spyan g.yon pa nas byung/ chu lha lto ba nas byung / dbyangs can ma zhal gyi lce rtse las 411

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa 'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()phyung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /bzhi pa rgya gar du dar tshul la gsum ste/ pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa byung tshul/tsan+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa byung tshul/ ka lu pa byā ka ra ṇa byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ kun shes las/ de bzhin bram ze pā ṇi ni yis kyang / /rang ming ldan pa'i bstan bcos chen po sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bram ze pā ṇi ni byung tshul spyi don du gsal zhing / spyir 'phags pa'i yul du grags pa'i sgra mdo ka tsan gnyis su ma 'dus pa dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇa ka wā pa'i mdo shin tu rgyas pa zhig paṇ+ḍi ta rā dza shrīs ka tsan gnyis kyi don bsdus pa rwa dza shrī byā ka ra ṇa zhes bya ba dang / rje btsun mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i chos 'byung las/ rgyal po tsan+da skyong gi grogs po bram ze in+d+ra sgyu ba zhes bya bas lha'i dbang po bsgrubs nas sgra'i nges gnas zhus te / des bshad pa bris pa in+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa zhes grags pa sna lo ka nyis(khri lnga stong yod pa 'di la lhas bstan pa'i ban sprod pa zhes zer ro gsungs pas/in+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa'i bshad rgyun yang rgya gar na yod par gsal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/kun shes las/ de la tsan+d+ra go mis bsdus pa yi/ /gzhung la tsan+d+ra par grags chos 'bangs kyis/ /byas pa'i 'grel pa dang bcas bod du 'gyur/ /zhes slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i tsan+d+ra pa char gtogs dang bcas pa byung tshul ston pa ste/ de yang lo rgyus yongs grags rnams spyi don na gsal zhing /der cung mi gsal ba rje btsun mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i chos 'byung du gsal ba ni / slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis ni shar phyogs wa ra spror 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig mu stegs rgyang 'phen pa'i ston pa zhig ri 12

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/dang rtsod par gyur te/ de'i ring lugs sun phyung yang rig pa ni blos rnam par brtags pa yin pas/ gang blo sgrims pa de rgyal bar zad kyis/ skye ba snga phyi yod pa'i rtags mngon sum du med pas/ kho bo cag de mi 'dod zer ba na/ rgyal po la sogs pa dbang por bzhag ste/ nga nyid skye ba len pa yin pas dpral bar rtags thob cig byas nas des dpral bar mtshal gyi thig le shar thim pa zhig byas/ kha nang du mu tig bcug ste/ de nyid du 'das te de'i lus zangs kha sbyar gyi nang du bcug ste rgyal pos rgyas btab bo/ /de'i tshe rgyal rigs kyi paṇ+ḍita bi sha sa kha zhes bya ba'i bur skye ba blangs pa bzhin/ de la khye'u mtshan dang ldan pa zhig btsas ma thag tu/ mtshal gyi thig le dpral bar yod pa kha na mu tig yod pa de byung / rgyal po sogs kyis sngar gyi phung po de la bltas pas/ dpral ba'i mtshal gyi thig le yang byi/ mu tig gi shul har re 'dug go /der mu stegs de yang skye ba snga phyi yod par yid ches skad/ khye'u des ma la btsas ma thag tu phyag byas te/ zla ba bcu 'o brgyal bar ma gyur tam byas pas/ byis pa btsas ma thag smra ba ni ltasang na no snyam nas kha rog 'dug byas so/ /de nas lo bdun gyi bar cang ma smras pas lhugs pa'o snyam mo/ /der mu stegs kyi rgol ba zhig gis/shin tu go dka' ba'i snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' 'gog pa zhig brtsams nas rgyal po dang mkhas pa'i tshogs la 'grims so / / der bi sha sa kha'i khyim du byung ba na/ de yun ring du brtags pas sgra don ji bzhin go ba yang med na lan gdab par ga la nus te/ don de sems shing khyim gyi phyi rol tu bya ba zhig la song ngo / /de tsan+d+ra go mi lo bdun lon pa des 413

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gtses bsdus /()bltas pa na/ don shes shing lan gdab par dka' ba med de/ de'i don 'grol ba'i yig chung btab/ lan gyi tshigs bcad kyang bris so/ /pha nang du 'ong ba na de ltar bris pa mthong nas/ khyim du su byung zhes tsan+d+ra go mi'i ma la dris so/ /gzhan su yang ma 'ongs te bu skugs pa blta zhing bri'o/ /der phas bu la dris pa na ma'i gdong la blta zhing 'dug go /mas spros shig byas pas/ 'di ni bdag gis bris pa yin te/ rgol ba 'di ldog pa ni dka' ba ma yin no zhes zer/ de nas nangs par zhig na tsan+d+ra go mi dang / mu stegs kyi ston pa de rtsod pas tsan+d+ra go mi rgyal te bya dga' chen po thob/ de nas sgra dang rtog ge la sogs pa'i rig gnas thun mong ba thams cad ma bslabs par rang shes shig byung ste/ phyogs thams cad du grags pas khyab bo/ /de nas theg pa chen po'i slob dpon zhig la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gnas lnga blangs/ slob dpon chen po blo gros brtan pa la mdo sde dang mngon pa'i sde sdod nan cher lan cig nyan pa tsam gyis mkhyen/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon mya ngan med pa zhes bya ba la bka' lung nod de rig sngags bsgrubs pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang / sgrol ma'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ shin tu mkhas pa chen por gyur/ de nas shar phyogs su rgyal po bha ra ṣa yul du sman dpyad dang sdeb sbyor dang bzo'i gnas kyi ston pa mang du byas/ khyad par du sgra rig pa mang du bshad cing yod/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i bu mo ta rā zhes bya ba bag mar blangs shing rgyal pos yul 'khor zhig kyang sbyin/ lan cig de'i g.yog mos ta rā zhes 'bod kyin 'dug pas/ yi dam dang mtshan mthun pa khyim thab tu mi rung ngo snyam nas/ slob dpon nyid yul gzhan du 414

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blogs la mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phre bab/'gro ba rgyal pos shes te/ de nga'i bu mo dang lhan cig mi 'dug na sgrom du chug la gaṅgā la skyur cig ces bsgos te de bzhin du byas pa na/ slob dpon gyis sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkha' dang rgya mtsho phrad mtshams kyi gling zhig la thon/ gling de 'phags mas sprul pa yin yang zer te/ tsan+d+ra dī pa zhes bya ba tsan+d+ra go mi nyid der bzhugs pa la ming chags shing da lta yang yod/ grong bdun stong tsam shong ba zhig 'dug zer/ der slob dpon gyis bzhugs te 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma'i rdo sku bzhengs/ thog mar nya pa rnams kyis gtam de thos/ de nas rim gyis skye bo gzhan yang byung ste grong khyer chags/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bskul bas go mi'i dge bsnyen mdzad/ mtshan de ltar grags/ de nas tshong pa rnams kyis khyer te sid+ma'i gling du byon/ yul de na klu nad mang du 'byung ba zhig yod pa las der seng ge sgra'i lha khang bzhengs pas rang zhi/ sman dpyad dang rig gnas rgya cher spel/ gling phran gyi skye bo rnams la phan btags/ theg chen ci rigs bshad/ yul bdag gnod sbyin las nor blangs te chos gzhi mang du btsugs/ slar 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho phyogs kyi brgyud du byon/ bram ze mchog srid kyi lha khang na/ klu la sgra nyan pa'i bkod pa dang / klu she khris byas pa'i pā ṇi pa'i 'grel pa 'dug pa yang gzigs pas/ 'grel pa zhes bya ba tshig nyung la don mang ba/ ma zlos pa tshang ba zhig dgos pa yin pa la/ klu ni rab tu rmongs te tshig mang ba/ don nyung ba/ zlos pa/ma rdzogs pa'o/ /zhes smad nas pā ṇi'i don 'grel du tsan+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa yan lag brgyad dang bcas pa bcas mdzad/ gzhung der nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag 415

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()rdzogs/ /zhes pa yang klu la zur za ba'o/ /de nas rig pa'i 'byung gnas nā le rgyur byon/ de nas zla grags dang rtsod pa mdzad pa'i tshul rnams phal cher spyi don bzhin la/ tsan+d+ra go mis thogs med kyi srol la brten te rnam rig gi phyogasabazung / zla grags kyis klu sgrub kyi gzhung sangs rgyas bskyangs sogs kyis bkral ba la brten te ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyogs bzung / lo gsum gyi bar du bgro gleng gi brgal brtag mdzad do/ /rtsod pa de blta ba'i phyir skye bo mang po rtag tu 'dus pas/ grong pa'i khye'u dang bu mo tshun chad kyis kyang phyogs tsam rig nas/kye ma 'phags pa lnga/ sgrub gzhung / /la la'i sman la la la'i dug /mi pham 'phags pa thogs med gzhung / /skye bo kun gyi bdud rtsi nyid/ /ces glur len no / / de nas nā len+t+ra ra bzhugs nas/ bzo gnas brgya rtsa/ sgra/ rtog ge sman dpyad/ sdeb sbyor/ zlos gar/ mngon brjod/ snyan ngag skar rtsis la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mang du brtsams/ slob ma rnams la de rnams gtso bor bshad pa'i tshe/ 'phags ma sgrol mas/ sa bcu pa dang zla ba sgron me dang / /sdong po rgyan pa dang ni laṅka 'jug /rgyal ba rnams kyi yul gyur klogs shig kye/ /sdeb sbyor ngan g.yo'i sbyor bas khyed la ci/ /zhes gsungs pas phyi rol gyi rig pa'i gnasarnams nyung ngur bstan cing / med du byung ba'i mdo lnga po de dag dus rtag tu gsungs/ bdag nyid kyang nyin rer zhal 'don mdzad/ mdo de rnams la bsdusadon re yang mdzad/ spyir snga phyir mdzad pa la bstod pa brgya dang brgyad/ nang rig pa'i bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad phyi rol gyi bstan bcos brgya dang brgyad bzo gnas brgya dang brgyad de phra mo thor bu ba bzhi brgya dang sum cu rtsa gnyis 416

tha snyad rig gan lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad snar bu'i zeng ba/brtsams zer/ pra ti ma ta mi zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos byang chub sems dpa'i lam rim mtha' dag ston pa zhig kyang mdzad de ches ma dar/ 'gro lding dang si sgo'i gling na de 'chad pa'i srol da lta'ang 'dug gsung / sdom pa nyi shu pa dang zla ba sgron me'i 'grel pa dang / sku gsum la 'jug pa ni/ theg chen gyi paṇ+ḍita phyis byon pa thams cad kyis slob par byed pa byung ngo / /sgrol ma'i sgrub thabasabargya rtsa dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa zhes slob dpon 'disamadzad pa bod du 'gyur bar snang ngo / khyad par tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi/sho lo ka bdun brgya yod pa pā ṇi dang mthun pa nyung ngu rnam gsal/ de'i yan lag tu yi ge'i mdo dang / u ṇa de'i mdo dang / ting sub kyi 'grel pa/ nye bsgyur gyi 'grel pa rnams mdzad/ de ltar sems can —gyi don yun ring du mdzad nas/ mthar po ta lar gshegs par bzhed de/ 'dzam bu'i gling nas dha na shrī'i gling du byon pa na/ sngon klu she ṣa la smad pas 'khon du bzung nas rgya mtsho'i rlabs chen pos gru gzings gzhig par brtsams/ rgya mtsho'i dbus nas sgra byung nas tsan+d+ra go mi phyir phyung zhig zer/ sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ 'phagasam gtso 'khor lnga nam mkha' lding la chibs pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon nas klu rnams 'jigs shing skrag nas bros/ gru dha na shrī ra bde bar slebs/ der dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten la mchod cing / sgrol ma'i lha khang brgya rtsa dang/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang brgya rtsa bzhengs/ ri bo po ta lar gshegs nas da lta yang lus ma spangs par bzhugs yod/ slob ma la springs pa'i 'phrin yig ni/ rgyal po'i bu rin chen grags pa zhes bya ba rab tu 417

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()byung ba phab pa zhig la po ta la nas tshong pa rnams la bskur bas/ de yang slob springs mthong nas chos bzhin spyod par gyur to zhes grags so/ /zhes 'byung /tsa/ paX yan lag tu 'grel bshad sogs don 'grel ji ltar byung ba ni spyi don ba na nag/su/ma pa ni/ kun shes las/ dbang phyug go chas gzhon nu gdong drag bsgrubs/ /grub nas tshar gcig bstan pas tshig don rtogs/ /cha bsags da lā pa yi mdo zhes bya/ /rang sde'i mkhas pa bgrod dka' seng ge yis/ /sbyar ba'i 'grel pa dur sing zhes bya dang / /gzhan sde jo bo grags 'byor gyis sbyar ba'i/ /slob phan zhes pa'i 'grel pa bod du byon/ /zhes gsungs pa ste/ lo rgyus rags rim spyi don ltar dang / der mi gsal ba'i lo rgyus jo bo mchog gi sprul nga 'i sku'i chos 'byung dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyi grogs po slob dpon bram ze mchog sred ces bya ba rgyal po bde byed kyi mdun na 'don du gnas so/ /de'i tshe rgyal po'i btsun mo tha chung zhig gi sgra'i gnas cung zad shes la rgyal pos ni mi shes so/ /skyed mos tshal du chu la rtse ba'i tshe/ rgyal pos de la chu gtor bas/des ma mo da ka piñtsa zhes bod skad du bdag la chu ma 'thor zhes pa'o/ /rgyal pos lho phyogs kyi yul skad dang sbyar bas/ bal sran gyi 'khur ba til mar gyis btsos pa byin cig ces par go nas de byin pas/ btsun mo des rgyal po ba lang lta bu dang lhan cig tu gnas nga las shi ba sla'o snyam nas/ lceb par brtsams pa las/ rgyal pos bzung nas sgra slob par byas te/ bram ze mchog sred la legs par bslabs so/ /'on kyang cung zad ma rdzogs pa las slob dpon sag warma 418

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blogs la mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/las blangs pa yin no/ /de la slob dpon mchog sred kyi lo rgyus ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mngon par dad pa'i bram ze las drug la brtson pa/'phags pa klu sgrub na len+t+ra'i shar phyogs ra ra'i yul na yod pa las/ des lo bcu gnyis su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sngags bzlas shing / mthar gser 'bum phrag bzhi'i yo byad sbyin sreg tu phul bas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal mngon sum du bstan nas/ khyod ci 'dod gsung ba la/ bdag grub pa chen po brgyad kyis sems can gyi don bya bar 'dod pas nag po chen po mngag gzhug tu 'tshal zhus pas de bzhin du gnang nas/ deng phyin chad du rig sngags thams cad ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du grub cing / ri lu la sogs pa grub pa brgyad po stong phrag res sems can rnams la phan btags so/ /grub pa thob pa stong phrag brgyad po de dag kyang khong la bla mar 'dzin/ rig pa mtha' dag kyang ma bslabs par rang shes so/ /de nas nub phyogs kyi yul du song nas rgyal po sa ni wa da na zhes bya ba longs spyod chen po dang ldan pa'i yul du gnas so / / der yang sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor bas sems can la phan 'dogs shing gnas pa las/ wā ra ṇa srir 'ongs pa'i tshe/ bar skabs der byung ba'i rgyal po bi ma shu la zhes bya ba'i yul du'ang sems can gyi don rgya chen po byas te/ skabs der ka sī dwa sa'i lo rgyus sbyar/ de nas lho phyogs su phyin/ rgyal po bde byed sgra slob par 'dod pa la/ sgra pā ṇi yongs su rdzogs par shes pa'i slob dpon ma rnyed nas/ klu'i rgyal po she ṣa zhes bya ba pā ṇi pa yongs su rdzogs pa shes pa zhig yod par shes nas/ bram ze mchog sred kyi rig sngags kyi mthus bkug nas blo 419

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ka 'bum gyi pā ṇi pa'i don thams cad rgya cher 'grel nus par 'chad par byas shing / slob dpon gyi yi ger 'bri ba las/ de gnyis kyi bar du yol bas chod par byas so/ /sgro ka stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga song ba na/ de'i lus ni ci 'dra snyam slob dpon gyis yol ba btegs nas bltas pas/ sbrul chen po 'gying ba mthong / klu yang ngo tsha nas bros so/ /de man chad du slob dpon nyid kyis 'grel pa byas te/ de la ni tshigs su bcad pa stong phrag bcu gnyis kyi tshad las med do / / de gnyis bsdoms pa la klus bstan pa'i brda sprod pa zhes grags/ der sgra la sogs pa'i rig pa'i gnas rnams kyang mang du bstan/ mthar nag po chen pos phrag pa la thogs te/ ri rab kyi rtse mo yongs 'du sa brtol gyi gnas su gshegs so/ /zhes grags so/ /der rgyal po bde byed slob dpon mchog sred kyis byas pa'i 'grel pa la yid ma ches par/ bram ze sa sta wa me gzhen nu gdong drug bsgrub tu bcug go khu1ba nas khyod ci 'dod zer ba la/ in+d+ra byā ka ra ṇa shes par 'tshal lo byas pas/ sirnyo waṇi sa ma nā ya/ zhes brjod pa tsam gyisasgra'i don mtha' dag shes so/ /sngar bod du grags pa'i lo rgyus ltar na/ ka wā pa'i kun bshad bzhi pa yan chad gzhen nu gdong drug gis bshad cing / ka wā pa zhes pa cha bsags kyi don rma bya'i mjug sgro kha dog sna tshogs pa bsags pa'i don du 'chad mod/ 'dir ni de ltar ma grags te/ ka lu pa ni sa lta warma nyid kyis brtsams la cha bsags kyi don ni nye bar mkho ba'i cha shas mtha' dag bsags pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /de bzhin du slob dpon 'di'i ming la dbang phyug go cha zhes bya ba yin cing / sarba wa me zhes pa yang yig nor brgyud 420

tha snyad rig gnas lnga'i ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blogs la mgyin rgyan legs bshad snor bu'i phreng ba/pa ste/ sa sta warma bdun pa'i go cha yin no/ /kā da sa'i lo rgyus ni/ wā ra ṇa sri'i rgyal po bi ma shukla'i mchod gnas su bram ze mchog sred yod pa'i tshe/ rgyal po'i bu mo dpyid ldan ma zhes bya ba bram ze mchog sred la sbyin par byas pa las/dpyid ldan ma nga rgyal gyis dregs pas mchog sred las kho mo mkhas pa'i phyir g.yog mo mi byed do zhes byas so/ /der mchog sred kyis 'di rdzun gyis bslu bar bya'o snyam nas/ 'o na bdag gi slob dpon mkhas pa/ bdag las blo grosabargya 'gyur gyis che ba zhig yod pas de spyan drangs la/ de la rgyal pos dpyid ldan ma stsol cig ces byas nas/ ma ga dha'i gnag rdzi gzugs bzang ba zhig shing gi yal ga'i rtse mo la gnas te/ yal ga'i rtsa ba la ste'u bsnun par byed par mthong nas/ shin tu blun par shes te/ de bos nas zhag 'gar khrus dang bku mnye phun sum tshogs par byas/ bram ze paṇ+ḍita'i cha byad du bcos/ oṃ su sti zhes bya ba gcig pu bslabs te/ rgyal po skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas bzhugs pa'i dbus su/ rgyal po la me tog gtor te/ oṃ su ste zhes bya ba 'di brjod cig gzhan su zhig gis dris kyang lan 'debs par ma byed cig ces bsgos te de ltar byed rgyu la/ de ngag rtab ste rgyal po la me tog gtor nas/ u sha ra ṭa zhes zer ro/ /der slob dpon gyis yi ge bzhi po de dag gi don bkrol te / u ma ya sa hi to ru tra/ shaṅka ra sa ni twa bi ṭam ka ra shrī la pā ṇisma rak+ṣa skyo shi ba sarba ta zhes pa'i don te/ shis pa brjod pa yin zhes kha bsgyur ro/ /tshig de bod skad du bsgyur na/ u ma dang bcas drag po dang / /bde byed dang bcas 'jug sel te/ /ṭaṃ tshul phyag na mdung thung yang / /zhi bas rtag tu 421

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya ri chos 'byung gtses bsdus/()bsrung bar mdzod/ /ces so/ /de nas dpyid ldan mas sgra'i don la sogs pa dris kyang cang mi smra la/mchog sred kyis bdag gi slob dpon mkhas pa 'di bud med kyis dris pa la lan ci la 'debs/ zhes rmongs par byas nas/ bram ze mchog sred lho phyogs su bros so/ /de nas lha khang rnams su khrid kyang cang mi smra'o/ /mthar lha khang gi phyi khyams su srog chags sna tshogs pa'i gzugs bris pa la/ ba lang gi gzugs brnyan mthong ba dang dga' ste/ phyugs skyong ba'i rnam 'gyur byed do/ /de nas kye ma ho 'di ni ba lang rdzi'o zhes te bslus par shes so/ /blo dang ldan na sgra bslab par bya'o zhes brtags pas skye bo shin tu blo rtul bar byung ste/ dpyid ldan mas kyang sdang por byas shing / nyin re bzhin me tog 'thu ru btang ngo / /ma ga dha'i phyogs gcig na lha mo nag mo'i sku lha'i bzo bos byas pa zhig yod de/ nyin re bzhin de la me tog mang du phul nas phyag btsal te gus pas gsol ba btab pas dus nam zhig na/ dpyid ldan ma lha la mchod pa'i dus shig la/ des tho rangs me tog 'thu ru song ba'i tshe dpyid ldan ma'i g.yog mo zhig kyal ma'i don du go la mur bzhin du lha mo nag mo'i rten gyi rgyab tu yib cing 'dug go /phyugs rdzi des sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ g.yog mo des go la mur 'phro lag tu gtad pas/ 'di ni lha mos dngos grub tu gnang ba yin no snyam du sems shing yid ches so/ /de nyid blo gros thogs pa med pas rtog ge dang / brda sprod pa dang / snyan ngag smra ba chen por gyur te/ lag pa g.yas su pad+ma'i me tog dang / g.yon du ut+pal zhig thogs te/ pad+ma ni me tog bzang yang yu ba rtsub/422

tha snyad rig gnas/ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/ut+pal ni me tog chung yang yu ba 'jam pa gang zhig 'dod/ ces pa'i don la/ bdag gi lag pa g.yas na pad+ma dang //g.yon na de bzhin ut+pala'i me tog /'jam pa'i yu ba'am rtsub pa'i yu ba can/ /gang 'dod long zhig pad+ma'i mig can ma / / zhes brjod pas mkhas par song ba shes te bkur sti chen po byas/ des lha mo nag mo la shin tu gus par byas pas/ kā li da sa ste nag mo'i 'bangs sam nag mo'i khol por grags/ dus de cam na snyan ngag mkhan mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bur gyur/ sprin gyi pho nya la sogs pa pho nya brgyad dang / gzhon nu 'byung ba la sogs pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos che ba yang mang du brtsams/'di dang sag warma gnyis ka grub mtha' ri phyi rol pa zhig go /zhes 'byung ngo / /lnga pa bod du 'gyur tshul bshad pa la gsum ste/ thu mi sam bho ṭa'i dus su brda sprod pa'i dbu brnyes tshul/ ska cog dang rin chen bzang pos srol btod tshul/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa dang / shong dpang yab sras kyi skabs su dar zhing rgyas tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rje btsun sprul pa'i lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po'i gsung las/ bod yul dbus kyi rgyal po mchog /gnam ri srong btsan yan chad la/ /bod la yi ge med ces grags/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /mkhan po thu mi sam bho ṭa/ /la tsā'i yi ge dper mdzad nas/ /dbyangs yig i tha e nyes bzhi/ /gsal byed ka sogs sum cu mdzad/ /de las rjes su 'jug pa bcu/ /de las kyang ni sngon 'jug lnga/ /ra la sa yi mgo gsum dang / /ya ra la yi smad 'dogs gsum/ /da dang sa yi yang 'jug sogs/ /ston pa'i bstan bcos rnam brgyad mdzad/ /bka' srol de nyid la brten nas/ /423

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'gung gtses bsdus/()lo paṇa skyes mchog du ma yis/ /rgya gar rgya nag kha che dang / /li dang bal po'i yul sogs nas/ /thub pa'i gsung rab sna tshogs bsgyur/ /brda yang mi 'dra sna tshogs bsgyur/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bod yul mun pa'i gling 'dir brjod pa sna tshogs kyi skad gdangs yod kyang / rjod byed kyi yi ge med pas/ gsung rab dang / lugs brgya'i gtsug lag bzang po'i srol lam med pa ni/ dper na skyes bu blo dang ldan yang smra ba'i lce med pa dang tshul mtshungs par gyur pa'i tshe/ de dag thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung bar bzhed nas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid mi'i gzugs kyi rnam par rol pa mkhan po thu mi sam bho ṭa zhes bya ba chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su byung bar gyur te/ de yang thu mi a nu'i bu thu mi sam bho ṭa zhes bya ba rgya gar du brdzangs paṇ+ḍi ta lha rig pa'i seng ge dang/ yig mkhan bram ze li byin la sogs pa la yi ge dang brda sprod pa'i tshul legs par bslabs/ mkhas par mkhyen/ bod du byon nas/ lha sa'i pho brang dgu mkhar mar bod la nye bar mkho ba'i gzugs 'chos par mdzad/ de yang rgya gar gyi phyi mo lnga bcu la/ bod du phyi mo sum cur byas/ dbyangs bcu drug las i u e tse( bzhi rnams dbyangs su mdzad/ a gsal byed du bsdus/gsal byed las kyang ṭa'i sde pa dor/ sde pa gzhan bzhi'i yang / bzhi pa rnamasadang ṣa rnams mi dgos par gzigs nas bzhag tsa tsha dza rnams rgya gar shar phyogs pa 'ga' zhig ca cha ja zhes te de gsum bkod/ rgya gar la med kyang bod la zha za 'a rnams dgos par dgongs te btsud/ de dag la nye bar mkho ba'i yan lag tu brda sprod pa'i gzhung tshan pa brgyad tsam mdzad par grags na'ang /424

tha snyad rig gnas lnga'i ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis phal cher nub nas mi snang la/ sum cu pa dang rtags kyi 'jug pa gnyis ni ding sang du yang mkhas pa dpyod ldan thams cad kyis tshad grub tu mdzad cing / rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs ltar rtogs dka' zhing / rtogs na gzhung don phun sum tshogs la gsung rab spyi la 'jug na yang gsal byed kyi mig lta bur gyur pa zhig ste/ de yang gzhud 'di nyid kyi yi ge'i rnam gzhag dang 'jug tshul sogs bod kyi skad gsung rab dang sbyor tshul rang tshugs thub par bshad cing / brda sprod pa'i gzhung lugs chen po rnams dang sbyar na/ sum cu pa ni ka lā pa'i ming le dang bshad tshul mtshungs shing /rtags 'jug ni kun bshad kyi brjod don dang 'brel ba yin no/ /de ltar bstan bcos dang yi ge de dag rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos kyang slob tshul yun ring du bstan/ thu mis thog mar mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa dang / mdo sde dkon mchog sprin sogs bsgyur/ gzhan yang bod kyi slob dpon dharma ko ṣa sogs blo gsal mang po la bshad pas/ bstan pa rin po che'i srol legs par tshugs/ rab byung gi grwa med kyang rgyal pos spyan ras gzigs kyi chos skor mang du gsungs shing / de dag gi sgom grwa legs par btsugs pas/ thar pa bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob pa yang mang du byung ba yin no/ /de ltar bstan bcos 'di nyid dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos phyis su byung ba yang / bdag nyid chen po bsod nams rtse mo'i byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇ+ḍita sa de'i 'grel pa dang / sgra'i bstan bcos mkhas pa'i kha rgyan/ dbus pa blo gsal gyi sum rtags kyi 'grel pa/ sgra pa sa thi shrī'i sum cu pa'i 'grel pa/425

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()dme pa'i sum rtags kyi 'grel pa/ don 'grel yi ge'i brda dag ston pa la lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis nyer mkho bsngas pa/ dbus pa blo gsal gyi phrad kyi gnad bsdus pa'i 'grel chung / snye thang wa grags seng gi gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ gtsang nag phug pa thugs rje seng ge'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ stag tshang gzhen nu dpal gyi 'od zer brgya pa/ bu ston seng ge 'od kyi sgra don rgya mtsho'i me long / rje byams pa gling pa'i smra ba'i rgyan/ bsam sdings pa kun bzang gi 'khrul pa spong ba/ rje btsun zha lu lo chen gyi za ma tog bkod pa/ dpal khang lo tsā ba'i ngag gi sgron ma/ge'i cad dzi pa klu sgrub rgya mtshos slob ma la phan pa la sogs pa mang du yad ga nyi/ / /ska/ cog dang rin t+ma bzang pos srol btod tshur ni/ zha lu lo chen gyis/ /chos rgyal ral nga can gyi dus/ /ska cog zhad gsum ma/khas mang gis/ /rgyal po'i bkas bskul gsar bcad kyi/ /skad kyis brda sbyar gtan la phab/ /slad nas rin chen bzang po dang / /blo ldan shes rab la sogs pa/ /mkhas mchog rnams kyis de la brten/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bar skabs su lo tsā ba chen po ska cog zhang gsum dang / rin chen bzang po/ blo ldan shes rab la sogs pa rnams kyis tshul 'di'i srol ches cher bstod par mdzad pa yin te/de yang rgyal po khri ral pa can gyi dus su rgyal blon rnams kyi bkas bskul te/sngon lha sras yab kyi ring la mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ ye shes dbang po/ zhang rgyal nyen nyi bzang / blon po khri sher sang shrī/ lo tsā ba dz+nyā de wa ko ga lce khyi 'brusabram ze a nan+da la sogs pas 'gyur mdzad pa rnams la chos kyi skad bod la ma 426

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed blo rgas la mgrin rgyar legs bshad snor bu'i phreng ba/grags pa mang dag cig byung zhis / rgya dkar nag dang / li dang / za hor la sogs pa yul sna tshogs nas bsgyur pas yul de dag gi brda mi 'dra ba mang pos chos slob dka' bar gzigs nas nyi 'og gi mkhas pa ā tsar+ya dzi na mi tra dang / su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / shrī len+da bo dhi dang / dwa na shī la dang / bod kyi mkhan po rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang / dharma shi la dang / lo tsā ba mkhas par tshud pa ska ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ dz+nyā na se na ste zhang ye shes sde dang / dza ya rak+ṣi ta dang / ma shrī warma dang / ra nan+ta shī la la sogs pas theg pa che chung las byung ba'i chos rgya gar skad las bod kyi skad du bsgyur zhing / ming du btags pa rnams dkar chag tu bris nas nam du yang gzhung lugs de ga las mi bsgyur zhing / kun gyis slob tu rung bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal pa la brten nas/sngar bsgyur ba rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ bkas bcad rnam pa gsum mdzad de/ skad dod so so dang bsgyur tshul yig char bkod/ sde pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba las gzhan dang / gsang sngags rnams rgyal blon lo paṇa dang bcas pa mthun grub 'a bsgyur )na ma gtogs/ lkog tu mi bsgyur bar bkas bcad/ tha na bre dang sras zho la sogs pa yang rgya gar dang mthun par bcos/ de thams cad lo paṇa rgyal blon dang bcas pa'i phyag rgyas btab/dkar chag tu bkod de/ bod 'bangs thams cad la de dag las mi 'da' bar dril bsgrags pa yin no/ /ji skad du yang sgra sbyor bam gnyis las/ rta'i lo la btsan po khri lde srong btsan pho brang 'on cang rdo na bzhugs/ stod smad kyi dmag rje dang rkun chen btul/ gar log gi pho nyas phyag btsal/ blon chen zhang khri zur 427

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa sbya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()ram shags dang / blon ma rje lha mdo la sogs pas bya las gnang mang po bcad de / rnga rta dang ba mar phal mo che phyag tu phul/ shad blon man chad so sor bya dga' stsal ba'i lan la/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsar+ya dzi na mi tra dang / su renan+dabo dhi dang / shī len+d+ra bo dhi dang / dā na shī la dang / bo dhi mi tra dang / bod kyi mkhan po rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang dharma ta shi dang / lo tsā ba mkhas par tshud pa dz+nyā na se na dang/mañdzu shrī warma dang / ra zhes shi la sogs pas/ theg pa che chung gi chos las byung ba'i rgya gar gyi skad las bod kyi skad du bsgyur zhing ming du btags pa rnams dkar chag tu bris te/ nam du yang gzhung lugs de las mi 'gyur zhing / kun gyis slob tu rung bar gyis shig ces bka' stsal nas sngon lha sras yab kyi ring la ā tsar+ya bo dhi satwa dang / ye shes dbang po dang / zhang rgyal nyen nyi bzang dang /blon po khri sher sang shī dang / lo tsā ba snyi de ba ko ṣa dang/ lce khyi 'brug dang /bram ze a nan+da la sogs pas chos kyi skad bod la ma grags pa las ming du btags pa dag ci mchis pa'i nang nas/ kha cig chos kyi gzhung dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi mthun te/ mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams kyang bcos/ skad kyi ming gces so 'tshal gyis bsnan nas theg pa che chung gi gzhung las ji skad 'byung ba dang / gna'i mkhan po chen po nā ga rdzun dang / bha su bskyo la sogs pas ji ltar bshad pa dang / byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs las ji skad du/ 'dren pa dang yang bstun te mjal dka' ba rnams kyang tshig so sor bkral nas gtan tshigs kyis bshad de gzhung du bris/ skad rkyang pa bshad mi 'tshal ba sgra ji bzhin du bsgyur ba'i rigs pa rnams kyang sgra btsan par bgyis te ming du btags/ skad 428

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/kha cig don bzhin du gdags pa'i rigs pa rnams kyang don btsan par bgyis te ming du btags te/ btsan po'i spyan sngar brnye chen po yon tan dang / brnye chen po ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'ang 'tshogs te/ rje blon gdan 'dzoms pa la zhus te/ dharma bsgyur ba'i thabs dang / rgya gar gyi skad las bod kyi skad du ming gdags pa'i rnam gzhag bkas bcad de gtan la phab/ dam pa'i chos bsgyur ba'i lugs ni sgra dang mthun la/ don dang yang mi 'gal la/ bod skad las kyang gar bde bar gyis shig dharma bsgyur ba la rgya gar gyi skad go rim las mi nor bar bod kyi skad du bsgyur ba don dang tshig tu 'brel zhing / bde na ma bsnor bar sgyur cig bsnor na bde zhing go ba bskyed pa zhig yod na/ tshigs bcad la ni rtsa ba bzhi pa'am drug pa'ang rung ste/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig gi nang gang bde bar bsnor zhing sgyur cig rkyang pa la ni don gar stegs pa yan chad kyi tshig dang don gnyis ka la gang bde bar bsdor nas sgyur cig skad gcig la ming du ma 'dren pa ste/ lhag 'og dang bstun la gang snyegs pa bzhin du ming thogs shig go ta ma lta bu go'i sgra las/ tshig dang / phyogs dang / sa dang / 'od dang / rdo rje dang / ba lang dang / mtho ris la sogs pa rnam pa du mar snyegs pa dang / ko'u shi ka lta bu /ku sha thogs pa dang / mkhas pa dang pad ma la dga' ba la/ 'ug pa dang mdzod ldan la sogs pa sgra'i lugs las drangs shing bsgyur na / rnam grangs mang po zhig tu stegs la/ bsgyur ba rnam pa gcig gi nang du ni/rnam grangs de kun 'du yang mi btub ste/ gcig tu chad par bya gtan tshigs chen po med pa rnams ni mi bsgyur bar/ rgya gar gyi skad so na zhog cig gar 429

brtse chen 'od snang las/ sa skya'i chos 'byujug ces bsdus/(྅/yang drang du rung ba'i tshig byung na/ phyogs gcig tu 'chad par mi bsgyur bar/spyir stegs su rung bar gyis shig yul dang sems can dang / me tog dang rtsi shing la sogs pa'i ming bsgyur ba mi go zhing tshig mi bde ba dang / 'ol cir bsgyur du rung yang don du de ltar yin nam min gtol med pa rnams ni mgo la yul zhes sam/ me tog ces bya ba gang la bya ba'i ming zhig bla thabs su bsnon la / rgya gar gyi skad so na zhog cig grangs la rgya gar gyi skad bzhin du bsgyur na / dge slong brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum zhes 'byung ba la sogs pa ni/ stong nyis brgya lnga bcu zhes tha mal par bod kyi lugs bzhin du bsgyur na don dang yang mi 'gal la/ bod kyi skad la yang bde bas grangs bsdom du rung ba rnams bod kyi lugs bzhin du thogs shig sa ri dang / sam dang / u pa lta bu la sogs pa tshig gi phrad dang rgyan lta bur 'byung ba rnams bsgyur na/ don dang mthun zhing 'byor ba'i thabs ni/ yongs su zhe'am/ yang dag pa zhe'am/ nye ba zhes sgra ji bzhin du sgyur cig don lhag par snyegs pa med pa rnams ni tshig gi lhad kyis bsnan mi dgos kyi don bzhin du thogs shig rnam grangs su gtogasapa'i tshig rnams ni ma 'doms na ming gang bod skad du phyir gdags shing tshig tu gang bde bar gdags so/ /'doms na so sor btags pa bzhin du thogs shig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos la sogs pa la zhe sa dang /ko long gi tshig gi rim pa ni/ sangs rgyas la zhes sa'i tshig tu bsgyur/ gzhan ma tshig 'bring po yan chad tsam du bya ste sngon lha sras yab kyi spyan sngar mkhan po dang lo tsā ba mkhas pa tshogs pas/ dharma dkon mchog sprin dang / 'phags pa laṅkar 430

tha snyad rig ba sa lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bzhad snar bu'i phreng ba/gshegs pa bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'i lugs bzhin du sgyur cig skad kyi lugs 'di ltar bkas bcad pa las so sor nas su 'chos shing 'og tu ming gsar du 'dogs su mi gnang gi bsgyur ba dang 'chad pa'i grwa so so nas skad gsar du ming gdags dgos pa zhig na/ so so'i grwa sar ming chad pa ma gdags par/ chos kyi gzhung dang / sgra'i lugs las ji ltar 'byung ba'i gtan tshigs dang chos la ji skad du gdags pa spyod de/ pho brang du bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs kyi 'dun sa dang / dharma zhu chen 'tshal ba'i grwar phul la snyan du zhus te bkas bcad nas skad kyi dkar chag gi dkyus su bsnon/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud rnams gzhung gis gsang bar bya ba yin te/ snod du ma gyur pa rnams la bshad cing bstan du yang mi rung la/ bar du bsgyur zhing dpyod du gnang gi kyang /ldem po'i ngag tu bshad pa ma khrol nas/ sgra ji bzhin du 'dzin cing log par sprod pa dag kyang 'byung / sngags rgyud ni nang nas thu zhing bod skad du bsgyur ba dag kyang 'byung / zhes gdags kyi/ phyin chad gzungs sngags dang / bla nasabaka' stsal te bsgyur du mi snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ltar de ltar sngar dar gyi skabs su sgra'i yig cha byung ba ni/ lo tsā ba lce khyi 'brug gis sgra'i gnas brgyad pa rtsa 'grel/ lo tsā ba spyis thun mong du bye brag rtogs byed che 'bring chung gsum/sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa sogs so/ /de dag gi rjes su zhugs nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs su lo tsā ba rnams kyi mchog rin chen bzang po dang / blo ldan shes rab la sogs pas kyang gtso bor lo tsā ba rnams kyi brda chad las ma g.yos shing / cung zad bcos pa gnyi zla la nyi zla dang / bstan chos la bstan bcos431

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa sbya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()dang / stug po la mthug po la sogs pa yod do/ /de ltar brda gsar rnying gi bye —brag rnam par 'byed tshul yang / dbus pa blo gsal gyi bstan bcos thor bu kha re dang / paṇa chen shāka mchog gi brda'i bye brag rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos/ smin drug lo 3 ba'i legs par bshad pa li shi'i gur khang la sogs pa rnams las rtogs par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa dang / shong ston yab sras kyi skabs su dar zhing rgyas tshul bshad pa ni/ kun shes las/ snga ma'i byings mdo yi ge'i mdo 'grel bcas/ /phyi ma'i byings mdo u ṇa 'grel par bcas/ /byings dang kun bshad dpung gnyen si sogs kyi/ /bya ba rgyas pa la sogs mang po dang / /snga ma'i su pya mtha' rin chen 'byung ldan sogs/ /sgra yi yan lag sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung rī/ /snyan ngag me long mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod/ /kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar la sogs pa/ khong dpang yab sras rnams kyis bsgyur zhing bshad/ /sgra dang snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod dang / /zlos gar rnams la rig gnas chung ngu'am/ /tha snyad rig pa'i gnas lngar grags pa rnams//chos rje sa paṇa yan la ma dar zhing / /thar lo yan la sgra mdo 'gyur ba med/ /sgra rig brjod bya spros te bshad na ni/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro 'di dag ni don legs par 'grel pa la sa bcad rnam pa gsum ste/ dang por bka' drin che ba bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa byon tshul/ bar bka' drin che ba shong dpang yab sras byon tshul/ mthar bka' drin che ba zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po byon tshul bshad pa'o//dang po ni/ skye ba du mar sbyangs pa dang / /mkhas pa du ma bsnyen pa 432

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/dang / / rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ shes bya kun la 'jigs med thob ces rang nyid kyi zhal gyis bzhes shing mkhas pa thams cad kyi tshad mar gyur pa/bod du rig gnas rnam pa bcu'i srol gang zag gcig nyid kyi dang por phye ba ni bdag nyid chen po sa paṇ+ḍita kho na ste/ de yang / yab dpal chen 'od po dang /yum nyi khri lcam gyi sras su 'khrungs pa nas bzung ste/ rnam thar rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes shing / 'dir rig gnas kyi tshul legs par gsan pa'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ gog mkhyen tsam gyi dus skye ba snga ma'i bag chags sad pa'i stobs kyis saṃ sla ta'i skad du ma smra ba byung bas/ yum na re/ 'di la rang ga gcig pa yong ba lags sam/ gtam go rgyu med pa'i ngag ngog mang po zer ba zhig gda' zhus pas/ rje pas saṃ : ta'i skad mkhyen pas/ khyod kyi bu la gang yang byung dogs med gsungs/ yang sa la phyag mdzub kyis nā ga ra dang / la tā'i dbyangasagasal bris nas klog tshul mdzad/ mi 'gom par phyag gis byil phyis nas gtong ba byung / thog mar rang gi yab las kye rdor gyi dbang sogs nod/ yi ge'i bye brag du ma dang/ rtsis dang gso dpyad ri mo la sogs pa mthar phyin par bslabs/ rje btsun rin po che la dbang rgyud man ngag sogs gsang sngags yab chos thams cad dang / rig gnas kyi cha shas 'ga' zhig kyang gsan pas tshegs med du thugs su chud/ de nas dge bshes zhu la sogs pa'i bod ston du ma las/ bod la yongs su grags pa'i chos skor thams cad gsan pas thams cad tshar re la thugs su chud/ lhag par rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi drung du lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs zhus pas/ dus de nyid 433

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()du bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gzigs/ chos thams cad skad cig la thugs su chud/ shes bya'i gnas thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob pa yin te / bstod pa mdzad pas kyang /zab mo'i lam gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /'on kyang tha snyad du gnas bcu gsan nas srol phye tshul cung zad brjod na/ thog mar sgra rig pa la/ rje bcun chen po grags pa'i zhabs drung du sgra'i gnas brgyad smra sgo la sogs pa rnams gsan cing / de nas 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan dam par gyur pa/ kha che'i bsod snyoms pa chen po mahā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī la sgra ka tsan snying po bsdu ba la sogs pa'i sgra'i mdo rnams rags rim gsan cing / nub phyogs a ti na war sku 'khrungs pa'i bram ze'i slob dpon chen po su rga ta shrī dpal ldan sa skyar spyan drangs nas lo gnyis kyi bar du ka lha pa rtsa ba dang / de'i 'grel pa stong phrag drug pa dang bcas pa/ming sgrub pa su brnya/ byings sgrub pa ti ngan/ rab tu sgrub pa mtha' dag gsan/paṇ+ḍi ta chen po sa shrī la tsan+d+ra pa/ de'i ming dang byings kyi sgrub pa rnams mtha' chod dang bcas pa gsan nas khong du chud par mdzad de/ de dag gi tshul gsal bar ston pa la/ sgra la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ smra sgo'i don bsdu la sogs pa mdzad nas/ sgra rig pa'i phyogs kyi srol legs par btod pa yin te/ nyid kyi gsung las/ gzhan dag gis ni sngon chad lugs 'byung 'di/ /gangs ri'i ngogs 'dir rgyas par ma mdzad la/ /de na mkhas pa rnams kyang rmongs gyur pas/ /'di la kho bo blo gros gsal phyir dbye/ /zhes gsungs shing / dpal khang lo tsā ba'i bstod par yang / in+d+ra pā ṇi byā dar cha 434

tha snyad rig gnas ji snar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/bsags sogs/ /legs sbyar rgya mtsho de nyid skad cig la/ /gzigs tshe brda byu sprod byed pa sarba dz+nyā/ /skabs gsum bla ma'i stan las babs sam snyam/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du tshad ma rig pa yang bod ston rnams la mang du gsan cing / khyad par kha che paṇa chen la rnam 'grel le'u dang po'i 'grel pa stong phrag phyed dang bzhi pa yan gsan nas bsgyur cing zhus/ slob dpon thar pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i rtog ge'i skad ces pa'i bstan bcos gsan cing bsgyur/ gzhan phyi rol rig byed kyi tshad ma drang srong chen po gzigs zan gyis sbyar ba'i rtog ge'i bstan bcos rig pa zhes bya ba sogs gsan cing / mdor na sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i yan lag thams cad thugs su chud cing / de dag gi don 'brel bar byed pa tshad ma rigs pa'i gter rtsa 'grel gnyis mdzad pa yin cing / nyid kyi gsung las/ shes bya'i mkha' la thogs med rgyu nus shing / /phas rgol nyi zla'i gzi brjid za nus kyang / /rtag tu skye bo kun gyisam mthong ba'i/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i sgra gcan 'dra/ /zhes gsungs shing / bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / tshad ma gsum gyi gnas gsum gzhal bya'i don/ /ma lus rtogs pas sgrub dang sun 'byin gyi/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom tshar gcod par/ /sde bdun mdzad pa'i blo bdun khyod kyi mtshan/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang sdeb sbyor gsan pa'i tshul yang / paṇ+ḍita sa shrī la dmar ser dang rgyal ba'i lhas mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung / khyad par de dag las yon tan brgyad kyis khyad par du 'phags pa slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa'i sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas dang / 'phags pa 435

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()'jam dpal gyi bṛta ma la sogs pa gsan nas legs par khong du chud/ de dag gi don 'grel pa la sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po mdzad de rig gnas 'di'i srol legs par phye ba yin te/ gzhung de nyid du/ sngon chad gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mkhas rnams kyi/ /rna ba'i snod du nye bar ma lhung zhing / /lce yi dbang pos kun nas ma myangs pa/ /ro brgya'i 'byung gnas dpag bsam shing 'di skyed/ /ces gsungs shing / bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / dmar ser rgyal lha'i lugs las khyad par du/ /yon tan brgyad kyis 'phags pa'i sdeb sbyor gzhud / /brit+ta dzā ti'i ngo mtshar rtogs byed la/ /zhi ba'i zhabs dang khyod blo mthun par gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /snyan ngag gi rig pa ni/ rdzi btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan la skyes rabs so bzhi pa dang / gzhen nu ma bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa la sogs pa'i skyes rabs kyi rigs du ma gsan cing / paṇ+ḍita sa shrī la snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po gsum dang chung ngu gsum/ rgyan gyi bstan bcos dbyangs can gyi mgul rgyan stong phrag brgyad pa dpag bsam 'khri shing la sogs pa mtshan nyid dang mtshan gzhi ston pa'i bstan bcos mang du gsan zhing / lhag par daṇ+ḍi'i tshig rgyan la mkhas par bslabs te/ de dag gi brjod don ma lus pa mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgor gtan la phab pas rig gnas 'di nyid kyi srol bla na med pa phye ba yin te/bdag nyid chen po'i gsung las/ 'ga' zhig sgra dang rnam par dbye ba dang /khams dang byed tshig dpe dang tshig gi rgyan/ /dbye bsdu grangs dang go rim nges pa la/ /'di na phal cher rmongs par mthong nas 'dir/ /mang du thos shing mthong 436

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/nas goms pa dang / /man ngag dbang gis dpal ldan kun dga' yi/ /rgyal mtshan 'di na 'ga' tsam 'chad pa la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dga' ba bskyed de nyon/ /zhes gsungs shing / bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / dbyangs can lang tsho zag zad ye shes kyi/ /rtse dgas thugs yid gcugs pa'i seng ge brtsen/ /tshig rgyan bal la gi ste lha'i rol sgras/ /yid bsgyur khams gsum dbugs 'byin snyan ngag mkhan/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du mngon brjod kyi rim pa yang bod du yongs su grags pa'i sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa'i ming gi tshogs mtha' yas pa dang / de dag kyang 'dod rgyal dang / rjes grub 'dra 'brel sogs so sor phye zhing / bkas bcad thog mtha' bar gsum du grags pa ltar/ brda gsar rnying gi bye brag thams cad legs par phyed cing /lhag par mkhas pa chen po dge 'dun dpal las mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos las yi ge re re'i mngon brjod gsan cing bsgyur/ a ma ra ko ṣa dang / sna tshogs gsal ba'i 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsan cing / de dag sde gsum mam bzhir 'dus shing / rtags gsum gyi rnam dbye legs par phyed pa'i sgo nas rig gnas 'di'i srol cher btod pa yin te/ nyid kyi gsung las/ byang phyogs 'di na tshig la mkhas pa med/ /legs par shes nas 'chad pa kho bo tsam/ /rtags kyi dbye ba phal cher 'dir mi 'jug /'on kyang bod la mkho ba tsam zhig bsdu/ /zhes gsungs shing / bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / ting sub mtha' dang rtags kyi rnam dbye sogs/ /so sor ma 'dres sna tshogs mngon brjod dag /'chad mkhas mtha' yas ming la ma rmongs pas/ /'chi med seng ge'i khengs pa 437

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung sa ces bsdu sa/()thung ngur mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin du zlos gar gyi bstan bcos kyang paṇ+ḍi ta sa ṅga shrī las gzugs kyi nyi ma'i bstan bcos dang / bha ra ta la sogs pa gsan cing khong du chud de/ de dag gi tshul phyogs tsam ston pa la rol mo'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba mdzad cing / nyid kyi gsung las kyang / sngon chad gzhan gyi yid la ma shar ba/ /'di 'dra gang gis shes de blo gros ldan/ /rgan po rnams kyis yang yang rnam dpyad pa'i/ /don de rtogs kyang de la ngo mtshar med/ /ces gsungs shing / bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / sngon byung zlos pa'i gar de skad rigs bzhi/ /brda sbyor la byang rgya mtsho'i mtha' la sogs/ /tshar phyin thugs chud zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /sgra skad kun gyis khyod la lung du ston/ /ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin du dus sbyor shes pa yang / rtsis kyi gzhi lo zla dag pa/lnga bsdus/ sgra gcan/ gza' lnga/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin/ du mjug la sogs 'char ba dang / nub pa'i mtha' dang / de dag gi dge legs kyi rtsis dang /dbyangs 'char la sogs pa'i rtsis rnams kyang phul du phyin pa mkhyen cing / de dag rgan po rnams la grags zin pa'i phyir/ srol 'byed kyi bstan bcos ni ma mdzad la/legs par gsungs pa'i brgyud pa'i srol ni mang du yod pa yin no/ /bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / rtsis grangs rig pa kun rdzob rten 'brel che/ /za 'og ltar gzigs srid pa'i ā dar+sha//dkar nag rtsis la byang pa'i rnam rig gi/gtsug lag rgya mtsho ri byi'i khyor chu bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du bzo rig pa yang rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams las legs par sbyangs shing / ri mo dang sku gzugs kyi mtshan nyid dang / cha tshad la sogs pa mdo rgyud kyi lung dang 438

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad snar bu'i phreng ba/mthun par mkhyen cing / zhar byung brtag pa rnam pa brgyad kyang khong du chud/ de dag gi mtshan nyid ston pa'i sku gzugs kyi bstan bcos dang / brtag pa'i bstan bcos sogs yod par gsungs kyang / deng sang dpe rgyun mthong ba ma byung la/de'i phyir nyid kyi gsung las/shes bya'i me tog yon tan dri bsung can//snyan pa'i mdog mdzes kun gyis bsngags na yang / /sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po min pas shes bya'i bcud ma rnyed/ /cesagasungs shing / de bzhin du bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / lus ngag yid dang bzo dang mchog phal gyi/ /gzugs brnyan bskrun la tshad dang 'phrul gyi dbyibs/ /sna tshogs byed po las tshul mtshar sdug gi /tshon brgya 'dren pa dpyod ldan dga' ba'i gnyen/ /zhes sogs so/ /gso ba rig pa mkhyen pa'i tshul yang / spyir phyi ri nang gi gzhud lugs du ma las byung ba rnams dang / khyad par yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po 'grel pa zla zer dang bcas pa thugs su chud cing / de dag gi don legs par ston pa'i bstan bcos yan lag brgyad pa'i bsdus pa zhes bya ba mdzad pa yin te/ ji skad du/ bstod pa mdzad pas/ ma rig rtsa ba bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /'phel zad 'khrug pa'i gnyen po tshe'i rig byed/ /thar pa'i 'tsho srog bsrung ba'i thabs tshul stong //ji bzhin mkhyen pa de 'dra gzhan gyis min//zhes gsungs so/ /nang rig pa ni/ rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams las/ bsam pa'i ra ba las 'das pa zhig gsan zhing / khyad par rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bka' drin gyis/ mdo rgyud thams cad la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad mnga' ba yin pas/ de'i tshul 439

brtse chen 'od snang las/ga skya'i chos 'byung gce bsdus/()rgyas par su zhig gis brjod par nus/ che long tsam brjod na yang mang du dogs pas 'dir rgyas par ma spros la/ dpyod ldan dag gis gzhan du shes par gyis shig de dag gi tshul ston pa'i bstan bcos kyang / gzhung lugs legs bshad/ thub pa dgongs gsal/ sems bskyed chen mo/ sdom gsum rab dbye/ bdag med bstod 'grel la sogs pa ji snyed cig yod pa yin pas bka' 'bum du shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du nyid kyi gsung las kyang / bstan pa'i mjug 'dir bstan la rab gus shing / /bstan pa mtha' dag bsrung zhing 'dzin 'dod pa/ sti kya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang pos bstan la phan phyir 'di sbyar ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / de bzhin du bstod pa mdzad pas kyang / yongs 'du'i tshal du ku snyi da ra dang / /'od ldan tshogs pa'imakha' nang nyin byed ltar/ /mkhas mang 'dus pa'i dbus na thams cad mkhyen/khyod dang mtshungs pa sngon dang phyi mthar su/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na rig gnas rnam pa bcu'i srol legs par phye nas gangs ri'i ljongs kyi blo gsal dag mkhas pa mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su chud cing / rigs pa dang mi rigs pa'i tshul mtha' dag 'byed shes pa ni rje btsun nyid kyi sku drin yin la/de lta bu'i rnam par thar pa gzhan la ston par bzhed nas/ nyid kyi gsung las/sgra pa nga yin rtog ge pa nga smra ba ngan 'joms nga 'dra med/ /sdeb sbyor nga mkhas snyan ngag nga nyid mngon brjod 'chad la 'gran med nga / /dus sbyor ngas shes phyi nang kun rig rnam dpyod blo gros mtshungs med nga / /de 'dra gang yin sa skya pa ste mkhas kha pa gzhan dag gzugs brnyan yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / rang nyid kyi 440

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/'grel pa'i sgo nas kyang gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /gnad des na bod yul gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir theg pa gsum dang rig gnas cha shas tsam gyis 'gyur dang bshad pa mdzad pa ni sngon dus kyang mang du byung mod/ bdag nyid chen po sapaṇa ma byon gong du ni rig gnas rnam pa bcu'i srol cher ma dar la/ dper na nor bu rin po che rdog ma phul du phyin pa yod kyang / de nyid la bug pa phug ste/srad bu brgyu ba'i lam med na lha dang mi rnams kyi mgrin pa'i rgyan du ci yang byed mi nus la/ de nyid la bzo bo mkhas pas rdo rje rin po che ste pha lam gyis bug pa phug zin na dar la sogs pa'i skud pa 'jam pos kyang rin po che rnams phreng bar byas nas mgrin pa'i rgyan du byed nus pa ltar/ bdag nyid chen po'i rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros rdo rje rin po che pha lam gyi zegs mas rig gnas rnam bcu'i nor bu brjod don legs par 'byed pa'i bug pa'i snang bas srol ma phye bar/ lo tsā ba gzhan mkhas par rlom pa'i rig pa srad bu'i tshogs kyis 'dun pa thod pa min na/ bod kyi blo gsal rnams kyi mgrin pa'i rgyan du rngo gar yang thogs pa min la/ de'i phyir bdag nyid chen pos srol btod/ shong dpang yab sras kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad nas/ rig gnas rnam pa bcu'i nor bu'i phreng bas bod kyi blo gsal rnams kyi mgrin pa'i rgyan mdzes par byed pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed ni sa paṇ+ḍi ta yin no/ /zhes pa'i snyan grags 'og min gyi bar du khyab bo zhes ston pa la/bstod pa mdzad pas/bsil sbyor sgeg mo theg gsum bsgyur bshad kyi/ /snang ba ka tsa li ta'i gos bklubs kyang / /gser zhal mngon du ma 'phyar de srid du/ /rig gnas rgyan gyi lang tsho'i gtam yang ci/ /rin thang 441

brtse chen 'od snang las/sa skya'i chos 'byung gces bsdus/()che ba'i nor bu rig gnas bcu/ khyod blo'i rdo rjes yang dag ma phug bar//gzhan rig srad bus 'jug pa thos min na/ /blo gsal mgrin pa'i rgyan du rngo gar thogs/ /de slad 'di na tha snyad shing rta'i srol/ /thog mar 'byed la ston pa gnyis pa zhes/ /gcig tu dkar ba'i snyan grags ā na ka /phyogs kyi mdzes mas brtan g.yo 'jig kyang brdung / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i bka' drin gsab pa dang / rang nyid kyang dam pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir/ rje btsun sa paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung rab la thos bsam sgom gsum zhe thag pa nas gyis shig ces yang yang du snying nas gdams pa yin te/ de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis 'di phyi'i don thams cad 'grub cing bstan pa la phan pa'i thos bsam bgyis pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang yang bde blag tu thob pa'i phyir/ de skad du yang nyid kyi gsung las/ des na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa yi/ /bstan bcos la ni byin rlabs yod/ /'di 'dra nyan bshad byed pa la/ /thos pa zhes ni brjod pa yin/ /de don spyod pa bsam pa yin/ /nan tan gyis ni de sgrub pa/ /sgom pa yin par shes par bya/ /thos bsam sgom gsum de ltar gyis/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /che khas dang / 'di la dga' bas nyan dang sems rnams kyi/ /sems la 'jam pa'i rdo rje rjes zhugs nas/ khyad par tshig gi don la mkhas pa yi/ /ngesapar byin gyis brlab par bdag gis shes/ /zhes gsungs shing zhal gyis bzhes pa lags so/ /gnyis pa bar du sku drin che ba shong dpang yab sras ji ltar byon pa'i tshul ni/ de yang thog mar bdag nyid chen pos srol legs par 442

tha snyad rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung tshul gsal bar byed pa blo gsal mgrin rgyan legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba/btod pa de nyid rgya gar gyi gzhung phal mo che bsgyur ba dang / bshad pa'i rgyun ches cher dar bar mdzad pa po ni shong dpang yab sras rnams yin pas bod la bka' drin shin tu che'o/ /de yang thog mar shong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan ni la stod lto'i dpyad lung shar gyi bong ra zhes par sku gzungs/ gzhon nu la rab tu byung / go yul ba mdo sde dpal rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ dus 'khor chag lugs/ bde kye phreng ba skor gsum sogs mang du gsan cing / gar thig rtsisal mkhas par sbyangs/ gza' gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me sogs rtsis kyi bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ de nas tsha nar srag bde ba'i drung du phar tshad mngon gsum la mkhas par sbyangs/ dus 'khor gyi skor shog sdebs bzhi bcu tsam phyag bris su bris nas yon du phul te/ 'bro lugs kyi dbang rgyud bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ 'phags pa rin po ches snga res sa skyar byon pa na bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa spel legs phul nas lo tsā slob tu 'gro bas rdzong bar zhu zhus pas/ de lta bu'i blo skye ba bzang / re zhig gzhung lugs gsar pa bsgyur ba'i nus pa ma byung yang / paṇ+ḍita la slob gnyer dang dri gtugs legs par gyis shig kho bos kyang chos rje pa brten yun thungs pas/ sdeb sbyor me tog gi chun po dang / tshig gter sogs tshul bzhin mi shes par/ 'di dag shes pa zhig cis kyang gyis shig mkhas par gyur pa'i tshe nged la cho me rje pa'i dgongs pa skong dgos kyi 'gyur 'dra yang dgos pa yod de rjes su byed do gsungs nas/ de dag gi dpe dang gser srang lnga / dar yug bcu rnams gnang byung ste/ rten 'brel yod pas do nub rje btsun gong ma'i gzims khang dpe kha ngo 443
